title: 已棄用的術語
text: 隨著 LlamaIndex 持續演進，許多 class 名稱與 API 已進行調整、優化或棄用。 以下是先前常用的棄用術語清單及其對應的替代方案連結。 GPTSimpleVectorIndex 此名稱已更改為 VectorStoreIndex，並將所有向量索引統一為單一介面。您可以透過修改底層的 vector store 來整合各種向量資料庫。 請參閱以下連結以了解更多使用詳情。 - Index Usage Pattern - Vector Store Guide - Vector Store Integrations GPTVectorStoreIndex 此名稱已更改為 VectorStoreIndex，但僅為名稱上的變更。請參閱以下連結以了解更多使用詳情。 - Index Usage Pattern - Vector Store Guide - Vector Store Integrations LLMPredictor LLMPredictor 物件不再建議使用者直接使用。您可以直接設定 LLM，並將其傳遞至 Settings 或使用 LLM 的介面。LLM class 本身具有與 LLMPredictor 相似的屬性與方法。 - LLMs 位於 LlamaIndex - Setting LLMs 的 Settings 中 PromptHelper and max\ input\ size/ Prompt helper 的 max input size 參數已被 context window 取代。 整體而言，PromptHelper 已被棄用，建議直接在 service context 與 node parser 中指定參數。 請參閱以下連結以了解更多詳情。 - Configuring settings 在 the Settings - Parsing Documents 至 Nodes ServiceContext ServiceContext 物件已被棄用，請改用 Settings 物件。 - Configuring settings 在 Settings 中 llama-index-legacy llama-index-legacy 套件已被棄用並從儲存庫中移除。請參閱最新的入門指南以獲取最新資訊與用法。 - 開始使用 AgentRunner/AgentWorker （及相關類別） AgentRunner 與 AgentWorker class 已被棄用，請改用 AgentWorkflow 與 Workflows。 這包括以下被棄用的 class： - AgentRunner - FunctionCallingAgent - FunctionCallingAgentWorker - llama index.core.agent.ReActAgent (請使用 llama\ index.core.agent.workflow.ReActAgent) - ReActAgentWorker - LATSAgentWorker - CoAAgentWorker - FnAgentWorker - QueryPipelineAgentWorker - MultiModalReActAgentWorker - IntrospectiveAgentWorker - SelfReflectiveAgentWorker - ToolInteractiveReflectionAgentWorker - LLMCompilerAgentWorker - QueryUnderstandAgentWorker QueryPipeline （及相關類別） QueryPipeline 已被棄用，請改用 Workflows。 這包括以下被棄用的 class： - AgentFnComponent - AgentInputComponent - BaseAgentComponent - CustomAgentComponent - ArgPackComponent - FnComponent - FunctionComponent - InputComponent - RouterComponent - SelectorComponent - ToolRunnerComponent - StatefulFnComponent - LoopComponent - 等等。
sourceText: As LlamaIndex continues to evolve, many class names and APIs have been adjusted, improved, and deprecated. The following is a list of previously popular terms that have been deprecated, with links to their replacements. GPTSimpleVectorIndex This has been renamed to VectorStoreIndex, as well as unifying all vector indexes to a single unified interface. You can integrate with various vector databases by modifying the underlying vector store. Please see the following links for more details on usage. - Index Usage Pattern - Vector Store Guide - Vector Store Integrations GPTVectorStoreIndex This has been renamed to VectorStoreIndex, but it is only a cosmetic change. Please see the following links for more details on usage. - Index Usage Pattern - Vector Store Guide - Vector Store Integrations LLMPredictor The LLMPredictor object is no longer intended to be used by users. Instead, you can setup an LLM directly and pass it into the Settings or the interface using the LLM. The LLM class itself has similar attributes and methods as the LLMPredictor. - LLMs in LlamaIndex - Setting LLMs in the Settings PromptHelper and max\ input\ size/ The max input size parameter for the prompt helper has since been replaced with context window. The PromptHelper in general has been deprecated in favour of specifying parameters directly in the service context and node parser. See the following links for more details. - Configuring settings in the Settings - Parsing Documents into Nodes ServiceContext The ServiceContext object has been deprecated in favour of the Settings object. - Configuring settings in the Settings llama-index-legacy The llama-index-legacy package has been deprecated and removed from the repository. Please see the latest getting started guide for the latest information and usage. - Getting Started AgentRunner/AgentWorker (and related classes) The AgentRunner and AgentWorker classes have been deprecated in favour of AgentWorkflow and Workflows. This includes the following deprecated classes: - AgentRunner - FunctionCallingAgent - FunctionCallingAgentWorker - llama index.core.agent.ReActAgent (use llama\ index.core.agent.workflow.ReActAgent) - ReActAgentWorker - LATSAgentWorker - CoAAgentWorker - FnAgentWorker - QueryPipelineAgentWorker - MultiModalReActAgentWorker - IntrospectiveAgentWorker - SelfReflectiveAgentWorker - ToolInteractiveReflectionAgentWorker - LLMCompilerAgentWorker - QueryUnderstandAgentWorker QueryPipeline (and related classes) QueryPipeline has been deprecated in favour of Workflows. This includes the following deprecated classes: - AgentFnComponent - AgentInputComponent - BaseAgentComponent - CustomAgentComponent - ArgPackComponent - FnComponent - FunctionComponent - InputComponent - RouterComponent - SelectorComponent - ToolRunnerComponent - StatefulFnComponent - LoopComponent - etc.

title: Documents 和 Nodes
text: 常見問題 (FAQ) 1. Node 物件的預設 chunk size 是什麼？ 2. 如何在 Document 物件中新增名稱、URL 等資訊？ 3. 如何在 Index 中更新現有的 document？ --- 1. Node 物件的預設 chunk size 是什麼？ 預設值是 1024。如果您想自訂 chunk size，可以參考 Customizing Node。 --- 2. 如何在 Document 物件中新增名稱、URL 等資訊？ 您可以自訂 Document 物件並以 metadata 的形式新增額外資訊。欲了解更多資訊，請參閱 Customize Document。 --- 3. 如何在 Index 中更新現有的 document？ 您可以借助 doc id 來更新/刪除 Index 中的現有 document。您也可以新增新的 document 到現有的 Index 中。欲了解更多資訊，請查閱 Document Management。
sourceText: FAQ 1. What is the default chunk size of a Node object? 2. How to add information like name, url in a Document object? 3. How to update existing document in an Index? --- 1. What is the default chunk size of a Node object? It’s 1024 by default. If you want to customize the chunk size, You can follow Customizing Node --- 2. How to add information like name, url in a Document object? You can customize the Document object and add extra info in the form of metadata. To know more on this follow Customize Document. --- 3. text: 在本指南中，我們將使用 Fleet Context 來下載 LlamaIndex 文件中的 embeddings，並在它之上建立一個混合的 dense/sparse vector retrieval engine。 先決條件 從 Fleet Context 下載 Embeddings 我們將使用 Fleet Context 來下載 LlamaIndex 全部文檔的 embeddings（約 12k chunks，約 100mb 的內容）。您可以透過指定 library 名稱作為參數，下載任何前 1220 個 library 的內容。您可以在頁面底部查看支援的完整 library 清單 此處。 我們這樣做是因為 Fleet 建立了一個 embeddings pipeline，它保留了許多重要的資訊，這將使檢索和生成更佳，包括頁面位置（用於 re-ranking）、chunk type（class/function/attribute/etc）、父級區段等。您可以在他們的 Github page 上閱讀更多相關資訊。 輸出 : 終端機視窗 輸出 : 終端機視窗 為 LlamaIndex 的混合搜尋建立 Pinecone Index 我們將建立一個 Pinecone index，並將我們的 vectors 存入其中，以便我們能夠使用 sparse vectors 和 dense vectors 進行混合檢索。在繼續之前，請確保您擁有一個 Pinecone account。 將 vectors 分批 upsert 到 Pinecone Pinecone 建議一次 upsert 100 個 vectors。我們將在修改資料格式後執行此操作。 在 LlamaIndex 中建立 Pinecone Vector Store 最後，我們將透過 LlamaIndex 建立 Pinecone vector store，並查詢它以獲取結果。 查詢您的 Index！ 輸出 : 終端機視窗
sourceText: In this guide, we will be using Fleet Context to download the embeddings for LlamaIndex’s documentation and build a hybrid dense/sparse vector retrieval engine on top of it. Pre-requisites Download Embeddings from Fleet Context We will be using Fleet Context to download the embeddings for the entirety of LlamaIndex’s documentation (\ 12k chunks, \ 100mb of content). You can download for any of the top 1220 libraries by specifying the library name as a parameter. You can view the full list of supported libraries here at the bottom of the page. We do this because Fleet has built a embeddings pipeline that preserves a lot of important information that will make the retrieval and generation better including position on page (for re-ranking), chunk type (class/function/attribute/etc), the parent section, and more. You can read more about this on their Github page. Output : Terminal window Output : Terminal window Create Pinecone Index for Hybrid Search in LlamaIndex We’re going to create a Pinecone index and upsert our vectors there so that we can do hybrid retrieval with both sparse vectors and dense vectors. Make sure you have a Pinecone account before you proceed. Batch upsert vectors into Pinecone Pinecone recommends upserting 100 vectors at a time. We’re going to do that after we modify the format of the data a bit. Build Pinecone Vector Store in LlamaIndex Finally, we’re going to build the Pinecone vector store via LlamaIndex and query it to get results. Query Your Index! Output : Terminal window

title: 使用 Graphsignal 進行追蹤
text: Graphsignal 為由 AI agents 和 LLM 驅動的應用程式提供可觀察性。它幫助開發人員確保 AI 應用程式按預期運行，並讓使用者獲得最佳體驗。 Graphsignal 自動 追蹤和監控 LlamaIndex。Trace 和 metrics 提供查詢、檢索和 index 操作的執行細節。這些洞察包括 prompts 、 completions 、 embedding statistics 、 retrieved nodes 、 parameters 、 latency 和 exceptions 。 當使用 OpenAI APIs 時，Graphsignal 提供額外的洞察，例如每個部署、模型或任何上下文的 token counts 和 costs 。 安裝與設定 新增 Graphsignal tracer 很簡單，只需安裝並設定即可： Terminal 視窗 您可以在 此處 取得一個 API key。 請參閱 快速入門指南、整合指南 和 example app 以獲取更多資訊。 追蹤其他功能 若要額外追蹤任何 function 或 code，您可以使用 decorator 或 context manager： 請參閱 Python API Reference 以獲取完整說明。 有用的連結 - Tracing 與監控 LlamaIndex Applications - Monitor OpenAI API Latency，Tokens， 速率限制，以及 More - OpenAI API Cost Tracking: 依據以下項目分析費用： 模型、部署與 Context
sourceText: Graphsignal provides observability for AI agents and LLM-powered applications. It helps developers ensure AI applications run as expected and users have the best experience. Graphsignal automatically traces and monitors LlamaIndex. Traces and metrics provide execution details for query, retrieval, and index operations. These insights include prompts , completions , embedding statistics , retrieved nodes , parameters , latency , and exceptions . When OpenAI APIs are used, Graphsignal provides additional insights such as token counts and costs per deployment, model or any context. Installation and Setup Adding Graphsignal tracer is simple, just install and configure it: Terminal window You can get an API key here. See the Quick Start guide, Integration guide, and an example app for more information. text: Guidance 是一種用於控制微軟開發的大型語言模型的指導語言。 Guidance 程式允許您將生成、提示和邏輯控制交織在一個連續的流程中，這與語言模型實際處理文本的方式相符。 結構化輸出 (Structured Output) Guidance 一個特別令人興奮的方面是能夠輸出結構化物件（例如遵循特定 schema 的 JSON，或一個 pydantic 物件）。Guidance 不僅僅是「建議」給 LLM 期望的輸出結構，而是能「強制」LLM 的輸出遵循所需的 schema。這使得 LLM 可以專注於內容而非語法，並完全消除輸出解析問題的可能性。 這對於較弱的 LLMs（參數數量較少，且未在足夠的原始碼資料上訓練，無法可靠地產生格式良好、分層的結構化輸出）尤其有效。 建立一個指導程式來產生 pydantic 物件 在 LlamaIndex 中，我們提供了與 guidance 的初始整合，讓生成結構化輸出（更具體地說是 pydantic 物件）變得非常簡單。 例如，如果我們想生成一組歌曲，具有以下 schema： 只需建立一個 GuidancePydanticProgram，指定我們想要的 pydantic 類別 Album，並提供一個合適的 prompt template。 注意：guidance 使用 handlebars-style 模板，它使用雙大括號進行變數替換，使用單大括號進行字面括號。這是與 Python 格式字串的相反慣例。 從 from llama index.core.prompts.guidance utils import convert to handlebars 轉換 Python 格式字串樣式模板到 guidance handlebars-style 模板。 現在我們可以透過呼叫它並提供額外的使用者輸入來運行該程式。這裡我們來做一些令人毛骨悚然的事情，並創建一個受《輝夜記》啟發的專輯。 我們有我們的 pydantic 物件： 您可以參閱 這個 notebook 以獲取更多詳細資訊。 使用 guidance 提高我們子問題查詢引擎的穩健性。 LlamaIndex 提供了一套進階查詢引擎工具，用於處理不同的使用案例。其中一些依賴中間步驟中的結構化輸出。我們可以利用 guidance 來提高這些查詢引擎的穩健性，確保中間回應具有預期的結構（以便它們可以正確解析為結構化物件）。 例如，我們實作了一個 GuidanceQuestionGenerator，可以插入到 SubQuestionQueryEngine 中，使其比使用預設設定更穩健。 請參閱 這個 notebook 以獲取更多詳細資訊。
sourceText: Guidance is a guidance language for controlling large language models developed by Microsoft. Guidance programs allow you to interleave generation, prompting, and logical control into a single continuous flow matching how the language model actually processes the text. Structured Output One particularly exciting aspect of guidance is the ability to output structured objects (think JSON following a specific schema, or a pydantic object). Instead of just “suggesting” the desired output structure to the LLM, guidance can actually “force” the LLM output to follow the desired schema. This allows the LLM to focus on the content rather than the syntax, and completely eliminate the possibility of output parsing issues. This is particularly powerful for weaker LLMs which be smaller in parameter count, and not trained on sufficient source code data to be able to reliably produce well-formed, hierarchical structured output. Creating a guidance program to generate pydantic objects In LlamaIndex, we provide an initial integration with guidance, to make it super easy for generating structured output (more specifically pydantic objects). For example, if we want to generate an album of songs, with the following schema: It’s as simple as creating a GuidancePydanticProgram, specifying our desired pydantic class Album, and supplying a suitable prompt template. Note: guidance uses handlebars-style templates, which uses double braces for variable substitution, and single braces for literal braces. This is the opposite convention of Python format strings. from llama\ index.core.prompts.guidance\ utils import convert\ to\ handlebars\ that can convert from the Python format string style template to guidance handlebars-style template. Now we can run the program by calling it with additional user input. Here let’s go for something spooky and create an album inspired by the Shining. We have our pydantic object: You can play with this notebook for more details. Using guidance to improve the robustness of our sub-question query engine. LlamaIndex provides a toolkit of advanced query engines for tackling different use-cases. Several rely on structured output in intermediate steps. We can use guidance to improve the robustness of these query engines, by making sure the intermediate response has the expected structure (so that they can be parsed correctly to a structured object). As an example, we implement a GuidanceQuestionGenerator that can be plugged into a SubQuestionQueryEngine` to make it more robust than using the default setting. See this notebook for more details.

title: LM Format Enforcer
text: LM Format Enforcer 是一個強制執行語言模型輸出格式（JSON Schema、Regex 等）的函式庫。它不只是向 LLM「建議」所需的輸出結構，而是能實際「強制」LLM 的輸出遵循指定的 schema。 image LM Format Enforcer 與本地的 LLMs（目前支援 LlamaCPP 和 HuggingfaceLLM backends）配合使用，僅透過處理 LLM 的輸出 logits 來運作。這使其能夠支援 beam search 和 batching 等進階生成方法，不同於其他修改生成迴圈本身的解決方案。請參閱 LM Format Enforcer page 中的比較表以了解更多詳情。 JSON Schema 輸出 在 LlamaIndex 中，我們提供與 LM Format Enforcer 的初始整合，讓生成結構化輸出（更具體地說是 pydantic 物件）變得非常簡單。 例如，如果我們想生成一張歌曲專輯，並使用以下 schema： 只需建立一個 LMFormatEnforcerPydanticProgram，指定我們想要的 pydantic class Album，並提供一個合適的 prompt template。 注意：LMFormatEnforcerPydanticProgram 會自動填入 pydantic class 在 prompt template 的選用 {json schema} 參數中的 json schema。這有助於 LLM 自然地生成正確的 JSON 並降低 format enforcer 的干擾，從而提高輸出品質。 現在我們可以透過呼叫並提供額外的使用者輸入來運行程式。這裡我們來做一些神秘的事情，並創作一張受《驚魂記》啟發的專輯。 我們有我們的 pydantic 物件： 您可以參閱 此 notebook 以獲取更多詳情。 正則表達式輸出 LM Format Enforcer 也支援 regex 輸出。由於 LlamaIndex 中尚無現有的 regular expressions 抽象層，我們將直接使用 LLM，在其中注入 LM Format Generator。 這將會導致 LLM 以我們指定的 regular expression 格式生成輸出。我們也可以解析輸出以獲取命名組： 請參閱 此 notebook 以獲取更多詳情。
sourceText: LM Format Enforcer is a library that enforces the output format (JSON Schema, Regex etc) of a language model. Instead of just “suggesting” the desired output structure to the LLM, LM Format Enforcer can actually “force” the LLM output to follow the desired schema. image LM Format Enforcer works with local LLMs (currently supports LlamaCPP and HuggingfaceLLM backends), and operates only by processing the output logits of the LLM. This enables it to support advanced generation methods like beam search and batching, unlike other solutions that modify the generation loop itself. See the comparison table in the LM Format Enforcer page for more details. JSON Schema Output In LlamaIndex, we provide an initial integration with LM Format Enforcer, to make it super easy for generating structured output (more specifically pydantic objects). For example, if we want to generate an album of songs, with the following schema: It’s as simple as creating a LMFormatEnforcerPydanticProgram, specifying our desired pydantic class Album, and supplying a suitable prompt template. Note: LMFormatEnforcerPydanticProgram automatically fills in the json schema of the pydantic class in the optional {json schema} parameter of the prompt template. This can help the LLM naturally generate the correct JSON and reduce the interference aggression of the format enforcer, increasing output quality. Now we can run the program by calling it with additional user input. Here let’s go for something spooky and create an album inspired by the Shining. We have our pydantic object: You can play with this notebook for more details. Regular Expression Output LM Format Enforcer also supports regex output. Since there is no existing abstraction for regular expressions in LlamaIndex, we will use the LLM directly, after injecting the LM Format Generator in it. This will cause the LLM to generate output in the regular expression format that we specified. We can also parse the output to get the named groups: See this notebook for more details.

title: Tonic Validate
text: 什麼是 Tonic Validate Tonic Validate 是一套協助開發者評估檢索增強生成（RAG）系統效能的工具。您可以用它快速抽查 LlamaIndex 設定的表現，也可以將它整合進現有的 CI/CD 流程，例如 GitHub Actions。Tonic Validate 由兩個部分組成： 1. 開源 SDK 2. 網頁介面（Web UI） 您也可以只使用 SDK，不搭配 Web UI。SDK 已包含評估 RAG 系統所需的工具；Web UI 則提供視覺化介面，讓您更容易掌握系統表現，不必只看原始數字。 若要使用 Web UI，請前往 這裡 註冊免費帳戶。 如何使用 Tonic Validate 設定 Tonic Validate 使用以下指令安裝 Tonic Validate： 使用 Tonic Validate 時需要提供 OpenAI API 金鑰，因為後端會呼叫 LLM 計算分數。將金鑰設為 OPENAI API KEY 環境變數即可。 若要將結果上傳到 UI，請先設定建立帳戶時取得的 Tonic Validate API 金鑰，並確認已註冊 Web UI。尚未註冊的話，請前往 這裡 建立帳戶。取得 API 金鑰後，將它設為 TONIC VALIDATE API KEY 環境變數即可。 單一問題使用範例 以下範例有一個問題及其參考答案，但 LLM 的回答與參考答案不完全一致。檢索結果包含兩段上下文，其中一段提供了正確答案。 答案相似度分數介於 0 到 5，用來衡量 LLM 的回答與參考答案有多相符。此例兩者並非完全一致，因此分數不會是滿分 5 分。 答案一致性分數介於 0.0 到 1.0，用來衡量回答是否包含檢索上下文中沒有的資訊。此例的回答確實出現在檢索到的上下文中，因此分數為 1。 增補準確率表示檢索到的上下文有多少比例出現在回答中。此例有一段檢索內容出現在回答裡，因此分數為 0.5。 增補精確率衡量與回答相關的檢索內容是否納入回答。此例的兩段內容都相關，但只有一段納入回答，因此分數為 0.5。 檢索精確率衡量檢索到的上下文中有多少與問題相關。此例兩段上下文都相關，因此分數為 1.0。 TonicValidateEvaluator 可以一次計算 Tonic Validate 的所有指標。 一次評估多個問題 您也可以使用 TonicValidateEvaluator 一次評估多個查詢與回答，並取得可記錄到 Tonic Validate UI 的 tonic\ validate Run 物件。 請將問題、LLM 回答、檢索到的上下文清單與參考答案分別放入清單，再呼叫 evaluate\ run。 將結果上傳到 UI 若要將評分結果上傳到 UI，可以使用 Tonic Validate API。請先依照設定 Tonic Validate一節的說明設定 TONIC VALIDATE API KEY。您也需要先在 Tonic Validate UI 建立專案並複製專案 ID。API 金鑰與專案都準備好後，就能初始化 Validate API 並上傳結果。 現在可以在 Tonic Validate UI 查看結果了！ Tonic Validate 圖表 端到端範例 接下來示範如何搭配 Llama Index 端到端使用 Tonic Validate。先用 Llama Index CLI 下載要處理的資料集： 終端機視窗 現在建立一個名為 llama.py 的 Python 檔案，並加入以下程式碼。 這段程式會載入資料集檔案，並初始化 Llama Index。 Llama Index CLI 也會下載範例資料集的問答清單，供您用來測試。若要使用這些問答，請執行以下程式碼。 接著向 Llama Index 查詢回答： 接著可以用以下方式計算分數： 若要將評分結果上傳到 UI，可以使用 Tonic Validate API。請先依照設定 Tonic Validate一節的說明設定 TONIC VALIDATE API KEY。您也需要先在 Tonic Validate UI 建立專案並複製專案 ID。API 金鑰與專案都準備好後，就能初始化 Validate API 並上傳結果。 更多文件 除了這裡的文件，也可以參閱 Tonic Validate 的 GitHub 專案頁面，了解如何使用 API 上傳結果。
sourceText: What is Tonic Validate Tonic Validate is a tool for people developing retrieval augmented generation (RAG) systems to evaluate the performance of their system. You can use Tonic Validate for one-off spot checks of your LlamaIndex setup’s performance or you can even use it inside an existing CI/CD system like Github Actions. There are two parts to Tonic Validate 1. The Open-Source SDK 2. The Web UI You can use the SDK without using the Web UI if you prefer. The SDK includes all of the tools needed to evaluate your RAG system. The purpose of the web UI is to provide a layer on top of the SDK for visualizing your results. This allows you to get a better sense of your system’s performance as opposed to viewing only raw numbers. If you want to use the web UI you can go to here to sign up for a free account. How to use Tonic Validate Setting Up Tonic Validate You can install Tonic Validate via the following command To use Tonic Validate, you need to provide an OpenAI key as the score calculations use an LLM on the backend. You can set an OpenAI key via setting the OPENAI API KEY environmental variable to your OpenAI API key. If you are uploading your results to the UI, also make sure to set your Tonic Validate API key you received during the account set up for the web UI. If you have not already set up your account on the web UI you can do so here. Once you have the API Key you can set it via the TONIC VALIDATE API KEY environment variable. One Question Usage Example For this example, we have an example of a question with a reference correct answer that does not match the LLM response answer. There are two retrieved context chunks, of which one of them has the correct answer. The answer similarity score is a score between 0 and 5 that scores how well the LLM answer matches the reference answer. In this case, they do not match perfectly, so the answer similarity score is not a perfect 5. The answer consistency score is between 0.0 and 1.0, and measure whether the answer has information that does not appear in the retrieved context. In this case, the answer does appear in the retrieved context, so the score is 1. Augmentation accuracy measures the percentage of the retrieved context that is in the answer. In this case, one of the retrieved contexts is in the answer, so this score is 0.5. Augmentation precision measures whether the relevant retrieved context makes it into the answer. Both of the retrieved contexts are relevant, but only one makes it into the answer. For that reason, this score is 0.5. Retrieval precision measures the percentage of retrieved context is relevant to answer the question. In this case, both of the retrieved contexts are relevant to answer the question, so the score is 1.0. The TonicValidateEvaluator can calculate all of Tonic Validate’s metrics at once. Evaluating multiple questions at once You can also evaluate more than one query and response at once using TonicValidateEvaluator, and return a tonic\ validate Run object that can be logged to the Tonic Validate UI. To do this, you put the questions, LLM answers, retrieved context lists, and reference answers into lists and call evaluate\ run. Uploading Results to the UI If you want to upload your scores to the UI, then you can use the Tonic Validate API. Before doing so, make sure you have TONIC VALIDATE API KEY set as described in the Setting Up Tonic Validate section. You also need to make sure you have a project created in the Tonic Validate UI and that you have copied the project id. After the API Key and project are set up, you can initialize the Validate API and upload the results. Now you can see your results in the Tonic Validate UI! title: 對 LlamaIndex 使用 UpTrain 進行評估
sourceTitle: Perform Evaluations on LlamaIndex with UpTrain
text: 概述 : 在此範例中，我們將展示如何使用 UpTrain 與 LlamaIndex 配合使用。UpTrain (github website docs) 是一個用於評估和改進 GenAI 應用程式的開源平台。它為 20 多個預先設定的檢查項目（涵蓋語言、程式碼、嵌入使用案例）提供評分，對失敗案例進行根本原因分析，並提供解決問題的見解。有關 UpTrain 評估的更多詳情，請參閱 here。 問題 : 隨著越來越多的公司將 LLM 原型機升級為可投入生產的應用程式，他們的 RAG pipeline 也變得越來越複雜。開發人員正在利用 QueryRewrite、Context ReRank 等模組來提高他們 RAG 系統的準確性。 複雜性的增加帶來了更多的故障點。 1. 需要進階的 Evals 來評估這些新模組的品質，並確定它們是否確實提高了系統的準確性。 2. 需要一個強健的實驗框架，以便系統性地測試不同的模組並做出數據驅動的決策。 解決方案 : UpTrain 幫助解決了這兩方面問題： 1. UpTrain 提供一系列檢查項目，用於評估生成回應、檢索的上下文以及所有中間步驟的品質。相關的檢查項目包括 ContextRelevance、SubQueryCompleteness、ContextReranking、ContextConciseness、FactualAccuracy、ContextUtilization、ResponseCompleteness、ResponseConciseness 等。 2. UpTrain 也允許您實驗不同的 embedding models，並擁有一個 “evaluate\ experiments” 方法來比較不同的 RAG 配置。 如何操作？ 您有兩種方法可以使用 UpTrain 與 LlamaIndex 配合使用： 1. 使用 UpTrain Callback Handler : 此方法允許您無縫整合 UpTrain 與 LlamaIndex。您可以將 UpTrainCallbackHandler 添加到現有的 LlamaIndex pipeline 中，它將會評估您 RAG pipeline 的所有組件。這是推薦的方法，因為它最容易使用，並且只需最少的努力就能提供儀表板和洞察。 2. 使用 UpTrain’s EvalLlamaIndex : 此方法允許您使用 UpTrain 對生成的回應進行評估。您可以使用 EvalLlamaIndex 物件來為查詢生成回應，然後對回應進行評估。您可以在下方找到關於如何操作的詳細教學。此方法提供了對評估更大的靈活性和控制權，但需要更多的努力來設定和使用。 1. 使用 UpTrain Callback Handler Open In Colab 以下三個示範解釋了如何使用 UpTrain Callback Handler 來評估您 RAG pipeline 的不同組件。 1. RAG Query Engine Evaluations : RAG query engine 在檢索上下文和生成回應方面扮演著關鍵角色。為確保其效能和回應品質，我們進行以下評估： - Context Relevance ：判斷檢索到的上下文是否包含回答使用者查詢的足夠資訊。 - Factual Accuracy ：評估 LLM 的回應是否可以透過檢索到的上下文進行驗證。 - Response Completeness ：檢查回應是否包含回答使用者查詢所需的所有資訊。 2. Sub-Question Query Generation Evaluation : SubQuestionQueryGeneration operator 將問題分解為子問題，並使用 RAG query engine 為每個子問題生成回應。為了衡量其準確性，我們使用： - Sub Query Completeness ：確保子問題準確且全面地涵蓋了原始查詢。 3. Re-Ranking Evaluations :重新排序涉及根據與查詢的相關性重新排序 nodes，並選擇最佳的 nodes。根據重新排序後返回的 nodes 數量進行不同的評估。 a. Nodes 數量相同 - Context Reranking ：檢查重新排序後的 nodes 順序是否比原始順序更貼合查詢。 b. Nodes 數量不同： - Context Conciseness ：檢視減少後的 nodes 數量是否仍能提供所有所需資訊。 這些評估共同確保了 RAG 查詢引擎、SubQuestionQueryGeneration operator 以及 LlamaIndex pipeline 中的重新排序過程的穩健性和有效性。 注意： - 我們使用基本的 RAG 查詢引擎進行了評估；也可以使用進階的 RAG 查詢引擎進行相同的評估。 - 重新排序評估也是如此，我們使用 SentenceTransformerRerank 進行了評估，也可以使用其他 re-rankers 進行相同的評估。 安裝依賴項和匯入函式庫 安裝 notebook 依賴項。 終端機視窗 匯入函式庫。 設定 UpTrain 提供以下服務： 1. 具備進階鑽取和篩選選項的儀表板 2. 失敗案例中的洞察和共同主題 3. 生產資料的可觀察性和即時監控 4. 透過與您的 CI/CD pipeline 無縫整合進行的迴歸測試 您可以選擇以下選項來使用 UpTrain 進行評估： 1. UpTrain 的開源軟體 (OSS) ： 您可以使用開源評估服務來評估您的模型。在此情況下，您需要提供一個 OpenAI API 金鑰。您可以在 這裡 取得您的金鑰。 為了在 UpTrain 儀表板中查看您的評估結果，您需要在終端機中執行以下指令進行設定： 終端機視窗 這將在您的本地機器上啟動 UpTrain 儀表板。您可以在 http://localhost:3000/dashboard 存取它。 參數： - key\ type=“openai” - api\ key=“OPENAI\ API\ KEY” - project\ name=“PROJECT\ NAME” 2. UpTrain 的託管服務和儀表板 ： 或者，您可以使用 UpTrain 的託管服務來評估您的模型。您可以 這裡 建立一個免費的 UpTrain 帳戶並獲得免費試用點數。如果您想要更多的試用點數，請 點擊這裡與 UpTrain 的維護者預約通話。 使用託管服務的好處包括： 1. 無需在本地機器上設定 UpTrain 儀表板。 2. 無需他們的 API 金鑰即可存取許多 LLMs。 完成評估後，您可以在 https://dashboard.uptrain.ai/dashboard 的 UpTrain 儀表板中查看結果。 參數： - key\ type=“uptrain” - api\ key=“UPTRAIN\ API\ KEY” - project\ name=“PROJECT\ NAME” 注意： project name 將是 UpTrain 儀表板中顯示所執行評估的專案名稱。 建立 UpTrain 回調處理器 載入和解析 Documents 從 Paul Graham 的文章 “What I Worked On” 中載入 documents。 將 document 解析為 nodes。 1. RAG 查詢引擎評估 UpTrain 回調處理器將自動擷取生成後的查詢、上下文和回應，並對回應執行以下三個評估 (從 0 到 1 評分) ： - Context Relevance ：判斷檢索到的上下文是否包含回答使用者查詢的足夠資訊。 - Factual Accuracy ：評估 LLM 的回應是否可以透過檢索到的上下文進行驗證。 - Response Completeness ：檢查回應是否包含回答使用者查詢所需的所有資訊。 這裡有一個儀表板範例，展示如何過濾和深入探討失敗案例，並獲得關於失敗案例的見解：image-2.png 2. 子問題查詢引擎評估 子問題查詢引擎 用於解決使用多個資料來源回答複雜查詢的問題。它會將複雜查詢分解成每個相關資料來源的子問題，然後收集所有中間回應並合成最終回應。 UpTrain callback handler 在生成後會自動擷取每個子問題及其回應，並對回應執行以下三個評估（評分範圍為 0 到 1）： - Context Relevance ：判斷檢索到的上下文是否包含回答使用者查詢的足夠資訊。 - Factual Accuracy ：評估 LLM 的回應是否可以透過檢索到的上下文進行驗證。 - Response Completeness ：檢查回應是否包含回答使用者查詢所需的所有資訊。 除了上述評估外，callback handler 還會執行以下評估： - Sub Query Completeness ：確保子問題準確且全面地涵蓋了原始查詢。 這裡有一個儀表板範例，以條形圖形式視覺化子問題的得分： image.png 3. 重新排序 (Re-ranking) 重新排序是根據與查詢的相關性重新排序 nodes 的過程。Llamaindex 提供多種重新排序演算法類別。我們在此範例中使用了 LLMRerank。 re-ranker 允許您輸入重新排序後要返回的前 n 個 nodes 的數量。如果此值與原始的 nodes 數量相同，re-ranker 只會重新排序 nodes，而不會改變 nodes 的數量。否則，它會重新排序 nodes 並返回前 n 個 nodes。 我們將根據重新排序後返回的 nodes 數量執行不同的評估。 3a. 重新排序（與相同數量的 nodes） 如果重新排序後返回的 nodes 數量與原始的 nodes 數量相同，則將執行以下評估： - Context Reranking ：檢查重新排序後的 nodes 的順序是否比原始順序更與查詢相關。 3b. 重新排序（與不同數量的 nodes） 如果重新排序後返回的 nodes 數量小於原始的 nodes 數量，則將執行以下評估： - Context Conciseness ：檢視減少後的 nodes 數量是否仍提供所有所需資訊。 UpTrain 的管理服務儀表板與見解 要透過 UpTrain callback handler 使用 UpTrain 的管理服務，唯一需要做的就是設定 key type 和 api key 參數。程式碼的其餘部分保持不變。 這裡有一個簡短的 GIF，展示了您從 UpTrain 管理服務中可以獲得的儀表板和見解： output.gif 2. 使用 UpTrain 的 EvalLlamaIndex Open In Colab 安裝 UpTrain 和 LlamaIndex 終端機視窗 匯入所需函式庫 建立查詢引擎的資料夾 您可以使用任何您擁有的 documents 來完成此操作。對於本教學，我們將使用從 Wikipedia 提取的紐約市資料。我們只會將一個 document 添加到資料夾中，但您可以添加任意多個。 建立查詢清單在我們生成回應之前，我們需要建立一個查詢清單。由於查詢引擎是根據紐約市訓練的，我們將建立與紐約市相關的查詢清單。 此 notebook 使用 OpenAI API 來為提示生成文字以及建立 Vector Store Index。因此，請將 openai.api\ key 設定為您的 OpenAI API key。 使用 LlamaIndex 建立查詢引擎 讓我們使用 LLamaIndex 建立一個 vector store index，然後將其用作查詢引擎，以檢索文件中的相關部分。 設定 UpTrain 提供以下服務： 1. 具有進階鑽取和篩選選項的儀表板 (Dashboards) 2. 失敗案例中的洞察和常見主題 3. 生產資料的可觀察性 (Observability) 和即時監控 4. 透過與您的 CI/CD pipelines 無縫整合進行的迴歸測試 (Regression testing) 您可以從以下兩種替代方案中選擇來使用 UpTrain 進行評估： 替代方案 1：使用 UpTrain 的開源軟體 (OSS) 進行評估 您可以使用開源評估服務來評估您的模型。在此情況下，您需要提供一個 OpenAI API key。您可以在 這裡 取得您的 key。 為了在 UpTrain 儀表板中查看您的評估結果，您需要透過在終端機中執行以下指令來設定： 終端機視窗 這將在您的本地機器上啟動 UpTrain 儀表板。您可以在 http://localhost:3000/dashboard 存取它。 注意： project name 將是 UpTrain 儀表板中顯示評估執行的專案名稱。 建立 EvalLlamaIndex 物件 現在我們已經建立了一個查詢引擎，我們可以利用它來建立一個 EvalLlamaIndex 物件。此物件將用於為查詢生成回應。 執行評估 現在我們有了查詢清單，我們可以利用 EvalLlamaIndex 物件為查詢生成回應，然後對回應進行評估。您可以在 這裡 找到 UpTrain 提供的詳盡評估清單。我們為本教學選擇了我們認為最相關的兩個： 1. Context Relevance (上下文相關性) ：此評估檢查檢索到的上下文是否與查詢相關。這很重要，因為檢索到的上下文是用於生成回應的。如果檢索到的上下文與查詢不相關，那麼回應也將與查詢不相關。 2. Response Conciseness (回應簡潔性) ：此評估檢查回應是否簡潔。這很重要，因為回應應該是簡潔的，不應包含任何不必要的資訊。 替代方案 2：使用 UpTrain 的託管服務和儀表板進行評估 或者，您可以使用 UpTrain 的託管服務來評估您的模型。您可以 這裡 建立一個免費的 UpTrain 帳戶並獲得免費試用點數。如果您需要更多的試用點數，請 在此處預約與 UpTrain 維護者的通話。 使用託管服務的好處包括： 1. 無需在您的本地機器上設定 UpTrain 儀表板。 2. 無需他們的 API key 即可存取許多 LLMs。 完成評估後，您可以在 https://dashboard.uptrain.ai/dashboard 的 UpTrain 儀表板中查看結果。 注意： project name 將是 UpTrain 儀表板中顯示評估執行的專案名稱。 建立 EvalLlamaIndex 物件 現在我們已經建立了一個查詢引擎，我們可以利用它來建立一個 EvalLlamaIndex 物件。此物件將用於為查詢生成回應。 執行評估現在我們有了查詢列表，可以使用 EvalLlamaIndex 物件來為查詢生成回應，然後對回應進行評估。您可以在 UpTrain 提供的豐富評估列表找到 此處。我們為本教學選了兩個我們認為最相關的評估： 1. Context Relevance ：此評估檢查檢索到的上下文是否與查詢相關。這很重要，因為檢索到的上下文是用來生成回應的。如果檢索到的上下文與查詢無關，那麼回應也就不會與查詢相關。 2. Response Conciseness ：此評估檢查回應是否簡潔。這很重要，因為回應應該是簡潔的，不應包含任何不必要的資訊。 儀表板： score 與案例數的直方圖 nyc\ dashboard.png 您可以篩選失敗案例並在其中生成共同的主題。這有助於識別核心問題並幫助解決它 nyc\ insights.png 更多資訊 1. sourceText: Overview : In this example, we will see how to use UpTrain with LlamaIndex. UpTrain (github website docs) is an open-source platform to evaluate and improve GenAI applications. It provides grades for 20+ preconfigured checks (covering language, code, embedding use cases), performs root cause analysis on failure cases and gives insights on how to resolve them. More details on UpTrain’s evaluations can be found here. Problem : As an increasing number of companies are graduating their LLM prototypes to production-ready applications, their RAG pipelines are also getting complex. Developers are utilising modules like QueryRewrite, Context ReRank, etc., to enhance the accuracy of their RAG systems. With increasing complexity comes more points of failure. 1. Advanced Evals are needed to evaluate the quality of these newer modules and determine if they actually improve the system’s accuracy. 2. A robust experimentation framework is needed to systematically test different modules and make data-driven decisions. Solution : UpTrain helps to solve for both: 1. UpTrain provides a series of checks to evaluate the quality of generated response, retrieved-context as well as all the interim steps. The relevant checks are ContextRelevance, SubQueryCompleteness, ContextReranking, ContextConciseness, FactualAccuracy, ContextUtilization, ResponseCompleteness, ResponseConciseness, etc. 2. UpTrain also allows you to experiment with different embedding models as well as have an “evaluate\ experiments” method to compare different RAG configurations. How to go about it? There are two ways you can use UpTrain with LlamaIndex: 1. Using the UpTrain Callback Handler : This method allows you to seamlessly integrate UpTrain with LlamaIndex. You can simply add UpTrainCallbackHandler to your existing LlamaIndex pipeline and it will evaluate all components of your RAG pipeline. This is the recommended method as it is the easiest to use and provides you with dashboards and insights with minimal effort. 2. Using UpTrain’s EvalLlamaIndex : This method allows you to use UpTrain to perform evaluations on the generated responses. You can use the EvalLlamaIndex object to generate responses for the queries and then perform evaluations on the responses. You can find a detailed tutorial on how to do this below. This method offers more flexibility and control over the evaluations, but requires more effort to set up and use. 1. Using the UpTrain Callback Handler Open In Colab The following three demonstrations explain how you can use UpTrain Callback Handler to evaluate different components of your RAG pipelines. 1. RAG Query Engine Evaluations : The RAG query engine plays a crucial role in retrieving context and generating responses. To ensure its performance and response quality, we conduct the following evaluations: - Context Relevance : Determines if the retrieved context has sufficient information to answer the user query or not. - Factual Accuracy : Assesses if the LLM’s response can be verified via the retrieved context. - Response Completeness : Checks if the response contains all the information required to answer the user query comprehensively. 2. Sub-Question Query Generation Evaluation : The SubQuestionQueryGeneration operator decomposes a question into sub-questions, generating responses for each using an RAG query engine. To measure it’s accuracy, we use: - Sub Query Completeness : Assures that the sub-questions accurately and comprehensively cover the original query. 3. Re-Ranking Evaluations : Re-ranking involves reordering nodes based on relevance to the query and choosing the top nodes. Different evaluations are performed based on the number of nodes returned after re-ranking. a. Same Number of Nodes - Context Reranking : Checks if the order of re-ranked nodes is more relevant to the query than the original order. b. Different Number of Nodes: - Context Conciseness : Examines whether the reduced number of nodes still provides all the required information. These evaluations collectively ensure the robustness and effectiveness of the RAG query engine, SubQuestionQueryGeneration operator, and the re-ranking process in the LlamaIndex pipeline. Note: - We have performed evaluations using a basic RAG query engine; the same evaluations can be performed using the advanced RAG query engine as well. - Same is true for Re-Ranking evaluations, we have performed evaluations using SentenceTransformerRerank, the same evaluations can be performed using other re-rankers as well. RAG Query Engine Evaluation UpTrain callback handler will automatically capture the query, context and response once generated and will run the following three evaluations (Graded from 0 to 1) on the response: - Context Relevance : Determines if the retrieved context has sufficient information to answer the user query or not. - Factual Accuracy : Assesses if the LLM’s response can be verified via the retrieved context. - Response Completeness : Checks if the response contains all the information required to answer the user query comprehensively. Here’s an example of the dashboard showing how you can filter and drill down to the failing cases and get insights on the failing cases: image-2.png 2. Sub-Question Query Engine Evaluation The sub-question query engine is used to tackle the problem of answering a complex query using multiple data sources. It first breaks down the complex query into sub-questions for each relevant data source, then gathers all the intermediate responses and synthesizes a final response. UpTrain callback handler will automatically capture the sub-question and the responses for each of them once generated and will run the following three evaluations (Graded from 0 to 1) on the response: - Context Relevance : Determines if the retrieved context has sufficient information to answer the user query or not. - Factual Accuracy : Assesses if the LLM’s response can be verified via the retrieved context. - Response Completeness : Checks if the response contains all the information required to answer the user query comprehensively. In addition to the above evaluations, the callback handler will also run the following evaluation: - Sub Query Completeness : Assures that the sub-questions accurately and comprehensively cover the original query. Here’s an example of the dashboard visualizing the scores of the sub-questions in the form of a bar chart: image.png 3. Re-ranking Re-ranking is the process of reordering the nodes based on their relevance to the query. There are multiple classes of re-ranking algorithms offered by Llamaindex. We have used LLMRerank for this example. The re-ranker allows you to enter the number of top n nodes that will be returned after re-ranking. If this value remains the same as the original number of nodes, the re-ranker will only re-rank the nodes and not change the number of nodes. Otherwise, it will re-rank the nodes and return the top n nodes. We will perform different evaluations based on the number of nodes returned after re-ranking. 3a. title: Python 非同步程式設計
text: 如果你剛開始使用 Python 非同步程式設計，本頁會帶你認識相關概念。 在 LlamaIndex 中，許多操作與函式都支援非同步（async）執行。這讓你可以同時執行多項操作而不阻塞主執行緒，通常能提升整體吞吐量與效能。 以下是幾個值得了解的核心概念： 1. asyncio 基礎 - 事件迴圈（event loop） ：事件迴圈負責排程與執行非同步操作，會持續檢查並執行工作（協程，coroutines）。所有由這個迴圈執行的非同步操作都由它管理，而且每個執行緒（thread）只能有一個事件迴圈。 - asyncio.run() ：這是執行非同步程式的入口點。它會建立並管理事件迴圈，並在程式結束後進行清理。請注意，這個函式設計為每個執行緒只呼叫一次。FastAPI 等框架會替你執行事件迴圈；其他框架則需要你自行啟動。 - Python Notebook 中的非同步程式 ：Python Notebook 有些不同，因為其中的事件迴圈通常已在執行。因此你不必自行呼叫 asyncio.run()，可直接呼叫非同步函式並使用 await。 2. 非同步函式與 await - 定義非同步函式 ：使用 async def 語法定義非同步函式（coroutine，協程）。呼叫非同步函式時不會立即執行，而會回傳一個 coroutine 物件，等待排程與執行。 - 使用 await ：在非同步函式中，使用 await 暫停目前函式，直到等待的工作（task）完成。寫下 await some fn() 時，函式會將控制權交還給事件迴圈，讓其他工作得以排程和執行。一次只會執行一個非同步函式；它們透過 await 彼此協作。 3. 認識並行 - 協作式並行（Cooperative Concurrency） ：你可以排程多個非同步工作（task），但同一時間只會執行一個。這與多個工作同時執行的真正平行處理不同。工作遇到 await 時會暫停，讓其他工作有機會執行。因此，非同步程式很適合用於 I/O 密集型任務，例如呼叫 LLM API 或其他服務，因為這類操作經常需要等待。 - 並非真正的平行處理 ：Asyncio 提供協作式並行，但不會讓多個工作真正同時執行。若 CPU 密集型工作需要平行處理，可以考慮使用 threading 或 multiprocessing。LlamaIndex 在大多數情況下會避免使用 multiprocessing，並由使用者自行實作，因為要安全且有效地處理這類工作並不容易。 4. 處理阻塞（同步）程式碼 - asyncio.to thread() ：有時你需要執行同步（阻塞）程式碼，又不想讓非同步程式停住。asyncio.to thread() 會將阻塞程式碼交由另一個執行緒執行，讓事件迴圈繼續處理其他工作。使用時請留意，它會增加一些額外成本，也可能讓偵錯更困難。 - 替代方案：Executor ：你也可能會看到使用 loop.run in executor() 執行阻塞函式的寫法。 5. 實用範例 以下範例示範如何使用 asyncio 撰寫並執行非同步函式：
sourceText: If you are new to async programming in Python, this page is for you. In LlamaIndex specifically, many operations and functions support async execution. This allows you to run multiple operations at the same time without blocking the main thread, which helps improve overall throughput and performance in many cases. Here are some of the key concepts you should understand: 1. The Basics of asyncio - Event Loop : The event loop handles the scheduling and execution of async operations. It continuously checks for and executes tasks (coroutines). All async operations run by this loop, and there can only be one event loop per thread. - asyncio.run() : This function is the entry point for running an asynchronous program. It creates and manages the event loop and cleans up after it completes. Remember that it is designed to be called once per thread. Some frameworks like FastAPI will run the event loop for you, others will require you to run it yourself. - Async + Python Notebooks : Python notebooks are a special case where the event loop is already running. This means you don’t need to call asyncio.run() yourself, and can directly call and await async functions. 2. Async Functions and await - Defining Async Functions : Use the async def syntax to define an asynchronous function (coroutine). Instead of executing immediately, calling an async function returns a coroutine object that needs to be scheduled and run. - Using await : Inside an async function, await is used to pause execution of that function until the awaited task is complete. When you write await some fn(), the function yields control back to the event loop so that other tasks can be scheduled and run. Only one async function executes at a time, and they cooperate by yielding with await. 3. Concurrency Explained - Cooperative Concurrency : Although you can schedule multiple async tasks, only one task runs at a time. This is different from true parallelism, where multiple tasks run at the same time. When a task hits an await, it suspends its execution so that another task may run. This makes async programs excellent for I/O-bound tasks where waiting is common, such as API calls to LLMs and other services. - Not True Parallelism : Asyncio enables concurrency but does not run tasks in parallel. For CPU-bound work requiring parallel execution, consider threading or multiprocessing. LlamaIndex typically avoids multiprocessing in most cases, and leaves it up to the user to implement, as it can be complex to do so in a way that is safe and efficient. 4. Handling Blocking (Synchronous) Code - asyncio.to thread() : Sometimes you need to run synchronous (blocking) code without freezing your async program. asyncio.to thread() offloads the blocking code to a separate thread, allowing the event loop to continue processing other tasks. Use it cautiously, as it adds some overhead and can make debugging more challenging. - Alternative: Executors : You might also encounter the use of loop.run in executor() to handle blocking functions. 5. title: 高階概念
text: 這是一份關於在建置 LLM 應用程式時，您會經常遇到的高階概念的快速指南。 大型語言模型 (LLMs) LLMs 是啟動 LlamaIndex 的基礎創新。它是一種人工智慧 (AI) 電腦系統，可以理解、生成和操作自然語言，包括根據其訓練資料或在查詢時提供給它的資料來回答問題。您可以 了解更多關於使用 LLMs。 代理應用程式 (Agentic Applications) 當在應用程式中使用 LLM 時，它通常用於做出決策、執行動作和/或與世界互動。這是 agentic application 的核心定義。 雖然 agentic application 的定義很廣泛，但有幾個關鍵特徵定義了 agentic application： - LLM 增強 (Augmentation) ：LLM 會搭配工具（即程式碼中任意可呼叫的函式）、記憶體和/或動態提示 (dynamic prompts)。 - 提示鏈 (Prompt Chaining) ：會使用多個 LLM 呼叫，它們相互建立，一個 LLM 呼叫的輸出會作為下一個的輸入。 - 路由 (Routing) ：LLM 用於將應用程式導向應用程式中的下一個適當步驟或狀態。 - 並行處理 (Parallelism) ：應用程式可以同時執行多個步驟或動作。 - 協調 (Orchestration) ：使用 LLMs 的層級結構來協調較低層級的動作和 LLMs。 - 反思 (Reflection) ：LLM 用於反思和驗證先前步驟或 LLM 呼叫的輸出，可用於引導應用程式到下一個適當的步驟或狀態。 在 LlamaIndex 中，您可以使用 Workflow 類別來協調一系列步驟和 LLMs，從而建置代理應用程式。您可以 了解更多關於 workflows。 Agents 我們將 agent 定義為「agentic application」的一個特定實例。agent 是一段軟體，它透過將 LLMs 與其他工具和記憶體結合，在一個推理迴圈中半自主地執行任務，該迴圈決定下一個要使用的工具（如果有）。 在實際操作中，這意味著類似於： - 一個 agent 接收使用者訊息 - agent 使用 LLM 來確定使用先前的對話歷史、工具和最新的使用者訊息所應採取的下一個適當動作 - agent 可能呼叫一個或多個工具來協助使用者的請求 - 如果使用了工具，agent 將解釋工具的輸出並將其用於告知下一個動作 - 一旦 agent 停止執行動作，它就會將最終輸出返回給使用者 您可以 了解更多關於 agents。 檢索增強生成 (Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)) 檢索增強生成 (RAG) 是使用 LlamaIndex 建置有資料支持的 LLM 應用程式的核心技術。它允許 LLMs 在查詢時將資料提供給 LLM 以回答有關您私人資料的問題，而不是在您的資料上訓練 LLM。為了避免每次都將 所有 資料發送給 LLM，RAG 會對您的資料進行索引，並僅選擇性地將相關部分與您的查詢一起發送。您可以 了解更多關於 RAG。 用例 (Use cases) 有無限多的有資料支持的 LLM 應用程式的用例，但它們大致可分為五個類別： Agents ：一個 agent 是一個由 LLM 驅動的自動決策者，它透過一組 工具 與世界互動。Agents 可以執行任意數量的步驟來完成給定的任務，動態決定最佳的行動方案，而不是遵循預先設定的步驟。這為它提供了額外的靈活性來處理更複雜的任務。 Workflows : LlamaIndex 中的 Workflow 是一個特定的事件驅動抽象，讓您可以協調一系列的步驟和 LLMs 呼叫。Workflows 可用於實作任何 agentic application，並且是 LlamaIndex 的核心組成部分。 Structured Data Extraction Pydantic extractor 讓您可以指定要從資料中提取的精確資料結構，並使用 LLMs 以類型安全的方式填補缺失的部分。這對於從 PDF、網站等非結構化來源中提取結構化資料非常有用，是自動化 workflows 的關鍵。 Query Engines : Query engine 是一個端到端的流程，讓您可以對資料提出問題。它會接收自然語言查詢，並回傳回應，以及檢索到的參考資料並傳遞給 LLM。 聊天引擎 : Chat engine 是一個端到端的流程，讓您可以與您的資料進行對話（多輪來回，而非單一問答）。 提示 - 告訴我如何 customize things \ 繼續學習我們的 understanding LlamaIndex 指南 \ 準備好深入了解了嗎？查看 元件指南
sourceText: This is a quick guide to the high-level concepts you’ll encounter frequently when building LLM applications. Large Language Models (LLMs) LLMs are the fundamental innovation that launched LlamaIndex. They are an artificial intelligence (AI) computer system that can understand, generate, and manipulate natural language, including answering questions based on their training data or data provided to them at query time. You can learn more about using LLMs. Agentic Applications When an LLM is used within an application, it is often used to make decisions, take actions, and/or interact with the world. This is the core definition of an agentic application . While the definition of an agentic application is broad, there are several key characteristics that define an agentic application: - LLM Augmentation : The LLM is augmented with tools (i.e. arbitrary callable functions in code), memory, and/or dynamic prompts. - Prompt Chaining : Several LLM calls are used that build on each other, with the output of one LLM call being used as the input to the next. - Routing : The LLM is used to route the application to the next appropriate step or state in the application. - Parallelism : The application can perform multiple steps or actions in parallel. - Orchestration : A hierarchical structure of LLMs is used to orchestrate lower-level actions and LLMs. - Reflection : The LLM is used to reflect and validate outputs of previous steps or LLM calls, which can be used to guide the application to the next appropriate step or state. In LlamaIndex, you can build agentic applications by using the Workflow class to orchestrate a sequence of steps and LLMs. You can learn more about workflows. Agents We define an agent as a specific instance of an “agentic application”. An agent is a piece of software that semi-autonomously performs tasks by combining LLMs with other tools and memory, orchestrated in a reasoning loop that decides which tool to use next (if any). What this means in practice, is something like: - An agent receives a user message - The agent uses an LLM to determine the next appropriate action to take using the previous chat history, tools, and the latest user message - The agent may invoke one or more tools to assist in the users request - If tools are used, the agent will then interpret the tool outputs and use them to inform the next action - Once the agent stops taking actions, it returns the final output to the user You can learn more about agents. Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) is a core technique for building data-backed LLM applications with LlamaIndex. It allows LLMs to answer questions about your private data by providing it to the LLM at query time, rather than training the LLM on your data. To avoid sending all of your data to the LLM every time, RAG indexes your data and selectively sends only the relevant parts along with your query. You can learn more about RAG. Use cases There are endless use cases for data-backed LLM applications but they can be roughly grouped into five categories: Agents : An agent is an automated decision-maker powered by an LLM that interacts with the world via a set of tools. Agents can take an arbitrary number of steps to complete a given task, dynamically deciding on the best course of action rather than following pre-determined steps. This gives it additional flexibility to tackle more complex tasks. Workflows : A Workflow in LlamaIndex is a specific event-driven abstraction that allows you to orchestrate a sequence of steps and LLMs calls. Workflows can be used to implement any agentic application, and are a core component of LlamaIndex. Structured Data Extraction Pydantic extractors allow you to specify a precise data structure to extract from your data and use LLMs to fill in the missing pieces in a type-safe way. This is useful for extracting structured data from unstructured sources like PDFs, websites, and more, and is key to automating workflows. Query Engines : A query engine is an end-to-end flow that allows you to ask questions over your data. It takes in a natural language query, and returns a response, along with reference context retrieved and passed to the LLM. Chat Engines : A chat engine is an end-to-end flow for having a conversation with your data (multiple back-and-forth instead of a single question-and-answer). text: 提示 如果您尚未安裝，請安裝 LlamaIndex 並完成 入門教學。如果您遇到不認識的術語，請查看 高層次概念。 在本節中，我們從您為 starter example 編寫的程式碼開始，並向您展示了您可以為您的使用情境自訂它的最常見方法： --- 「我想將我的 documents 解析成更小的區塊」 --- 「我想使用不同的 vector store」 首先，您可以安裝您想使用的 vector store。例如，若要使用 Chroma 作為 vector store，您可以使用 pip 安裝它： 終端機視窗 要了解所有可用的整合，請查看 整合頁面。 然後，您可以在程式碼中使用它： StorageContext 定義了 documents、embeddings 和 indexes 的儲存後端。您可以了解更多關於 storage 和 如何自訂它。 --- 「我想在查詢時檢索更多上下文」 as query engine 在 index 上建立預設的 retriever 和 query engine。您可以透過傳入 keyword arguments 來設定 retriever 和 query engine。在這裡，我們設定 retriever 返回最相似的 top 5 個 documents（而不是預設的 2 個）。您可以了解更多關於 retrievers 和 query engines。 --- 「我想使用不同的 LLM」 您可以了解更多關於 customizing LLMs。 --- 「我想使用不同的 response mode」 您可以了解更多關於 query engines 和 response modes。 --- 「我想串流回傳回應」 您可以了解更多關於 streaming responses。 --- 「我想使用 chatbot 而不是 Q\&A」 了解更多關於 chat engine。 --- 後續步驟 - 想對您可以設定的（幾乎）所有內容進行全面了解？從 Understanding LlamaIndex 開始。 - 想對特定模組有更深入的了解？查看 component guides。
sourceText: Tip If you haven’t already, install LlamaIndex and complete the starter tutorial. If you run into terms you don’t recognize, check out the high-level concepts. In this section, we start with the code you wrote for the starter example and show you the most common ways you might want to customize it for your use case: --- “I want to parse my documents into smaller chunks" --- "I want to use a different vector store” First, you can install the vector store you want to use. For example, to use Chroma as the vector store, you can install it using pip: Terminal window To learn more about all integrations available, check out the integrations page. Then, you can use it in your code: StorageContext defines the storage backend for where the documents, embeddings, and indexes are stored. You can learn more about storage and how to customize it. --- ”I want to retrieve more context when I query” as query engine builds a default retriever and query engine on top of the index. You can configure the retriever and query engine by passing in keyword arguments. Here, we configure the retriever to return the top 5 most similar documents (instead of the default of 2). You can learn more about retrievers and query engines. --- ”I want to use a different LLM” You can learn more about customizing LLMs. --- ”I want to use a different response mode” You can learn more about query engines and response modes. --- ”I want to stream the response back” You can learn more about streaming responses. --- ”I want a chatbot instead of Q\&A” Learn more about the chat engine. --- Next Steps - Want a thorough walkthrough of (almost) everything you can configure? Get started with Understanding LlamaIndex. - Want more in-depth understanding of specific modules? Check out the component guides.

title: 安裝與設定
text: LlamaIndex 生態系統由一系列採命名空間組織的 Python 套件構成。 對使用者來說，pip install llama-index 會安裝一組核心入門套件，您也能視需求另行安裝整合套件。 完整的套件與可用整合清單請見整合套件頁面。 使用 pip 快速安裝 想快速開始，請執行以下指令： 終端機視窗 這組入門套件包含： - llama-index-core - llama-index-llms-openai - llama-index-embeddings-openai - llama-index-readers-file 注意： llama-index-core 預先附有 NLTK 和 tiktoken 檔案，可避免程式執行時下載檔案和呼叫網路。 重要：設定 OpenAI 環境 預設會使用 OpenAI gpt-3.5-turbo 產生文字，並以 text-embedding-ada-002 執行檢索與嵌入向量（新專案建議明確傳入 model="text-embedding-3-small"）。若要使用這些功能，請先將 OPENAI\ API\ KEY 設為環境變數。登入 OpenAI 帳戶後，即可建立新的 API 金鑰。 提示 您也可以使用眾多其他可用的 LLM。依照 LLM 服務提供者而定，您可能還需要設定額外的環境變數和 token。 查看 OpenAI 入門範例 使用 pip 自訂安裝 如果您不使用 OpenAI，或希望自行挑選要安裝的套件，可以按需求逐一安裝。 例如，要使用 Ollama 和 HuggingFace 嵌入模型建立本機環境，可安裝： 終端機視窗 查看本機模型入門範例 查看 LLM 使用與設定完整指南。 查看 嵌入模型使用與設定完整指南。 從原始碼安裝 先複製此儲存庫：git clone https://github.com/run-llama/llama index.git，接著依序執行： - 安裝 Poetry - 協助管理套件相依性 - 若要使用 Poetry 執行 shell 命令，但尚未安裝 shell 外掛程式，請執行以下指令新增： - poetry shell - 此指令會建立虛擬環境，讓安裝的套件限制在此專案中 - pip install -e llama-index-core - 安裝核心套件 - （可選）poetry install --with dev,docs - 安裝大多數本機開發工作所需的所有相依套件 接著可依需求使用 pip 安裝整合套件，例如： 終端機視窗
sourceText: The LlamaIndex ecosystem is structured using a collection of namespaced python packages. What this means for users is that pip install llama-index comes with a core starter bundle of packages, and additional integrations can be installed as needed. A complete list of packages and available integrations is available on the integrations page. Quickstart Installation from Pip To get started quickly, you can install with: Terminal window This is a starter bundle of packages, containing - llama-index-core - llama-index-llms-openai - llama-index-embeddings-openai - llama-index-readers-file NOTE: llama-index-core comes pre-bundled with NLTK and tiktoken files to avoid downloads and network calls at runtime. Important: OpenAI Environment Setup By default, we use the OpenAI gpt-3.5-turbo model for text generation and text-embedding-ada-002 for retrieval and embeddings (for new projects we recommend passing model="text-embedding-3-small" explicitly). In order to use this, you must have an OPENAI\ API\ KEY set up as an environment variable. You can obtain an API key by logging into your OpenAI account and creating a new API key. Tip You can also use one of many other available LLMs. You may need additional environment keys + tokens setup depending on the LLM provider. Check out our OpenAI Starter Example Custom Installation from Pip If you aren’t using OpenAI, or want a more selective installation, you can install individual packages as needed. For example, for a local setup with Ollama and HuggingFace embeddings, the installation might look like: Terminal window Check out our Starter Example with Local Models A full guide to using and configuring LLMs is available here. A full guide to using and configuring embedding models is available here. Installation from Source Git clone this repository: git clone https://github.com/run-llama/llama index.git. Then do the following: - Install poetry - this will help you manage package dependencies - If you need to run shell commands using Poetry but the shell plugin is not installed, add the plugin by running: - poetry shell - this command creates a virtual environment, which keeps installed packages contained to this project - pip install -e llama-index-core - this will install the core package - (Optional) poetry install --with dev,docs - this will install all dependencies needed for most local development From there, you can install integrations as needed with pip, For example: Terminal window

title: 如何閱讀 LlamaIndex 文件
text: 歡迎使用 LlamaIndex 文件！我們努力讓這份文件對各種經驗程度的讀者都易於理解，不論你對 LlamaIndex、LLM 或生成式 AI 熟悉與否。 開始之前 LlamaIndex 是 Python 程式庫，因此請先安裝 Python，並具備基本的 Python 使用經驗。若你偏好 JavaScript，也可以試用我們的 TypeScript 套件。 許多範例以 Notebook 呈現；這裡的 Notebook 指 Jupyter 風格的筆記本。你不必安裝 Jupyter，也能在 Google Colab 等託管服務上試用大多數範例。 這些文件的結構 本文件依照下列架構編排。你可以從頁面頂端的連結由左至右瀏覽，或點選每頁底端的「下一步」連結，快速了解各部分內容。 1. 開始使用 ：你目前所在的章節。即使完全不熟悉 LlamaIndex 和 LLM，我們也會帶你安裝程式庫、撰寫第一個只需五行程式碼的範例、認識 LLM 應用程式的高階概念，接著示範如何自訂這個五行範例以符合你的需求。 2. 了解 LlamaIndex ：完成入門章節後，請接著閱讀了解 LlamaIndex。我們會透過一系列精簡教學，帶你逐步建置可用於正式環境的 LlamaIndex 應用程式，並在過程中加深你對這個程式庫及 LLM 的理解。 3. 使用情境 ：如果你是正在評估 LlamaIndex 是否適用於專案的開發者，可以先看可建置項目的總覽。 4. 範例 ：我們幾乎為所有功能都準備了豐富的 Notebook 範例。你可以瀏覽這些範例，探索並學習 LlamaIndex 的不同用法。 5. 元件指南 ：這些指南深入介紹 LlamaIndex 的各個元件及其用法。請前往查看。
sourceText: Welcome to the LlamaIndex documentation! We’ve tried hard to make these docs approachable regardless of your experience level with LlamaIndex and with LLMs and generative AI in general. Before you start LlamaIndex is a Python library, so you should have Python installed and a basic working understanding of how to write it. If you prefer JavaScript, we recommend trying out our TypeScript package. Many of our examples are formatted as Notebooks, by which we mean Jupyter-style notebooks. You don’t have to have Jupyter installed; you can try out most of our examples on a hosted service like Google Colab. Structure of these docs Our docs are structured so you should be able to roughly progress simply by moving across the links at the top of the page from left to right, or just hitting the “next” link at the bottom of each page. 1. Getting started: The section you’re in right now. We can get you going from knowing nothing about LlamaIndex and LLMs. Install the library, write your first demo in five lines of code, learn more about the high level concepts of LLM applications, and then see how you can customize the five-line example to meet your needs. 2. Understand: Once you’ve completed the Getting Started section, the Understanding section is the next place to go. In a series of bite-sized tutorials, we’ll walk you through every stage of building a production LlamaIndex application and help you level up on the concepts of the library and LLMs in general as you go. 3. Use cases: If you’re a dev trying to figure out whether LlamaIndex will work for your use case, we have an overview of the types of things you can build. 4. Examples: We have rich notebook examples for nearly every feature under the sun. Explore these to find and learn something new about LlamaIndex. 5. Component guides: These are comprehensive, lower-level guides to the individual components of LlamaIndex and how to use them. Check them out.

sourceText: This tutorial will show you how to get started building agents with LlamaIndex. We’ll start with a basic example and then show how to add RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) capabilities. Tip Make sure you’ve followed the installation steps first. Tip Want to use local models? If you want to do our starter tutorial using only local models, check out this tutorial instead. Set your OpenAI API key LlamaIndex uses OpenAI’s gpt-3.5-turbo by default, although this example uses gpt-4o-mini for the LLM. Make sure your API key is available to your code by setting it as an environment variable: Terminal window Tip If you are using an OpenAI-Compatible API, you can use the OpenAILike LLM class. You can find more information in the OpenAILike LLM integration and OpenAILike Embeddings integration. Basic Agent Example Let’s start with a simple example using an agent that can perform basic multiplication by calling a tool. Create a file called starter.py: This will output something like: The result of \( 1234 \times 4567 \) is \( 5,678,678 \). What happened is: - The agent was given a question: What is 1234 4567? - Under the hood, this question, plus the schema of the tools (name, docstring, and arguments) were passed to the LLM - The agent selected the multiply tool and wrote the arguments to the tool - The agent received the result from the tool and interpolated it into the final response Tip As you can see, we are using async python functions. Many LLMs and models support async calls, and using async code is recommended to improve performance of your application. To learn more about async code and python, we recommend this short section on async + python. Adding Chat History The AgentWorkflow is also able to remember previous messages. This is contained inside the Context of the AgentWorkflow. If the Context is passed in, the agent will use it to continue the conversation. Adding RAG Capabilities Now let’s enhance our agent by adding the ability to search through documents. First, let’s get some example data using our terminal: Terminal window Your directory structure should look like this now: Now we can create a tool for searching through documents using LlamaIndex. With no Settings.embed model configured, VectorStoreIndex falls back to OpenAIEmbedding, which will use the text-embedding-ada-002 model by default. For new projects we recommend passing OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small") explicitly. Tip Prefer to run embeddings locally with no API key? Swap the hosted embedder for a local Sentence Transformers model in two lines: See the local starter tutorial for a fully-local pipeline. Our modified starter.py should look like this: The agent can now seamlessly switch between using the calculator and searching through documents to answer questions. Storing the RAG Index To avoid reprocessing documents every time, you can persist the index to disk: Tip If you used a vector store integration besides the default, chances are you can just reload from the vector store: What’s Next? This is just the beginning of what you can do with LlamaIndex agents! You can: - Add more tools to your agent - Use different LLMs - Customize the agent’s behavior using system prompts - Add streaming capabilities - Implement human-in-the-loop workflows - Use multiple agents to collaborate on tasks Some helpful next links: - See more advanced agent examples in our Agent documentation - Learn more about high-level concepts - Explore how to customize things - Check out the component guides

text: 本教學將向您示範如何使用 LlamaIndex 來建立 agents。我們將從一個基本範例開始，然後示範如何新增 RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) 功能。 我們將使用 BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 作為 embedding model，並透過 llama3.1 8B 透過 Ollama 進行服務。 提示 請確保您已先完成 安裝 步驟。 設定 Ollama 是一個工具，可幫助您以最少的設定在本地設定 LLMs。 請參閱 README 以了解如何安裝它。 要下載 Llama3 model，只需執行 ollama pull llama3.1。 注意 ：您需要一台至少有 \ 32GB RAM 的機器。 如我們的 安裝指南 所解釋，llama-index 實際上是一組套件。要運行 Ollama 和 Huggingface，我們需要安裝這些整合： 終端機視窗 套件名稱會顯示導入的內容，這對於記住如何導入或安裝它們非常有幫助！ 更多整合資訊請參閱 整合頁面。 基本 Agent 範例 讓我們從一個簡單的範例開始，使用一個可以透過呼叫 tool 執行基本乘法的 agent。建立一個名為 starter.py 的檔案： 這會輸出類似於：The answer to 1234 4567 is 5635678. 發生的情況是： - agent 接收了一個問題：What is 1234 4567? - 在底層，這個問題以及工具的 schema (name, docstring, 和 arguments) 被傳遞給 LLM - agent 選擇了 multiply 工具並為工具寫入了 arguments - agent 接收到工具的結果並將其插值到最終的回應中 提示 如您所見，我們正在使用 async python 函數。許多 LLMs 和 model 都支援 async calls，建議使用 async code 來提升應用程式的效能。如需了解更多關於 async code 和 python 的資訊，我們推薦參閱這篇 short section on async + python。 新增聊天記錄 AgentWorkflow 也能夠記住先前的訊息。這包含在 AgentWorkflow 的 Context 內部。 如果傳入 Context，agent 將會使用它來繼續對話。 新增 RAG 功能 現在讓我們透過新增搜尋 documents 的能力來增強我們的 agent。首先，讓我們使用終端機獲取一些範例資料： 終端機視窗 您的目錄結構現在應該如下所示： 現在我們可以使用 LlamaIndex 為搜尋 documents 建立一個 tool。與依賴任何 hosted-API default 不同，我們將配置 Settings.embed model 到 HuggingFaceEmbedding(model name="BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5")，以便索引和檢索都使用一個本地的 Sentence Transformers model，無需 API key。 我們修改後的 starter.py 應該如下所示： agent 現在可以無縫切換，在使用計算器和搜尋 documents 之間來回答問題。 儲存 RAG 索引 為避免每次都重新處理 documents，您可以將索引持久化到磁碟： 提示 如果您除了 default 之外使用了 vector store integration，那麼您很可能可以直接從 vector store 重新載入： 下一步是什麼？ 這只是您能用 LlamaIndex agents 做的事情的開始！您可以： - 向您的 agent 添加更多 tools - 使用不同的 LLMs - 使用 system prompts 自訂 agent 的行為 - 新增 streaming capabilities - 實作 human-in-the-loop workflows - 使用多個 agents 協作完成任務 一些有幫助的後續連結： - 在我們的 Agent documentation 中查看更多進階 agent 範例- 瞭解更多關於 高層次概念 - 探索如何 customize things - 查看 component guides
sourceText: This tutorial will show you how to get started building agents with LlamaIndex. We’ll start with a basic example and then show how to add RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) capabilities. We will use BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5 as our embedding model and llama3.1 8B served through Ollama. Tip Make sure you’ve followed the installation steps first. Setup Ollama is a tool to help you get set up with LLMs locally with minimal setup. Follow the README to learn how to install it. To download the Llama3 model just do ollama pull llama3.1. NOTE : You will need a machine with at least \ 32GB of RAM. As explained in our installation guide, llama-index is actually a collection of packages. To run Ollama and Huggingface, we will need to install those integrations: Terminal window The package names spell out the imports, which is very helpful for remembering how to import them or install them! More integrations are listed on the integrations page. Basic Agent Example Let’s start with a simple example using an agent that can perform basic multiplication by calling a tool. Create a file called starter.py: This will output something like: The answer to 1234 4567 is 5635678. What happened is: - The agent was given a question: What is 1234 4567? - Under the hood, this question, plus the schema of the tools (name, docstring, and arguments) were passed to the LLM - The agent selected the multiply tool and wrote the arguments to the tool - The agent received the result from the tool and interpolated it into the final response Tip As you can see, we are using async python functions. Many LLMs and models support async calls, and using async code is recommended to improve performance of your application. To learn more about async code and python, we recommend this short section on async + python. Adding Chat History The AgentWorkflow is also able to remember previous messages. This is contained inside the Context of the AgentWorkflow. If the Context is passed in, the agent will use it to continue the conversation. Adding RAG Capabilities Now let’s enhance our agent by adding the ability to search through documents. First, let’s get some example data using our terminal: Terminal window Your directory structure should look like this now: Now we can create a tool for searching through documents using LlamaIndex. Rather than relying on any hosted-API default, we’ll configure Settings.embed model to HuggingFaceEmbedding(model name="BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5") so both indexing and retrieval use a local Sentence Transformers model with no API key required. Our modified starter.py should look like this: The agent can now seamlessly switch between using the calculator and searching through documents to answer questions. Storing the RAG Index To avoid reprocessing documents every time, you can persist the index to disk: Tip If you used a vector store integration besides the default, chances are you can just reload from the vector store: What’s Next? This is just the beginning of what you can do with LlamaIndex agents! You can: - Add more tools to your agent - Use different LLMs - Customize the agent’s behavior using system prompts - Add streaming capabilities - Implement human-in-the-loop workflows - Use multiple agents to collaborate on tasks Some helpful next links: - See more advanced agent examples in our Agent documentation - Learn more about high-level concepts - Explore how to customize things - Check out the component guides

title: LlamaIndex Framework
text: LlamaIndex Framework LlamaIndex 是 LlamaParse 背後的公司；LlamaParse 是為 AI agents 打造的文件解析平台。LlamaIndex Framework 則是我們最初推出、用於 RAG 與 agents 的開源工具套件。 開始教學 安裝 GitHub 簡介 LlamaIndex Framework 是一套 Python 工具，可用來在您的資料上打造由 LLM 驅動的 agents。LLM 是以公開資料訓練，而不是以您的資料訓練。您的資料可能存放在 API 後端、資料庫中，或困在 PDF 與投影片裡。上下文增補（context augmentation）會在模型產生回答時，將這些資料提供給模型；其中最廣為人知的形式是檢索增強生成（RAG）。這個框架提供打造各種上下文增補應用所需的元件，從原型一路支援到正式環境；它也是將 LlamaParse 解析後的文件交給能運用這些資料的 agent 的最直接途徑。 - Agents 是由 LLM 驅動的助理，會使用工具完成任務，例如根據您的文件回答問題，或在其他系統中採取行動。RAG pipeline 是 agent 可以呼叫的眾多工具之一。 - Workflows 是事件驅動的多步驟流程，結合 agents、資料連接器與工具，並支援分支、重試及人工參與審查，也能部署為服務。 此框架由可組合的元件構成。高階 API 只需幾行程式碼，就能讓您從文件取得答案；低階 API 則可讓您自訂或替換任何元件。 資料連接器 索引與向量儲存庫 查詢與聊天引擎 Agents 與工具 Workflows 模型、評估與可觀測性 剛接觸 LlamaIndex？入門教學會示範如何建立一個能使用您文件的工具的 agent；本機模型教學則會在不使用託管 API 的情況下完成相同目標；文件導覽會依照您的經驗程度，指引您閱讀合適的章節。學習部分則會逐步帶您完成一個完整應用程式。 遇到複雜文件時 框架內建的讀取器處理乾淨文字沒有問題。遇到掃描 PDF、表單、試算表和投影片時，索引內容的品質會直接影響每個答案的品質。這正是 LlamaParse 的用途：Parse（針對掃描文件、表格與圖表的 agentic OCR）、Extract（依照您的 schema 擷取 JSON）、Classify、Split 和 Index（代管式匯入與檢索）。解析完成的頁面可直接加入框架索引： 終端機視窗 OpenAI API 金鑰用於建立索引；預設會使用 OpenAI 為頁面產生嵌入向量。若要改用本機嵌入向量，請依照本機模型教學的說明設定 Settings.embed model。 接下來，這個索引就和其他工具一樣：入門教學會示範如何將它交給 agent 使用。 若要使用全代管式檢索，Index 會讓索引與資料來源保持同步，並將檢索結果提供給 query engine 或 agent。若要在自己的電腦上解析文件，LiteParse 是開源的本機方案。 複雜文件進，乾淨 Markdown 出 透過 API 提供 agentic OCR 與結構化擷取，並提供 Python、TypeScript、Go 和 Java SDK。可免費開始使用。 取得 API 金鑰 LlamaParse 文件 LlamaCloud 現已更名為 LlamaParse。 這個託管平台過去稱為 LlamaCloud，現在已改名為 LlamaParse。相關文件請見 developers.llamaindex.ai/llamaparse。 您可以打造的應用 Agents 可呼叫工具、跨對話輪次保留狀態，並串流回報進度的助理。 Workflows 透過分支、重試與人工審查進行事件驅動的協調。 問答 找出相關段落，並附上引用來回答問題（RAG）。 聊天機器人 透過記憶和追問，與您的資料進行對話。 結構化擷取 使用 Pydantic 將文字擷取為具型別的欄位，或透過 Extract 處理整份文件。 多模態 在檢索與生成過程中處理文字、圖片、表格和圖表。 更多應用案例請見使用案例頁面，內容涵蓋文字轉 SQL、查詢 CSV、提示技巧與微調。 LlamaIndex 開源專案 此框架是我們最早推出的開源專案，但並非唯一一個。後續專案規模較小、專注於文件，可搭配此框架使用，也能獨立運作。 LiteParse 快速的開源文件解析器，可在您的電腦上執行，提供版面配置、邊界框、Markdown 與內建 OCR。無需雲端或金鑰。 ExtractBench 企業文件的 schema 導向擷取基準，可用真實表單與合約比較結構化擷取效果。 ParseBench 文件解析與 OCR 的開放基準測試，可用來比較適合您文件類型的解析器。 LlamaIndex Framework 這套 Python 工具包提供連接器、索引、查詢引擎、agents 和 workflows。 取得協助並參與貢獻 LlamaIndex Framework 採 MIT 授權，並與社群共同打造。貢獻指南涵蓋從修正文檔到新增整合套件的各種貢獻。常見問題則回答新手最常提出的問題。 Discord GitHub 問題追蹤 X LinkedIn PyPI 上的 llama-index 整合套件 探索更多 LlamaIndex 資源：create-llama、全端專案及 Discover LlamaIndex 影片系列。
sourceText: LlamaIndex Framework LlamaIndex is the company behind LlamaParse, the document parsing platform for AI agents. The LlamaIndex framework is our original open-source toolkit for RAG and agents. Start the tutorial Installation GitHub Introduction The LlamaIndex framework is a Python toolkit for building LLM-powered agents over your data. LLMs are trained on public data, not yours. Your data is behind APIs, in databases, or trapped in PDFs and slide decks. Context augmentation makes that data available to the model at the moment it answers, and its best-known form is retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The framework gives you the parts to build any context-augmentation use case, from prototype to production, and it is the shortest path from documents parsed by LlamaParse to an agent that can use them. - Agents are LLM-powered assistants that use tools to complete tasks, from answering questions over your documents to taking actions in other systems. A RAG pipeline is one of many tools an agent can call. - Workflows are event-driven, multi-step processes that combine agents, data connectors and tools, with branching, retries and human-in-the-loop review, and can be deployed as services. The framework is built from composable parts. The high-level API gets you from documents to answers in a few lines; the lower-level API lets you customize or replace any of them. Data connectors Indexes and vector stores Query and chat engines Agents and tools Workflows Models, evaluation and observability New here? The starter tutorial builds an agent with a tool over your documents, the local-models tutorial does the same without any hosted API, and how to read these docs points you to the right section for your experience level. The Learn section then walks through a complete application step by step. When the documents get hard The framework’s built-in readers are fine for clean text. For scanned PDFs, forms, spreadsheets and slide decks, the quality of what goes into your index decides the quality of every answer. That is what LlamaParse is for: Parse (agentic OCR for scans, tables and charts), Extract (JSON in your schema), Classify, Split and Index (managed ingestion and retrieval). Parsed pages drop straight into a framework index: Terminal window The OpenAI key is for the index, which embeds the pages with OpenAI by default. To embed locally instead, set Settings.embed model as in the local-models tutorial. From there the index is a tool like any other: the starter tutorial shows how to hand it to an agent. For fully managed retrieval, Index keeps an index in sync with your data sources and serves retrieval to your query engine or agent. For parsing on your own machine, LiteParse is the open-source, local option. Hard documents in, clean Markdown out Agentic OCR and structured extraction as an API, with SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Go and Java. Free to start. Get an API key LlamaParse docs LlamaCloud is now LlamaParse The hosted platform formerly called LlamaCloud has been renamed LlamaParse. Its documentation lives at developers.llamaindex.ai/llamaparse. What you can build Agents Assistants that call tools, keep state across turns and stream progress. Workflows Event-driven orchestration with branching, retries and human review. Question answering Retrieve the right passages and answer with citations (RAG). Chatbots Conversations over your data with memory and follow-ups. Structured extraction Typed fields from text with Pydantic, or from whole documents with Extract. Multi-modal Text, images, tables and charts in retrieval and generation. More on the use cases page: text-to-SQL, querying CSVs, prompting techniques and fine-tuning. LlamaIndex open source The framework is the oldest of our open-source projects, not the only one. The newer ones are smaller, focused on documents, and work with the framework or on their own. LiteParse A fast, open-source document parser that runs on your machine. Layout, bounding boxes, Markdown, built-in OCR. No cloud, no key. ExtractBench A schema-guided extraction benchmark for enterprise documents, so you can compare structured extraction on real forms and contracts. ParseBench An open benchmark for document parsing and OCR, so you can compare parsers on your kind of documents. LlamaIndex Framework This toolkit: connectors, indexes, query engines, agents and workflows for Python. Get help and contribute LlamaIndex Framework is MIT-licensed and built with its community. The contributing guide covers everything from a documentation fix to a new integration. The FAQ answers the questions everyone asks first. Discord GitHub issues X LinkedIn llama-index on PyPI Integrations More from LlamaIndex: create-llama, full-stack projects and the Discover LlamaIndex video series.

sourceText: Cohere Embed is the first embedding model that natively supports float, int8, binary and ubinary embeddings. 1. v3 models support all embedding types while v2 models support only float embedding type. 2. The default embedding type is float with LlamaIndex. You can customize it for v3 models using parameter embedding type. In this notebook, we will demonstrate using Cohere Embeddings with different models, input types and embedding types. Refer to their main blog post for more details on Cohere int8 & binary Embeddings. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. With latest embed-english-v3.0 embeddings. - input\ type=“search\ document”: Use this for texts (documents) you want to store in your vector database - input\ type=“search\ query”: Use this for search queries to find the most relevant documents in your vector database The default embedding type is float. We’d all have dinner there once a week — on tuesdays, since I was already cooking for the thursday diners on thursdays — and after dinner we’d bring in experts on startups to give talks. We knew undergrads were deciding then about summer jobs, so in a matter of days we cooked up something we called the Summer Founders Program, and I posted an announcement on my site, inviting undergrads to apply. I had never imagined that writing essays would be a way to get “deal flow,” as investors call it, but it turned out to be the perfect source. \[15] We got 225 applications for the Summer Founders Program, and we were surprised to find that a lot of them were from people who’d already graduated, or were about to that spring. Already this SFP thing was starting to feel more serious than we’d intended. We invited about 20 of the 225 groups to interview in person, and from those we picked 8 to fund. They were an impressive group. That first batch included reddit, Justin Kan and Emmett Shear, who went on to found Twitch, Aaron Swartz, who had already helped write the RSS spec and would a few years later become a martyr for open access, and Sam Altman, who would later become the second president of YC. I don’t think it was entirely luck that the first batch was so good. You had to be pretty bold to sign up for a weird thing like the Summer Founders Program instead of a summer job at a legit place like Microsoft or Goldman Sachs. The deal for startups was based on a combination of the deal we did with Julian ($10k for 10%) and what Robert said MIT grad students got for the summer ($6k). We invested $6k per founder, which in the typical two-founder case was $12k, in return for 6%. That had to be fair, because it was twice as good as the deal we ourselves had taken. So we didn’t reach breakeven until about when Yahoo bought us in the summer of 1998. Which in turn meant we were at the mercy of investors for the entire life of the company. And since both we and our investors were noobs at startups, the result was a mess even by startup standards. It was a huge relief when Yahoo bought us. In principle our Viaweb stock was valuable. It was a share in a business that was profitable and growing rapidly. But it didn’t feel very valuable to me; I had no idea how to value a business, but I was all too keenly aware of the near-death experiences we seemed to have every few months. Nor had I changed my grad student lifestyle significantly since we started. So when Yahoo bought us it felt like going from rags to riches. Since we were going to California, I bought a car, a yellow 1998 VW GTI. I remember thinking that its leather seats alone were by far the most luxurious thing I owned. The next year, from the summer of 1998 to the summer of 1999, must have been the least productive of my life. I didn’t realize it at the time, but I was worn out from the effort and stress of running Viaweb. For a while after I got to California I tried to continue my usual m.o. of programming till 3 in the morning, but fatigue combined with Yahoo’s prematurely aged culture and grim cube farm in Santa Clara gradually dragged me down. After a few months it felt disconcertingly like working at Interleaf. Yahoo had given us a lot of options when they bought us. At the time I thought Yahoo was so overvalued that they’d never be worth anything, but to my astonishment the stock went up 5x in the next year. I hung on till the first chunk of options vested, then in the summer of 1999 I left. It had been so long since I’d painted anything that I’d half forgotten why I was doing this. My brain had been entirely full of software and men’s shirts for 4 years.
