title: Isaacus Embeddings
text: llama-index-embeddings-isaacus 套件包含用於建構使用 Isaacus legal AI embedding model 的應用程式的 LlamaIndex 整合。此整合讓您可以輕鬆連接並使用 Kanon 2 Embedder ——全球最準確的法律 embedding model，該模型可在 Massive Legal Embedding Benchmark (MLEB) 上進行測試。 Isaacus embeddings 支援針對特定任務的優化： - task="retrieval/query"：為搜尋查詢優化 embeddings - task="retrieval/document"：為 documents 進行索引優化 在本筆筆記中，我們將演示如何使用 Isaacus Embeddings 進行法律 document 檢索。 安裝 安裝必要的整合。 如果您在 colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 設定 取得您的 Isaacus API 金鑰 1. 在 Isaacus Platform 建立帳戶 2. 增加一個 payment method 以領取您的 free credits 3. 建立一個 API key 基本用法 取得單一 Embedding 取得批次 Embeddings 針對特定任務的 Embeddings Isaacus embeddings 支援不同的任務以達到最佳效能： - retrieval/document ：用於為 documents 進行索引 - retrieval/query ：用於搜尋查詢 使用適當的任務可以提高檢索準確度。 維度降低 您可以降低 embedding 的維度，以加快搜尋速度並降低儲存成本： 完整的 RAG 範例與法律 Documents 現在讓我們使用 Isaacus embeddings 和法律 document（Uber 的 10-K SEC 報告）建立一個完整的 RAG pipeline。 下載法律 Document 資料 我們將使用 Uber 的 10-K SEC 報告，其中包含法律和監管資訊——非常適合展示 Kanon 2 的法律領域專業知識。 載入法律 Document 使用 Document 任務建立索引 在建立索引時，我們在 task="retrieval/document" 中使用它來優化 embeddings 以便 document 儲存。 使用法律問題進行查詢 現在我們將使用法律特定的問題來查詢索引。請注意，get query embedding 會自動使用 task="retrieval/query" 以獲得最佳查詢效能。 查詢法律訴訟相關問題 使用 LLM 建立查詢引擎 將 Isaacus embeddings 與 LLM 結合，以實現完整的問答： 另一個法律查詢 異步用法 Isaacus embeddings 也支援異步操作，以在異步應用程式中獲得更好的效能： 總結 在本筆筆記中，我們演示了： 1. 基本用法 - 取得單一和批次 embeddings 2. 針對特定任務的優化 - 使用 retrieval/document 進行索引和 retrieval/query 進行搜尋 3. 維度降低 - 降低 embedding 大小以提高效率 4. 法律 RAG pipeline - 使用法律 documents（Uber 10-K）建立完整的檢索系統 5. 異步操作 - 使用異步方法以獲得更好的效能 Kanon 2 Embedder 在法律 document 的理解和檢索方面表現出色，使其成為法律科技應用、合規工具、合約分析等的理想選擇。 額外資源 - Isaacus Documentation - Kanon 2 Embedder Announcement - Massive Legal Embedding Benchmark (MLEB) - Isaacus Platform
sourceText: The llama-index-embeddings-isaacus package contains LlamaIndex integrations for building applications with Isaacus’ legal AI embedding models. This integration allows you to easily connect to and use the Kanon 2 Embedder - the world’s most accurate legal embedding model on the Massive Legal Embedding Benchmark (MLEB). Isaacus embeddings support task-specific optimization: - task="retrieval/query": Optimize embeddings for search queries - task="retrieval/document": Optimize embeddings for documents to be indexed In this notebook, we will demonstrate using Isaacus Embeddings for legal document retrieval. Installation Install the necessary integrations. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Setup Get your Isaacus API key 1. Create an account at Isaacus Platform 2. Add a payment method to claim your free credits 3. Create an API key Basic Usage Get a Single Embedding Get Batch Embeddings Task-Specific Embeddings Isaacus embeddings support different tasks for optimal performance: - retrieval/document : For documents to be indexed - retrieval/query : For search queries Using the appropriate task improves retrieval accuracy. Dimensionality Reduction You can reduce the embedding dimensionality for faster search and lower storage costs: Full RAG Example with Legal Documents Now let’s build a complete RAG pipeline using Isaacus embeddings with a legal document (Uber’s 10-K SEC filing). Download Legal Document Data We’ll use Uber’s 10-K SEC filing, which contains legal and regulatory information - perfect for demonstrating Kanon 2’s legal domain expertise. Load the Legal Document Build Index with Document Task We use task="retrieval/document" when building the index to optimize embeddings for document storage. Query with Legal Questions Now we’ll query the index with legal-specific questions. Note that get query embedding automatically uses task="retrieval/query" for optimal query performance. Query about Legal Proceedings Build a Query Engine with LLM Combine Isaacus embeddings with an LLM for complete question answering: Another Legal Query Async Usage Isaacus embeddings also support async operations for better performance in async applications: Summary In this notebook, we demonstrated: 1. Basic usage - Getting single and batch embeddings 2. Task-specific optimization - Using retrieval/document for indexing and retrieval/query for searching 3. Dimensionality reduction - Reducing embedding size for efficiency 4. Legal RAG pipeline - Building a complete retrieval system with legal documents (Uber 10-K) 5. Async operations - Using async methods for better performance The Kanon 2 Embedder excels at legal document understanding and retrieval, making it ideal for legal tech applications, compliance tools, contract analysis, and more. title: Jina 嵌入模型
text: 如果您在 colab 中開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 您可能還需要 llama-index 沒有直接提供的其他套件。 對於此範例，您需要一個 API 金鑰，該金鑰可以從 取得。 透過 JinaAI 嵌入模型對文本和查詢進行嵌入 API 您可以使用 JinaEmbedding class 來對您的文本和查詢進行編碼。Jina 提供一系列可適應不同用例的模型。 模型 維度 語言 MRL（套娃式表示學習） 上下文 :------------------------: :-------: :-------------------------: :--------------: :-----: jina-embeddings-v3 1024 Multilingual (89 languages) Yes 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-en 768 English No 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-de 768 German & English No 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-es 768 Spanish & English No 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-zh 768 Chinese & English No 8192 推薦模型：jina-embeddings-v3 : 我們推薦 jina-embeddings-v3 作為來自 Jina AI 的最新且表現最佳的嵌入模型。此模型具有 5 個針對特定任務訓練的 adapter，基於其 backbone 進行訓練，以優化各種嵌入用例。 預設情況下，JinaEmbedding class 使用 jina-embeddings-v3。在 backbone 上，jina-embeddings-v3 已經使用 5 個針對不同嵌入用例的特定任務 adapter 進行訓練。 特定任務 adapter： 在您的請求中包含 task 以優化下游應用程式： - retrieval.query : 用於對檢索任務中的使用者查詢或問題進行編碼。 - retrieval.passage : 用於在索引時對大型 documents 進行編碼。 - classification : 用於對文本進行文本分類任務的編碼。 - text-matching : 用於對文本進行相似度匹配的編碼，例如衡量兩個句子之間的相似度。 - separation : 用於聚類或重新排序任務。 Matryoshka Representation Learning： jina-embeddings-v3 支援 Matryoshka Representation Learning，允許使用者在最小的性能損失下控制嵌入維度。在您的請求中包含 dimensions 以選擇所需的維度。預設情況下， dimensions 設定為 1024，建議的數值在 256 到 1024 之間。您可以參考下表以了解維度與性能的關係： 維度 32 64 128 256 512 768 1024 :--------------------------------------: :---: :---: :---: :---: :---: :--: :---: 平均檢索效能（nDCG\@10） 52.54 58.54 61.64 62.72 63.16 63.3 63.35 長上下文嵌入模型的延遲分塊 (Late Chunking) jina-embeddings-v3 支援 Late Chunking，這是一種利用模型的長上下文能力來生成上下文分塊嵌入的技術。在您的請求中包含 late chunking=True 以啟用上下文分塊表示。當設定為 true 時，Jina AI API 會將輸入欄位中的所有句子連接成一個字串並將其作為單一字串傳送給模型。在內部，模型會對這個長連接字串進行嵌入，然後執行 late chunking，返回一個與輸入列表大小相符的嵌入列表。 透過 JinaCLIP 嵌入圖像和查詢 API 您也可以使用 JinaEmbedding class 來對您的圖像和查詢進行編碼。 分批嵌入 您也可以分批嵌入文本，批次大小可以透過設定 embed batch size 參數來控制（如果未傳遞，預設值為 10，且不應大於 2048）。 讓我們使用 Jina AI Embeddings 建構一個 RAG pipeline 下載資料 匯入 載入資料 建置 index 建置 retriever
sourceText: If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. You may also need other packages that do not come direcly with llama-index For this example, you will need an API key which you can get from Embed text and queries with Jina embedding models through JinaAI API You can encode your text and your queries using the JinaEmbedding class. Jina offers a range of models adaptable to various use cases. Model Dimension Language MRL (matryoshka) Context :------------------------: :-------: :-------------------------: :--------------: :-----: jina-embeddings-v3 1024 Multilingual (89 languages) Yes 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-en 768 English No 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-de 768 German & English No 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-es 768 Spanish & English No 8192 jina-embeddings-v2-base-zh 768 Chinese & English No 8192 Recommended Model: jina-embeddings-v3 : We recommend jina-embeddings-v3 as the latest and most performant embedding model from Jina AI. This model features 5 task-specific adapters trained on top of its backbone, optimizing various embedding use cases. By default JinaEmbedding class uses jina-embeddings-v3. On top of the backbone, jina-embeddings-v3 has been trained with 5 task-specific adapters for different embedding uses. Task-Specific Adapters: Include task in your request to optimize your downstream application: - retrieval.query : Used to encode user queries or questions in retrieval tasks. - retrieval.passage : Used to encode large documents in retrieval tasks at indexing time. - classification : Used to encode text for text classification tasks. - text-matching : Used to encode text for similarity matching, such as measuring similarity between two sentences. - separation : Used for clustering or reranking tasks. Matryoshka Representation Learning : jina-embeddings-v3 supports Matryoshka Representation Learning, allowing users to control the embedding dimension with minimal performance loss.\ Include dimensions in your request to select the desired dimension.\ By default, dimensions is set to 1024, and a number between 256 and 1024 is recommended.\ You can reference the table below for hints on dimension vs. performance: Dimension 32 64 128 256 512 768 1024 :--------------------------------------: :---: :---: :---: :---: :---: :--: :---: Average Retrieval Performance (nDCG\@10) 52.54 58.54 61.64 62.72 63.16 63.3 63.35 Late Chunking in Long-Context Embedding Models jina-embeddings-v3 supports Late Chunking, the technique to leverage the model’s long-context capabilities for generating contextual chunk embeddings. Include late chunking=True in your request to enable contextual chunked representation. When set to true, Jina AI API will concatenate all sentences in the input field and feed them as a single string to the model. Internally, the model embeds this long concatenated string and then performs late chunking, returning a list of embeddings that matches the size of the input list. text: 探索 MixedBread AI 的 embedding model 搭配自訂編碼格式（binary、int、float、base64 等）、embedding dimension（Matryoshka）和 context prompts 的能力。 如果您在 colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 使用 prompt 進行上下文 embedding prompt 可以改善模型對 embedding 在後續任務中如何使用的理解，進而提高效能。我們的實驗顯示，使用特定領域的 prompt 可以提高效能。 Quantization 和 Matryoshka 支援 Mixedbread AI embedding 支援 quantization 和 matryoshka，以減小 embedding 的大小以獲得更好的儲存，同時保留大部分效能。請參閱這些文章以獲取更多資訊： - Binary 以及 Scalar Embedding Quantization 對於 Significantly Faster & Cheaper Retrieval - 64 每個 embedding 的位元組數，yee-haw。 使用不同的編碼格式 預設的 encoding format 是 float。我們也支援 float16、binary、ubinary、int8、uint8、base64。 使用不同的 embedding dimension Mixedbread AI embedding model 支援 Matryoshka dimension truncation。預設 dimension 設定為模型的最大值。請留意我們的網站以查看哪些 model 支援 Matryoshka。
sourceText: Explore the capabilities of MixedBread AI’s embedding models with custom encoding formats (binary, int, float, base64, etc.), embedding dimensions (Matryoshka) and context prompts. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Using prompt for contextual embedding The prompt can improve the model’s understanding of how the embedding will be used in subsequent tasks, which in turn increases the performance. Our experiments show that having domain specific prompts can increase the performance. Quantization and Matryoshka support The Mixedbread AI embedding supports quantization and matryoshka to reduce the size of embeddings for better storage while retaining most of the performance. See these posts for more information: - Binary and Scalar Embedding Quantization for Significantly Faster & Cheaper Retrieval - 64 bytes per embedding, yee-haw. Using different encoding formats The default encoding format is float. We also support float16, binary, ubinary, int8, uint8, base64. Using different embedding dimensions Mixedbread AI embedding models support Matryoshka dimension truncation. The default dimension is set to the model’s maximum. Keep an eye on our website to see what models support Matryoshka.

text: llama-index-embeddings-nvidia 套件包含 LlamaIndex 整合，用於使用 NVIDIA NIM 推理微服務上的模型來建構應用程式。NIM 支援來自社群以及 NVIDIA 的聊天、embedding 和 re-ranking 模型等各領域的模型。這些模型由 NVIDIA 進行優化，以在 NVIDIA 加速基礎設施上提供最佳效能，並以 NIM 的形式部署，這是一種易於使用、預先建置的容器，可使用單一指令在 NVIDIA 加速基礎設施上的任何地方部署。 NIM 的 NVIDIA 主機部署可於 NVIDIA API catalog 上進行測試。測試後，NIM 可以使用 NVIDIA AI Enterprise 授權從 NVIDIA 的 API catalog 中匯出，並在本地或雲端運行，讓企業擁有其 IP 和 AI 應用的所有權和完全控制權。 NIM 依據模型進行打包成容器映像，並透過 NVIDIA NGC Catalog 分發為 NGC container images。NIM 的核心是提供簡單、一致且熟悉的 API，用於在 AI 模型上執行推理。 安裝 設定 開始使用： 1. 在 NVIDIA 建立免費帳戶，該平台託管 NVIDIA AI Foundation 模型。 2. 選擇 Retrieval 標籤，然後選擇您選擇的模型。 3. 在 Input 下，選擇 Python 標籤，然後點擊 Get API Key。然後點擊 Generate Key。 4. 複製並儲存生成的金鑰為 NVIDIA API KEY。從那裡，您應該可以存取 endpoint。 使用 NVIDIA API Catalog 在初始化 embedding 模型時，您可以透過傳遞模型名稱（例如 NV-Embed-QA）來選擇模型，或不傳遞任何參數來使用預設模型。 此模型是一個經過微調的 E5-large 模型，支援預期的 Embeddings 方法，包括： - get query embedding：為查詢樣本生成查詢 embedding。 - get text embedding batch：為您想要搜尋的 documents 列表生成文本 embedding。 - 以及上述方法的非同步版本。 使用 NVIDIA NIMs 除了連接到託管的 NVIDIA NIMs 之外，此連接器還可用於連接到本地 NIM 實例。這有助於在需要時將您的應用程式本地化。 有關如何設定本地 NIM 實例的說明，請參閱 NVIDIA NIM。 相似度 以下是這些資料點的相似度快速測試： 查詢 (Queries)： - Komchatka 的天氣如何？ - 義大利以什麼食物聞名？ - 我的名字是什麼？我敢打賭你記不起來…… - 人生的意義到底是什麼？ - 人生的意義是為了享受樂趣 :D 文本 (Texts)： - Komchatka 的天氣很冷，冬季漫長而嚴酷。 - 義大利以義大利麵、披薩、冰淇淋和濃縮咖啡聞名。 - 我無法記住個人姓名，只能提供資訊。 - 人生的目的各不相同，通常被視為個人實現。 - 享受人生的瞬間確實是一種很棒的方法。 Embed queries Embed documents 現在我們已經生成了 embedding，我們可以對結果進行簡單的相似度檢查，看看哪個 documents 會在檢索任務中觸發出合理的答案： 提醒一下，發送到我們系統的查詢和 documents 是： 查詢 (Queries)： - “NONE”：預設選項。如果輸入過大會拋出例外。 - “START”：伺服器從開頭（左側）截斷輸入，必要時丟棄 token。 - “END”：伺服器從結尾（右側）截斷輸入，必要時丟棄 token。
sourceText: The llama-index-embeddings-nvidia package contains LlamaIndex integrations building applications with models on NVIDIA NIM inference microservice. NIM supports models across domains like chat, embedding, and re-ranking models from the community as well as NVIDIA. These models are optimized by NVIDIA to deliver the best performance on NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure and deployed as a NIM, an easy-to-use, prebuilt containers that deploy anywhere using a single command on NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure. NVIDIA hosted deployments of NIMs are available to test on the NVIDIA API catalog. After testing, NIMs can be exported from NVIDIA’s API catalog using the NVIDIA AI Enterprise license and run on-premises or in the cloud, giving enterprises ownership and full control of their IP and AI application. NIMs are packaged as container images on a per model basis and are distributed as NGC container images through the NVIDIA NGC Catalog. At their core, NIMs provide easy, consistent, and familiar APIs for running inference on an AI model. Installation Setup To get started: 1. Create a free account with NVIDIA, which hosts NVIDIA AI Foundation models. 2. Select the Retrieval tab, then select your model of choice. 3. Under Input select the Python tab, and click Get API Key. Then click Generate Key. 4. Copy and save the generated key as NVIDIA API KEY. From there, you should have access to the endpoints. Working with the NVIDIA API Catalog When initializing an embedding model, you can select a model by passing a model name (for example, NV-Embed-QA), or use the default by not passing any arguments. This model is a fine-tuned E5-large model which supports the expected Embeddings methods including: - get query embedding: Generate query embedding for a query sample. - get text embedding batch: Generate text embeddings for a list of documents which you would like to search over. - And asynchronous versions of the above. Working with NVIDIA NIMs In addition to connecting to hosted NVIDIA NIMs, this connector can be used to connect to local NIM instances. This helps you take your applications local when necessary. For instructions on how to set up local NIM instances, refer to NVIDIA NIM. Similarity The following is a quick test of the similarity for these data points: Queries: - What’s the weather like in Komchatka? - What kinds of food is Italy known for? - What’s my name? I bet you don’t remember… - What’s the point of life anyways? - The point of life is to have fun :D Texts: - Komchatka’s weather is cold, with long, severe winters. - Italy is famous for pasta, pizza, gelato, and espresso. - I can’t recall personal names, only provide information. - Life’s purpose varies, often seen as personal fulfillment. - Enjoying life’s moments is indeed a wonderful approach. Embed queries Embed documents Now that we’ve generated our embeddings, we can do a simple similarity check on the results to see which documents would have triggered as reasonable answers in a retrieval task: As a reminder, the queries and documents sent to our system were: Queries: - What’s the weather like in Komchatka? - What kinds of food is Italy known for? - What’s my name? I bet you don’t remember… - What’s the point of life anyways? - The point of life is to have fun :D Texts: - Komchatka’s weather is cold, with long, severe winters. - Italy is famous for pasta, pizza, gelato, and espresso. - I can’t recall personal names, only provide information. - Life’s purpose varies, often seen as personal fulfillment. - Enjoying life’s moments is indeed a wonderful approach. Truncation Embedding models typically have a fixed context window that determines the maximum number of input tokens that can be embedded. This limit could be a hard limit, equal to the model’s maximum input token length, or an effective limit, beyond which the accuracy of the embedding decreases. Since models operate on tokens and applications usually work with text, it can be challenging for an application to ensure that its input stays within the model’s token limits. By default, an exception is thrown if the input is too large. To assist with this, NVIDIA NIMs provide a truncate parameter that truncates the input on the server side if it’s too large. The truncate parameter has three options: - “NONE”: The default option. An exception is thrown if the input is too large. - “START”: The server truncates the input from the start (left), discarding tokens as necessary. - “END”: The server truncates the input from the end (right), discarding tokens as necessary.

sourceTitle: Oracle AI Vector Search: Generate Embeddings
text: Oracle AI Vector Search 專為人工智慧 (AI) 工作負載設計，讓您能夠根據語義而非關鍵字來查詢資料。Oracle AI Vector Search 的最大優勢之一是，可以在單一系統中將非結構化資料的語義搜尋與業務資料的關聯式搜尋結合。這不僅功能強大，而且效率也顯著更高，因為您無需新增專門的 vector database，從而消除了多個系統之間資料片段化的困擾。 此外，您的 vectors 可以受益於 Oracle Database 最強大的所有功能，例如： - Partitioning Support - Real Application Clusters scalability - Exadata smart scans - Shard processing across geographically distributed databases - Transactions - Parallel SQL - Disaster recovery - Security - Oracle Machine Learning - Oracle Graph Database - Oracle Spatial and Graph - Oracle Blockchain - JSON 本指南將演示如何使用 Oracle AI Vector Search 中的 Embedding Capabilities，使用 OracleEmbeddings 為您的 documents 生成 embeddings。 如果您剛開始使用 Oracle Database，請考慮探索 free Oracle 23 AI，它為設定您的資料庫環境提供了很好的入門介紹。在操作資料庫時，通常建議避免預設使用系統使用者；相反地，您可以建立自己的使用者以增強安全性與客製化。有關使用者建立的詳細步驟，請參閱我們的 端到端指南，該指南也展示了如何在 Oracle 中設定使用者。此外，了解使用者權限對於有效管理資料庫安全性至關重要。您可以在官方的 Oracle guide 中了解有關管理使用者帳戶和安全性的更多資訊。 先決條件 請確保已安裝 Oracle Python Client driver，以協助 llama\ index 與 Oracle AI Vector Search 的整合。 連線到 Oracle Database 以下範例程式碼將展示如何連線到 Oracle Database。預設情況下，python-oracledb 以 ‘Thin’ 模式運行，直接連線到 Oracle Database。此模式不需要 Oracle Client libraries。然而，當 python-oracledb 使用它們時，會提供額外的功能。當使用 Oracle Client libraries 時，Python-oracledb 被稱為 ‘Thick’ 模式。這兩種模式都具備全面功能，支援 Python Database API v2.0 Specification。請參閱以下 guide，其中說明了每種模式支援的功能。如果您無法使用 thin-mode，可能需要切換到 thick-mode。 對於 embedding 生成，使用者有幾種提供者選項可供選擇，包括在資料庫內進行 embedding 生成，以及 OcigenAI、Hugging Face 和 OpenAI 等第三方服務。選擇使用第三方提供者的使用者必須建立包含所需驗證資訊的憑證。或者，如果使用者選擇 ‘database’ 作為其提供者，則必須將 ONNX model 載入到 Oracle Database 中以協助 embedding。 載入 ONNX Model Oracle 支援多種 embedding provider，讓使用者可以在專有的資料庫解決方案和 OCIGENAI、HuggingFace 等第三方服務之間進行選擇。此選擇決定了生成和管理 embeddings 的方法。 重要 ：如果使用者選擇資料庫選項，則必須將 ONNX model 上傳到 Oracle Database 中。相反地，如果選擇第三方提供者進行 embedding 生成，則無需將 ONNX model 上傳到 Oracle Database。直接在 Oracle 中使用 ONNX 模型的一大優勢是它能透過消除向外部方傳輸資料的需求，提供增強的安全性與效能。此外，此方法避免了通常與 network 或 REST API 呼叫相關的延遲。 以下是將 ONNX 模型上傳到 Oracle Database 的範例程式碼： 建立憑證 當選擇第三方提供者來生成 embeddings 時，使用者需要建立憑證以安全地存取提供者的 endpoint。 重要： 選擇使用「database」提供者來生成 embeddings 時，不需要憑證。然而，如果使用者決定使用第三方提供者，則必須為所選的提供者建立特定的憑證。 以下是一個說明範例： 生成 Embeddings Oracle AI Vector Search 提供多種方法來生成 embeddings，可利用本地託管的 ONNX 模型或第三方 API。有關配置這些替代方案的完整說明，請參閱 Oracle AI 向量搜尋指南。 注意： 使用者可能需要配置 proxy 來使用第三方 embedding 生成提供者，但「database」提供者（使用 ONNX 模型）則不需要。 以下範例程式碼將展示如何生成 embeddings： 端到端示範 請參閱我們的完整示範指南 Oracle AI 向量搜尋 End-至-End Demo Guide，利用 Oracle AI Vector Search 建構一個端到端的 RAG pipeline。
sourceText: Oracle AI Vector Search is designed for Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads that allows you to query data based on semantics, rather than keywords. One of the biggest benefits of Oracle AI Vector Search is that semantic search on unstructured data can be combined with relational search on business data in one single system. This is not only powerful but also significantly more effective because you don’t need to add a specialized vector database, eliminating the pain of data fragmentation between multiple systems. In addition, your vectors can benefit from all of Oracle Database’s most powerful features, like the following: - Partitioning Support - Real Application Clusters scalability - Exadata smart scans - Shard processing across geographically distributed databases - Transactions - Parallel SQL - Disaster recovery - Security - Oracle Machine Learning - Oracle Graph Database - Oracle Spatial and Graph - Oracle Blockchain - JSON The guide demonstrates how to use Embedding Capabilities within Oracle AI Vector Search to generate embeddings for your documents using OracleEmbeddings. If you are just starting with Oracle Database, consider exploring the free Oracle 23 AI which provides a great introduction to setting up your database environment. While working with the database, it is often advisable to avoid using the system user by default; instead, you can create your own user for enhanced security and customization. For detailed steps on user creation, refer to our end-to-end guide which also shows how to set up a user in Oracle. Additionally, understanding user privileges is crucial for managing database security effectively. You can learn more about this topic in the official Oracle guide on administering user accounts and security. Prerequisites Ensure you have the Oracle Python Client driver installed to facilitate the integration of llama\ index with Oracle AI Vector Search. Connect to Oracle Database The following sample code will show how to connect to Oracle Database. By default, python-oracledb runs in a ‘Thin’ mode which connects directly to Oracle Database. This mode does not need Oracle Client libraries. However, some additional functionality is available when python-oracledb uses them. Python-oracledb is said to be in ‘Thick’ mode when Oracle Client libraries are used. Both modes have comprehensive functionality supporting the Python Database API v2.0 Specification. See the following guide that talks about features supported in each mode. You might want to switch to thick-mode if you are unable to use thin-mode. For embedding generation, several provider options are available to users, including embedding generation within the database and third-party services such as OcigenAI, Hugging Face, and OpenAI. Users opting for third-party providers must establish credentials that include the requisite authentication information. Alternatively, if users select ‘database’ as their provider, they are required to load an ONNX model into the Oracle Database to facilitate embeddings. Load ONNX Model Oracle accommodates a variety of embedding providers, enabling users to choose between proprietary database solutions and third-party services such as OCIGENAI and HuggingFace. This selection dictates the methodology for generating and managing embeddings. Important : Should users opt for the database option, they must upload an ONNX model into the Oracle Database. text: 由 Keval Dekivadiya 維護，TextEmbed 依 Apache-2.0 License 授權。 TextEmbed 是一個高吞吐量、低延遲的 REST API，專為提供 vector embeddings 而設計。它支援多種 sentence-transformer 模型和框架，適用於自然語言處理中的各種應用。 功能 - 高吞吐量與低延遲 (High Throughput & Low Latency) ：設計用於有效處理大量的請求。 - 靈活的模型支援 (Flexible Model Support) ：可與多種 sentence-transformer 模型協作。 - 可擴展性 (Scalable) ：輕鬆整合到大型系統中，並隨著需求擴展。 - 批次處理 (Batch Processing) ：支援批次處理以獲得更好、更快的推論 (inference)。 - OpenAI 相容的 REST API Endpoint ：提供一個 OpenAI 相容的 REST API endpoint。 - 單行指令部署 (Single Line Command Deployment) ：透過單一指令部署多個模型，實現高效部署。 - 支援 Embedding 格式 (Support for Embedding Formats) ：支援 binary、float16 和 float32 embedding 格式，以加快檢索速度。 開始使用 先決條件 (Prerequisites) 請確保已安裝 Python 3.10 或更高版本。您還需要安裝所需的依賴項 (dependencies)。 透過 PyPI 安裝 安裝所需的依賴項： 啟動 TextEmbed 伺服器 使用您想要的模型啟動 TextEmbed 伺服器： 使用 llama-index 的範例 以下是一個簡單的範例，讓您開始使用 llama-index： 欲了解更多資訊，請閱讀 文件。

統計是準確的。 注意 ：Anthropic 最近更新了其 token 統計的 API。在 Anthropic python 客戶端最新版本中，舊版模型如 claude-2.1 不再支援 token 統計。 基本用法 您可以傳遞一個 prompt 給 complete： 您也可以傳遞一組聊天訊息給 chat： Streaming Support 每個方法都透過 stream 前綴支援 Bedrock Support LlamaIndex 透過 AWS Bedrock 也支援 Anthropic 模型。 Multi-Modal Support 使用 ChatMessage 物件，您可以將圖片和文字傳遞給 LLM。 提示詞 快取 Anthropic 模型支援 prompt caching 的概念——如果一個 prompt 被重複多次，或 prompt 的開頭被重複，LLM 可以重用預先計算的 attention 結果來加快回應速度並降低成本。 要啟用 prompt caching，您可以將 cache control 設定在您的 ChatMessage 物件上，或將 cache idx 設定在 LLM 上，以始終快取前 X 則訊息（-1 代表所有訊息）。 Structured Prediction LlamaIndex 提供了一個直觀的介面，透過 streaming。 模型思考 使用 claude-3.7 Sonnet，您可以讓模型對任務「思考」得更深入，在寫出最終答案之前生成一個 chain-of-thought 回應。 您可以透過將 thinking dict 參數傳遞給 constructor 來啟用此功能，指定用於思考過程的 token 數量。 我們也可以暴露確切的思考過程： Tool/Function Calling Anthropic 透過 API 支援直接的 tool/function calling。使用 LlamaIndex，我們可以實作一些核心的 agentic tool calling 模式。 我們可以簡單地進行一次遍歷來呼叫 tool 並獲取結果： 我們也可以使用較底層的 API 來實作一個 agentic tool-calling loop！ Server-Side Tool Calling 在最新版本中，Anthropic 現在也支援 server-side tool calling。 以下是如何使用它的範例： Tool Calling + Citations 在 llama-index-core =0.12.46 + llama-index-llms-anthropic =0.7.6 中，我們新增了輸出可引用的 tool 結果的支援！使用 Anthropic，您現在可以利用伺服器端引用來引用工具結果的特定部分。 如果 LLM 引用了一個工具結果，該引用將以 CitationBlock 的形式出現在輸出中，其中包含來源、標題和被引用的內容。 讓我們看看實踐中可以這樣做的方法。 首先，我們定義一個回傳可引用區塊的虛擬工具/函式。 Agents + 可引用工具 您也可以直接在預建的 agents 中使用這些工具，例如 FunctionAgent，以在輸出中獲得相同的引用。 手動工具呼叫 + 引用 使用回傳可引用區塊的工具，我們可以手動在一個手動 agent 迴圈中呼叫 LLM，並提供該工具。 一旦 LLM 停止進行工具呼叫，我們就可以回傳最終回應並解析回應中的引用。
sourceText: Anthropic offers many state-of-the-art models from the haiku, sonnet, and opus families. Read on to learn how to use these models with LlamaIndex! If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Set Tokenizer First we want to set the tokenizer, which is slightly different than TikToken. This ensures that token counting is accurate throughout the library. NOTE : Anthropic recently updated their token counting API. Older models like claude-2.1 are no longer supported for token counting in the latest versions of the Anthropic python client. Basic Usage You can call complete with a prompt: You can also call chat with a list of chat messages: Streaming Support Every method supports streaming through the stream prefix. Async Usage Every synchronous method has an async counterpart. Vertex AI Support By providing the region and project id parameters (either through environment variables or directly), you can use an Anthropic model through Vertex AI. Do keep in mind that setting region and project\ id here will make Anthropic use the Vertex AI client Bedrock Support LlamaIndex also supports Anthropic models through AWS Bedrock. Multi-Modal Support Using ChatMessage objects, you can pass in images and text to the LLM. Prompt Caching Anthropic models support the idea of prompt cahcing — wherein if a prompt is repeated multiple times, or the start of a prompt is repeated, the LLM can reuse pre-calculated attention results to speed up the response and lower costs. To enable prompt caching, you can set cache control on your ChatMessage objects, or set cache idx on the LLM to always cache the first X messages (with -1 being all messages). Structured Prediction LlamaIndex provides an intuitive interface for converting any Anthropic LLMs into a structured LLM through structured predict - simply define the target Pydantic class (can be nested), and given a prompt, we extract out the desired object. Structured Prediction with Streaming Any LLM wrapped with as structured llm supports streaming through stream chat. Model Thinking With claude-3.7 Sonnet, you can enable the model to “think” harder about a task, generating a chain-of-thought response before writing out the final answer. You can enable this by passing in the thinking dict parameter to the constructor, specififying the amount of tokens to reserve for the thinking process. We can also expose the exact thinking process: Tool/Function Calling Anthropic supports direct tool/function calling through the API. Using LlamaIndex, we can implement some core agentic tool calling patterns. We can simply do a single pass to call the tool and get the result: We can also use lower-level APIs to implement an agentic tool-calling loop! Server-Side Tool Calling Anthropic now also supports server-side tool calling in latest versions. Here’s an example of how to use it: Tool Calling + Citations In llama-index-core =0.12.46 + llama-index-llms-anthropic =0.7.6, we’ve added support for outputting citable tool results! Using Anthropic, you can now utilize server-side citations to cite specific parts of your tool results. If the LLM cites a tool result, the citation will appear in the output as a CitationBlock, containing the source, title, and cited content. Let’s cover a few ways to do this in practice. First, let’s define a dummy tool/function that returns a citable block. Agents + Citable Tools You can also use these tools directly in pre-built agents, like the FunctionAgent, to get the same citations in the output. Manual Tool Calling + Citations Using our tool that returns a citable block, we can manually call the LLM with the given tool in a manual agent loop. Once the LLM stops making tool calls, we can return the final response and parse the citations from the response.

title: Anthropic 提示快取
text: 在本 Notebook 中，我們將演示如何使用 Anthropic Prompt Caching 與 LlamaIndex abstraction 進行使用。 透過在 messages request 中標記 cache control 來啟用 Prompt Caching。 Prompt Caching 的運作方式 當您啟用 Prompt Caching 發送請求時： 1. 系統會檢查提示前綴是否已從最近的查詢中快取。 2. 如果找到，則使用快取版本，減少處理時間和成本。 3. 否則，系統會處理完整的提示並將前綴快取以供未來使用。 注意： A. Prompt caching 可與 Claude 4 Opus、Claude 4 Sonnet、Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Claude 3.5 Haiku、Claude 3 Haiku 和 Claude 3 Opus 模型一起使用。 B. 最短可快取的提示長度為： C. 即使標記了 cache control，較短的提示也無法被快取。 設定 API Keys 設定 LLM 下載資料 在本次演示中，我們將使用 Paul Graham Essay 中的文字。我們將對該文字進行快取並基於它執行一些查詢。 載入資料 提示詞 快取 要啟用 prompt caching，您只需在 LlamaIndex 中使用 CachePoint 區塊：該區塊之前的內容都將被快取。 我們可以透過檢查以下參數來驗證文字是否已快取： cache creation input tokens: 建立新條目時寫入快取的 token 數量。 cache read input tokens: 針對本次請求從快取中檢索的 token 數量。 input tokens: 未從快取中讀取或用於建立快取的輸入 token 數量。 讓我們檢視原始回應。 如您所見，由於我運行了幾次不同的次數，cache creation input tokens 和 cache read input tokens 的值都大於零，這表示文字已正確快取。 現在，讓我們對同一個 document 執行另一個查詢。它應該會從快取中檢索 document 的文字，這將反映在 cache read input tokens 中。 如您所見，回應是使用快取文字生成的，如 cache read input tokens 所示。 使用 Anthropic，預設快取持續時間為 5 分鐘。您也可以設定更長的快取時間，例如 1 小時，只需在 CachControl 中的 ttl 參數中指定即可。
sourceText: In this Notebook, we will demonstrate the usage of Anthropic Prompt Caching with LlamaIndex abstractions. Prompt Caching is enabled by marking cache control in the messages request. How Prompt Caching works When you send a request with Prompt Caching enabled: 1. The system checks if the prompt prefix is already cached from a recent query. 2. If found, it uses the cached version, reducing processing time and costs. 3. Otherwise, it processes the full prompt and caches the prefix for future use. Note: A. Prompt caching works with Claude 4 Opus, Claude 4 Sonnet, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Claude 3 Haiku and Claude 3 Opus models. B. The minimum cacheable prompt length is: C. Shorter prompts cannot be cached, even if marked with cache control. Setup API Keys Setup LLM Download Data In this demonstration, we will use the text from the Paul Graham Essay. We will cache the text and run some queries based on it. Load Data Prompt Caching To enable prompt caching, you can just use the CachePoint block within LlamaIndex: everything previous to that block will be cached. We can verify if the text is cached by checking the following parameters: cache creation input tokens: Number of tokens written to the cache when creating a new entry. cache read input tokens: Number of tokens retrieved from the cache for this request. input tokens: Number of input tokens which were not read from or used to create a cache. Let’s examine the raw response. As you can see, since I’ve ran this a few different times, cache creation input tokens and cache read input tokens are both higher than zero, indicating that the text was cached properly. Now, let’s run another query on the same document. It should retrieve the document text from the cache, which will be reflected in cache read input tokens. As you can see, the response was generated using cached text, as indicated by cache read input tokens. With Anthropic, the default cache lasts 5 minutes. You can also have longer lasting caches, for instance 1 hour, you just have to specify that under the ttl argument in CachControl.

text: ASI1-Mini 是由 fetch.ai 開發的先進的 agentic LLM，fetch.ai 是分散式運作人工超級智慧聯盟 (Artificial Superintelligence Alliance for decentralized operations) 的創始成員。其獨特的架構使其能夠執行任務並與其他 agents 協作，在複雜環境中實現高效、適應性的問題解決。 本筆筆記演示如何使用 ASI 模型與 LlamaIndex 互動。它涵蓋了各種功能，包括基本完成 (completion)、chat、streaming、function calling、structured prediction、RAG 等。如果您在 colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 設定 首先，讓我們安裝所需的套件： 設定 API 金鑰 您需要為 ASI 設定您的 API 金鑰，如果想比較兩者，則可選擇性地為 OpenAI 設定金鑰： 基本完成 (Basic Completion) 讓我們從使用 ASI 進行基本完成的範例開始： Chat 現在讓我們嘗試 chat 功能： Streaming ASI 支援 chat 回應的 streaming： 使用 stream chat endpoint 使用 stream complete endpoint Image Support 對於許多模型，ASI 對 chat 訊息輸入中的圖片提供支援。 使用 chat 訊息的 content blocks 功能，您可以輕鬆地在單一 LLM prompt 中組合文字和圖片。 Function Calling/Tool Calling ASI LLM 具備原生的 function calling 支援。這方便地整合了 LlamaIndex tool abstractions，讓您可以將任何任意的 Python function 插入到 LLM 中。 在下面的範例中，我們定義了一個用於生成 Song object 的 function。 嚴格的 parameter 會告知 ASI 是否在生成 tool calls/structured outputs 時使用 constrained sampling。這意味著生成的 tool call schema 將始終包含預期的欄位。 由於這似乎會增加延遲，它預設為 false。 手動 Tool Calling 雖然使用 predict and call 的自動 tool calling 提供了一種簡化的體驗，但手動 tool calling 讓您對流程擁有更多控制權。使用手動 tool calling，您可以： 1. 明確控制何時以及如何呼叫工具 2. 在繼續對話前處理中間結果 3. 實作自訂的錯誤處理和備援策略 4. 在特定順序中串接多個 tool calls ASI 支援手動 tool calling，但與某些其他 LLMs 相比，需要更具體的提示。為了獲得 ASI 的最佳結果，請包含一個解釋可用工具的 system message，並在您的 user prompt 中提供特定的參數。 以下範例演示了使用 ASI 手動 tool calling 來生成一首歌： Structured Prediction 您可以使用 ASI 從文字中提取結構化資料： 注意： 目前 ASI 不支援 structured streaming。 Async ASI 支援 async 操作： 簡單 RAG 讓我們使用 ASI 實作一個簡單的 RAG 應用程式： LlamaCloud RAG 如果您有 LlamaCloud 帳戶，您可以使用 ASI 與 LlamaCloud 進行 RAG： 在每個實例層級設定 API 金鑰 如果需要，您可以讓不同的 LLM 實例使用不同的 API 金鑰： 額外的 kwargs與其在每次 chat 或 completion call 中都添加相同的參數，您可以在 per-instance 層級使用 additional\ kwargs 來設定它們： 結論 本筆 notebook 演示了如何使用 ASI 與 LlamaIndex 的各種方式。此整合支援 LlamaIndex 中大部分的功能，包括： - 基本 completion 和 chat - Streaming responses - Multimodal support - Function calling - Structured prediction - Async operations - RAG applications - LlamaCloud integration - Per-instance API keys - Additional kwargs 請注意，目前 ASI 不支援 structured streaming。
sourceText: ASI1-Mini is an advanced, agentic LLM designed by fetch.ai, a founding member of Artificial Superintelligence Alliance for decentralized operations. Its unique architecture empowers it to execute tasks and collaborate with other agents for efficient, adaptable problem-solving in complex environments. This notebook demonstrates how to use ASI models with LlamaIndex. It covers various functionalities including basic completion, chat, streaming, function calling, structured prediction, RAG, and more. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Setup First, let’s install the required packages: Setting API Keys You’ll need to set your API keys for ASI and optionally for OpenAI if you want to compare the two: Basic Completion Let’s start with a basic completion example using ASI: Chat Now let’s try chat functionality: Streaming ASI supports streaming for chat responses: Using stream chat endpoint Using stream complete endpoint Image Support ASI has support for images in the input of chat messages for many models. Using the content blocks feature of chat messages, you can easily combone text and images in a single LLM prompt. Function Calling/Tool Calling ASI LLM have native support for function calling. This conveniently integrates with LlamaIndex tool abstractions, letting you plug in any arbitrary Python function to the LLM. In the example below, we define a function to generate a Song object. The strict parameter tells ASI whether or not to use constrained sampling when generating tool calls/structured outputs. This means that the generated tool call schema will always contain the expected fields. Since this seems to increase latency, it defaults to false. Manual Tool Calling While automatic tool calling with predict and call provides a streamlined experience, manual tool calling gives you more control over the process. With manual tool calling, you can: 1. Explicitly control when and how tools are called 2. Process intermediate results before continuing the conversation 3. Implement custom error handling and fallback strategies 4. Chain multiple tool calls together in a specific sequence ASI supports manual tool calling, but requires more specific prompting compared to some other LLMs. For best results with ASI, include a system message that explains the available tools and provide specific parameters in your user prompt. The following example demonstrates manual tool calling with ASI to generate a song: Structured Prediction You can use ASI to extract structured data from text: Note: Structured streaming is currently not supported with ASI. Async ASI supports async operations: Simple RAG Let’s implement a simple RAG application with ASI: LlamaCloud RAG If you have a LlamaCloud account, you can use ASI with LlamaCloud for RAG: Set API Key at a per-instance level If desired, you can have separate LLM instances use separate API keys: Additional kwargs Rather than adding the same parameters to each chat or completion call, you can set them at a per-instance level with additional\ kwargs: Conclusion This notebook demonstrates the various ways you can use ASI with LlamaIndex. The integration supports most of the functionality available in LlamaIndex, including: - Basic completion and chat - Streaming responses - Multimodal support - Function calling - Structured prediction - Async operations - RAG applications - LlamaCloud integration - Per-instance API keys - Additional kwargs Note that structured streaming is currently not supported with ASI.

sourceText: This notebook explains how to use llama-index-llm-azure-inference package with models deployed with the Azure AI model inference API in Azure AI studio or Azure Machine Learning. The package also support GitHub Models (Preview) endpoints. If you’re opening this notebook on Google Colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Prerequisites The Azure AI model inference is an API that allows developers to get access to a variety of models hosted on Azure AI using a consistent schema. You can use llama-index-llms-azure-inference integration package with models that support this API, including models deployed to Azure AI serverless API endpoints and a subset of models from Managed Inference. To read more about the API specification and the models that support it see Azure AI model inference API. To run this tutorial you need: 1. Create an Azure subscription. 2. Create an Azure AI hub resource as explained at How to create and manage an Azure AI Studio hub. 3. Deploy one model supporting the Azure AI model inference API. In this example we use a Mistral-Large deployment. - You can follow the instructions at Deploy models as serverless APIs. Alternatively, you can use GitHub Models endpoints with this integration, including the free tier experience. Read more about GitHub models. Environment Setup Follow this steps to get the information you need from the model you want to use: 1. Go to the Azure AI Foundry (formerly Azure AI Studio) or Azure Machine Learning studio, depending on the product you are using. 2. Go to deployments (endpoints in Azure Machine Learning) and select the model you have deployed as indicated in the prerequisites. 3. Copy the endpoint URL and the key. If your model was deployed with Microsoft Entra ID support, you don’t need a key. In this scenario, we have placed both the endpoint URL and key in the following environment variables: Connect to your deployment and endpoint To use LLMs deployed in Azure AI studio or Azure Machine Learning you need the endpoint and credentials to connect to it. Alternatively, if you endpoint support Microsoft Entra ID, you can use the following code to create the client: Note: When using Microsoft Entra ID, make sure that the endpoint was deployed with that authentication method and that you have the required permissions to invoke it. title: Baseten Cookbook
text: Model APIs 與專屬部署 Baseten 提供兩種主要的推論方式。 1. Model APIs 是給熱門開源模型的公開 endpoint（如 GPT-OSS, Kimi K2, DeepSeek 等），您可以直接透過 slug 使用前沿模型，例如 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324，並且會依據 token 數量計費。您可以在此處找到支援的模型列表： 。 2. 專屬部署適用於服務自訂模型，您希望對生產工作負載進行自動擴展（autoscale）並擁有細緻的配置（fine-grain configuration）。您需要在 Baseten dashboard 中部署模型，並提供 8 個字元的模型 ID，例如 abcd1234。 預設情況下，我們將 model apis 參數設定為 True。如果您想使用專屬部署，在實例化 Baseten 物件時，必須將 model apis 參數設定為 False。 實例化 (Instantiation) 使用 prompt 呼叫 complete 使用訊息列表呼叫 chat Streaming 使用 stream complete endpoint 使用 stream chat endpoint Async Async 操作用於長時間運行的推論任務，這些任務可能會遇到請求超時（request timeouts）、批次推論工作（batch inference jobs），以及對特定請求的優先處理。 (1) 在整合中，acomplete async function 使用 aiohttp 函式庫，在 python 中的一個異步 HTTP client。該函式會呼叫適當的 Baseten model endpoint 上的 async\ predict，如果成功，使用者會收到帶有 request\ id 的回應。使用者可以透過回傳的 request\ id 檢查狀態或取消 async\ predict 請求。 (2) 一旦模型完成請求的執行，async 結果會發送到使用者提供的 webhook endpoint。使用者的 endpoint 負責驗證 webhook 簽名以確保安全性，然後處理並儲存輸出。 Baseten: 取得 request\ id → 結果發送到 webhook 注意：Async 僅適用於專屬部署，不適用於 Model APIs。achat 不支援，因為聊天（chat）不適用於 async 操作。
sourceText: Model APIs vs. Dedicated Deployments Baseten offers two main ways for inference. 1. Model APIs are public endpoints for popular open source models (GPT-OSS, Kimi K2, DeepSeek etc) where you can directly use a frontier model via slug e.g. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3-0324 and you will be charged on a per-token basis. You can find the list of supported models here: . 2. Dedicated deployments are useful for serving custom models where you want to autoscale production workloads and have fine-grain configuration. You need to deploy a model in your Baseten dashboard and provide the 8 character model id like abcd1234. By default, we set the model apis parameter to True. If you want to use a dedicated deployment, you must set the model apis parameter to False when instantiating the Baseten object. Instantiation Call complete with a prompt Call chat with a list of messages Streaming Using stream complete endpoint Using stream chat endpoint Async Async operations are used for long-running inference tasks that may hit request timeouts, batch inference jobs, and prioritizing certain requests. (1) In the integation, acomplete async function is implemented using the aiohttp library, an asynchronous HTTP client in python. The function invokes the async\ predict at the approriate Baseten model endpoint, then the user receives a response with the request\ id if successful. The user can then check the status or cancel the async\ predict request using the returned request\ id. (2) Once the model finishes executing the request, the async result will be posted to the user provided webhook endpoint. The user’s endpoint is responsible for validating the webhook signature for security, then processing and storing the output. Baseten: Get request\ id → result is posted to webhook Note: Async is only available for dedicated deployments and not for model APIs. achat is not supported because chat does not make sense for async operations.

title: Cleanlab 可信賴語言模型
text: Cleanlab 的 Trustworthy Language Model 會即時評估每個 LLM 回應的可靠性，使用最先進的不確定性估計方法來評估 LLMs。在應用程式中，若未經檢查的幻覺（hallucinations）和其他 LLM 錯誤會導致應用程式無法運行，因此信任評分至關重要。 本頁演示了如何使用 TLM 來取代您自己的 LLM，以生成回應並評估其可靠性。不過，使用 TLM 並非唯一的方法。若要將信任評分加入到您現有的未修改的 RAG 應用程式中，您可以參考 此 Trustworthy RAG 教程。除了 RAG 應用程式之外，您還可以透過 TLM.get trustworthiness score() 評估任何 LLM 已生成的回應的可靠性。 請在 Cleanlab 文件 中了解更多資訊。 設定 如果您在 Colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 您也會在 additional kwargs 中獲得上述回應的信任分數。TLM 會自動為所有 \ 配對計算此分數。 高分表示 LLM 的回應可以被信任。我們再舉一個例子。 低分表示不應信任 LLM 的回應。 從這兩個簡單的範例中，我們可以觀察到得分最高的 LLM 的回應是直接、準確且恰當詳細的。另一方面，信任分數低的 LLM 的回應會傳達無幫助或事實不準確的答案，有時被稱為幻覺（hallucinations）。 串流 (Streaming) Cleanlab 的 TLM 原生不支援同時串流回應和信任分數。然而，有另一種方法可以實現低延遲的串流回應，可用於您的應用程式。 有關此方法的詳細資訊和範例程式碼，請參閱 這裡。 TLM 的進階使用 TLM 可以配置以下選項： - model : 要使用的底層 LLM - max\ tokens : 在回應中生成的最大 token 數 - num\ candidate\ responses : TLM 內部生成的替代候選回應的數量 - num\ consistency\ samples : 用於評估 LLM-response-consistency 的內部採樣量 - use\ self\ reflection : 是否要求 LLM 對其生成的回應進行自我反思並自我評估此回應 - log : 指定要返回的額外元數據。在此處包含 “explanation” 可以取得回應為何被評為低信任度的解釋 這些配置在初始化時作為一個 dictionary 傳遞給 CleanlabTLM 物件。 有關這些選項的更多詳細資訊可參閱 Cleanlab 的 API documentation，而這些選項的幾個使用案例則在 此 notebook 中進行探討。 讓我們考慮一個應用程式需要使用 gpt-4 模型並以 128 輸出 token 的範例。 要了解為什麼 TLM 對先前與馬力相關的問題估計了低信任度，請在初始化 TLM 時指定 "explanation" 標誌。
sourceText: Cleanlab’s Trustworthy Language Model scores the trustworthiness of every LLM response in real-time, using state-of-the-art uncertainty estimates for LLMs. Trust scoring is crucial for applications where unchecked hallucinations and other LLM errors are a show-stopper. This page demonstrates how to use TLM in place of your own LLM, to both generate responses and score their trustworthiness. That’s not the only way to use TLM though. To add trust scoring to your existing unmodified RAG application, you can instead see this Trustworthy RAG tutorial. Beyond RAG applications, you can score the trustworthiness of responses already generated from any LLM via TLM.get trustworthiness score(). Learn more in the Cleanlab documentation. Setup If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. You also get the trustworthiness score of the above response in additional kwargs. TLM automatically computes this score for all the \ pair. A high score indicates that LLM’s response can be trusted. Let’s take another example here. A low score indicates that the LLM’s response shouldn’t be trusted. From these 2 straightforward examples, we can observe that the LLM’s responses with the highest scores are direct, accurate, and appropriately detailed.\ On the other hand, LLM’s responses with low trustworthiness score convey unhelpful or factually inaccurate answers, sometimes referred to as hallucinations. Streaming Cleanlab’s TLM does not natively support streaming both the response and the trustworthiness score. However, there is an alternative approach available to achieve low-latency, streaming responses that can be used for your application.\ Detailed information about the approach, along with example code, is available here. Advance use of TLM TLM can be configured with the following options: - model : underlying LLM to use - max\ tokens : maximum number of tokens to generate in the response - num\ candidate\ responses : number of alternative candidate responses internally generated by TLM - num\ consistency\ samples : amount of internal sampling to evaluate LLM-response-consistency - use\ self\ reflection : whether the LLM is asked to self-reflect upon the response it generated and self-evaluate this response - log : specify additional metadata to return. include “explanation” here to get explanations of why a response is scored with low trustworthiness These configurations are passed as a dictionary to the CleanlabTLM object during initialization.\ More details about these options can be referred from Cleanlab’s API documentation and a few use-cases of these options are explored in this notebook. Let’s consider an example where the application requires gpt-4 model with 128 output tokens. To understand why the TLM estimated low trustworthiness for the previous horsepower related question, specify the "explanation" flag when initializing the TLM.

title: Google GenAI
text: 在本筆 Notebook 中，我們將展示如何使用 google-genai Python SDK 與 LlamaIndex 互動，以與 Google GenAI 模型互動。 如果您在 Colab 中開啟此 Notebook，您需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙 和 google-genai Python SDK。 基本用法 您需要從 Google AI Studio 取得一個 API key。取得後，您可以選擇明確地傳遞給模型，或使用 GOOGLE API KEY environment variable。 基本用法 您可以傳遞一個 prompt 給 complete： 您也可以傳遞一組聊天訊息給 chat： Streaming Support 每個方法都透過 stream prefix 支援串流。 Async Usage 每個同步方法都有一個 async 對應方法。 Vertex AI Support 透過提供 region 和 project id 參數（透過 environment variables 或直接），您可以啟用透過 Vertex AI 的使用。 Cached Content Support Google GenAI 支援快取內容，以便在多次請求中重複使用大型 context 時，提升效能和成本效益。這對於 RAG 應用程式、document 分析以及具有一致 context 的多輪對話特別有用。 優點 - 更快的回應 - 透過減少輸入 token 使用量來 節省成本 - 跨多個查詢保持 一致的 context - 非常適合 使用大型檔案進行 document 分析 建立快取內容 首先，使用 Google GenAI SDK 建立快取內容： 選項 1：上傳本地檔案 選項 2：帶有內容結構的多個檔案 使用 LlamaIndex 進行快取內容： 快取建立後，使用 LlamaIndex 進行使用： 在生成配置中使用快取內容： 用於請求級別的快取控制： 快取管理 Multi-Modal Support 使用 ChatMessage 物件，您可以將圖片和文字傳遞給 LLM。 您也可以傳遞 documents。 最後，您也可以傳遞影片。 Structured Prediction LlamaIndex 提供了一個直觀的介面，透過 structured predict 將任何 LLM 轉換為結構化的 LLM——只需定義目標 Pydantic class（可以巢狀），並給定一個 prompt，我們就能提取出所需的物件。 帶有串流的結構化預測 任何用 as structured llm 包裹的 LLM 支援透過 stream chat 串流。 Tool/Function Calling Google GenAI 透過 API 支援直接的 tool/function calling。使用 LlamaIndex，我們可以實作一些核心的 agentic tool calling 模式。 我們可以簡單地進行一次遍歷來呼叫工具並取得結果： 我們也可以使用較底層的 API 來實作一個 agentic tool-calling loop！ 我們也可以在單一請求中同時呼叫多個工具，這對於需要不同類型資訊的複雜查詢非常有效率。 Google Search Grounding Google Gemini 2.0 和 2.5 模型支援 Google Search grounding，這允許模型搜尋即時資訊並以網頁搜尋結果為基礎來錨定其回應。這對於獲取最新資訊特別有用。built in tool 參數接受 Google Search 工具，使模型能夠以 Google Search 結果中的真實世界資料來為其回應提供依據。 Google Search grounding tool 提供以下幾項優勢： - 即時資訊 (Real-time information) ：存取最新事件和最新資料 - 事實準確性 (Factual accuracy) ：回應基於實際的搜尋結果 - 來源歸屬 (Source attribution) ：Grounding metadata 包含搜尋來源 - 自動搜尋決策 (Automatic search decisions) ：模型根據查詢決定何時需要搜尋 您也可以使用 grounding tool 與 chat messages 一起使用： Code Execution built in tool 參數也接受 code execution tools，使模型能夠撰寫並執行 Python code 來解決問題、執行計算和分析資料。這對於數學運算、資料分析和生成視覺化特別有用。 存取 Code Execution 詳情 當模型使用 code execution 時，您可以透過 raw response 存取已執行的 code、結果和其他 metadata。這包括： - executable\ code ：實際執行的 Python code - code\ execution\ result ：執行 code 的輸出結果 - text ：模型的解釋和評論 讓我們實際操作一下： Image Generation 選擇模型也支援影像輸出，以及影像輸入。使用 response modalities config，我們可以使用 Gemini model 來生成和編輯影像！ png 我們也可以編輯影像！ png
sourceText: In this notebook, we show how to use the google-genai Python SDK with LlamaIndex to interact with Google GenAI models. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will need to install LlamaIndex 🦙 and the google-genai Python SDK. Basic Usage You will need to get an API key from Google AI Studio. Once you have one, you can either pass it explicity to the model, or use the GOOGLE API KEY environment variable. Basic Usage You can call complete with a prompt: You can also call chat with a list of chat messages: Streaming Support Every method supports streaming through the stream prefix. Async Usage Every synchronous method has an async counterpart. Vertex AI Support By providing the region and project id parameters (either through environment variables or directly), you can enable usage through Vertex AI. Cached Content Support Google GenAI supports cached content for improved performance and cost efficiency when reusing large contexts across multiple requests. This is particularly useful for RAG applications, document analysis, and multi-turn conversations with consistent context. Benefits - Faster responses - Cost savings through reduced input token usage - Consistent context across multiple queries - Perfect for document analysis with large files Creating Cached Content First, create cached content using the Google GenAI SDK: Option 1: Upload Local Files Option 2: Multiple Files with Content Structure Using Cached Content with LlamaIndex Once you have created the cache, use it with LlamaIndex: Using Cached Content in Generation Config For request-level caching control: Cache Management Multi-Modal Support Using ChatMessage objects, you can pass in images and text to the LLM. You can also pass in documents. Finally, you can also pass videos. Structured Prediction LlamaIndex provides an intuitive interface for converting any LLM into a structured LLM through structured predict - simply define the target Pydantic class (can be nested), and given a prompt, we extract out the desired object. Structured Prediction with Streaming Any LLM wrapped with as structured llm supports streaming through stream chat. Tool/Function Calling Google GenAI supports direct tool/function calling through the API. Using LlamaIndex, we can implement some core agentic tool calling patterns. We can simply do a single pass to call the tool and get the result: We can also use lower-level APIs to implement an agentic tool-calling loop! We can also call multiple tools simultaneously in a single request, making it efficient for complex queries that require different types of information. Google Search Grounding Google Gemini 2.0 and 2.5 models support Google Search grounding, which allows the model to search for real-time information and ground its responses with web search results. This is particularly useful for getting up-to-date information. The built in tool parameter accepts Google Search tools that enable the model to ground its responses with real-world data from Google Search results. The Google Search grounding tool provides several benefits: - Real-time information : Access to current events and up-to-date data - Factual accuracy : Responses grounded in actual search results - Source attribution : Grounding metadata includes search sources - Automatic search decisions : The model determines when to search based on the query You can also use the grounding tool with chat messages: Code Execution The built in tool parameter also accepts code execution tools that enable the model to write and execute Python code to solve problems, perform calculations, and analyze data. This is particularly useful for mathematical computations, data analysis, and generating visualizations. Accessing Code Execution Details When the model uses code execution, you can access the executed code, results, and other metadata through the raw response. This includes: - executable\ code : The actual Python code that was executed - code\ execution\ result : The output from running the code - text : The model’s explanation and commentary Let’s see this in action: Image Generation Select models also support image outputs, as well as image inputs. Using the response modalities config, we can generate and edit images with a Gemini model! png We can also edit the image! png

sourceText: Welcome to Groq! 🚀 At Groq, we’ve developed the world’s first Language Processing Unit™, or LPU. The Groq LPU has a deterministic, single core streaming architecture that sets the standard for GenAI inference speed with predictable and repeatable performance for any given workload. Beyond the architecture, our software is designed to empower developers like you with the tools you need to create innovative, powerful AI applications. With Groq as your engine, you can: - Achieve uncompromised low latency and performance for real-time AI and HPC inferences 🔥 - Know the exact performance and compute time for any given workload 🔮 - Take advantage of our cutting-edge technology to stay ahead of the competition 💪 Want more Groq? Check out our website for more resources and join our Discord community to connect with our developers! Setup If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. title: Hugging Face 大型語言模型
text: 您可以透過多種方式使用 Hugging Face 的 LLM，既可在本機執行，也可使用 Hugging Face 的 Inference Providers。Hugging Face 提供多個 Python 套件來連接這些服務，而 LlamaIndex 會將它們包裝成 LLM 實體： - transformers 套件：使用 llama index.llms.HuggingFaceLLM - Hugging Face Inference Providers，由 [huggingface hub[inference]](https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface hub) 包裝：使用 llama index.llms.HuggingFaceInferenceAPI 上述兩種方式可以有許多組合，因此這份筆記只介紹幾種常見做法。以下以 Hugging Face 的 Text Generation 任務 為例。 先安裝這個示範所需的套件： - transformers[torch] 是 HuggingFaceLLM 所需的套件。 - huggingface hub[inference] 是 HuggingFaceInferenceAPI 所需的套件。 - 在 Z shell (zsh) 中執行時，需要為參數加上引號。 如果您在 Colab 開啟這份筆記，可能需要先安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 環境準備完成後，就來試用看看： 設定 Hugging Face 帳戶 首先，請建立 Hugging Face 帳戶並取得 token。您可以在此註冊，接著在此建立 token。 終端機視窗 透過 Inference Providers 使用模型 使用開源模型最簡單的方式，是透過 Hugging Face 的 Inference Providers。以下以適合處理複雜任務的 DeepSeek R1 模型為例。 透過這些推論服務，您可以在無伺服器架構上執行模型，不必自行管理推論主機。 您也可以指定偏好的推論服務提供者；此處使用 together provider。 在本機使用開源模型 首先使用一個適合本機推論的開源模型。第一次呼叫時，模型會下載到本機的 Hugging Face 模型快取；之後便會使用您電腦上的硬體執行。 以下使用適合本機推論的 Gemma 3N E4B 模型。 使用專用的 Inference Endpoint 您也可以為模型啟用專用的 Inference Endpoint，並透過該端點執行模型。 使用本機推論引擎（vLLM 或 TGI） 您也可以使用本機推論引擎執行模型，例如 vLLM 或 TGI。 透過 HuggingFaceInferenceAPI 執行文字補全時，底層使用的是 Hugging Face 的 Text Generation 任務。 設定分詞器 如果您修改了 LLM，也應同步調整全域分詞器（tokenizer）。 Hugging Face Inference API 也包裝了其他任務，例如： - llama index.llms.HuggingFaceInferenceAPI.chat：對話任務 - llama index.embeddings.HuggingFaceInferenceAPIEmbedding：特徵擷取任務 此外，也支援透過以下套件使用 Hugging Face 嵌入模型： - transformers[torch]：由 HuggingFaceEmbedding 包裝。 - huggingface hub[inference]：由 HuggingFaceInferenceAPIEmbedding 包裝。 以上兩種方式都繼承自 llama index.embeddings.base.BaseEmbedding。
sourceText: There are many ways to interface with LLMs from Hugging Face, either locally or via Hugging Face’s Inference Providers. Hugging Face itself provides several Python packages to enable access, which LlamaIndex wraps into LLM entities: - The transformers package: use llama index.llms.HuggingFaceLLM - The Hugging Face Inference Providers, [wrapped by huggingface hub[inference]](https://github.com/huggingface/huggingface hub): use llama index.llms.HuggingFaceInferenceAPI There are many possible permutations of these two, so this notebook only details a few. Let’s use Hugging Face’s Text Generation task as our example. In the below line, we install the packages necessary for this demo: - transformers[torch] is needed for HuggingFaceLLM - huggingface hub[inference] is needed for HuggingFaceInferenceAPI - The quotes are needed for Z shell (zsh) If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Now that we’re set up, let’s play around: Setup Hugging Face Account First, you need to create a Hugging Face account and get a token. You can sign up here. Then you’ll need to create a token here. Terminal window Use a model via Inference Providers The easiest way to use an open source model is to use the Hugging Face Inference Providers. Let’s use the DeepSeek R1 model, which is great for complex tasks. With inference providers, you can use the model on serverless infrastructure from inference providers. We can also specify our preferred inference provider. Let’s use the together provider. Use an open source model locally First, we’ll use an open source model that’s optimized for local inference. This model is downloaded (if first invocation) to the local Hugging Face model cache, and actually runs the model on your local machine’s hardware. We’ll use the Gemma 3N E4B model, which is optimized for local inference. Use a dedicated Inference Endpoint We can also spin up a dedicated Inference Endpoint for a model and use that to run the model. Use a local inference engine (vLLM or TGI) We can also use a local inference engine like vLLM or TGI to run the model. Underlying a completion with HuggingFaceInferenceAPI is Hugging Face’s Text Generation task. Setting a tokenizer If you are modifying the LLM, you should also change the global tokenizer to match! If you’re curious, other Hugging Face Inference API tasks wrapped are: - llama index.llms.HuggingFaceInferenceAPI.chat: Conversational task - llama index.embeddings.HuggingFaceInferenceAPIEmbedding: Feature Extraction task And yes, Hugging Face embedding models are supported with: - transformers[torch]: wrapped by HuggingFaceEmbedding - huggingface hub[inference]: wrapped by HuggingFaceInferenceAPIEmbedding Both of the above two subclass llama index.embeddings.base.BaseEmbedding.

text: 使用 llamafile 是在本地運行 LLM 的最簡單方法。llamafile 將模型權重和一個 特別編譯 的 llama.cpp 打包成一個單一檔案，可以在大多數電腦上運行，無需額外的依賴項。它們還附帶一個嵌入式的 inference server，提供一個用於與您的模型互動的 API。 設定 1. 從 HuggingFace 下載一個 llamafile 2. 使檔案可執行 3. 運行檔案 以下是一個顯示所有 3 個設定步驟的簡單 bash 腳本： Terminal 視窗 您的模型的 inference server 預設監聽在 localhost:8080。 如果您在 colab 上打開此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 警告：TinyLlama 對 Octavia Butler 的描述中包含許多不實資訊。 例如，她出生於加州，而不是賓夕法尼亞州。關於她的家庭和教育的資訊是幻覺。她沒有擔任小學教師。相反地，她接了一系列臨時工作，使她能專注於寫作。她的作品並未「迅速獲得認可」：她大約在 1970 年出版了第一篇短篇小說，但直到 14 年後才獲得知名度，當時她的短篇小說《Speech Sounds》在 1984 年贏得了 Hugo Award。請參閱 Wikipedia 以獲取 Octavia Butler 的真實傳記。 我們在這個範例 Notebook 中主要使用 TinyLlama 模型，因為它很小，因此可以快速下載用於範例目的。較大的模型可能會產生較少的幻覺。然而，這應該提醒我們，LLMs 經常會說謊，即使是關於足以有維基百科頁面的主題。重要的是要用您自己的研究來驗證它們的輸出。 使用一組訊息呼叫 chat 串流 (Streaming) 使用 stream complete endpoint 使用 stream chat endpoint
sourceText: One of the simplest ways to run an LLM locally is using a llamafile. llamafiles bundle model weights and a specially-compiled version of llama.cpp into a single file that can run on most computers any additional dependencies. They also come with an embedded inference server that provides an API for interacting with your model. Setup 1. Download a llamafile from HuggingFace 2. Make the file executable 3. Run the file Here’s a simple bash script that shows all 3 setup steps: Terminal window Your model’s inference server listens at localhost:8080 by default. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. WARNING: TinyLlama’s description of Octavia Butler above contains many falsehoods. For example, she was born in California, not Pennsylvania. The information about her family and her education is a hallucation. She did not work as an elementary school teacher. Instead, she took a series of temporary jobs that would allow her to focus her energy on writing. Her work did not “quickly gain recognition”: she sold her first short story around 1970, but did not gain prominence for another 14 years, when her short story “Speech Sounds” won the Hugo Award in 1984. Please refer to Wikipedia for a real biography of Octavia Butler. We use the TinyLlama model in this example notebook primarily because it’s small and therefore quick to download for example purposes. A larger model might hallucinate less. However, this should serve as a reminder that LLMs often do lie, even about topics that are well-known enough to have a Wikipedia page. It’s important verify their outputs with your own research. The author then shifted to using microcomputers, which allowed for more interactive programming and writing, and he began to write essays again. Later, in March 2015, he started working on Lisp again, attracted by its unique characteristics and power as a programming language. `

Full MACOS instructions are also here. In general: - Use CuBLAS if you have CUDA and an NVidia GPU - Use METAL if you are running on an M1/M2 MacBook - Use CLBLAST if you are running on an AMD/Intel GPU For me, on a MAC, I need to install the metal backend. Terminal window Then you can install the required llama-index pacakages Setup LLM The LlamaCPP llm is highly configurable. Depending on the model being used, you’ll want to pass in messages to prompt and completion to prompt functions to help format the model inputs. For any kwargs that need to be passed in during initialization, set them in model kwargs. A full list of available model kwargs is available in the LlamaCPP docs. For any kwargs that need to be passed in during inference, you can set them in generate kwargs. See the full list of generate kwargs here. In general, the defaults are a great starting point. The example below shows configuration with all defaults. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. title: Maritalk
text: 簡介 MariTalk 是一款由巴西公司 Maritaca AI 開發的助理。MariTalk 基於經過特別訓練以良好理解葡萄牙語的語言模型。 本筆 Notebook 透過兩個範例，演示如何使用 MariTalk 與 Llama Index 進行操作： 1. 使用聊天方式獲取寵物名字建議； 2. 使用少樣本範例（few-shot examples）並提供完整方法，對電影評論進行負面或正面分類。 安裝 如果您在 Colab 中開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex。 API Key 您需要一個可從 chat.maritaca.ai（「Chaves da API」部分）獲取的 API 金鑰。 範例 1 - 使用聊天進行寵物名字建議 串流生成 (Stream Generation) 對於涉及生成長文本的任務，例如創建一篇詳盡的文章或翻譯一個大型 document，接收文本的片段，隨著文本生成，會比等待完整文本更有優勢。這使應用程式更具反應性和效率，尤其是在生成文本很長時。我們提供兩種方法來滿足這種需求：同步（synchronous）和非同步（asynchronous）。 範例 2 - 使用完整方法進行少樣本範例 (Few-shot Examples) 當使用模型並搭配少樣本範例時，我們建議使用 llm.complete() 方法。
sourceText: Introduction MariTalk is an assistant developed by the Brazilian company Maritaca AI. MariTalk is based on language models that have been specially trained to understand Portuguese well. This notebook demonstrates how to use MariTalk with Llama Index through two examples: 1. Get pet name suggestions with chat method; 2. Classify film reviews as negative or positive with few-shot examples with complete method. Installation If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex. API Key You will need an API key that can be obtained from chat.maritaca.ai (“Chaves da API” section). Example 1 - Pet Name Suggestions with Chat Stream Generation For tasks involving the generation of long text, such as creating an extensive article or translating a large document, it can be advantageous to receive the response in parts, as the text is generated, instead of waiting for the complete text. This makes the application more responsive and efficient, especially when the generated text is extensive. We offer two approaches to meet this need: one synchronous and another asynchronous. Example 2 - Few-shot Examples with Complete We recommend using the llm.complete() method when using the model with few-shot examples

sourceText: If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Call complete with a prompt Call chat with a list of messages Call with random seed Streaming Using stream complete endpoint Configure Model Function Calling mistral-large supports native function calling. There’s a seamless integration with LlamaIndex tools, through the predict and call function on the llm. This allows the user to attach any tools and let the LLM decide which tools to call (if any). If you wish to perform tool calling as part of an agentic loop, check out our agent guides instead. NOTE : If you use another Mistral model, we will use a ReAct prompt to attempt to call the function. Your mileage may vary. You get the same result if you use the async variant (it will be faster since we do asyncio.gather under the hood). Structured Prediction An important use case for function calling is extracting structured objects. LlamaIndex provides an intuitive interface for converting any LLM into a structured LLM - simply define the target Pydantic class (can be nested), and given a prompt, we extract out the desired object. Structured Prediction with Streaming Any LLM wrapped with as structured llm supports streaming through stream chat. Async

sourceText: The llama-index-llms-nvidia package contains LlamaIndex integrations for chat models and embeddings powered by NVIDIA AI Foundation Models, and hosted on the NVIDIA API Catalog. NVIDIA AI Foundation models are community- and NVIDIA-built models that are optimized to deliver the best performance on NVIDIA-accelerated infrastructure. You can use the API to query live endpoints that are available on the NVIDIA API Catalog to get quick results from a DGX-hosted cloud compute environment, or you can download models from NVIDIA’s API catalog with NVIDIA NIM, which is included with the NVIDIA AI Enterprise license. The ability to run models on-premises gives your enterprise ownership of your customizations and full control of your IP and AI application. NIMs can be exported from NVIDIA’s API catalog using the NVIDIA AI Enterprise license and run on-premises or in the cloud, NIMs are packaged as container images on a per model basis and are distributed as NGC container images through the NVIDIA NGC Catalog. At their core, NIMs provide easy, consistent, and familiar APIs for running inference on an AI model. NVIDIA’s LLM connector This example goes over how to use LlamaIndex to interact with and develop LLM-powered systems using the publicly-accessible AI Foundation endpoints. With this connector, you’ll be able to connect to and generate from compatible models available as hosted NVIDIA NIMs, such as: - Google’s gemma-7b - Mistal AI’s mistral-7b-instruct-v0.2 - And more! Installation Setup To get started: 1. Create a free account with NVIDIA, which hosts NVIDIA AI Foundation models. 2. Click on your model of choice. 3. Under Input select the Python tab, and click Get API Key. Then click Generate Key. 4. Copy and save the generated key as NVIDIA\ API\ KEY. From there, you should have access to the endpoints. Working with NVIDIA API Catalog Working with NVIDIA NIMs In addition to connecting to hosted NVIDIA NIMs, this connector can be used to connect to local microservice instances. This helps you take your applications local when necessary. For instructions on how to setup local microservice instances, see Loading a specific model Now we can load our NVIDIA LLM by passing in the model name, as found in the docs - located here NOTE: The default model is meta/llama3-8b-instruct. We can observe which model our llm object is currently associated with the .model attribute. Basic Functionality Now we can explore the different ways you can use the connector within the LlamaIndex ecosystem! Before we begin, lets set up a list of ChatMessage objects - which is the expected input for some of the methods. We’ll follow the same basic pattern for each example: 1. We’ll point our NVIDIA LLM to our desired model 2. We’ll examine how to use the endpoint to achieve the desired task! Complete: .complete() We can use .complete()/.acomplete() (which takes a string) to prompt a response from the selected model. Let’s use our default model for this task. We can verify this is the expected default by checking the .model attribute. Let’s call .complete() on our model with a string, in this case "Hello!", and observe the response. As is expected by LlamaIndex - we get a CompletionResponse in response. Async Complete: .acomplete() There is also an async implementation which can be leveraged in the same way! Chat: .chat() Now we can try the same thing using the .chat() method. This method expects a list of chat messages - so we’ll use the one we created above. We’ll use the mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-instruct-v0.1 model for the example. All we need to do now is call .chat() on our list of ChatMessages and observe our response. You’ll also notice that we can pass in a few additional key-word arguments that can influence the generation - in this case, we’ve used the seed parameter to influence our generation and the stop parameter to indicate we want the model to stop generating once it reaches a certain token! NOTE: You can find information about what additional kwargs are supported by the model’s endpoint by referencing the API documentation for the selected model. Mixtral’s is located here as an example! As expected, we receive a ChatResponse in response. Async Chat: (achat) We also have an async implementation of the .chat() method which can be called in the following way. Stream: .stream chat() We can also use the models found on build.nvidia.com for streaming use-cases! Let’s select another model and observe this behaviour. We’ll use Google’s gemma-7b model for this task. Let’s call our model with .stream chat(), which again expects a list of ChatMessage objects, and capture the response. As we can see, the response is a generator with the streamed response. Let’s take a look at the final response once the generation is complete. Async Stream: .astream chat() We have the equivalent async method for streaming as well, which can be used in a similar way to the sync implementation. Streaming Query Engine Responses Let’s look at a slightly more involved example using a query engine! We’ll start by loading some data (we’ll be using the Hitchhiker’s Guide to the Galaxy). Loading Data Let’s first create a directory where our data can live. We’ll download our data from the above source. We’ll need to have an embedding model for this step! We’ll use NVIDIA NV-Embed-QA model to achieve this, and save it in our Settings. Now we can load our document and create an index leveraging the above Now we can create a simple query engine and set our streaming parameter to True. Let’s send a query to our query engine, and then stream the response. Tool calling Starting in v0.2.1, NVIDIA supports tool calling. NVIDIA provides integration with the variety of models on build.nvidia.com as well as local NIMs. Not all these models are trained for tool calling. Be sure to select a model that does have tool calling for your experimention and applications. title: NVIDIA NIMs
text: llama-index-llms-nvidia 套件包含 LlamaIndex 整合，用於使用 NVIDIA NIM 推理微服務建立模型應用程式。NIM 支援來自社群以及 NVIDIA 的聊天、embedding 和 re-ranking 模型等各領域的模型。這些模型由 NVIDIA 進行優化，以在 NVIDIA 加速基礎設施上提供最佳效能，並以 NIM 的形式部署，這是一種易於使用、預建的容器，可使用單一指令在 NVIDIA 加速基礎設施上的任何地方部署。 NIM 的 NVIDIA 託管部署可於 NVIDIA API catalog 上進行測試。測試後，NIM 可以使用 NVIDIA AI Enterprise 授權從 NVIDIA 的 API catalog 中匯出，並在本地或雲端運行，讓企業擁有其 IP 和 AI 應用的所有權和完全控制權。 NIM 依模型進行打包成容器映像，並透過 NVIDIA NGC Catalog 分發為 NGC container images。NIM 的核心是提供簡單、一致且熟悉的 API，用於在 AI 模型上執行推理。 導入一個測試資料集，關於 2021 年舊金山房屋建築的 PDF。 設定 從 NVIDIA API Catalog 匯入依賴項，並設定您的 NVIDIA API 金鑰。 開始使用： 1. 使用 NVIDIA 建立免費帳戶，該平台託管 NVIDIA AI Foundation 模型。 2. 點擊您選擇的模型。 3. 在 Input 下，選擇 Python 標籤，然後點擊 Get API Key 。接著點擊 Generate Key 。 4. 複製並儲存生成的金鑰為 NVIDIA API KEY。從那裡您應該可以存取 endpoint。 使用 NVIDIA 託管的 NIM 進行 embedding 模型。 NVIDIA 的預設 embedding 只會嵌入前 512 個 tokens，因此請將 chunk size 設定為 500，以最大化 embedding 的準確性。 將 embedding 模型設定為 NVIDIA 的預設模型。如果一個 chunk 超過模型可以編碼的 token 數量，預設行為會拋出錯誤，因此請將 truncate="END" 設定為丟棄超過限制的 tokens。 現在資料已嵌入並在記憶體中索引，請設定 LLM。可以透過遵循 NIM 快速入門指南 在 5 分鐘內使用 Docker 在本地託管 NIM。 以下範例展示了如何： - 使用 Meta 的 open-source meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct 模型作為本地 NIM。 - 使用 NVIDIA API Catalog 中的 meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct 作為 NIM。 如果您正在使用本地 NIM，請將 base url 更改為您部署的 NIM URL。 範例會檢索最相關的 20 個 chunk 來回答問題。 提出一個在 document（第 18 頁）中單一位置就能回答的簡單問題。 現在提出一個需要閱讀表格的更複雜問題（請參閱 document 第 41 頁）： 這不是正確的答案。嘗試使用更進階的 PDF 解析器，LlamaParse： 使用更好的解析器，LLM 能夠正確回答問題。 現在嘗試一個更棘手的問題： LLM 感到困惑；這似乎是房屋單元的百分比增加。 嘗試為 LLM 提供更多上下文（40 而不是 20），然後使用 reranker 對這些 chunk 進行排序。請使用 NVIDIA 的 reranker： 太棒了！現在數字是正確的（如果您想知道，這在第 35 頁）。
sourceText: The llama-index-llms-nvidia package contains LlamaIndex integrations building applications with models on NVIDIA NIM inference microservice. NIM supports models across domains like chat, embedding, and re-ranking models from the community as well as NVIDIA. These models are optimized by NVIDIA to deliver the best performance on NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure and deployed as a NIM, an easy-to-use, prebuilt containers that deploy anywhere using a single command on NVIDIA accelerated infrastructure. NVIDIA hosted deployments of NIMs are available to test on the NVIDIA API catalog. After testing, NIMs can be exported from NVIDIA’s API catalog using the NVIDIA AI Enterprise license and run on-premises or in the cloud, giving enterprises ownership and full control of their IP and AI application. NIMs are packaged as container images on a per model basis and are distributed as NGC container images through the NVIDIA NGC Catalog. At their core, NIMs provide easy, consistent, and familiar APIs for running inference on an AI model. Bring in a test dataset, a PDF about housing construction in San Francisco in 2021. Setup Import dependencies and set up your NVIDIA API key from the NVIDIA API Catalog. To get started: 1. Create a free account with NVIDIA, which hosts NVIDIA AI Foundation models. 2. Click on your model of choice. 3. Under Input , select the Python tab, and click Get API Key . Then click Generate Key . 4. Copy and save the generated key as NVIDIA API KEY. From there, you should have access to the endpoints. Use an NVIDIA-hosted NIM for the embedding model. NVIDIA’s default embeddings only embed the first 512 tokens, so set the chunk size to 500 to maximize the accuracy of embeddings. Set the embedding model to NVIDIA’s default. If a chunk exceeds the number of tokens the model can encode, the default behavior is to throw an error, so set truncate="END" to instead discard tokens that go over the limit. Now that the data is embedded and indexed in memory, set up the LLM. NIM can be hosted locally using Docker in 5 minutes by following the NIM quick start guide. The following example shows how to: - Use Meta’s open-source meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct model as a local NIM. - Use meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct as a NIM from the API Catalog hosted by NVIDIA. If you are using a local NIM, change the base url to your deployed NIM URL. The example retrieves the top 20 most relevant chunks to answer the question. Ask a simple question that is answered in one place in the document (on page 18). Now ask a more complicated question that requires reading a table (on page 41 of the document): That’s not the right answer. Try a more advanced PDF parser, LlamaParse: With a better parser, the LLM is able to answer the question correctly. Now try a trickier question: The LLM is getting confused; this appears to be the percentage increase in housing units. Try giving the LLM more context (40 instead of 20) and then sorting those chunks with a reranker. Use NVIDIA’s reranker for this: Excellent! Now the figure is correct (this is on page 35, in case you’re wondering).
