title: Milvus 向量資料庫與混合搜尋
sourceTitle: Milvus Vector Store With Hybrid Search
text: 混合搜尋結合語意檢索與關鍵字比對的優點，能提供更準確且更符合上下文的結果。由於同時運用語意搜尋和關鍵字比對，混合搜尋特別適合複雜的資訊檢索工作。 這份筆記示範如何在 LlamaIndex RAG 管線中使用 Milvus 進行混合搜尋。我們會先介紹建議的預設混合搜尋方式（語意搜尋 + BM25），再探索其他稀疏嵌入方法，以及如何自訂混合重排器。 前置需求 安裝相依套件 開始前，請先安裝以下相依套件： 如果您使用 Google Colab，可能需要 重新啟動執行階段 （開啟介面上方的「Runtime」選單，再從下拉選單選擇「Restart session」。） 設定帳戶 本教學使用 OpenAI 產生文字嵌入與回答。請先準備 OpenAI API 金鑰。 使用 Milvus 向量儲存區時，請指定 Milvus 伺服器的 URI，也可以選擇提供 TOKEN。若要啟動 Milvus 伺服器，請依照 Milvus 安裝指南設定，或免費試用 Zilliz Cloud。 目前 Milvus Standalone、Milvus Distributed 和 Zilliz Cloud 支援全文搜尋；Milvus Lite 尚未支援，預計未來才會實作。如需更多資訊，請聯絡 。 載入範例資料 執行以下指令，將範例文件下載到「data/paul\ graham」資料夾： 接著使用 SimpleDirectoryReaderLoad 載入 Paul Graham 的文章〈What I Worked On〉： 使用 BM25 進行混合搜尋 本節示範如何使用 BM25 執行混合搜尋。首先初始化 MilvusVectorStore，並為範例文件建立索引。預設設定如下： - 使用預設嵌入模型（OpenAI 的 text-embedding-ada-002）產生密集嵌入。 - 當 enable\ sparse 為 True 時，使用 BM25 執行全文搜尋。 - 啟用混合搜尋時，使用 k=60 的 RRFRanker 合併結果。 以下說明 MilvusVectorStore 中用來設定密集與稀疏欄位的參數： 密集向量欄位 - enable dense (bool)：用來啟用或停用密集嵌入的布林旗標，預設為 True。 - dim (int, optional)：此 collection 中嵌入向量的維度。 - embedding field (str, optional)：collection 的密集嵌入欄位名稱，預設為 DEFAULT\ EMBEDDING\ KEY。 - index config (dict, optional)：建立密集嵌入索引時使用的設定，預設為 None。 - search config (dict, optional)：搜尋 Milvus 密集索引時使用的設定。此設定必須與 index config 指定的索引類型相容，預設為 None。 - similarity metric (str, optional)：密集嵌入使用的相似度度量，目前支援 IP、COSINE 和 L2。 稀疏向量欄位 - enable sparse (bool)：用來啟用或停用稀疏嵌入的布林旗標，預設為 False。 - sparse embedding field (str)：稀疏嵌入欄位名稱，預設為 DEFAULT\ SPARSE\ EMBEDDING\ KEY。 - sparse embedding function (Union[BaseSparseEmbeddingFunction, BaseMilvusBuiltInFunction], optional)：當 enable\ sparse 為 True 時，請提供此物件，將文字轉換為稀疏嵌入。若為 None，預設會使用 BM25BuiltInFunction；若現有 collection 未使用內建函式，也可以使用 BGEM3SparseEmbedding。 - sparse index config (dict, optional)：建立稀疏嵌入索引時使用的設定，預設為 None。 若要在查詢時啟用混合搜尋，請將 vector store query mode 設為 “hybrid”。系統會合併語意搜尋與全文搜尋的結果，再重新排序。以下用範例查詢測試：「What did the author learn at Viaweb?」 自訂文字分析器 分析器在全文搜尋中負責將句子切分為 token，並執行詞幹提取、停用詞移除等詞彙處理；分析器通常依語言而異。詳情請參閱 Milvus 分析器指南。 Milvus 支援兩種分析器： 內建分析器 與 自訂分析器 。預設情況下，若將 enable sparse 設為 True，MilvusVectorStore 會使用預設設定的 BM25BuiltInFunction，並採用依標點符號切分文字的標準內建分析器。 若要使用其他分析器或自訂現有分析器，可在 analyzer params 參數中指定值，設定 BM25BuiltInFunction。接著將此函式設為 sparse embedding function，並套用至 MilvusVectorStore。 使用其他稀疏嵌入進行混合搜尋 除了結合語意搜尋與 BM25，Milvus 也支援使用稀疏嵌入函式進行混合搜尋，例如 BGE-M3。以下範例使用內建的 BGEM3SparseEmbeddingFunction 產生稀疏嵌入。 首先安裝 FlagEmbedding 套件： 接著建立向量儲存區與索引：密集嵌入使用預設的 OpenAI 模型，稀疏嵌入則使用內建的 BGE-M3： 接著使用範例問題執行混合搜尋： 自訂稀疏嵌入函式 只要繼承 BaseSparseEmbeddingFunction，您也可以自訂稀疏嵌入函式，並實作以下方法： - encode queries：將文字轉換為查詢用的稀疏嵌入清單。 - encode documents：將文字轉換為文件用的稀疏嵌入清單。 每個方法的輸出都應符合稀疏嵌入格式，也就是由字典組成的清單。每個字典以整數作為維度的 key，並以浮點數作為該維度的嵌入權重值（例如 {1: 0.5, 2: 0.3}）。 以下示範如何使用 BGE-M3 實作自訂稀疏嵌入函式： 自訂混合重排器 Milvus 支援兩種重排策略：倒數排名融合（RRF）與加權評分。MilvusVectorStore 混合搜尋的預設排序器是 k=60 的 RRF。若要自訂混合排序器，請調整以下參數： - hybrid ranker (str)：指定混合搜尋查詢使用的排序器類型。目前僅支援 \[“RRFRanker”, “WeightedRanker”]，預設為 “RRFRanker”。 - hybrid ranker params (dict, optional)：混合排序器的設定參數。字典結構會依使用的排序器而異： - “RRFRanker” 需要包含： - “k” (int)：倒數排名融合（RRF）使用的參數。演算法會用此值計算排名分數，並合併多種排序策略的結果，以提高搜尋相關性。若未指定，預設值為 60。 - “WeightedRanker” 需要包含： - “weights” (list of float)：包含且只包含兩個權重的清單： 1. 密集嵌入部分的權重。 2. 稀疏嵌入部分的權重。這兩個值用來調整混合檢索中密集與稀疏嵌入的比重。若未指定，預設權重為 \[1.0, 1.0]。
sourceText: Hybrid search leverages the strengths of both semantic retrieval and keyword matching to deliver more accurate and contextually relevant results. By combining the advantages of semantic search and keyword matching, hybrid search is particularly effective in complex information retrieval tasks. This notebook demonstrates how to use Milvus for hybrid search in LlamaIndex RAG pipelines. We’ll begin with the recommended default hybrid search (semantic + BM25) and then explore other alternative sparse embedding methods and customization of hybrid reranker. Prerequisites Install dependencies Before getting started, make sure you have the following dependencies installed: If you’re using Google Colab, you may need to restart the runtime (Navigate to the “Runtime” menu at the top of the interface, and select “Restart session” from the dropdown menu.) Set up accounts This tutorial uses OpenAI for text embeddings and answer generation. You need to prepare the OpenAI API key. To use the Milvus vector store, specify your Milvus server URI (and optionally with the TOKEN). To start a Milvus server, you can set up a Milvus server by following the Milvus installation guide or simply trying Zilliz Cloud for free. Full-text search is currently supported in Milvus Standalone, Milvus Distributed, and Zilliz Cloud, but not yet in Milvus Lite (planned for future implementation). Reach out for more information. Load example data Run the following commands to download sample documents into the “data/paul\ graham” directory: Then use SimpleDirectoryReaderLoad to load the essay “What I Worked On” by Paul Graham: Hybrid Search with BM25 This section shows how to perform a hybrid search using BM25. To get started, we will initialize the MilvusVectorStore and create an index for the example documents. The default configuration uses: - Dense embeddings from the default embedding model (OpenAI’s text-embedding-ada-002) - BM25 for full-text search if enable\ sparse is True - RRFRanker with k=60 for combining results if hybrid search is enabled Here is more information about the arguments for configuring dense and sparse fields in the MilvusVectorStore: dense field - enable dense (bool): A boolean flag to enable or disable dense embedding. Defaults to True. - dim (int, optional): The dimension of the embedding vectors for the collection. - embedding field (str, optional): The name of the dense embedding field for the collection, defaults to DEFAULT\ EMBEDDING\ KEY. - index config (dict, optional): The configuration used for building the dense embedding index. Defaults to None. - search config (dict, optional): The configuration used for searching the Milvus dense index. Note that this must be compatible with the index type specified by index config. Defaults to None. - similarity metric (str, optional): The similarity metric to use for dense embedding, currently supports IP, COSINE and L2. sparse field - enable sparse (bool): A boolean flag to enable or disable sparse embedding. Defaults to False. - sparse embedding field (str): The name of sparse embedding field, defaults to DEFAULT\ SPARSE\ EMBEDDING\ KEY. - sparse embedding function (Union[BaseSparseEmbeddingFunction, BaseMilvusBuiltInFunction], optional): If enable\ sparse is True, this object should be provided to convert text to a sparse embedding. If None, the default sparse embedding function (BM25BuiltInFunction) will be used, or use BGEM3SparseEmbedding given existing collection without built-in functions. - sparse index config (dict, optional): The configuration used to build the sparse embedding index. Defaults to None. To enable hybrid search during the querying stage, set vector store query mode to “hybrid”. This will combine and rerank search results from both semantic search and full-text search. Let’s test with a sample query: “What did the author learn at Viaweb?”: Customize text analyzer Analyzers play a vital role in full-text search by breaking sentences into tokens and performing lexical processing, such as stemming and stop-word removal. They are typically language-specific. For more details, refer to Milvus Analyzer Guide. Milvus supports two types of analyzers: Built-in Analyzers and Custom Analyzers . By default, if enable sparse is set to True, MilvusVectorStore utilizes the BM25BuiltInFunction with default configurations, employing the standard built-in analyzer that tokenizes text based on punctuation. To use a different analyzer or customize the existing one, you can provide values to the analyzer params argument when building the BM25BuiltInFunction. Then, set this function as the sparse embedding function in MilvusVectorStore. Hybrid Search with Other Sparse Embedding Besides combining semantic search with BM25, Milvus also supports hybrid search using a sparse embedding function such as BGE-M3. The following example uses the built-in BGEM3SparseEmbeddingFunction to generate sparse embeddings. First, we need to install the FlagEmbedding package: Then let’s build the vector store and index using the default OpenAI model for densen embedding and the built-in BGE-M3 for sparse embedding: Now let’s perform a hybrid search query with a sample question: Customize Sparse Embedding Function You can also customize the sparse embedding function as long as it inherits from BaseSparseEmbeddingFunction, including the following methods: - encode queries: This method converts texts into list of sparse embeddings for queries. - encode documents: This method converts text into list of sparse embeddings for documents. The output of each method should follow the format of the sparse embedding, which is a list of dictionaries. Each dictionary should have a key (an integer) representing the dimension, and a corresponding value (a float) representing the embedding’s magnitude in that dimension (e.g., {1: 0.5, 2: 0.3}). For example, here’s a custom sparse embedding function implementation using BGE-M3: Customize hybrid reranker Milvus supports two types of reranking strategies: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) and Weighted Scoring. The default ranker in MilvusVectorStore hybrid search is RRF with k=60. To customize the hybrid ranker, modify the following parameters: - hybrid ranker (str): Specifies the type of ranker used in hybrid search queries. Currently only supports \[“RRFRanker”, “WeightedRanker”]. Defaults to “RRFRanker”. - hybrid ranker params (dict, optional): Configuration parameters for the hybrid ranker. The structure of this dictionary depends on the specific ranker being used: - For “RRFRanker”, it should include: - “k” (int): A parameter used in Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). This value is used to calculate the rank scores as part of the RRF algorithm, which combines multiple ranking strategies into a single score to improve search relevance. The default value is 60 if not specified. - For “WeightedRanker”, it expects: - “weights” (list of float): A list of exactly two weights: 1. The weight for the dense embedding component. 2. The weight for the sparse embedding component. These weights are used to balance the significance of the dense and sparse components of the embeddings in the hybrid retrieval process. The default weights are \[1.0, 1.0] if not specified.

title: Milvus 向量儲存
text: 本指南演示如何使用 LlamaIndex 和 Milvus 建構一個 Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) 系統。 RAG 系統結合了檢索系統與生成模型，根據給定的 prompt 生成新的文字。該系統首先使用像 Milvus 這樣的向量相似度搜尋引擎從資料庫中檢索相關的 documents，然後使用生成模型根據檢索到的 documents 生成新的文字。 Milvus 是世界上最先進的開源向量資料庫，旨在為 embedding similarity search 和 AI 應用提供支援。 在本次筆記中，我們將快速演示如何使用 MilvusVectorStore。 開始之前 安裝依賴項 如果您在 colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 此 Notebook 將使用 Milvus Lite，需要較新的 pymilvus 版本： 如果您使用 Google Colab，要啟用剛安裝的依賴項，您可能需要 重新啟動執行階段 （點擊螢幕頂部的「Runtime」選單，然後從下拉選單中選擇「Restart session」）。 設定 OpenAI 首先，讓我們加入 openai api 金鑰。這將允許我們存取 chatgpt。 準備資料 您可以使用以下指令下載範例資料： 開始使用 生成我們的資料 作為第一個範例，讓我們從檔案 paul graham essay.txt 生成一個 document。這是 Paul Graham 標題為 What I Worked On 的一篇單篇論文。為了生成 documents，我們將使用 SimpleDirectoryReader。 建立跨資料的索引 現在我們有了 document，我們可以建立一個索引並插入 document。對於索引，我們將使用 MilvusVectorStore。MilvusVectorStore 接受幾個參數： 基本參數 - uri (str, optional)：連接的 URI，格式為 以供 Milvus 或 Zilliz Cloud 服務，或用於 lite 本地 Milvus 的 “path/to/local/milvus.db”。預設值為 ”./milvus\ llamaindex.db”。 - token (str, optional)：登入的 token。如果未使用 rbac 則為空，如果使用 rbac 則很可能是 “username:password”。 - collection name (str, optional)：資料將儲存的集合名稱。預設值為 “llamalection”。 - overwrite (bool, optional)：是否覆蓋同名現有集合。預設值為 False。 包含 doc id 和 text 的標量欄位 - doc id field (str, optional)：集合中 doc\ id 的名稱。預設值為 DEFAULT\ DOC\ ID\ KEY。 - text key (str, optional)：傳入集合中儲存的 key text。用於自帶集合。預設值為 DEFAULT\ TEXT\ KEY。 - scalar field names (list, optional)：將包含在集合 schema 中的額外標量欄位的名稱。 - scalar field types (list, optional)：額外標量欄位的類型。 密集欄位 (dense field) - enable dense (bool)：啟用或禁用密集 embedding 的布林標誌。預設值為 True。 - dim (int, optional)：集合中 embedding vector 的維度。在設定 enable\ sparse 為 False 時，需要此參數。 - embedding field (str, optional)：集合中密集 embedding 的欄位名稱，預設值為 DEFAULT\ EMBEDDING\ KEY。 - index config (dict, optional)：用於建立密集 embedding 索引的設定。預設值為 None。 - search config (dict, optional)：用於搜尋 Milvus 密集索引的設定。請注意，這必須與 index config 指定的索引類型相容。預設值為 None。 - similarity metric (str, optional)：用於密集 embedding 的相似度度量。目前支援 IP、COSINE 和 L2。 稀疏欄位 (sparse field) - enable sparse (bool)：啟用或禁用稀疏 embedding 的布林標誌。預設值為 False。 - sparse embedding field (str)：稀疏 embedding 的欄位名稱，預設值為 DEFAULT\ SPARSE\ EMBEDDING\ KEY。- sparse embedding function (Union[BaseSparseEmbeddingFunction, BaseMilvusBuiltInFunction], optional)：如果 enable\ sparse 為 True，此物件應提供以將文字轉換為稀疏嵌入。如果為 None，將使用預設的稀疏嵌入函式 (BM25BuiltInFunction)。 - sparse index config (dict, optional)：用於建構稀疏嵌入索引的設定。預設為 None。 hybrid ranker - hybrid ranker (str)：指定在 hybrid search 查詢中使用哪種 ranker。目前僅支援 \[“RRFRanker”, “WeightedRanker”]。預設為 “RRFRanker”。 - hybrid ranker params (dict, optional)：hybrid ranker 的設定參數。此字典的結構取決於使用的特定 ranker： - 對於 “RRFRanker”，應包含： - “k” (int)：Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) 中使用的參數。此值用於計算 rank scores，作為 RRF 演算法的一部分，將多種排序策略合併為單一分數以提高搜尋相關性。 - 對於 “WeightedRanker”，它期望： - “weights” (list of float)：一個包含兩個權重的列表： 1. 密集嵌入組件的權重。 2. 稀疏嵌入組件的權重。這些權重用於調整混合檢索過程中密集和稀疏嵌入組件的重要性。預設為一個空字典，表示 ranker 將使用其預定義的 default settings 運作。 others - collection properties (dict, optional)：集合屬性，如 TTL (Time-To-Live) 和 MMAP (memory mapping)。預設為 None。它可能包含： - “collection.ttl.seconds” (int)：設定此屬性後，當前集合中的資料將在指定的時間後過期。集合中過期的資料將會被清理，並且不會參與搜尋或查詢。 - “mmap.enabled” (bool)：是否在集合層級啟用 memory-mapped storage。 - index management (IndexManagement)：指定要使用的索引管理策略。預設為 “create\ if\ not\ exists”。 - batch size (int)：配置在將資料插入 Milvus 時，每個批次中要處理的 documents 數量。預設為 DEFAULT\ BATCH\ SIZE。 - consistency level (str, optional)：用於新建立集合的一致性級別。預設為 “Session”。 對於 MilvusVectorStore 的參數： - 將 uri 設定為本地檔案，例如 ./milvus.db，是最方便的方法，因為它會自動利用 Milvus Lite 將所有資料儲存到此檔案中。 - 如果您有大量資料，可以設定一個在 docker 或 kubernetes 上更高效的 Milvus 伺服器。在此設定中，請將伺服器 URI，例如 http://localhost:19530，作為您的 uri。 - 如果您想使用 Zilliz Cloud，用於 Milvus 的全託管雲端服務，請調整 uri 和 token，它們對應於 Zilliz Cloud 中的 Public Endpoint 和 Api key。 查詢資料 現在我們在索引中儲存了我們的 document，我們可以對索引提出問題。索引將使用儲存在自身的資料作為 chatgpt 的知識庫。 下一個測試顯示覆蓋會移除先前的資料。 下一個測試顯示向現有索引中新增額外資料。 Metadata filtering 我們可以透過過濾特定來源來產生結果。以下範例說明如何從目錄載入所有 documents，然後根據 metadata 進行過濾。 我們只想從檔案 uber 2021.pdf 中檢索 documents。 當從檔案 paul graham essay.txt 檢索時，我們得到不同的結果。
sourceText: This guide demonstrates how to build a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system using LlamaIndex and Milvus. The RAG system combines a retrieval system with a generative model to generate new text based on a given prompt. The system first retrieves relevant documents from a corpus using a vector similarity search engine like Milvus, and then uses a generative model to generate new text based on the retrieved documents. Milvus is the world’s most advanced open-source vector database, built to power embedding similarity search and AI applications. In this notebook we are going to show a quick demo of using the MilvusVectorStore. Before you begin Install dependencies If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. This notebook will use Milvus Lite requiring a higher version of pymilvus: If you are using Google Colab, to enable dependencies just installed, you may need to restart the runtime (click on the “Runtime” menu at the top of the screen, and select “Restart session” from the dropdown menu). Setup OpenAI Lets first begin by adding the openai api key. This will allow us to access chatgpt. Prepare data You can download sample data with the following commands: Getting Started Generate our data As a first example, lets generate a document from the file paul graham essay.txt. It is a single essay from Paul Graham titled What I Worked On. To generate the documents we will use the SimpleDirectoryReader. Create an index across the data Now that we have a document, we can can create an index and insert the document. For the index we will use a MilvusVectorStore. MilvusVectorStore takes in a few arguments: basic args - uri (str, optional): The URI to connect to, comes in the form of “ ” for Milvus or Zilliz Cloud service, or “path/to/local/milvus.db” for the lite local Milvus. Defaults to ”./milvus\ llamaindex.db”. - token (str, optional): The token for log in. Empty if not using rbac, if using rbac it will most likely be “username:password”. - collection name (str, optional): The name of the collection where data will be stored. Defaults to “llamalection”. - overwrite (bool, optional): Whether to overwrite existing collection with the same name. Defaults to False. scalar fields including doc id & text - doc id field (str, optional): The name of the doc\ id field for the collection. Defaults to DEFAULT\ DOC\ ID\ KEY. - text key (str, optional): What key text is stored in in the passed collection. Used when bringing your own collection. Defaults to DEFAULT\ TEXT\ KEY. - scalar field names (list, optional): The names of the extra scalar fields to be included in the collection schema. - scalar field types (list, optional): The types of the extra scalar fields. dense field - enable dense (bool): A boolean flag to enable or disable dense embedding. Defaults to True. - dim (int, optional): The dimension of the embedding vectors for the collection. Required when creating a new collection with enable\ sparse is False. - embedding field (str, optional): The name of the dense embedding field for the collection, defaults to DEFAULT\ EMBEDDING\ KEY. - index config (dict, optional): The configuration used for building the dense embedding index. Defaults to None. - search config (dict, optional): The configuration used for searching the Milvus dense index. Note that this must be compatible with the index type specified by index config. Defaults to None. - similarity metric (str, optional): The similarity metric to use for dense embedding, currently supports IP, COSINE and L2. sparse field - enable sparse (bool): A boolean flag to enable or disable sparse embedding. Defaults to False. - sparse embedding field (str): The name of sparse embedding field, defaults to DEFAULT\ SPARSE\ EMBEDDING\ KEY. - sparse embedding function (Union[BaseSparseEmbeddingFunction, BaseMilvusBuiltInFunction], optional): If enable\ sparse is True, this object should be provided to convert text to a sparse embedding. If None, the default sparse embedding function (BM25BuiltInFunction) will be used. - sparse index config (dict, optional): The configuration used to build the sparse embedding index. Defaults to None. hybrid ranker - hybrid ranker (str): Specifies the type of ranker used in hybrid search queries. Currently only supports \[“RRFRanker”, “WeightedRanker”]. Defaults to “RRFRanker”. - hybrid ranker params (dict, optional): Configuration parameters for the hybrid ranker. The structure of this dictionary depends on the specific ranker being used: - For “RRFRanker”, it should include: - “k” (int): A parameter used in Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). This value is used to calculate the rank scores as part of the RRF algorithm, which combines multiple ranking strategies into a single score to improve search relevance. - For “WeightedRanker”, it expects: - “weights” (list of float): A list of exactly two weights: 1. The weight for the dense embedding component. 2. The weight for the sparse embedding component. These weights are used to adjust the importance of the dense and sparse components of the embeddings in the hybrid retrieval process. Defaults to an empty dictionary, implying that the ranker will operate with its predefined default settings. others - collection properties (dict, optional): The collection properties such as TTL (Time-To-Live) and MMAP (memory mapping). Defaults to None. It could include: - “collection.ttl.seconds” (int): Once this property is set, data in the current collection expires in the specified time. Expired data in the collection will be cleaned up and will not be involved in searches or queries. - “mmap.enabled” (bool): Whether to enable memory-mapped storage at the collection level. - index management (IndexManagement): Specifies the index management strategy to use. Defaults to “create\ if\ not\ exists”. - batch size (int): Configures the number of documents processed in one batch when inserting data into Milvus. Defaults to DEFAULT\ BATCH\ SIZE. - consistency level (str, optional): Which consistency level to use for a newly created collection. Defaults to “Session”. For the parameters of MilvusVectorStore: - Setting the uri as a local file, e.g../milvus.db, is the most convenient method, as it automatically utilizes Milvus Lite to store all data in this file. - If you have large scale of data, you can set up a more performant Milvus server on docker or kubernetes. In this setup, please use the server uri, e.g.http://localhost:19530, as your uri. - If you want to use Zilliz Cloud, the fully managed cloud service for Milvus, adjust the uri and token, which correspond to the Public Endpoint and Api key in Zilliz Cloud. Query the data Now that we have our document stored in the index, we can ask questions against the index. The index will use the data stored in itself as the knowledge base for chatgpt. This next test shows that overwriting removes the previous data. The next test shows adding additional data to an already existing index. Metadata filtering We can generate results by filtering specific sources. The following example illustrates loading all documents from the directory and subsequently filtering them based on metadata. We want to only retrieve documents from the file uber 2021.pdf. We get a different result this time when retrieve from the file paul graham essay.txt.

text: 本筆記示範如何將 Milvus 的 vector store 應用於 LlamaIndex，重點關注 metadata 過濾功能。您將學會如何使用 metadata 為 documents 建立索引，使用 LlamaIndex 的內建 metadata 篩選器執行 vector 搜尋，並將 Milvus 的原生篩選表達式應用於 vector store。 在本筆記結束時，您將了解如何利用 Milvus 的篩選功能，根據 document 的 metadata 來縮小搜尋結果。 先決條件 安裝依賴項 在開始之前，請確保已安裝以下依賴項： 如果您使用 Google Colab，您可能需要 重新啟動 runtime （導航至介面頂部的「Runtime」選單，並從下拉選單中選擇「Restart session」）。 設定帳戶 本教學使用 OpenAI 進行文字嵌入和答案生成。您需要準備 OpenAI API key。 要使用 Milvus vector store，請指定您的 Milvus server URI（可選地使用 TOKEN）。要啟動 Milvus server，您可以遵循 Milvus 安裝指南 設定 Milvus server，或直接嘗試 Zilliz Cloud 進行免費試用。 準備資料 在此範例中，我們將使用幾本書籍，它們的標題相似或相同，但 metadata 不同（作者、類型和出版年份）作為範例資料。這將幫助展示 Milvus 如何根據 vector 相似度和 metadata 屬性來篩選和檢索 documents。 建置索引 在本節中，我們將使用預設的嵌入模型（OpenAI 的 text-embedding-ada-002）在 Milvus 中儲存範例資料。標題將轉換為 text embeddings 並儲存在 dense embedding field 中，而所有 metadata 將儲存在 scalar fields 中。 Metadata 篩選器 在本節中，我們將將 LlamaIndex 的內建 metadata 篩選器和條件應用於 Milvus 搜尋。 定義 metadata 篩選器 使用篩選器從 vector store 檢索 多重 Metadata 篩選器 您也可以組合多個 metadata 篩選器來建立更複雜的查詢。LlamaIndex 支援 AND 和 OR 條件來組合篩選器。這使得能夠根據 metadata 屬性更精確、更靈活地檢索 documents。 條件 AND 嘗試一個篩選範例，用於篩選出版於 1979 年到 2010 年之間的書籍（具體來說，其中 1979 < year ≤ 2010）： 條件 OR 嘗試另一個範例，用於篩選由 Georges Perec 或 Keith Richards 撰寫的書籍： 使用 Milvus 的 Keyword Arguments 除了內建的篩選功能外，您還可以透過 string expr keyword argument 使用 Milvus 的原生篩選表達式。這允許您在搜尋操作期間直接將特定的篩選表達式傳遞給 Milvus，超越標準的 metadata 篩選，以存取 Milvus 的進階篩選能力。 Milvus 提供強大且靈活的篩選選項，可用於精確查詢您的 vector data： - 基本運算子：比較運算子、範圍篩選器、算術運算子和邏輯運算子 - 篩選表達式模板：常用篩選場景的預定義模式 - 專門運算子：針對 JSON 或 array fields 的資料類型特定運算子 有關 Milvus 篩選表達式的完整文件和範例，請參閱 Milvus Filtering 的官方文件。
sourceText: This notebook illustrates the use of the Milvus vector store in LlamaIndex, focusing on metadata filtering capabilities. You will learn how to index documents with metadata, perform vector searches with LlamaIndex’s built-in metadata filters, and apply Milvus’s native filtering expressions to the vector store. By the end of this notebook, you will understand how to utilize Milvus’s filtering features to narrow down search results based on document metadata. Prerequisites Install dependencies Before getting started, make sure you have the following dependencies installed: If you’re using Google Colab, you may need to restart the runtime (Navigate to the “Runtime” menu at the top of the interface, and select “Restart session” from the dropdown menu.) Set up accounts This tutorial uses OpenAI for text embeddings and answer generation. You need to prepare the OpenAI API key. To use the Milvus vector store, specify your Milvus server URI (and optionally with the TOKEN). To start a Milvus server, you can set up a Milvus server by following the Milvus installation guide or simply trying Zilliz Cloud for free. Prepare data For this example, we’ll use a few books with similar or identical titles but different metadata (author, genre, and publication year) as the sample data. This will help demonstrate how Milvus can filter and retrieve documents based on both vector similarity and metadata attributes. Build Index In this section, we will store sample data in Milvus using the default embedding model (OpenAI’s text-embedding-ada-002). Titles will be converted into text embeddings and stored in a dense embedding field, while all metadata will be stored in scalar fields. Metadata Filters In this section, we will apply LlamaIndex’s built-in metadata filters and conditions to Milvus search. Define metadata filters Retrieve from vector store with filters Multiple Metdata Filters You can also combine multiple metadata filters to create more complex queries. LlamaIndex supports both AND and OR conditions to combine filters. This allows for more precise and flexible retrieval of documents based on their metadata attributes. Condition AND Try an example filtering for books published between 1979 and 2010 (specifically, where 1979 < year ≤ 2010): Condition OR Try another example that filters books written by either Georges Perec or Keith Richards: Use Milvus’s Keyword Arguments In addition to the built-in filtering capabilities, you can use Milvus’s native filtering expressions by the string expr keyword argument. This allows you to pass specific filter expressions directly to Milvus during search operations, extending beyond the standard metadata filtering to access Milvus’s advanced filtering capabilities. Milvus provides powerful and flexible filtering options that enable precise querying of your vector data: - Basic Operators: Comparison operators, range filters, arithmetic operators, and logical operators - Filter Expression Templates: Predefined patterns for common filtering scenarios - Specialized Operators: Data type-specific operators for JSON or array fields For comprehensive documentation and examples of Milvus filtering expressions, refer to the official documentation of Milvus Filtering.

title: Nile Vector Store (Multi-tenant PostgreSQL)
text: 此筆筆記展示如何使用基於 Postgres 的 vector store NileVectorStore 來儲存和查詢多租戶 RAG 應用程式的 vector embeddings。 什麼是 Nile？ Nile 是一個 Postgres 資料庫，它允許每個租戶進行所有資料庫操作，包括自動擴展 (auto-scaling)、分支 (branching) 和備份 (backups)，並提供完全的客戶隔離 (customer isolation)。 多租戶 RAG 應用程式越來越受歡迎，因為它們在利用大型語言模型 (large language models) 的同時提供了安全性和隱私性。 然而，管理底層的 Postgres 資料庫並非簡單。DB-per-tenant 成本高昂且難以管理，而共享 DB 則存在安全和隱私問題，同時也限制了 RAG 應用程式的擴展性和效能。Nile 重新設計了 Postgres，以提供所有世界的最佳體驗——DB-per-tenant 的隔離性，同時擁有共享 DB 的成本效益和開發者體驗。 在共享 DB 中儲存數百萬個 vector 可能會很慢，並需要大量的資源來索引和查詢。但如果你在 Nile 的虛擬租戶資料庫中儲存 1000 個租戶，每個租戶有 1000 個 vector，這可以相當可管理。特別是你可以將較大的租戶放在自己的計算資源上，而較小的租戶可以有效地共享計算資源並根據需要自動擴展。 開始使用 Nile 首先，請註冊 Nile。註冊 Nile 後，您將被升級為建立第一個資料庫。請開始操作。您將被重新導向到新資料庫的「Query Editor」頁面。 從那裡，點擊「Home」（左側選單上的頂部圖示），點擊「generate credentials」並複製結果的 connection string。您稍後會需要它。 額外資源 - Nile 的 LlamaIndex documentation - Nile 的 generative AI 與向量 embeddings docs - Nile 的 pgvector primer - Few 中你不知道的事 pgvector 開始之前 安裝依賴項 讓我們安裝並匯入依賴項。 如果你在 colab 上開啟此 Notebook，你可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 設定與 Nile 資料庫的連線 假設您遵循了先前部分「Getting Started with Nile」中的說明，您現在應該有了一個連接到 Nile 資料庫的 connection string。 您可以將其設定在名為 NILEDB SERVICE URL 的環境變數中，或直接設定在 Python 中。 現在，我們將建立一個 NileVectorStore。請注意，除了 URL 和 dimensions 等常用參數外，我們還設定了 tenant aware=True。 :fire: NileVectorStore 支援 tenant-aware vector stores，它為每個租戶隔離 documents，以及一個通常用於所有租戶可存取的共享資料的 regular store。下文將展示 tenant-aware vector store。 設定 OpenAI 您可以將其設定在 .env 檔案中，或直接設定在 Python 中。 多租戶相似性搜尋 為了展示使用 LlamaIndex 和 Nile 進行多租戶相似性搜尋，我們將下載兩個 documents——每個都有一個來自不同公司的銷售通話記錄。Nexiv 提供 IT 服務，ModaMart 則在零售業。我們將為每個 document 添加租戶識別碼並將它們載入到 tenant-aware vector store 中。然後，我們將對每個租戶查詢該儲存。您會看到同一個問題會產生兩種不同的回應，因為它會為每個租戶檢索不同的 documents。 下載資料 載入 documents 我們將使用 LlamaIndex 的 SimpleDirectoryReader 來載入 documents。因為我們想在載入後更新 documents 中的租戶元數據 (tenant metadata)，我們將為每個租戶使用一個單獨的 reader。 使用租戶元數據豐富 documents我們將建立兩個 Nile tenants，並將每個 tenant 的 ID 加入到 document metadata 中。我們還會新增一些額外的 metadata，例如自訂的 document ID 和 category。此 metadata 可用於在檢索過程中過濾 documents。當然，在您自己的應用程式中，您也可以為現有 tenant 載入 documents，並新增任何您認為有用的 metadata 資訊。 使用 NileVectorStore 建立 VectorStore index 我們將所有 documents 載入到同一個 VectorStoreIndex 中。由於我們在設定時建立了 tenant-aware 的 NileVectorStore，Nile 將會正確使用 metadata 中的 tenant id 欄位來隔離它們。 在沒有 tenant id 的情況下，在 tenant-aware store 中載入 documents 將會拋出一個 ValueException。 為每個 tenant 查詢 index 您可以在下方看到我們如何為每個查詢指定 tenant，因此我們得到與該 tenant 相關的結果，且僅限於該 tenant。 查詢現有的 embeddings 在上面的範例中，我們透過載入和 embedding 新的 documents 來建立 index。但如果我們已經在 Nile 中生成並儲存了 embeddings 怎麼辦？在這種情況下，您仍然像上面一樣初始化 NileVectorStore，但您使用以下內容而不是 VectorStoreIndex.from documents(...)： 使用 ANN indexes 進行近似最近鄰搜尋 Nile 支援 pgvector 支援的所有 index - IVFFlat 和 HNSW。IVFFlat 速度更快，資源消耗較少，且易於調整。HNSW 需要更多的資源來建立和使用，調整起來更具挑戰性，但具有出色的準確度/速度權衡。讓我們看看如何使用 index，儘管一個 2-document 的範例實際上不需要它們。 IVFFlat Index IVFFlat index 的運作方式是將向量空間劃分為稱為「lists」的區域，首先找到最近的 lists，然後在這些 lists 內部搜尋最近的鄰居。在 index 建立時，您會指定 lists 的數量（nlists），在查詢時，您可以指定搜尋中將使用多少個最近的 lists（ivfflat probes）。 HNSW Index HNSW index 的運作方式是將向量空間劃分為一個多層圖，其中每一層都包含不同粒度點之間的連接。在搜尋過程中，它會從粗到細層進行導航，識別資料中的最近鄰居。在 index 建立期間，您會指定一層中的最大連接數（m）以及建構圖時考慮的候選向量數量（ef construction）。在查詢時，您可以指定要搜尋的候選列表的大小（hnsw ef）。 額外的 VectorStore 操作 Metadata Filters NileVectorStore 也支援基於 metadata 過濾 vectors。例如，當我們載入 documents 時，我們為每個 document 包含了 category metadata。現在我們可以使用這些資訊來過濾檢索到的 documents。請注意，此過濾是 除了 tenant 過濾之外的。在 tenant-aware vector store 中，tenant 過濾是強制性的，以防止意外的資料洩漏。 刪除 Documents 刪除 documents 可能非常重要。特別是如果您的部分 tenant 位於需要 GDPR 的地區。
sourceText: This notebook shows how to use the Postgres based vector store NileVectorStore to store and query vector embeddings for multi-tenant RAG applications. What is Nile? Nile is a Postgres database that enables all database operations per tenant including auto-scaling, branching, and backups, with full customer isolation. Multi-tenant RAG applications are increasingly popular, since they provide security and privacy while using large language models. However, managing the underlying Postgres database is not straightforward. DB-per-tenant is expensive and complex to manage, while shared-DB has security and privacy concerns, and also limits the scalability and performance of the RAG application. Nile re-engineered Postgres to deliver the best of all worlds - the isolation of DB-per-tenant, at the cost, efficiency and developer experience of a shared-DB. Storing millions of vectors in a shared-DB can be slow and require significant resources to index and query. But if you store 1000 tenants in Nile’s virtual tenant databases, each with 1000 vectors, this can be quite managable. Especially since you can place larger tenants on their own compute, while smaller tenants can efficiently share compute resources and auto-scale as needed. Getting Started with Nile Start by signing up for Nile. Once you’ve signed up for Nile, you’ll be promoted to create your first database. Go ahead and do so. You’ll be redirected to the “Query Editor” page of your new database. From there, click on “Home” (top icon on the left menu), click on “generate credentials” and copy the resulting connection string. You will need it in a sec. Additional Resources - Nile’s LlamaIndex documentation - Nile’s generative AI and vector embeddings docs - Nile’s pgvector primer - Few things you didn’t know about pgvector Before you begin Install dependencies Lets install and import dependencies. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Setup connection to Nile database Assuming you followed the instructions in the previous section, Getting Started with Nile, you should now have a connection string to your Nile database. You can set it in an environment variable called NILEDB SERVICE URL, or in Python directly. And now, we’ll create a NileVectorStore. Note that in addition to the usual parameters like URL and dimensions, we also set tenant aware=True. :fire: NileVectorStore supports both tenant-aware vector stores, that isolates the documents for each tenant and a regular store which is typically used for shared data that all tenants can access. Below, we’ll demonstrate the tenant-aware vector store. Setup OpenAI You can set it in an .env file, or in Python directly Multi-tenant similarity search To demonstrate multi-tenant similarity search with LlamaIndex and Nile, we will download two documents - each with a transcript from a sales call by a different company. Nexiv provides IT services and ModaMart is in retail. We’ll add tenant identifiers to each document and load them to a tenant-aware vector store. Then, we will query the store for each tenant. You will see how the same question generates two different responses, because it retrieves different documents for each tenant. Download data Load documents We’ll use LlamaIndex’s SimpleDirectoryReader to load the documents. Because we want to update the documents with the tenant metadata after loading, we’ll use a separate reader for each tenant Enrich documents with tenant metadata We are going to create two Nile tenants and the add the tenant ID of each to the document metadata. We are also adding some additional metadata like a custom document ID and a category. This metadata can be used for filtering documents during the retrieval process. Of course, in your own application, you could also load documents for existing tenants and add any metadata information you find useful. Creating a VectorStore index with NileVectorStore We are loading all documents to the same VectorStoreIndex. Since we created a tenant-aware NileVectorStore when we set things up, Nile will correctly use the tenant id field in the metadata to isolate them. Loading documents without tenant id to a tenant-aware store will throw a ValueException. Querying the index for each tenant You can see below how we specify the tenant for each query, and therefore we get an answer relevant to that tenant and only for them Querying existing embeddings In the example above, we created the index by loading and embedding new documents. But what if we already generated the embeddings and stored them in Nile. In that case, you still initialize NileVectorStore as above, but instead of VectorStoreIndex.from documents(...) you use this: Using ANN indexes for approximate nearest neighbor search Nile supports all indexes supported by pgvector - IVFFlat and HNSW. IVFFlat is faster, uses fewer resources and is simple to tune. HNSW uses more resources to create and use, and is more challenging to tune but has great accuracy/speed tradeoffs. Lets see how to use indexes, even though a 2-document example doesn’t actually require them. IVFFlat Index IVFFlat indexes work by separating the vector space into regions called “lists”, first finding the nearest lists and then searching for the nearest neighbors within these lists. You specify the number of lists (nlists) during index creation, and then when querying, you can specify how many nearest lists will be used in the search (ivfflat probes). HNSW Index HNSW indexes work by separating the vector space into a multi-layer graph where each layer contains connections between points at varying levels of granularity. During a search, it navigates from coarse to finer layers, identifying the nearest neighbors in the data. During index creation, you specify the maximum number of connections in a layer (m) and the number of candidate vectors considered when building the graph (ef construction). While querying, you can specify the size of the candidate list that will be searched (hnsw ef). Additional VectorStore operations Metadata Filters NileVectorStore also supports filtering vectors based on metadata. For example, when we loaded the documents, we included category metadata for each document. We can now use this information to filter the retrieved documents. Note that this filtering is in addition to the tenant filter. In a tenant-aware vector store, the tenant filter is mandatory, in order to prevent accidental data leaks. Deleting Documents Deleting documents can be quite important. Especially if some of your tenants are in a region where GDPR is required.

sourceText: This notebook will demonstrate the use of ObjectBox as an efficient, on-device vector-store with LlamaIndex. We will consider a simple RAG use-case where given a document, the user can ask questions and get relevant answers from a LLM in natural language. The RAG pipeline will be configured along the following verticals: - A builtin SimpleDirectoryReader reader from LlamaIndex - A builtin SentenceSplitter node-parser from LlamaIndex - Models from HuggingFace as embedding providers - ObjectBox as NoSQL and vector datastore - Google’s Gemini as a remote LLM service 1) Installing dependencies We install integrations for HuggingFace and Gemini to use along with LlamaIndex \2K \[91m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m\[90m╺\[0m\[90m━━\[0m \[32m1.5/1.6 MB\[0m \[31m40.2 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:01\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m1.6/1.6 MB\[0m \[31m25.4 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m4.0/4.0 MB\[0m \[31m44.0 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m1.5/1.5 MB\[0m \[31m38.9 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m1.1/1.1 MB\[0m \[31m37.5 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m76.4/76.4 kB\[0m \[31m5.2 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m77.9/77.9 kB\[0m \[31m4.9 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m49.3/49.3 kB\[0m \[31m3.1 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[2K \[90m━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━\[0m \[32m58.3/58.3 kB\[0m \[31m3.4 MB/s\[0m eta \[36m0:00:00\[0m \[?25h 2) Downloading the documents 3) Setup a LLM for RAG (Gemini) We use Google Gemini’s cloud-based API as a LLM. You can get an API-key from the [console. 4) Setup an embedding model for RAG (HuggingFace bge-small-en-v1.5) HuggingFace hosts a variety of embedding models, which could be observed from the MTEB Leaderboard. 5) Prepare documents and nodes In a RAG pipeline, the first step is to read the given documents. We use the SimpleDirectoryReader that selects the best file reader by checking the file extension from the directory. Next, we produce chunks (text subsequences) from the contents read by the SimpleDirectoryReader from the documents. A SentenceSplitter is a text-splitter that preserves sentence boundaries while splitting the text into chunks of size chunk size. 6) Configure ObjectBoxVectorStore The ObjectBoxVectorStore can be initialized with several options: - embedding dim (required): The dimensions of the embeddings that the vector DB will hold - distance type: Choose from COSINE, DOT PRODUCT, DOT PRODUCT NON NORMALIZED and EUCLIDEAN - db directory: The path of the directory where the .mdb ObjectBox database file should be created - clear db: Deletes the existing database file if it exists on db directory - do log: Enables logging from the ObjectBox integration 7) Chat with the document Optional: Configuring ObjectBoxVectorStore as a retriever A LlamaIndex retriever is responsible for fetching similar chunks from a vector DB given a query. Optional: Removing chunks associated with a single query using delete nodes We can use the ObjectBoxVectorStore.delete nodes method to remove chunks (nodes) from the vector DB providing a list containing node IDs as an argument. Optional: Removing a single document from the vector DB The ObjectBoxVectorStore.delete method can be used to remove chunks (nodes) associated with a single document whose id is provided as an argument.

title: Oracle AI Vector Search：向量儲存庫
sourceTitle: Oracle AI Vector Search: Vector Store
text: Oracle AI Vector Search 專為人工智慧（AI）工作負載打造，可依語意而非關鍵字查詢資料。它的一大優勢，是能在同一套系統中，結合非結構化資料的語意搜尋與商務資料的關聯式搜尋。這不只功能強大，也能避免額外導入專用向量資料庫，減少多個系統間資料分散所帶來的管理負擔。 此外，向量資料也能運用 Oracle Database 多項強大的功能，例如： - 分區支援 - Real Application Clusters 擴充性 - Exadata 智慧掃描 - 跨地理區域分散式資料庫的分片處理 - 交易處理 - 平行 SQL - 災難復原 - 安全性 - Oracle Machine Learning - Oracle Graph Database - Oracle Spatial and Graph - Oracle Blockchain - JSON 本指南示範如何使用 Oracle AI Vector Search 的向量功能。 如果你剛開始使用 Oracle Database，可以先看看免費版 Oracle Database 23ai，了解如何設定資料庫環境。使用資料庫時，通常不建議預設使用 system 使用者；你可以建立自己的使用者，以提升安全性並依需求調整設定。如需建立使用者的詳細步驟，請參閱我們的端對端指南，其中也示範如何在 Oracle 中設定使用者。此外，了解使用者權限對有效管理資料庫安全性也很重要。你可以參閱 Oracle 官方的使用者帳戶與安全性管理指南，深入了解相關內容。 先決條件 若要搭配 Oracle AI Vector Search 使用 LlamaIndex，請先安裝 Oracle Python Client 驅動程式。 連線至 Oracle AI Vector Search 以下範例程式碼示範如何連線至 Oracle Database。python-oracledb 預設會以 Thin 模式直接連線至 Oracle Database，無須安裝 Oracle Client 程式庫。不過，使用 Oracle Client 程式庫可支援部分額外功能；這種連線方式稱為 Thick 模式。兩種模式都完整支援 Python Database API v2.0 Specification。各模式支援的功能詳情請參閱這份指南。如果 Thin 模式無法滿足需求，可以改用 Thick 模式。 匯入 Oracle AI Vector Search 所需的相依套件 載入文件 使用 AI Vector Search 建立採用不同距離策略的多個 Vector Store 首先，我們會建立三個 Vector Store，分別使用不同的距離函式。目前尚未建立索引，因此這些 Vector Store 暫時只會建立資料表；稍後我們會用它們建立 HNSW 索引。 連線至 Oracle Database 後，可以看到三個資料表：Documents\ DOT、Documents\ COSINE 和 Documents\ EUCLIDEAN。 接著，我們會再建立三個資料表：Documents\ DOT\ IVF、Documents\ COSINE\ IVF 和 Documents\ EUCLIDEAN\ IVF，並在這些資料表上建立 IVF 索引，而不是 HNSW 索引。 如需了解 Oracle AI Vector Search 支援的索引類型，請參閱這份指南 示範如何新增、刪除文字，以及執行基本相似度搜尋 示範如何依不同距離策略設定參數並建立索引 接著，我們會在六個 Vector Store 上執行進階搜尋。以下三種搜尋都會分別示範有篩選條件和沒有篩選條件的情況；篩選條件只會選出 ID 為 101 的文件，並排除其他文件 端對端示範 如需使用 Oracle AI Vector Search 建立完整的 RAG pipeline，請參閱我們的Oracle AI Vector Search 端對端示範指南。
sourceText: Oracle AI Vector Search is designed for Artificial Intelligence (AI) workloads that allows you to query data based on semantics, rather than keywords. One of the biggest benefits of Oracle AI Vector Search is that semantic search on unstructured data can be combined with relational search on business data in one single system. This is not only powerful but also significantly more effective because you don’t need to add a specialized vector database, eliminating the pain of data fragmentation between multiple systems. In addition, your vectors can benefit from all of Oracle Database’s most powerful features, like the following: - Partitioning Support - Real Application Clusters scalability - Exadata smart scans - Shard processing across geographically distributed databases - Transactions - Parallel SQL - Disaster recovery - Security - Oracle Machine Learning - Oracle Graph Database - Oracle Spatial and Graph - Oracle Blockchain - JSON The guide demonstrates how to use Vector Capabilities within Oracle AI Vector Search. If you are just starting with Oracle Database, consider exploring the free Oracle 23 AI which provides a great introduction to setting up your database environment. While working with the database, it is often advisable to avoid using the system user by default; instead, you can create your own user for enhanced security and customization. For detailed steps on user creation, refer to our end-to-end guide which also shows how to set up a user in Oracle. Additionally, understanding user privileges is crucial for managing database security effectively. You can learn more about this topic in the official Oracle guide on administering user accounts and security. Prerequisites Please install Oracle Python Client driver to use Llama Index with Oracle AI Vector Search. Connect to Oracle AI Vector Search The following sample code will show how to connect to Oracle Database. By default, python-oracledb runs in a ‘Thin’ mode which connects directly to Oracle Database. This mode does not need Oracle Client libraries. However, some additional functionality is available when python-oracledb uses them. Python-oracledb is said to be in ‘Thick’ mode when Oracle Client libraries are used. Both modes have comprehensive functionality supporting the Python Database API v2.0 Specification. See the following guide that talks about features supported in each mode. You might want to switch to thick-mode if you are unable to use thin-mode. Import the required dependencies to play with Oracle AI Vector Search Load Documents Using AI Vector Search Create a bunch of Vector Stores with different distance strategies First we will create three vector stores each with different distance functions. Since we have not created indices in them yet, they will just create tables for now. Later we will use these vector stores to create HNSW indicies. You can manually connect to the Oracle Database and will see three tables Documents\ DOT, Documents\ COSINE and Documents\ EUCLIDEAN. We will then create three additional tables Documents\ DOT\ IVF, Documents\ COSINE\ IVF and Documents\ EUCLIDEAN\ IVF which will be used to create IVF indicies on the tables instead of HNSW indices. To understand more about the different types of indices Oracle AI Vector Search supports, refer to the following guide Demonstrating add, delete operations for texts, and basic similarity search Demonstrating index creation with specific parameters for each distance strategy Now we will conduct a bunch of advanced searches on all six vector stores. Each of these three searches have a with and without filter version. The filter only selects the document with id 101 out and filters out everything else End to End Demo Please refer to our complete demo guide Oracle AI Vector Search End-to-End Demo Guide to build an end to end RAG pipeline with the help of Oracle AI Vector Search.

title: 從簡單到進階的自動檢索指南（搭配 Pinecone + Arize Phoenix）
sourceTitle: A Simple to Advanced Guide with Auto-Retrieval (with Pinecone + Arize Phoenix)
text: 在本筆 Notebook 中，我們將展示如何對 Pinecone 執行 auto-retrieval ，這讓您能夠執行超出標準 top-k semantic search 的廣泛半結構化查詢。 我們將展示如何設定基本的 auto-retrieval，以及如何擴展它（透過自訂 prompt 和動態 metadata 檢索）。 如果您在 Colab 中開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 第一部分：設定 Auto-Retrieval 要設定 auto-retrieval，請執行以下步驟： 1. 我們將進行一些設定、載入資料，並建立一個 Pinecone vector index。 2. 我們將定義我們的 autoretriever 並執行一些範例查詢。 3. 我們將使用 Phoenix 觀察每個 trace 並視覺化 prompt 的輸入/輸出。 4. 我們將向您展示如何自訂 auto-retrieval prompt。 1.a 設定 Pinecone/Phoenix、載入資料並建立 Vector Index 在本節中，我們設定 pinecone 並導入一些關於書籍/電影的玩具資料（包含文字資料和 metadata）。 我們也設定 Phoenix，以便它能擷取下游的 traces。 載入 documents，建立 PineconeVectorStore 和 VectorStoreIndex 1.b 定義 Autoretriever，執行一些範例查詢 設定 VectorIndexAutoRetriever 其中一個輸入是 schema，用來描述 vector store collection 包含的內容。這類似於描述 SQL 資料庫中某個表的 table schema。此 schema 資訊隨後被注入到 prompt 中，傳遞給 LLM 以推斷完整的查詢應該是什麼（包括 metadata 篩選器）。 執行一些查詢 讓我們執行一些利用結構化資訊的範例查詢。 傳入額外的 Metadata 篩選器 如果您有想要傳入但無法自動推斷的額外 metadata 篩選器，請執行以下操作。 失敗查詢的範例 請注意，沒有結果被檢索！我們稍後會修復這個問題。 視覺化 Traces 讓我們開啟 Phoenix 來查看 traces！ 讓我們看看 auto-retrieval prompt。我們可以看到 auto-retrieval prompt 使用了兩個 few-shot 範例。 第二部分：擴展 Auto-Retrieval（使用動態 Metadata 檢索） 我們現在透過自訂 prompt 來擴展 auto-retrieval。在第一部分，我們明確添加了一些規則。 在第二部分，我們實作 dynamic metadata retrieval ，它會進行第一階段的檢索過程，從 vector db 中擷取相關 metadata，並將其作為 few-shot 範例插入到 auto-retrieval prompt 中。（當然，第二階段的檢索過程會從 vector db 中檢索實際的項目）。 2.a 改善 Auto-retrieval Prompt 我們的 auto-retrieval prompt 可以運作，但可以透過多種方式進行改進。一些範例包括它包含 2 個硬編碼的 few-shot 範例（如何包含您自己的？），以及 auto-retrieval 並不「總是」推斷出正確的 metadata 篩選器。 例如，所有 theme 的欄位都是大寫的。我們如何告訴 LLM，這樣它就不會錯誤地推斷出一個小寫的「theme」？ 讓我們嘗試修改 prompt！ 自訂 Prompt 讓我們稍微自訂一下 prompt。我們執行以下操作： - 移除第一個 few-shot 範例以節省 tokens - 添加一個訊息，如果推斷出「theme」，則總是將字母大寫。 請注意，prompt template 需要定義 schema str、info str 和 query str。 json {{ "metadata info": [ {{ "name": "author", "type": "str", "description": "Author name" }}, {{ "name": "book title", "type": "str", "description": "Book title" }}, {{ "name": "year", "type": "int", "description": "Year Published" }}, {{ "name": "pages", "type": "int", "description": "Number of pages" }}, {{ "name": "summary", "type": "str", "description": "A short summary of the book" }} ], "content info": "Classic literature" }} {{"query": "Books related to theme of marriage for social standing", "filters": [{{"key": "year", "value": "1813", "operator": " "}}, {{"key": "author", "value": "Jane Austen", "operator": "=="}}], "top k": null}} {info str} 您會注意到我們新增了 additional instructions 模板變數。這允許我們插入特定向量集合的指示。 我們將使用 partial format 來添加指示。 重新執行一些查詢 現在讓我們嘗試重新執行一些查詢，看看值是自動推斷的。 2.b 實作動態元數據檢索 除了在提示中硬編碼規則之外，另一種方法是檢索 相關的少樣本元數據範例 ，以幫助 LLM 更好地推斷正確的 metadata 篩選器。 這將更好地防止 LLM 在推斷 “where” 子句時出錯，特別是在拼寫/值的正確格式等方面。 我們可以透過 vector retrieval 來做到這一點。現有的 vector db collection 儲存原始文字 + metadata；我們可以直接查詢此 collection，或者僅對 metadata 進行索引並從中檢索。在本節中，我們選擇前者，但在實務上您可能希望採用後者。 我們使用前一節中定義的相同的 prompt tmpl str。 重新執行一些查詢 現在讓我們嘗試重新執行一些查詢，看看值是自動推斷的。
sourceText: In this notebook we showcase how to perform auto-retrieval against Pinecone, which lets you execute a broad range of semi-structured queries beyond what you can do with standard top-k semantic search. We show both how to setup basic auto-retrieval, as well as how to extend it (by customizing the prompt and through dynamic metadata retrieval). If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Part 1: Setup Auto-Retrieval To setup auto-retrieval, do the following: 1. We’ll do some setup, load data, build a Pinecone vector index. 2. We’ll define our autoretriever and run some sample queries. 3. We’ll use Phoenix to observe each trace and visualize the prompt inputs/outputs. 4. We’ll show you how to customize the auto-retrieval prompt. 1.a Setup Pinecone/Phoenix, Load Data, and Build Vector Index In this section we setup pinecone and ingest some toy data on books/movies (with text data and metadata). We also setup Phoenix so that it captures downstream traces. Load documents, build the PineconeVectorStore and VectorStoreIndex 1.b Define Autoretriever, Run Some Sample Queries Setup the VectorIndexAutoRetriever One of the inputs is a schema describing what content the vector store collection contains. This is similar to a table schema describing a table in the SQL database. This schema information is then injected into the prompt, which is passed to the LLM to infer what the full query should be (including metadata filters). Let’s run some queries Let’s run some sample queries that make use of the structured information. Pass in Additional Metadata Filters If you have additional metadata filters you want to pass in that aren’t autoinferred, do the following. Example of a failing Query Note that no results are retrieved! We’ll fix this later on. Visualize Traces Let’s open up Phoenix to take a look at the traces! Let’s take a look at the auto-retrieval prompt. We see that the auto-retrieval prompt makes use of two few-shot examples. Part 2: Extending Auto-Retrieval (with Dynamic Metadata Retrieval) We now extend auto-retrieval by customizing the prompt. In the first part, we explicitly add some rules. In the second part we implement dynamic metadata retrieval , which will do a first-stage retrieval pass of fetching relevant metadata from the vector db, and insert that as few-shot examples to the auto-retrieval prompt. (Of course, the second stage retrieval pass retrieves the actual items from the vector db). 2.a Improve the Auto-retrieval Prompt Our auto-retrieval prompt works, but it can be improved in various ways. Some examples include the fact that it includes 2 hardcoded few-shot examples (how can you include your own?), and also the fact that the auto-retrieval doesn’t “always” infer the right metadata filters. For instance, all the theme fields are capitalized. How do we tell the LLM that, so it doesn’t erroneously infer a “theme” that’s in lower-case? Let’s take a stab at modifying the prompt! Customize the Prompt Let’s customize the prompt a little bit. We do the following: - Take out the first few-shot example to save tokens - Add a message to always capitalize a letter if inferring “theme”. Note that the prompt template expects schema str, info str, and query str to be defined. json {{ "metadata info": [ {{ "name": "author", "type": "str", "description": "Author name" }}, {{ "name": "book title", "type": "str", "description": "Book title" }}, {{ "name": "year", "type": "int", "description": "Year Published" }}, {{ "name": "pages", "type": "int", "description": "Number of pages" }}, {{ "name": "summary", "type": "str", "description": "A short summary of the book" }} ], "content info": "Classic literature" }} {{"query": "Books related to theme of marriage for social standing", "filters": [{{"key": "year", "value": "1813", "operator": " "}}, {{"key": "author", "value": "Jane Austen", "operator": "=="}}], "top k": null}} {info str} You’ll notice we added an additional instructions template variable. This allows us to insert vector collection-specific instructions. We’ll use partial format to add the instruction. Re-run some queries Now let’s try rerunning some queries, and we’ll see that the value is auto-inferred. 2.b Implement Dynamic Metadata Retrieval An option besides hardcoding rules in the prompt is to retrieve relevant few-shot examples of metadata , to help the LLM better infer the correct metadata filters. This will better prevent the LLM from making mistakes when inferring “where” clauses, especially around aspects like spelling / correct formatting of the value. We can do this via vector retrieval. The existing vector db collection stores the raw text + metadata; we could query this collection directly, or separately only index the metadata and retrieve from that. In this section we choose to do the former but in practice you may want to do the latter. We use the same prompt tmpl str defined in the previous section. Re-run some queries Now let’s try rerunning some queries, and we’ll see that the value is auto-inferred.

text: 在這個 Notebook 中，我們將展示如何使用 Postgresql 和 pgvector 在 LlamaIndex 中執行向量搜尋。 如果您在 Colab 上開啟此 Notebook，您可能需要安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 執行以下儲存格將在 Colab 中安裝帶有 PGVector 的 Postgres。 設定 OpenAI 第一步是設定 openai 金鑰。它將用於為載入到索引中的 documents 建立 embeddings。 下載資料 載入 documents 使用 SimpleDirectoryReader 從 data/paul graham/ 載入儲存的 documents。 建立資料庫 使用在 localhost 上運行的現有 postgres，建立我們將使用的資料庫。 建立索引 在這裡，我們使用先前載入的 documents 建立一個由 Postgres 支援的索引。PGVectorStore 接受幾個參數。以下範例建立了一個具有 HNSW 索引（m = 16, ef\ construction = 64, ef\ search = 40）並使用 vector cosine ops 方法的 PGVectorStore。 查詢索引 現在我們可以使用我們的索引來提問。 查詢現有索引 混合搜尋 (Hybrid Search) 要啟用混合搜尋，您需要： 1. 在建構 PGVectorStore 時傳入 hybrid search=True（並可選地使用 text search config 設定所需的語言）。 2. 在建構查詢引擎時傳入 vector store query mode="hybrid"（此設定會在底層傳遞給 retriever）。您也可以可選地設定 sparse top k 以設定我們應從稀疏文本搜尋中獲得的結果數量（預設值使用與 similarity top k 相同的數值）。 使用 QueryFusionRetriever 改善混合搜尋 由於文本搜尋和向量搜尋的得分計算方式不同，僅由文本搜尋找到的 nodes 將會獲得較低的得分。 您通常可以透過使用 QueryFusionRetriever 來改善混合搜尋的效能，它能更好地利用互信息來排序 nodes。 元數據過濾器 (Metadata filters) PGVectorStore 支援在 nodes 中儲存元數據，並在檢索步驟中根據該元數據進行過濾。 下載 git commits dataset 加上帶有自訂元數據的 nodes 應用元數據過濾器 現在我們可以在檢索 nodes 時，根據提交作者或日期進行過濾。 應用巢狀過濾器 (nested filters) 在上述範例中，我們使用 AND 或 OR 組合了多個過濾器。我們也可以組合多組過濾器。 例如在 SQL 中： 上述內容可以使用 IN 運算符來簡化。PGVectorStore 支援 in、nin 和 contains 用於比較一個元素與一個列表。 自訂查詢 (Customize queries) 可以建立更複雜的查詢，例如連接其他表格。這是透過將 customize query fn 參數設定為您的函式來完成的。首先，讓我們建立一個使用者表並填充它。 然後，我們可以建立一個查詢自訂函式，並使用 PGVectorStore 實例化 customize query fn。 接著，我們可以查詢 vector store，並從 node 的 metadata 中，檢索附加到 select statement 中的任何欄位，這些欄位位於名為 custom fields 的 dictionary 中。 PgVector 查詢選項 IVFFlat Probes 指定 IVFFlat probes 的數量（預設為 1） 在從 index 檢索時，您可以指定適當的 IVFFlat probes 數量（召回率越高越好，速度越快越好） HNSW EF Search 指定搜尋的動態 candidate list 的大小（預設為 40）
sourceText: In this notebook we are going to show how to use Postgresql and pgvector to perform vector searches in LlamaIndex If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Running the following cell will install Postgres with PGVector in Colab. Setup OpenAI The first step is to configure the openai key. It will be used to created embeddings for the documents loaded into the index Download Data Loading documents Load the documents stored in the data/paul graham/ using the SimpleDirectoryReader Create the Database Using an existing postgres running at localhost, create the database we’ll be using. Create the index Here we create an index backed by Postgres using the documents loaded previously. PGVectorStore takes a few arguments. The example below constructs a PGVectorStore with a HNSW index with m = 16, ef\ construction = 64, and ef\ search = 40, with the vector cosine ops method. Query the index We can now ask questions using our index. Querying existing index Hybrid Search To enable hybrid search, you need to: 1. pass in hybrid search=True when constructing the PGVectorStore (and optionally configure text search config with the desired language) 2. pass in vector store query mode="hybrid" when constructing the query engine (this config is passed to the retriever under the hood). You can also optionally set the sparse top k to configure how many results we should obtain from sparse text search (default is using the same value as similarity top k). Improving hybrid search with QueryFusionRetriever Since the scores for text search and vector search are calculated differently, the nodes that were found only by text search will have a much lower score. You can often improve hybrid search performance by using QueryFusionRetriever, which makes better use of the mutual information to rank the nodes. Metadata filters PGVectorStore supports storing metadata in nodes, and filtering based on that metadata during the retrieval step. Download git commits dataset Add nodes with custom metadata Apply metadata filters Now we can filter by commit author or by date when retrieving nodes. Apply nested filters In the above examples, we combined multiple filters using AND or OR. We can also combine multiple sets of filters. e.g. in SQL: The above can be simplified by using the IN operator. PGVectorStore supports in, nin, and contains for comparing an element with a list. Customize queries It is possible to build more complex queries such as joining other tables. This is done by setting the customize query fn argument with your function. First, lets create a user table and populate it. Then, we can create a query customization function and instantiate PGVectorStore with customize query fn. We can then query the vector store and retrieve any additional field added to the select statement in a dictionary named custom fields in the node metadata. 向量可以捕捉整個文本的豐富語義。 sparse 向量則有所不同。它們使用專門的方法或模型（TF-IDF、BM25、SPLADE 等）來生成向量。這些向量通常大部分是零，因此它們是 sparse 向量。這些 sparse 向量擅長捕捉特定的關鍵字和相似的細節。 本筆筆記將帶您設定和自訂使用 Huggingface 中的 Qdrant 和 "prithvida/Splade PP en v1" sourceText: Qdrant supports hybrid search by combining search results from sparse and dense vectors. dense vectors are the ones you have probably already been using — embedding models from OpenAI, BGE, SentenceTransformers, etc. are typically dense embedding models. They create a numerical representation of a piece of text, represented as a long list of numbers. These dense vectors can capture rich semantics across the entire piece of text. sparse vectors are slightly different. They use a specialized approach or model (TF-IDF, BM25, SPLADE, etc.) for generating vectors. These vectors are typically mostly zeros, making them sparse vectors. These sparse vectors are great at capturing specific keywords and similar small details. This notebook walks through setting up and customizing hybrid search with Qdrant and "prithvida/Splade PP en v1" variants from Huggingface. Setup First, we setup our env and load our data. Indexing Data Now, we can index our data. Hybrid search with Qdrant must be enabled from the beginning — we can simply set enable hybrid=True. This will run sparse vector generation locally using the "prithvida/Splade PP en v1" using fastembed, in addition to generating dense vectors with OpenAI. Hybrid Queries When querying with hybrid mode, we can set similarity top k and sparse top k separately. sparse top k represents how many nodes will be retrieved from each dense and sparse query. For example, if sparse top k=5 is set, that means I will retrieve 5 nodes using sparse vectors and 5 nodes using dense vectors. similarity top k controls the final number of returned nodes. In the above setting, we end up with 10 nodes. A fusion algorithm is applied to rank and order the nodes from different vector spaces (relative score fusion in this case). similarity top k=2 means the top two nodes after fusion are returned. Llama 2 was specifically trained differently from Llama 1 by making changes such as performing more robust data cleaning, updating data mixes, training on 40% more total tokens, doubling the context length, and using grouped-query attention (GQA) to improve inference scalability for larger models. Additionally, Llama 2 adopted most of the pretraining setting and model architecture from Llama 1 but included architectural enhancements like increased context length and grouped-query attention. Lets compare to not using hybrid search at all! Async Support And of course, async queries are also supported (note that in-memory Qdrant data is not shared between async and sync clients!) \[Advanced] Customizing Hybrid Search with Qdrant In this section, we walk through various settings that can be used to fully customize the hybrid search experience Customizing Sparse Vector Generation Sparse vector generation can be done using a single model, or sometimes distinct separate models for queries and documents. Customizing hybrid fusion fn() By default, when running hbyrid queries with Qdrant, Relative Score Fusion is used to combine the nodes retrieved from both sparse and dense queries. title: Hybrid RAG 與 Qdrant：多租戶、自訂分片、分散式設定
sourceTitle: Hybrid RAG with Qdrant: multi-tenancy, custom sharding, distributed setup
text: 您將建立的內容 本 Notebook 實作了基於 LlamaIndex 的生產級 Hybrid RAG，使用 Qdrant，專為多租戶和透過自訂分片 (custom sharding) 進行擴展而設計。 - Hybrid search：使用 dense embeddings + sparse BM25 以獲得更高的召回率和精確度。 - 多租戶 (Multitenancy)：使用 payload filters 和 shard routing 來隔離租戶。 - 自訂分片 (Custom sharding)：為每個租戶保持本地化，以提高效能和成本效益。 - 分散式 Qdrant：設定多 node，並帶有複製 (replication) 以實現高可用性和吞吐量。 本 Notebook 將引導您完成一個端到端 (end to end) 的 Retrieval Augmented Generation workflow，該流程使用 Qdrant 作為分散式 hybrid search back-end，並使用 LlamaIndex 作為 orchestration layer。您將建立一個感知租戶的 RAG，它結合了 dense vectors 和 sparse signals，使用 filters 隔離每個租戶的資料，並使用自訂的 shard key 來路由資料和查詢以實現擴展。 安裝依賴項 關於依賴項 - llama-index：用於資料攝取 (ingestion)、索引 (indexing) 和檢索 (retrieval) 的 orchestration layer。 - llama-index-vector-stores-qdrant：與 hybrid 支援整合的 Qdrant。 - fastembed：輕量級、對 CPU 友善的 embedding/sparse 模型。 請確保您已啟動一個分散式 Qdrant cluster。以下是一個 compose.yaml 檔案： 匯入與全局 settings Settings 與連線 - Embeddings：FastEmbedEmbedding('BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5') 是一個緊湊、高品質的基準模型。 - Connection：QDRANT URL 預設指向 HTTP endpoint；設定 QDRANT API KEY 以用於安全/雲端設定。 建立可分散式集合 (collection) 設定雙向量 Schema (dense + sparse) - 定義向量欄位名稱：dense 用於 embeddings，sparse 用於 BM25-style signals。 - Dense 設定： - 在執行時透過 probing Settings.embed model 來確定 embedding 的維度（避免硬編碼）。 - 使用 cosine distance 進行語義相似度計算。 - Sparse 設定： - 啟用 in-memory sparse index (on disk=False) 以支援 hybrid scoring。 - 這些 settings 建立了集合的 dual-index layout，稍後由 QdrantVectorStore 用於 hybrid retrieval。 分片鍵 (Shard keys) 與選擇器合約 (selector contract) - shard keys：\[‘tenant\ a’, ‘tenant\ b’] — 使用自訂分片 (custom sharding) 的預定義分割，以保持每個租戶的本地化。 - payload indexes：在 tenant id 上建立 keyword index，以加速基於篩選器 (filter-based) 的查詢。 - shard key selector fn(tenant id) - tenant id：回傳用於寫入和讀取的 shard key。 初始化帶有自訂分片的 hybrid Qdrant store 此步驟會建立或附加到 COLLECTION 中命名的集合，並設定一個 dual-vector hybrid store： - Hybrid search：enable hybrid=True 與 dense vector name='dense' 和 sparse vector name='sparse'。 - Dense 設定：dense config 使用 cosine distance，並從 Settings.embed model 推導大小。 - Sparse 設定：sparse config 啟用 in-memory sparse index；fastembed sparse model='Qdrant/bm25' 提供 BM25-style signals。 - 分散式拓撲 (Distributed topology)： - sharding method=Custom 與 shard keys=['tenant a','tenant b']。 - shard key selector fn(tenant id) - tenant id 路由寫入和讀取。 - shard number=6, replication factor=2 用於擴展和高可用性 (High availability)。 - Payload index：payload indexes 加速對 tenant id 的篩選。 冪等行為 (Idempotent behavior)：如果集合不存在，vector store 將建立該集合，並在後續執行中重複使用它。 準備多租戶資料集 我們建立兩個具有小型 document 集合的租戶。每個 Document 包含 tenant\ id、tags 和 doc\ id。 資料集設計與可擴展性 我們模擬兩個具有少量短 documents 的租戶。每個 Document 包含： - tenant id 用於隔離和分片路由 (shard routing)， - tags 用於快速篩選和除錯 (debugging)， - text 用於 dense/sparse indexing 的內容。 使用分片鍵實現局部性 (locality) 進行攝取我們使用 active Settings.embed\ model 將文字嵌入，然後使用 payload 和 shard key 對每個點進行 upsert。這樣可以確保每個租戶都位於集群中的一個 shard group 內。 Embedding 策略 - FastEmbed 保持此示範對 CPU 友好。對於生產環境，請考慮使用服務（例如 text-embedding-3-large 或自建模型）並快取 embeddings。 - 如果您更改了模型，請更新 dense config.size 以匹配，並考慮重新索引。 - 避免在 notebook 中每次運行時都進行 embedding；持久化或快取以加快迭代速度。 擷取流程與局部性保證 - 我們使用配置的 embedding model（dense）嵌入每個 document，並依賴 vector store 來建立 sparse representation。 - 寫入使用 shard identifier=tenant id，確保 documents 位於預期的 shard group 上。 提示：對於大型批次，請優先使用 async ingestion APIs 並對 documents 進行分塊以控制背壓。 索引包裝與重用性 StorageContext.from defaults(vector store=vector store) 將 Qdrant collection 綁定到 LlamaIndex 的 VectorStoreIndex，而無需重新嵌入資料。 優點： - 對多個 retriever 或查詢 pipeline 重用相同的物理 collection。 - 透過 retriever 配置切換檢索模式（dense-only、sparse-only、hybrid），而不是資料佈局。 - 將 ingestion 相關問題（sharding、replication）與應用程式查詢邏輯解耦。 多租戶檢索 使用一個租戶範圍的 hybrid retriever，並保持查詢在 shard 局部。如果您想在租戶資料內進行過濾，也可以使用 metadata filters。 hybrid 模式的檢索提示 - 將 vector store query mode=HYBRID 設定為組合 dense 和 sparse。調整 similarity top k、sparse top k 和 hybrid top k。 - 將 vector store kwargs={"shard identifier": tenant id} 傳遞以保持查詢在租戶的 shard 內。 - 添加 metadata filters（例如在 tenant id 或 tags 上）在需要時進一步縮小候選者範圍。 解釋結果 - 輸出會顯示 hybrid score、tags（metadata）和匹配文字的 snippet。 - 透過切換 tenant id 並觀察結果僅來自該租戶的 documents，來驗證租戶隔離性。
sourceText: What you’ll build This notebook implements a production-style Hybrid RAG on Qdrant using LlamaIndex, designed for multitenancy and scale-out via custom sharding. - Hybrid search: dense embeddings + sparse BM25 for higher recall and precision. - Multitenancy: isolate tenants using payload filters and shard routing. - Custom sharding: keep each tenant local for performance and cost efficiency. - Distributed Qdrant: multi-node setup with replication for high availability and throughput. This notebook walks through an end to end Retrieval Augmented Generation workflow that uses Qdrant as a distributed hybrid search backend and LlamaIndex as the orchestration layer. You will build a tenant aware RAG that combines dense vectors with sparse signals, you will isolate data per tenant with filters, and you will route data and queries with a custom shard key for scale. Install dependencies About the dependencies - llama-index: orchestration layer for ingestion, indexing, and retrieval. - llama-index-vector-stores-qdrant: Qdrant integration with hybrid support. - fastembed: lightweight CPU-friendly embedding/sparse models Make sure you have a distributed Qdrant cluster up and running. Here is a compose.yaml file: Imports and global settings Settings and connectivity - Embeddings: FastEmbedEmbedding('BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5') is a compact, high-quality baseline. - Connection: QDRANT URL defaults to an HTTP endpoint; set QDRANT API KEY for secured/cloud setups. Create distributed-ready collection Configure dual-vector schema (dense + sparse) - Define vector field names: dense for embeddings and sparse for BM25‑style signals. - Dense config: - Determine embedding dimensionality at runtime by probing Settings.embed model (avoids hardcoding). - Use cosine distance for semantic similarity. - Sparse config: - Enable an in‑memory sparse index (on disk=False) to support hybrid scoring. - These settings establish the collection’s dual‑index layout used later by QdrantVectorStore for hybrid retrieval. Shard keys and selector contract - shard keys: \[‘tenant\ a’, ‘tenant\ b’] — predefined partitions used with custom sharding to keep each tenant local. - payload indexes: keyword index on tenant id to accelerate filter-based queries. - shard key selector fn(tenant id) - tenant id: returns the shard key used for both writes and reads. Initialize hybrid Qdrant store with custom sharding This step creates or attaches to the collection named in COLLECTION and configures a dual‑vector hybrid store: - Hybrid search: enable hybrid=True with dense vector name='dense' and sparse vector name='sparse'. - Dense config: dense config uses cosine distance and derives size from Settings.embed model. - Sparse config: sparse config enables an in‑memory sparse index; fastembed sparse model='Qdrant/bm25' supplies BM25‑style signals. - Distributed topology: - sharding method=Custom with shard keys=['tenant a','tenant b']. - shard key selector fn(tenant id) - tenant id routes both writes and reads. - shard number=6, replication factor=2 for scale and High availability. - Payload index: payload indexes accelerates filtering on tenant id. Idempotent behavior: the vector store will create the collection if missing and reuse it on subsequent runs. Prepare multi-tenant dataset We create two tenants with small document sets. Each Document carries tenant\ id, tags, and a doc\ id. Dataset design and extensibility We simulate two tenants with a few short documents each. Every Document carries: - tenant id for isolation and shard routing, - tags for quick filtering and debugging, - text content used for dense/sparse indexing. Ingest with shard key for locality Here we embed text with the active Settings.embed\ model, then upsert each point with payload and a shard key. This keeps each tenant local to a shard group in a cluster. Embedding strategy - FastEmbed keeps this demo CPU-friendly. For production, consider a service (e.g., text-embedding-3-large or in-house model) and cache embeddings. - If you change the model, update dense config.size to match and consider reindexing. - Avoid embedding on every run in notebooks; persist or cache to speed up iterations. Ingestion flow and locality guarantees - We embed each doc with the configured embedding model (dense) and rely on the vector store to build the sparse representation. - Writes use shard identifier=tenant id, ensuring documents live on the intended shard group. Tip: For large batches, prefer the async ingestion APIs and chunk documents for backpressure control. Index wrapping and reusability StorageContext.from defaults(vector store=vector store) binds the Qdrant collection to LlamaIndex’s VectorStoreIndex without re-ingesting data. Benefits: - Reuse the same physical collection for multiple retrievers or query pipelines. - Swap retrieval modes (dense-only, sparse-only, hybrid) via retriever config, not data layout. - Keep ingestion concerns (sharding, replication) decoupled from application query logic. Multi-tenant retrieval Use a tenant-scoped hybrid retriever and keep queries shard-local. You can also use metadata filters if you want to filter within the tenant’s data. Retrieval tips for hybrid mode - Set vector store query mode=HYBRID to combine dense and sparse. Tune similarity top k, sparse top k, and hybrid top k. - Pass vector store kwargs={"shard identifier": tenant id} to keep queries within the tenant’s shard. - Add metadata filters (e.g., on tenant id or tags) to further narrow candidates when needed. Interpreting results - The printout shows the hybrid score, tags (metadata), and snippet of the matched text. - Verify tenant isolation by switching tenant id and observing that results come only from that tenant’s documents.

text: 這份 Notebook 將快速示範如何使用 RedisVectorStore。 如果您在 Colab 開啟這份 Notebook，可能需要先安裝 LlamaIndex 🦙。 啟動 Redis 啟動 Redis 最簡單的方式是使用 Redis Stack Docker 映像，或快速註冊 免費 Redis Cloud 執行個體。 若要依照本教學完成所有步驟，請使用以下指令啟動映像： 終端機視窗 這也會在連接埠 8001 啟動 RedisInsight UI，您可以前往 開啟。 設定 OpenAI 首先加入 OpenAI API 金鑰，之後即可使用 OpenAI 產生嵌入向量，並使用 ChatGPT。 下載資料 載入資料集 這裡會使用一組 Paul Graham 的文章，將文字轉成嵌入向量並存入 RedisVectorStore，再透過查詢取得 LLM 問答流程所需的上下文。 初始化預設 Redis Vector Store 文件準備完成後，就可以使用 default 設定初始化 Redis Vector Store，將向量存入 Redis，並建立索引以進行即時搜尋。 查詢預設向量儲存 資料存入索引後，就可以針對索引提出問題。 索引會將這些資料作為 LLM 的知識庫。預設的 as\ query\ engine() 會使用 OpenAI 嵌入向量，並以 GPT 作為語言模型。因此，除非改用自訂或本機語言模型，否則必須提供 OpenAI 金鑰。 接下來會先測試索引搜尋，再使用 LLM 執行完整的 RAG 流程。 使用自訂索引 Schema 多數情況下，您會需要自訂底層索引的設定與規格，例如指定要啟用的 metadata 篩選條件。 在 Redis 中，只要定義索引 schema 物件（可從檔案或 dict 建立），再將它傳入 vector store 用戶端包裝器即可。 本範例會進行以下調整： 1. 將嵌入模型改為 Cohere 2. 新增文件時間戳記 updated at metadata 欄位 3. 將現有的 file name metadata 欄位加入索引 進一步了解 schema 與索引設計（Redis）。 查詢向量儲存並依 Metadata 篩選 額外的 metadata 已加入 Redis 索引，現在來試試搭配篩選條件進行查詢。 從 Redis 的既有索引還原 從索引還原時，需要提供 Redis 連線用戶端（或 URL）、overwrite=False，並傳入先前使用的相同 schema 物件。您也可以使用 .to yaml() 將設定存入 YAML 檔案，方便日後載入。 未來版本 — 我們會提供便利方法，讓您只需指定索引名稱即可載入： 刪除文件或整個索引 有時可能需要刪除文件或整個索引，可使用 delete 和 delete index 方法完成。 不過，Redis 索引仍會保留（其中不含任何文件），以便後續持續執行 upsert。 疑難排解 如果您得到空查詢結果，請檢查以下幾點： 索引 Schema 與其他 vector stores 不同，Redis 要求使用者明確定義索引的 schema。這是基於以下幾個原因： 1. Redis 用於多種用例，包括即時 vector search，但也用於標準的 document 儲存/檢索、caching、messaging、pub/sub、session mangement 等。記錄上的所有屬性不需要都進行索引。這部分是為了效率，部分是為了盡量減少使用者的負擔。 2. 使用 Redis & LlamaIndex 時，所有索引 schema 至少必須包含以下欄位 id、doc id、text 和 vector。 使用預設 schema（假設 OpenAI embeddings），或使用自訂 schema（請參閱上方）來實例化您的 RedisVectorStore。 前綴問題 Redis 要求所有記錄都具有一個 key prefix，用於將 keyspace 劃分為「partitions」，以適應可能不同的應用程式、用例和客戶端。 請確保所選的 prefix，作為索引 schema 的一部分，在您的程式碼中保持一致（與特定的索引綁定）。 要查看您的索引是用哪個 prefix 建立的，您可以在 Redis CLI 中運行 FT.INFO ，並查看 index definition = prefixes 下的內容。 資料 vs 索引 Redis 將資料集中的記錄和索引視為不同的實體。這讓您在執行更新、upserts 和索引 schema migration 時擁有更大的靈活性。 如果您有一個現有的索引，並想確認它是否被刪除，您可以在 Redis CLI 中運行 FT.DROPINDEX 。請注意，除非您傳遞 DD，否則這 不會 刪除您的實際資料。 使用 metadata 時的空查詢 如果您在索引建立 之後 才向索引添加 metadata，然後嘗試對該 metadata 進行查詢，您的查詢將會回傳空結果。 Redis 僅在索引建立時對欄位進行索引（類似於它對 prefix 的索引方式，如上所述）。
sourceText: In this notebook we are going to show a quick demo of using the RedisVectorStore. If you’re opening this Notebook on colab, you will probably need to install LlamaIndex 🦙. Start Redis The easiest way to start Redis is using the Redis Stack docker image or quickly signing up for a FREE Redis Cloud instance. To follow every step of this tutorial, launch the image as follows: Terminal window This will also launch the RedisInsight UI on port 8001 which you can view at . Setup OpenAI Lets first begin by adding the openai api key. This will allow us to access openai for embeddings and to use chatgpt. Download Data Read in a dataset Here we will use a set of Paul Graham essays to provide the text to turn into embeddings, store in a RedisVectorStore and query to find context for our LLM QnA loop. Initialize the default Redis Vector Store Now we have our documents prepared, we can initialize the Redis Vector Store with default settings. This will allow us to store our vectors in Redis and create an index for real-time search. Query the default vector store Now that we have our data stored in the index, we can ask questions against the index. The index will use the data as the knowledge base for an LLM. The default setting for as\ query\ engine() utilizes OpenAI embeddings and GPT as the language model. Therefore, an OpenAI key is required unless you opt for a customized or local language model. Below we will test searches against out index and then full RAG with an LLM. Use a custom index schema In most use cases, you need the ability to customize the underling index configuration and specification. For example, this is handy in order to define specific metadata filters you wish to enable. With Redis, this is as simple as defining an index schema object (from file or dict) and passing it through to the vector store client wrapper. For this example, we will: 1. switch the embedding model to Cohere 2. add an additional metadata field for the document updated at timestamp 3. index the existing file name metadata field Learn more about schema and index design with redis. Query the vector store and filter on metadata Now that we have additional metadata indexed in Redis, let’s try some queries with filters. Restoring from an existing index in Redis Restoring from an index requires a Redis connection client (or URL), overwrite=False, and passing in the same schema object used before. (This can be offloaded to a YAML file for convenience using .to yaml()) In the near future — we will implement a convenience method to load just using an index name: Deleting documents or index completely Sometimes it may be useful to delete documents or the entire index. This can be done using the delete and delete index methods. However, the Redis index still exists (with no associated documents) for continuous upsert. Troubleshooting If you get an empty query result, there a couple of issues to check: Schema Unlike other vector stores, Redis expects users to explicitly define the schema for the index. This is for a few reasons: 1. Redis is used for many use cases, including real-time vector search, but also for standard document storage/retrieval, caching, messaging, pub/sub, session mangement, and more. Not all attributes on records need to be indexed for search. This is partially an efficiency thing, and partially an attempt to minimize user foot guns. 2. All index schemas, when using Redis & LlamaIndex, must include the following fields id, doc id, text, and vector, at a minimum. Instantiate your RedisVectorStore with the default schema (assumes OpenAI embeddings), or with a custom schema (see above). Prefix issues Redis expects all records to have a key prefix that segments the keyspace into “partitions” for potentially different applications, use cases, and clients. Make sure that the chosen prefix, as part of the index schema, is consistent across your code (tied to a specific index). To see what prefix your index was created with, you can run FT.INFO in the Redis CLI and look under index definition = prefixes. Data vs Index Redis treats the records in the dataset and the index as different entities. This allows you more flexibility in performing updates, upserts, and index schema migrations. If you have an existing index and want to make sure it’s dropped, you can run FT.DROPINDEX in the Redis CLI. Note that this will not drop your actual data unless you pass DD Empty queries when using metadata If you add metadata to the index after it has already been created and then try to query over that metadata, your queries will come back empty. Redis indexes fields upon index creation only (similar to how it indexes the prefixes, above).
