text: 開始使用 從 index 建構一個聊天引擎： 提示 要了解如何建構 index，請參閱 索引 與您的資料進行對話： 重置聊天記錄以開始新的對話： 進入互動式聊天 REPL： 設定聊天引擎 設定聊天引擎與設定 query engine 非常相似。 高階 (High-Level) API 您只需一行程式碼即可直接從 index 建構和設定聊天引擎： 注意：您可以透過指定 chat mode 作為 kwarg 來存取不同的聊天引擎。condense question 對應於 CondenseQuestionChatEngine，react 對應於 ReActChatEngine，context 對應於 ContextChatEngine。 注意：雖然高階 API 旨在優化易用性，但它 不會 暴露完整的配置範圍。 可用的聊天模式 (Available Chat Modes) - best - 將 query engine 轉變為一個 tool，用於與 ReAct 資料 agent 或 OpenAI 資料 agent 配合使用，取決於您的 LLM 支援的內容。OpenAI 資料 agents 需要 gpt-3.5-turbo 或 gpt-4，因為它們使用 API 的 function calling 功能來自 OpenAI。 - condense question - 查看聊天記錄並將使用者訊息重寫為 index 的 query。在讀取 query engine 的回應後返回回應。 - context - 使用每一個使用者訊息從 index 中檢索 nodes。檢索到的文字會插入到 system prompt 中，以便聊天引擎可以自然回應或使用 query engine 的上下文。 - condense plus context - condense question 和 context 的組合。查看聊天記錄並將使用者訊息重寫為 index 的 retrieval query。檢索到的文字會插入到 system prompt 中，以便聊天引擎可以自然回應或使用 query engine 的上下文。 - simple - 直接與 LLM 進行簡單的聊天，不涉及 query engine。 - react - 與 best 相同，但強制使用 ReAct 資料 agent。 - openai - 與 best 相同，但強制使用 OpenAI 資料 agent。 低階組合 (Low-Level Composition) API 如果您需要更細緻的控制，可以使用低階組合 API。具體來說，您會明確建構 ChatEngine 物件，而不是呼叫 index.as chat engine(...)。 注意：您可能需要查看 API 的參考或範例 notebook。 以下是一個配置的範例： - 設定 condense question prompt， - 使用現有的歷史記錄初始化對話， - 列印詳細的 debug 訊息。 串流 (Streaming) 要啟用串流，您只需呼叫 stream chat endpoint，而不是 chat endpoint。 !!! warning 這與 query engine (您傳入 streaming=True flag 的地方) 有點不一致。我們正在努力使行為更一致！ 同步 (Synchronous) (stream chat): 非同步 (Asynchronous) (astream chat): 在使用 async framework (如 FastAPI) 時，請使用 astream\ chat。請注意，您必須等待呼叫並迭代提供的 async streaming interface (例如 async\ response\ gen() 或 achat\ stream)。 參閱 端到端教學
sourceText: Get Started Build a chat engine from index: Tip To learn how to build an index, see Indexing Have a conversation with your data: Reset chat history to start a new conversation: Enter an interactive chat REPL: Configuring a Chat Engine Configuring a chat engine is very similar to configuring a query engine. High-Level API You can directly build and configure a chat engine from an index in 1 line of code: Note: you can access different chat engines by specifying the chat mode as a kwarg. condense question corresponds to CondenseQuestionChatEngine, react corresponds to ReActChatEngine, context corresponds to a ContextChatEngine. Note: While the high-level API optimizes for ease-of-use, it does NOT expose full range of configurability. Available Chat Modes - best - Turn the query engine into a tool, for use with a ReAct data agent or an OpenAI data agent, depending on what your LLM supports. OpenAI data agents require gpt-3.5-turbo or gpt-4 as they use the function calling API from OpenAI. - condense question - Look at the chat history and re-write the user message to be a query for the index. Return the response after reading the response from the query engine. - context - Retrieve nodes from the index using every user message. The retrieved text is inserted into the system prompt, so that the chat engine can either respond naturally or use the context from the query engine. - condense plus context - A combination of condense question and context. Look at the chat history and re-write the user message to be a retrieval query for the index. The retrieved text is inserted into the system prompt, so that the chat engine can either respond naturally or use the context from the query engine. - simple - A simple chat with the LLM directly, no query engine involved. - react - Same as best, but forces a ReAct data agent. - openai - Same as best, but forces an OpenAI data agent. Low-Level Composition API You can use the low-level composition API if you need more granular control. Concretely speaking, you would explicitly construct ChatEngine object instead of calling index.as chat engine(...). Note: You may need to look at API references or example notebooks. Here’s an example where we configure the following: - configure the condense question prompt, - initialize the conversation with some existing history, - print verbose debug message. Streaming To enable streaming, you simply need to call the stream chat endpoint instead of the chat endpoint. !!! warning This somewhat inconsistent with query engine (where you pass in a streaming=True flag). We are working on making the behavior more consistent! Synchronous (stream chat): Asynchronous (astream chat): When using async frameworks (like FastAPI), use astream\ chat. Note that you must await the call and iterate over the provided async streaming interface (e.g., async\ response\ gen() or achat\ stream). See an end-to-end tutorial

title: 聊天引擎

sourceText: Concept Chat engine is a high-level interface for having a conversation with your data (multiple back-and-forth instead of a single question & answer). Think ChatGPT, but augmented with your knowledge base. Conceptually, it is a stateful analogy of a Query Engine. By keeping track of the conversation history, it can answer questions with past context in mind. Tip If you want to ask standalone question over your data (i.e. without keeping track of conversation history), use Query Engine instead. Usage Pattern Get started with: To stream response: More details in the complete usage pattern guide. Modules In our modules section, you can find corresponding tutorials to see the available chat engines in action.

title: 回應模式
text: 目前，我們支援以下選項： - refine：透過依序處理每個檢索到的文本區塊來 建立並精煉 答案。這會針對每個 Node/檢索到的區塊進行單獨的 LLM 呼叫。 詳情： 第一個區塊用於使用 text qa template 提示進行查詢。然後，答案、下一個區塊（以及原始問題）會用於另一個使用 refine template 提示的查詢。以此類推，直到所有區塊都被解析。 如果一個區塊太大，無法在視窗內容納（考慮提示大小），則使用 TokenTextSplitter（允許區塊之間有部分文本重疊）進行分割，並且（新的）附加區塊被視為原始區塊集合中的區塊（因此也會使用 refine template 進行查詢）。 適合需要更詳細的答案。 - compact（預設）：類似於 refine，但會 壓縮 （連接）區塊，從而減少 LLM 呼叫次數。 詳情： 將盡可能多的文本（從檢索到的區塊中連接/打包）放入上下文視窗內（考慮 text qa template 和 refine template 之間的最大提示大小）。如果文本太長無法放入一個提示中，則會根據需要分割成多個部分（使用 TokenTextSplitter，從而允許文本區塊之間有部分重疊）。 每個文本部分都被視為一個「chunk」，並傳送給 refine synthesizer。 簡而言之，它就像 refine，但 LLM 呼叫次數較少。 - tree summarize：重複查詢 LLM，使用 summary template 提示，直到所有連接的區塊都被查詢，從而產生越多答案，這些答案本身會被遞迴用作 tree summarize LLM 呼叫中的區塊，以此類推，直到只剩一個區塊，因此只有一個最終答案。 詳情： 使用 summary template 提示盡可能多地將區塊連接以適應上下文視窗，如果需要則分割（再次使用 TokenTextSplitter 並允許部分文本重疊）。然後，對每個產生的區塊/分割進行查詢，對 summary template（沒有 refine 查詢！）進行查詢，以獲取最多的答案。 如果只有一個答案（因為只有一個區塊），則它是最終答案。 如果有多個答案，這些答案本身被視為區塊，並遞迴傳送給 tree summarize 流程（連接/分割以適應/查詢）。 適合摘要目的。 - simple summarize：將所有文本區塊截斷以適應單個 LLM 提示。適合快速摘要，但由於截斷可能丟失細節。 - no text：只運行 retriever 以獲取原本會傳送給 LLM 的 nodes，而實際上不傳送它們。然後可以透過檢查 response.source nodes 來檢查。 - accumulate：給定一組文本區塊和查詢，將查詢應用於每個文本區塊，並將回應累積到一個陣列中。返回所有回應的連接字串。適合當你需要對每個文本區塊分別運行相同的查詢時。 - compact accumulate：與 accumulate 相同，但會像 compact 一樣「壓縮」每個 LLM 提示，並對每個文本區塊運行相同的查詢。 請參閱 Response Synthesizer 以了解更多資訊。
sourceText: Right now, we support the following options: - refine: create and refine an answer by sequentially going through each retrieved text chunk. This makes a separate LLM call per Node/retrieved chunk. Details: the first chunk is used in a query using the text qa template prompt. Then the answer and the next chunk (as well as the original question) are used in another query with the refine template prompt. And so on until all chunks have been parsed. If a chunk is too large to fit within the window (considering the prompt size), it is split using a TokenTextSplitter (allowing some text overlap between chunks) and the (new) additional chunks are considered as chunks of the original chunks collection (and thus queried with the refine template as well). Good for more detailed answers. - compact (default): similar to refine but compact (concatenate) the chunks beforehand, resulting in less LLM calls. Details: stuff as many text (concatenated/packed from the retrieved chunks) that can fit within the context window (considering the maximum prompt size between text qa template and refine template). If the text is too long to fit in one prompt, it is split in as many parts as needed (using a TokenTextSplitter and thus allowing some overlap between text chunks). Each text part is considered a “chunk” and is sent to the refine synthesizer. In short, it is like refine, but with less LLM calls. - tree summarize: Query the LLM using the summary template prompt as many times as needed so that all concatenated chunks have been queried, resulting in as many answers that are themselves recursively used as chunks in a tree summarize LLM call and so on, until there’s only one chunk left, and thus only one final answer. Details: concatenate the chunks as much as possible to fit within the context window using the summary template prompt, and split them if needed (again with a TokenTextSplitter and some text overlap). Then, query each resulting chunk/split against summary template (there is no refine query !) and get as many answers. If there is only one answer (because there was only one chunk), then it’s the final answer. If there are more than one answer, these themselves are considered as chunks and sent recursively to the tree summarize process (concatenated/splitted-to-fit/queried). Good for summarization purposes. - simple summarize: Truncates all text chunks to fit into a single LLM prompt. Good for quick summarization purposes, but may lose detail due to truncation. - no text: Only runs the retriever to fetch the nodes that would have been sent to the LLM, without actually sending them. Then can be inspected by checking response.source nodes. - accumulate: Given a set of text chunks and the query, apply the query to each text chunk while accumulating the responses into an array. Returns a concatenated string of all responses. Good for when you need to run the same query separately against each text chunk. - compact accumulate: The same as accumulate, but will “compact” each LLM prompt similar to compact, and run the same query against each text chunk. See Response Synthesizer to learn more.

title: 串流
text: LlamaIndex 支援即時串流生成的回應。這讓您在完整回應完成前，就能開始列印或處理回應的開頭部分。這可以大幅降低查詢的感知延遲。 設定 要啟用串流，您需要使用支援串流的 LLM。目前，OpenAI、HuggingFaceLLM 以及大多數 LangChain LLMs（透過 LangChainLLM）支援串流。 注意：如果 LLM 不支援串流，您選擇的 NotImplementedError 將會被提升。 若要設定查詢引擎使用高階的 API 進行串流，在建構查詢引擎時設定 streaming=True。 如果您使用低階的 API 來組成查詢引擎，在建構 Response Synthesizer 時傳遞 streaming=True： 串流回應 在正確設定 LLM 和查詢引擎後，呼叫 query 現在會回傳一個 StreamingResponse 物件。 當 LLM 呼叫 開始 時，回應會立即回傳，無需等待完整完成。 注意：在查詢引擎進行多次 LLM 呼叫的情況下，只有最後一次 LLM 呼叫會被串流，回應在最後一次 LLM 呼叫開始時回傳。 您可以從串流回應中取得一個 Generator，並逐一迭代接收到的 tokens： 或者，如果您只是想列印即時到達的文字： 請參閱 端到端範例
sourceText: LlamaIndex supports streaming the response as it’s being generated. This allows you to start printing or processing the beginning of the response before the full response is finished. This can drastically reduce the perceived latency of queries. Setup To enable streaming, you need to use an LLM that supports streaming. Right now, streaming is supported by OpenAI, HuggingFaceLLM, and most LangChain LLMs (via LangChainLLM). Note: if streaming is not supported by the LLM you choose a NotImplementedError will be raised. To configure query engine to use streaming using the high-level API, set streaming=True when building a query engine. If you are using the low-level API to compose the query engine, pass streaming=True when constructing the Response Synthesizer: Streaming Response After properly configuring both the LLM and the query engine, calling query now returns a StreamingResponse object. The response is returned immediately when the LLM call starts , without having to wait for the full completion. Note: In the case where the query engine makes multiple LLM calls, only the last LLM call will be streamed and the response is returned when the last LLM call starts. title: 貢獻 `LabelledRagDataset`
text: 注意： LlamaDatasets 已棄用且不再維護。本頁僅供參考，不再接受新的提交。 建立一個更穩健的 RAG 系統需要多元化的評估套件。這就是我們推出 LlamaDatasets 的原因。在本頁中，我們將討論如何貢獻第一種可用的 LlamaDataset，即 LabelledRagDataset。 貢獻一個 LabelledRagDataset 涉及兩個高階步驟。一般來說，您必須建立 LabelledRagDataset，將其儲存為 json，並提交此 json 檔案和原始文本檔案到我們的 llama-datasets repository。此外，您還需要建立一個 pull request，將資料集的所需 metadata 上傳到我們的 llama-hub repository。 為了讓提交流程更順暢，我們準備了一個範本 notebook，您可以依照此範本從零開始建立一個 LabelledRagDataset（或將結構相似的問答資料集轉換為此），並執行其他必要的步驟來完成您的提交。請參閱下方連結的「LlamaDataset Submission Template Notebook」。 貢獻其他 llama-datasets 貢獻我們其他 llama-datasets（例如 LabelledEvaluatorDataset）的通用流程與先前描述的 LabelledRagDataset 的流程相同。這些其他資料集的提交範本即將推出！ 提交範例 閱讀完整的 提交範例 Notebook。
sourceText: NOTE: LlamaDatasets are deprecated and no longer maintained. This page is kept for reference and new submissions are not being accepted. Building a more robust RAG system requires a diversified evaluation suite. That is why we launched LlamaDatasets. In this page, we discuss how you can contribute the first kind of LlamaDataset made available, that is, LabelledRagDataset. Contributing a LabelledRagDataset involves two high level steps. Generally speaking, you must create the LabelledRagDataset, save it as a json and submit both this json file and the source text files to our llama-datasets repository. Additionally, you’ll have to make a pull request, to upload required metadata of the dataset to our llama-hub repository. To help make the submission process a lot smoother, we’ve prepared a template notebook that you can follow to create a LabelledRagDataset from scratch (or convert a similarly structured question-answering dataset into one) and perform other required steps to make your submission. Please refer to the “LlamaDataset Submission Template Notebook” linked below. Contributing Other llama-datasets The general process for contributing any of our other llama-datasets such as the LabelledEvaluatorDataset is the same as for the LabelledRagDataset previously described. Submission templates for these other datasets are coming soon! Submission Example Read the full submission example Notebook.

title: 使用 `LabelledEvaluatorDataset` 評估 Evaluators
text: llama-datasets 的目的是為建構者提供快速評估 LLM 系統或任務的工具。基於此精神，LabelledEvaluatorDataset 旨在以無縫且輕鬆的方式促進評估者（evaluators）的評估。 此資料集包含主要具有以下屬性的範例：query、answer、ground truth answer、reference score 和 reference feedback，以及一些其他補充屬性。使用此資料集產生評估的流程包括使用提供的 LLM 評估者對資料集進行預測，然後計算衡量評估好壞的指標，透過將其與對應的參考進行計算比較。 以下是使用 EvaluatorBenchmarkerPack 來方便處理上述流程的程式碼片段。 相關的 LabelledPairwiseEvaluatorDataset 一個相關的 llama-dataset 是 LabelledPairwiseEvaluatorDataset，它同樣旨在評估評估者，但這次評估者被任務到比較一對 LLM 回應與給定的查詢，並在它們之間決定哪個更好。上述描述的使用流程與 LabelledEvaluatorDataset 的流程完全相同，唯一的區別是 LLM 評估者必須具備執行成對評估任務的能力——即必須是 PairwiseComparisonEvaluator。 更多學習資料 要看到這些資料集的作用，請查看下方列出的筆記本，這些筆記本在略微修改的 MT-Bench 資料集上對 LLM 評估者進行了基準測試。 - MTBench Single Grading - MTBench Human Judge
sourceText: The purpose of the llama-datasets is to provide builders the means to quickly benchmark LLM systems or tasks. In that spirit, the LabelledEvaluatorDataset exists to facilitate the evaluation of evaluators in a seamless and effortless manner. This dataset consists of examples that carries mainly the following attributes: query, answer, ground truth answer, reference score, and reference feedback along with some other supplementary attributes. The user flow for producing evaluations with this dataset consists of making predictions over the dataset with a provided LLM evaluator, and then computing metrics that measure goodness of evaluations by computationally comparing them to the corresponding references. Below is a snippet of code that makes use of the EvaluatorBenchmarkerPack to conveniently handle the above mentioned process flow. The related LabelledPairwiseEvaluatorDataset A related llama-dataset is the LabelledPairwiseEvaluatorDataset, which again is meant to evaluate an evaluator, but this time where the evaluator is tasked on comparing a pair of LLM responses to a given query and to determine the better one amongst them. The usage flow described above is exactly the same as it is for the LabelledEvaluatorDataset, with the exception that the LLM evaluator must be equipped to perform the pairwise evaluation task — i.e., should be a PairwiseComparisonEvaluator. More learning materials To see these datasets in action, be sure to checkout the notebooks listed below that benchmark LLM evaluators on slightly adapted versions of the MT-Bench dataset. - MTBench Single Grading - MTBench Human Judge

text: 使用 BaseEvaluator LlamaIndex 中的所有評估模組都實作了 BaseEvaluator 類別，具有兩種主要方法： 1. evaluate 方法接受 query、contexts、response 和額外的 keyword arguments。 2. evaluate response 方法提供了一個替代介面，它接受一個 llamaindex Response 物件（其中包含 response string 和 source nodes），而不是單獨的 contexts 和 response。 在功能上與 evaluate 相同，只是在直接操作 llamaindex 物件時更簡單。 使用 EvaluationResult 每個 evaluator 在執行時都會輸出一個 EvaluationResult： 不同的 evaluator 可能會填入結果欄位的一個子集。 評估回應忠實度（即幻覺） FaithfulnessEvaluator 評估答案是否忠於檢索到的 context（換句話說，是否存在 hallucination）。 您也可以選擇單獨評估每個 source context： 您將會得到一個結果列表，對應於 response.source nodes 中每個 source node。 評估查詢 + 回應相關性 RelevancyEvaluator 評估檢索到的 context 和答案對於給定的 query 是否相關且一致。 請注意，此 evaluator 除了 Response 物件外，還需要傳入 query。 同樣地，您也可以針對特定的 source node 進行評估。 問題生成 LlamaIndex 也可以生成用於回答問題的 question。將其與上述 evaluators 結合使用，您可以為您的資料建立一個完全自動化的評估流程。 批次評估 我們也提供了一個 batch evaluation runner，用於對多個問題運行一組 evaluators。 整合 我們也與社群評估工具進行整合。 - UpTrain - DeepEval - Ragas DeepEval DeepEval 提供 6 個 evaluators（包括 3 個 RAG evaluators，用於 retriever 和 generator evaluation），並由其專有的 evaluation metrics 驅動。要安裝 deepeval： 然後您可以匯入並使用 deepeval 中的 evaluators。完整範例： 以下是如何匯入 deepeval 中的所有 6 個 evaluators： 如需了解如何使用 deepeval 的 evaluation metrics 與 LlamaIndex 結合，並利用其完整的 LLM testing suite，請造訪 docs.
sourceText: Using BaseEvaluator All of the evaluation modules in LlamaIndex implement the BaseEvaluator class, with two main methods: 1. The evaluate method takes in query, contexts, response, and additional keyword arguments. 2. The evaluate response method provide an alternative interface that takes in a llamaindex Response object (which contains response string and source nodes) instead of separate contexts and response. It’s functionally the same as evaluate, just simpler to use when working with llamaindex objects directly. Using EvaluationResult Each evaluator outputs a EvaluationResult when executed: Different evaluators may populate a subset of the result fields. Evaluating Response Faithfulness (i.e. Hallucination) The FaithfulnessEvaluator evaluates if the answer is faithful to the retrieved contexts (in other words, whether if there’s hallucination). You can also choose to evaluate each source context individually: You’ll get back a list of results, corresponding to each source node in response.source nodes. Evaluating Query + Response Relevancy The RelevancyEvaluator evaluates if the retrieved context and the answer is relevant and consistent for the given query. Note that this evaluator requires the query to be passed in, in addition to the Response object. Similarly, you can also evaluate on a specific source node. Question Generation LlamaIndex can also generate questions to answer using your data. Using in combination with the above evaluators, you can create a fully automated evaluation flow over your data. Batch Evaluation We also provide a batch evaluation runner for running a set of evaluators across many questions. Integrations We also integrate with community evaluation tools. - UpTrain - DeepEval - Ragas DeepEval DeepEval offers 6 evaluators (including 3 RAG evaluators, for both retriever and generator evaluation) powered by its proprietary evaluation metrics. To being, install deepeval: You can then import and use evaluators from deepeval. title: 評估
text: 概念 評估和基準測試是 LLM 開發中的關鍵概念。為了提升 LLM 應用程式（RAG, agents）的效能，您必須有方法來衡量它。 LlamaIndex 提供關鍵模組來衡量生成結果的品質。我們也提供關鍵模組來衡量檢索品質。 - Response Evaluation ：回應是否符合檢索的上下文？是否也符合查詢？是否符合參考答案或指南？ - Retrieval Evaluation ：檢索到的來源是否與查詢相關？ 本章節描述了 LlamaIndex 中評估元件的工作方式。 Response Evaluation 生成結果的評估可能很困難，因為與傳統機器學習不同，預測結果不是單一數字，對於這個問題很難定義量化的指標。 LlamaIndex 提供 LLM-based 評估模組來衡量結果的品質。這會使用一個「gold」LLM（例如 GPT-4）來以多種方式判斷預測的答案是否正確。 請注意，許多目前的評估模組 不需要 真實標籤（ground-truth labels）。評估可以透過查詢、上下文、回應的組合，並將這些與 LLM 呼叫結合來進行。 這些評估模組的形式如下： - Correctness ：生成答案是否與給定的查詢的參考答案相符（需要標籤）。 - Semantic Similarity ：預測的答案是否與參考答案在語義上相似（需要標籤）。 - Faithfulness ：評估答案是否忠於檢索到的上下文（換句話說，是否存在幻覺）。 - Context Relevancy ：檢索到的上下文是否與查詢相關。 - Answer Relevancy ：生成的答案是否與查詢相關。 - Guideline Adherence ：預測的答案是否遵守特定的指南。 Question Generation 除了評估查詢外，LlamaIndex 也可以使用您的資料來生成用於評估的問題。這意味著您可以自動生成問題，然後運行一個評估流程來測試 LLM 是否能使用您的資料準確地回答問題。 Retrieval 評估 我們也提供模組來幫助獨立評估檢索。 檢索評估的概念並非新事物；給定一個問題資料集和真實排序（ground-truth rankings），我們可以利用 mean-reciprocal rank (MRR)、hit-rate、precision 等排序指標來評估 retrievers。 核心的檢索評估步驟圍繞以下內容： - Dataset generation ：給定一個非結構化的文本語料庫，合成生成 (question, context) 對。 - Retrieval Evaluation ：給定一個 retriever 和一組問題，使用排序指標來評估檢索到的結果。 整合 我們也整合了社群評估工具。 - UpTrain - Tonic Validate（包含用於視覺化結果的 Web UI） - DeepEval - Ragas - RAGChecker - Cleanlab 使用模式 有關完整使用細節，請參閱下方的使用模式。 - Query Eval Usage Pattern - Retrieval Eval Usage Pattern 模組 使用這些元件的 Notebooks 可在 module guides 中找到。
sourceText: Concept Evaluation and benchmarking are crucial concepts in LLM development. To improve the performance of an LLM app (RAG, agents), you must have a way to measure it. LlamaIndex offers key modules to measure the quality of generated results. We also offer key modules to measure retrieval quality. - Response Evaluation : Does the response match the retrieved context? Does it also match the query? Does it match the reference answer or guidelines? - Retrieval Evaluation : Are the retrieved sources relevant to the query? This section describes how the evaluation components within LlamaIndex work. Response Evaluation Evaluation of generated results can be difficult, since unlike traditional machine learning the predicted result isn’t a single number, and it can be hard to define quantitative metrics for this problem. LlamaIndex offers LLM-based evaluation modules to measure the quality of results. This uses a “gold” LLM (e.g. GPT-4) to decide whether the predicted answer is correct in a variety of ways. Note that many of these current evaluation modules do not require ground-truth labels. Evaluation can be done with some combination of the query, context, response, and combine these with LLM calls. These evaluation modules are in the following forms: - Correctness : Whether the generated answer matches that of the reference answer given the query (requires labels). - Semantic Similarity Whether the predicted answer is semantically similar to the reference answer (requires labels). - Faithfulness : Evaluates if the answer is faithful to the retrieved contexts (in other words, whether if there’s hallucination). - Context Relevancy : Whether retrieved context is relevant to the query. - Answer Relevancy : Whether the generated answer is relevant to the query. - Guideline Adherence : Whether the predicted answer adheres to specific guidelines. Question Generation In addition to evaluating queries, LlamaIndex can also use your data to generate questions to evaluate on. This means that you can automatically generate questions, and then run an evaluation flow to test if the LLM can actually answer questions accurately using your data. Retrieval Evaluation We also provide modules to help evaluate retrieval independently. The concept of retrieval evaluation is not new; given a dataset of questions and ground-truth rankings, we can evaluate retrievers using ranking metrics like mean-reciprocal rank (MRR), hit-rate, precision, and more. The core retrieval evaluation steps revolve around the following: - Dataset generation : Given an unstructured text corpus, synthetically generate (question, context) pairs. - Retrieval Evaluation : Given a retriever and a set of questions, evaluate retrieved results using ranking metrics. Integrations We also integrate with community evaluation tools. - UpTrain - Tonic Validate(Includes Web UI for visualizing results) - DeepEval - Ragas - RAGChecker - Cleanlab Usage Pattern For full usage details, see the usage pattern below. - Query Eval Usage Pattern - Retrieval Eval Usage Pattern Modules Notebooks with usage of these components can be found in the module guides.

title: 文件管理
text: LlamaIndex 多數索引結構都支援 新增 、 刪除 、 更新 與 重新整理 操作。 新增 初次建立索引後，您仍可將新的 Document「插入」任何索引資料結構中。LlamaIndex 會將文件拆成多個節點，再匯入索引。 底層的插入機制取決於索引結構。例如，摘要索引會將新的 Document 作為額外節點加入清單；向量儲存庫索引則會將新的 Document 及其嵌入向量寫入底層的文件／嵌入儲存庫。 範例如下： 刪除 指定 document\ id，即可從多數索引資料結構刪除 Document。（ 注意 ：目前樹狀索引（tree index）不支援刪除。）與該文件對應的所有節點都會一併刪除。 若您在多個索引間共用同一個 docstore，delete from docstore 預設為 False。即使設為 False，查詢時也不會使用這些節點，因為它們會從索引的 index struct 中移除；該結構負責追蹤哪些節點可供查詢。 更新 若索引中已存在某個 Document，當文件內容變更時，可以使用相同的 doc id 更新該 Document。 重新整理 載入資料時，若為每份文件設定 doc id ，也可以自動重新整理索引。 refresh() 函式只會更新 doc id 相同但文字內容不同的文件。索引中尚不存在的文件也會一併新增。 refresh() 還會回傳布林值清單，指出輸入的哪些文件已在索引中更新。 上例中，我們另外傳入了一些 kwargs，確保文件會從 docstore 刪除；這當然是選擇性的。 若您 print() refresh() 的輸出，就能看到哪些輸入文件已重新整理： 當您讀取的目錄持續有新資料加入時，這項功能特別實用。 若要自動設定文件的 doc id ，請在 SimpleDirectoryReader 中啟用 filename as id 旗標。更多資訊請參閱自訂 Document。 文件追蹤 若索引使用 docstore（也就是多數向量儲存庫整合以外的所有索引），您也可以查看已加入 docstore 的文件。 輸出中的每筆資料都以匯入文件的 id 作為索引鍵，並列出該文件切分出的節點所對應的 node ids。 此外，系統也會追蹤每份輸入文件原有的 metadata 字典。metadata 屬性的詳細說明請參閱自訂 Document。
sourceText: Most LlamaIndex index structures allow for insertion , deletion , update , and refresh operations. Insertion You can “insert” a new Document into any index data structure, after building the index initially. This document will be broken down into nodes and ingested into the index. The underlying mechanism behind insertion depends on the index structure. For instance, for the summary index, a new Document is inserted as additional node(s) in the list. For the vector store index, a new Document (and embeddings) is inserted into the underlying document/embedding store. An example code snippet is given below: Deletion You can “delete” a Document from most index data structures by specifying a document\ id. ( NOTE : the tree index currently does not support deletion). All nodes corresponding to the document will be deleted. delete from docstore will default to False in case you are sharing nodes between indexes using the same docstore. However, these nodes will not be used when querying when this is set to False as they will be deleted from the index struct of the index, which keeps track of which nodes can be used for querying. Update If a Document is already present within an index, you can “update” a Document with the same doc id (for instance, if the information in the Document has changed). Refresh If you set the doc id of each document when loading your data, you can also automatically refresh the index. The refresh() function will only update documents who have the same doc id , but different text contents. Any documents not present in the index at all will also be inserted. refresh() also returns a boolean list, indicating which documents in the input have been refreshed in the index. Again, we passed some extra kwargs to ensure the document is deleted from the docstore. This is of course optional. If you print() the output of refresh(), you would see which input documents were refreshed: This is most useful when you are reading from a directory that is constantly updating with new information. To automatically set the doc id when using the SimpleDirectoryReader, you can set the filename as id flag. You can learn more about customzing Documents. Document Tracking Any index that uses the docstore (i.e. all indexes except for most vector store integrations), you can also see which documents you have inserted into the docstore. Each entry in the output shows the ingested doc id s as keys, and their associated node ids of the nodes they were split into. Lastly, the original metadata dictionary of each input document is also tracked. You can read more about the metadata attribute in Customizing Documents.

title: 各種索引的運作方式
text: 本指南搭配示意圖，說明各種索引的運作方式。 術語說明： - Node ：對應 Document 中的一個文字片段。LlamaIndex 接收 Document 物件後，會在內部解析並切分內容，建立 Node 物件。 - Response Synthesis ：這個模組會根據檢索到的 Node 組合出回應。如何指定不同的回應模式請參閱該指南。 摘要索引（Summary Index，舊稱 List Index） 摘要索引會將 Nodes 依序串接儲存。 查詢方式 查詢時若未指定其他參數，LlamaIndex 會將清單中的所有 Nodes 載入 Response Synthesis 模組。 摘要索引支援多種查詢方式，例如以嵌入向量為基礎的查詢會擷取 top-k 鄰近項目，也可以加上關鍵字篩選條件，如下所示： 向量儲存索引（Vector Store Index） 向量儲存索引會將每個 Node 及其對應的 embedding 儲存在向量儲存區。 查詢方式 查詢向量儲存索引時，系統會擷取最相似的 top-k 個 Nodes，並將它們傳遞給 Response Synthesis 模組。 樹狀索引（Tree Index） 樹狀索引會以一組 Nodes 建立階層式樹狀結構，這些 Nodes 會成為樹的葉節點。 查詢方式 查詢樹狀索引時，系統會從根節點往下走訪至葉節點。預設值（child branch factor=1）時，每個父節點只會選取一個子節點；若設為 child branch factor=2，每一層則會選取兩個子節點。 關鍵字表索引（Keyword Table Index） 關鍵字表索引會從每個 Node 擷取關鍵字，並建立關鍵字與對應 Nodes 之間的映射。 查詢方式 查詢時，系統會從查詢中擷取相關關鍵字，與先前擷取的 Node 關鍵字比對，找出對應的 Nodes，再將這些 Nodes 傳入 Response Synthesis 模組。 屬性圖索引（Property Graph Index） 屬性圖索引會先建立知識圖譜，其中包含已加上標籤的 Node 及其關係。圖譜的建構方式可高度自訂：你可以讓 LLM 擷取所需資訊、使用嚴格的 schema 進行擷取，或實作自己的擷取模組。 也可以選擇替 Node 建立 embedding，以供後續檢索。 你也可以略過建置步驟，透過 Neo4j 等整合方式連接到現有的知識圖譜。 查詢方式 屬性圖索引也支援彈性的查詢。檢索時會使用多個子檢索器（sub-retrievers）並合併結果。預設會使用關鍵字加同義詞擴展，並在圖譜已建立 embedding 時搭配向量檢索，找出相關三元組（triples）。 你也可以在檢索到的三元組（triples）中一併包含來源文字（若圖譜是在 LlamaIndex 之外建立，則無法使用此功能）。 完整說明請參閱屬性圖指南。
sourceText: This guide describes how each index works with diagrams. Some terminology: - Node : Corresponds to a chunk of text from a Document. LlamaIndex takes in Document objects and internally parses/chunks them into Node objects. - Response Synthesis : Our module which synthesizes a response given the retrieved Node. You can see how to specify different response modes. Summary Index (formerly List Index) The summary index simply stores Nodes as a sequential chain. Querying During query time, if no other query parameters are specified, LlamaIndex simply loads all Nodes in the list into our Response Synthesis module. The summary index does offer numerous ways of querying a summary index, from an embedding-based query which will fetch the top-k neighbors, or with the addition of a keyword filter, as seen below: Vector Store Index The vector store index stores each Node and a corresponding embedding in a Vector Store. Querying Querying a vector store index involves fetching the top-k most similar Nodes, and passing those into our Response Synthesis module. Tree Index The tree index builds a hierarchical tree from a set of Nodes (which become leaf nodes in this tree). Querying Querying a tree index involves traversing from root nodes down to leaf nodes. By default, (child branch factor=1), a query chooses one child node given a parent node. If child branch factor=2, a query chooses two child nodes per level. Keyword Table Index The keyword table index extracts keywords from each Node and builds a mapping from each keyword to the corresponding Nodes of that keyword. Querying During query time, we extract relevant keywords from the query, and match those with pre-extracted Node keywords to fetch the corresponding Nodes. The extracted Nodes are passed to our Response Synthesis module. Property Graph Index The Property Graph Index works by first building a knowledge graph containing labelled nodes and relations. The construction of this graph is extremely customizable, ranging from letting the LLM extract whatever it wants, to extracting using a strict schema, to even implementing your own extraction modules. Optionally, nodes can also be embedded for retrieval later. You can also skip creation, and connect to an existing knowledge graph using an integration like Neo4j. Querying Querying a Property Graph Index is also highly flexible. Retrieval works by using several sub-retrievers and combining results. By default, keyword + synoymn expanasion is used, as well as vector retrieval (if your graph was embedded), to retrieve relevant triples. You can also chose to include the source text in addition to the retrieved triples (unavailable for graphs created outside of LlamaIndex). See more in the full guide for Property Graphs.

title: LlamaCloudIndex + LlamaCloudRetriever
text: LlamaCloudIndex 會將此框架連接至 Index 的第一版，也就是 LlamaParse 提供的代管式資料匯入與檢索服務。LlamaParse 是 LlamaIndex 團隊提供的託管文件平台，先前名為 LlamaCloud，因此下方的類別與套件名稱沿用舊名稱。 此整合套件適用於較早版本的 Index LlamaCloudIndex 隨 llama-cloud-services 套件提供；該套件已棄用且不再更新，並連線至 Index 第一版。安裝此套件會固定使用舊版 llama-cloud，因此無法與目前的 llama-cloud SDK 共用同一個環境。新專案請透過 Index v2，並搭配 llama-cloud SDK 使用。 Index 提供以下功能： - 代管式資料匯入：解析、切分、產生嵌入向量及管理文件，並與資料來源保持同步 - 代管式檢索：提供為 RAG 系統調校的檢索端點；此處會將它用作 LlamaIndex 檢索器或查詢引擎 關於服務本身，請參閱該版 Index 的說明文件。 取得存取權 請先註冊 LlamaParse以取得 API 金鑰，接著可在控制台建立索引，或執行下方程式碼建立索引。若您需要自行託管或指定專屬區域，請洽詢我們的企業方案。 設定 請先確認已安裝最新版 LlamaIndex。 接著安裝整合套件；它不包含在 llama-index 中： 使用方式 執行以下程式碼，即可在 LlamaCloud 建立索引： 您也可以設定檢索器，以使用代管式檢索： 當然，您也可以使用其他索引捷徑，充分運用新建立的代管索引： 檢索器設定 以下列出所有 retriever 設定／kwargs： - dense similarity top k：Optional\[int] — 若大於 0，使用密集檢索擷取 k 個節點 - sparse similarity top k：Optional\[int] — 若大於 0，使用稀疏檢索擷取 k 個節點 - enable reranking：Optional\[bool] — 是否啟用重排；重排會犧牲部分速度以換取準確度 - rerank top n：Optional\[int] — 初步檢索結果重排後要回傳的節點數量 - alpha Optional\[float] — 密集與稀疏檢索的權重。1 表示完全採用密集檢索，0 表示完全採用稀疏檢索。 複合檢索的使用方式 設定多個索引以匯入不同類型的資料後，您可能會想建立一個應用程式，跨這些索引查詢資料。 這時可使用 LlamaCloudCompositeRetriever 類別。以下程式碼示範如何設定複合檢索器： 複合檢索的相關參數 以下幾個參數可用來調整複合檢索的行為： - mode：Optional[CompositeRetrievalMode] — 可設為 CompositeRetrievalMode.FULL 或 CompositeRetrievalMode.ROUTING - full：此模式會查詢所有已連結的子索引，並對各子索引回傳的所有節點進行重排。 - routing：此模式會由 agent 根據您提供的子索引 name 與 description 判斷哪些子索引與查詢最相關，並只查詢相關索引。接著，系統會先對所選子索引中的節點進行重排，再將結果放入檢索回應。 - rerank top n：Optional[int] — 決定從所有索引檢索出的節點中，重排後要回傳的節點數量
sourceText: LlamaCloudIndex connects this framework to the first version of Index, the managed ingestion and retrieval service in LlamaParse, the hosted document platform from the LlamaIndex team. LlamaParse was previously called LlamaCloud, which is where the class and package names below come from. This integration targets the earlier version of Index LlamaCloudIndex ships in llama-cloud-services, a package that is deprecated and no longer updated, and it talks to the first version of Index. Installing it pins an old release of llama-cloud, so it cannot share an environment with the current llama-cloud SDK. For new projects, use Index v2 through the llama-cloud SDK. Index gives you - Managed ingestion: parsing, chunking, embedding and document management, kept in sync with your data sources - Managed retrieval: a retrieval endpoint tuned for your RAG system, used here as a LlamaIndex retriever or query engine For the service itself, see the documentation for that version of Index. Access Sign up for LlamaParse to get an API key, then create an index from the dashboard or with the code below. Talk to us about enterprise plans if you need self-hosting or a dedicated region. Setup First, make sure you have the latest LlamaIndex version installed. Then install the integration package, which is not included with llama-index: Usage You can create an index on LlamaCloud using the following code: You can also configure a retriever for managed retrieval: And of course, you can use other index shortcuts to get use out of your new managed index: Retriever Settings A full list of retriever settings/kwargs is below: - dense similarity top k: Optional\[int] — If greater than 0, retrieve k nodes using dense retrieval - sparse similarity top k: Optional\[int] — If greater than 0, retrieve k nodes using sparse retrieval - enable reranking: Optional\[bool] — Whether to enable reranking or not. Sacrifices some speed for accuracy - rerank top n: Optional\[int] — The number of nodes to return after reranking initial retrieval results - alpha Optional\[float] — The weighting between dense and sparse retrieval. 1 = Full dense retrieval, 0 = Full sparse retrieval. Composite Retrieval Usage Once you’ve setup multiple indexes that are ingesting various forms of data, you may want to create an application that can query over the data across all of your indices. This is where you can use the LlamaCloudCompositeRetriever class. The following snippet shows you how to setup the composite retriever: Composite Retrieval related parameters There are a few parameters that are specific to tuning the composite retrieval parameters: - mode: Optional[CompositeRetrievalMode] — Can either be CompositeRetrievalMode.FULL or CompositeRetrievalMode.ROUTING - full: In this mode, all attached sub-indices will be queried and reranking will be executed across all nodes received from these sub-indices. - routing: In this mode, an agent determines which sub-indices are most relevant to the provided query (based on the sub-index’s name & description you’ve provided) and only queries those indices that are deemed relevant. Only the nodes from that chosen subset of indices are then reranked before being returned in the retrieval response. - rerank top n: Optional[int] — Determines how many nodes to return after re-ranking across the nodes retrieved from all indices

title: 使用 Property Graph Index
text: 物件圖是帶有標籤的 nodes（即實體類別、文字標籤等）的知識集合，透過關係連結成結構化的路徑，這些物件具有屬性（即 metadata）。 在 LlamaIndex 中，PropertyGraphIndex 提供了關於以下事項的關鍵協調： - 建構圖 (constructing a graph) - 查詢圖 (querying a graph) 使用方法 基本使用方法可以透過直接匯入類別並使用它來找到： 建構 (Construction) 在 LlamaIndex 中，物件圖的建構透過對每個 chunk 執行一系列 kg extractors，並將實體和關係作為 metadata 附加到每個 llama-index node 上來完成。您可以在這裡使用任意數，它們都會被套用。 如果您已經使用過 ingestion pipeline 中的轉換器或 metadata 提取器，那麼這會非常熟悉（而且這些 kg extractors 與 ingestion pipeline 相容）！ 提取器是使用適當的 kwarg 設定的： 如果未提供，預設值是 SimpleLLMPathExtractor 和 ImplicitPathExtractor。 所有 kg extractors 詳見下文。 (default) SimpleLLMPathExtractor 使用 LLM 來提示和解析單跳路徑，格式為 (entity1, relation, entity2) 的簡短陳述。 如果您需要，也可以自訂提示和用於解析路徑的函式。 這裡是一個簡單的（但天真的）範例： (default) ImplicitPathExtractor 使用 node.relationships 屬性對每個 llama-index node 物件提取路徑。 此提取器不需要 LLM 或 embedding model 就能運行，因為它僅僅是解析已存在於 llama-index node 物件上的屬性。 DynamicLLMPathExtractor 根據可選的允許實體類型和關係類別列表，提取路徑（包括實體類型！）。如果未提供任何，則 LLM 會自行分配類型。如果提供了，它將幫助引導 LLM，但不會強制要求確切的類型。 SchemaLLMPathExtractor 遵循允許的實體、關係以及哪些實體可以連接到哪些關係的嚴格模式來提取路徑。 使用 pydantic、LLMs 的結構化輸出，以及一些巧妙的驗證，我們可以動態指定模式並對每條路徑驗證提取結果。 此提取器極度可自訂，並提供選項來自訂： - 模式的各個方面（如上所示） - extract prompt - strict=False 與 strict=True，以允許不在模式之外的三元組或不允許 - raise on error=False 與 raise on error=True，以控制是否吞噬並記錄 LLM API 錯誤（預設），或是否導致 pipeline 崩潰。 - 如果您是 pydantic 專業人士並想建立自訂驗證的 pydantic 類別，可以傳入您自己的 kg schema cls。 檢索與查詢 (Retrieval and Querying) 帶有標籤的物件圖可以透過多種方式進行查詢，以檢索 nodes 和路徑。在 LlamaIndex 中，我們可以一次組合多個 node 檢索方法！ 如果未提供子檢索器，預設值是 LLMSynonymRetriever 和 VectorContextRetriever（如果啟用 embedding）。 所有檢索器目前都包含： - LLMSynonymRetriever - 根據 LLM 生成的關鍵字/同義詞進行檢索 - VectorContextRetriever - 根據嵌入的圖 nodes 進行檢索 - TextToCypherRetriever - 要求 LLM 根據物件圖的模式生成 cypher - CypherTemplateRetriever - 使用由 LLM 推斷的參數的 cypher template - CustomPGRetriever - 易於子類和實作自訂檢索邏輯 通常，您會定義一個或多個這些子檢索器並將它們傳遞給 PGRetriever： 請閱讀下文以了解所有檢索器的更多詳細資訊。 (default) LLMSynonymRetriever LLMSynonymRetriever 接收查詢，並嘗試生成關鍵字和同義詞以檢索 nodes（以及因此連接到該 nodes 的路徑）。 明確宣告 retriever 允許您自訂多個選項。以下是預設值： (預設，若支援) VectorContextRetriever VectorContextRetriever 根據向量相似度檢索 nodes，然後獲取連接到這些 nodes 的路徑。 如果您的 graph store 支援 vectors，則您只需為儲存管理該 graph store。否則，您需要提供一個 vector store，除了 graph store（預設使用 in-memory SimpleVectorStore）。 TextToCypherRetriever TextToCypherRetriever 使用 graph store schema、您的 query 和一個 prompt template 進行 text-to-cypher，以生成並執行一個 cypher query。 注意： 由於 SimplePropertyGraphStore 並非實際的 graph database，它不支援 cypher queries。 您可以使用 index.property graph store.get schema str() 來檢查 schema。 注意： 執行任意 cypher 存在風險。請確保您採取必要的措施（只讀角色、沙盒環境等），以確保在生產環境中的安全使用。 CypherTemplateRetriever 這是 TextToCypherRetriever 的一個更受限制的版本。與讓 LLM 自由生成任何 cypher statement 不同，我們可以提供一個 cypher template，讓 LLM 填補空白。 為了說明如何運作，這裡有一個小範例： Storage 目前，支援 property graphs 的 graph stores 包括： In-Memory Native Embedding Support Async Server or disk based? -------------------------- --------- ------------------------ ----- --------------------- SimplePropertyGraphStore ✅ ❌ ❌ Disk Neo4jPropertyGraphStore ❌ ✅ ❌ Server NebulaPropertyGraphStore ❌ ❌ ❌ Server TiDBPropertyGraphStore ❌ ✅ ❌ Server FalkorDBPropertyGraphStore ❌ ✅ ❌ Server Saving 寫入/讀取磁碟 預設的 property graph store，SimplePropertyGraphStore，將所有內容儲存在記憶體中，並從磁碟中持久化和載入。 以下是使用預設 graph store 儲存/載入 index 的範例： Saving 與使用 Integrations 載入 Integrations 通常會自動儲存。有些 graph stores 支援 vectors，有些則不支援。您也可以將 graph store 與外部 vector db 結合使用。 此範例展示了如何使用 Neo4j 和 Qdrant 來儲存/載入 property graph index。 注意： 如果沒有傳入 qdrant，neo4j 會自行儲存和使用 embeddings。此範例說明了超出此情況的靈活性。 pip install llama-index-graph-stores-neo4j llama-index-vector-stores-qdrant 使用 Property Graph Store Directly property graphs 的基礎儲存類別是 PropertyGraphStore。這些 property graph stores 是使用不同類型的 LabeledNode 物件構建的，並使用 Relation 物件連接。 我們可以自己建立這些，也可以插入我們自己！ graph store 上其他有用的方法包括： - graph store.get(ids=[]) - 根據 ids 獲取 nodes - graph store.get(properties={"key": "val"}) - 根據匹配的 properties 獲取 nodes - graph store.get rel map([entity node], depth=2) - 獲取到特定深度的 triples - graph store.get llama nodes(['id1']) - 獲取原始的 text nodes - graph store.delete(ids=['id1']) - 根據 ids 刪除 - graph store.delete(properties={"key": "val"}) - 根據 properties 刪除 - graph store.structured query(" ") - 執行一個 cypher query（假設 graph store 支援） 此外，對於所有這些功能都存在 a 版本以支援 async（即 aget, adelete 等）。 Advanced Customization如同 LlamaIndex 中的所有元件，您可以子類模組並自訂使其完全符合您的需求，或嘗試新的想法並研究新的模組！ 子類 Extractors LlamaIndex 中的 Graph extractors 子類 TransformComponent class。如果您之前操作過 ingestion pipeline，這會很熟悉，因為它是同一個 class。 extractors 的要求是將 insert graph data 插入到 node 的 metadata 中，然後由 index 稍後處理。 以下是一個創建自訂 extractor 的子類範例： 子類 Retrievers retriever 比 extractors 稍微複雜一些，它有自己的特殊 class 來幫助使子類變得更容易。 retrieval 的 return type 非常靈活，它可以是： - 一個 string - 一個 TextNode - 一個 NodeWithScore - 上述任何一種的列表 (list) 以下是一個創建自訂 retriever 的子類範例： 對於更複雜的自訂和使用案例，建議查看 source code 並直接子類 BasePGRetriever。 範例 在下方，您可以找到一些展示 PropertyGraphIndex 的範例 notebook： - Basic Usage - Using Neo4j - Using Nebula - Advanced Usage with Neo4j 以及本地 models - Using a Property Graph Store - Creating 自訂 Graph Retriever - Comparing KG Extractors
sourceText: A property graph is a knowledge collection of labeled nodes (i.e. entity categories, text labels, etc.) with properties (i.e. metadata), linked together by relationships into structured paths. In LlamaIndex, the PropertyGraphIndex provides key orchestration around - constructing a graph - querying a graph Usage Basic usage can be found by simply importing the class and using it: Construction Property graph construction in LlamaIndex works by performing a series of kg extractors on each chunk, and attaching entities and relations as metadata to each llama-index node. You can use as many as you like here, and they will all get applied. If you’ve used transformations or metadata extractors with the ingestion pipeline, then this will be very familiar (and these kg extractors are compatible with the ingestion pipeline)! Extractors are set using the appropriate kwarg: If not provided, the defaults are SimpleLLMPathExtractor and ImplicitPathExtractor. All kg extractors are detailed below. (default) SimpleLLMPathExtractor Extract short statements using an LLM to prompt and parse single-hop paths in the format (entity1, relation, entity2) If you want, you can also customize the prompt and the function used to parse the paths. Here’s a simple (but naive) example: (default) ImplicitPathExtractor Extract paths using the node.relationships attribute on each llama-index node object. This extractor does not need an LLM or embedding model to run, since it’s merely parsing properties that already exist on llama-index node objects. DynamicLLMPathExtractor Will extract paths (including entity types!) according to optional list of allowed entity types and relation types. If none are provided, then the LLM will assign types as it sees fit. If they are provided, it will help guide the LLM, but will not enforce exactly those types. SchemaLLMPathExtractor Extract paths following a strict schema of allowed entities, relationships, and which entities can be connected to which relationships. Using pydantic, structured outputs from LLMs, and some clever validation, we can dynamically specify a schema and verify the extractions per-path. This extractor is extremely customizable, and has options to customize - various aspects of the schema (as seen above) - the extract prompt - strict=False vs. strict=True, to allow triples outside of the schema or not - raise on error=False vs. raise on error=True to control whether LLM API errors are swallowed and logged (default), or if they crash the pipeline. - passing in your own custom kg schema cls if you are a pydantic pro and wanted to create you own pydantic class with custom validation. Retrieval and Querying Labeled property graphs can be queried in several ways to retrieve nodes and paths. And in LlamaIndex, we can combine several node retrieval methods at once! If no sub-retrievers are provided, the defaults are LLMSynonymRetriever and VectorContextRetriever (if embeddings are enabled). All retrievers currently include: - LLMSynonymRetriever - retrieve based on LLM generated keywords/synonyms - VectorContextRetriever - retrieve based on embedded graph nodes - TextToCypherRetriever - ask the LLM to generate cypher based on the schema of the property graph - CypherTemplateRetriever - use a cypher template with params inferred by the LLM - CustomPGRetriever - easy to subclass and implement custom retrieval logic Generally, you would define one or more of these sub-retrievers and pass them to the PGRetriever: Read on below for more details on all retrievers. (default) LLMSynonymRetriever The LLMSynonymRetriever takes the query, and tries to generate keywords and synonyms to retrieve nodes (and therefore the paths connected to those nodes). Explicitly declaring the retriever allows you to customize several options. Here are the defaults: (default, if supported) VectorContextRetriever The VectorContextRetriever retrieves nodes based on their vector similarity, and then fetches the paths connected to those nodes. If your graph store supports vectors, then you only need to manage that graph store for storage. Otherwise, you will need to provide a vector store in addition to the graph store (by default, uses the in-memory SimpleVectorStore). TextToCypherRetriever The TextToCypherRetriever uses a graph store schema, your query, and a prompt template for text-to-cypher in order to generate and execute a cypher query. NOTE: Since the SimplePropertyGraphStore is not actually a graph database, it does not support cypher queries. You can inspect the schema by using index.property graph store.get schema str(). NOTE: Executing arbitrary cypher has its risks. Ensure you take the needed measures (read-only roles, sandboxed env, etc.) to ensure safe usage in a production environment. CypherTemplateRetriever This is a more constrained version of the TextToCypherRetriever. Rather than letting the LLM have free-range of generating any cypher statement, we can instead provide a cypher template and have the LLM fill in the blanks. To illustrate how this works, here is a small example: Storage Currently, supported graph stores for property graphs include: In-Memory Native Embedding Support Async Server or disk based? -------------------------- --------- ------------------------ ----- --------------------- SimplePropertyGraphStore ✅ ❌ ❌ Disk Neo4jPropertyGraphStore ❌ ✅ ❌ Server NebulaPropertyGraphStore ❌ ❌ ❌ Server TiDBPropertyGraphStore ❌ ✅ ❌ Server FalkorDBPropertyGraphStore ❌ ✅ ❌ Server Saving to/from disk The default property graph store, SimplePropertyGraphStore, stores everything in memory and persists and loads from disk. Here’s an example of saving/loading an index with the default graph store: Saving and Loading with Integrations Integrations typically save automatically. Some graph stores will support vectors, others might not. You can always combine a graph store with an external vector db as well. This example shows how you might save/load a property graph index using Neo4j and Qdrant. Note: If qdrant wasn’t passed in, neo4j would store and use the embeddings on its own. This example illustrates the flexibility beyond that. pip install llama-index-graph-stores-neo4j llama-index-vector-stores-qdrant Using the Property Graph Store Directly The base storage class for property graphs is the PropertyGraphStore. These property graph stores are constructed using different types of LabeledNode objects, and connected using Relation objects. We can create these ourselves, and also insert ourselves! Other helpful methods on the graph store include: - graph store.get(ids=[]) - gets nodes based on ids - graph store.get(properties={"key": "val"}) - gets nodes based on matching properties - graph store.get rel map([entity node], depth=2) - gets triples up to a certain depth - graph store.get llama nodes(['id1']) - gets the original text nodes - graph store.delete(ids=['id1']) - delete based on ids - graph store.delete(properties={"key": "val"}) - delete based on properties - graph store.structured query(" ") - runs a cypher query (assuming the graph store supports it) In addition a versions exist for all of these for async support (i.e. aget, adelete, etc.). Advanced Customization As with all components in LlamaIndex, you can sub-class modules and customize things to work exactly as you need, or try out new ideas and research new modules! Sub-Classing Extractors Graph extractors in LlamaIndex subclass the TransformComponent class. If you’ve worked with the ingestion pipeline before, this will be familiar since it is the same class. The requirement for extractors is that the insert graph data into the metadata of the node, which will then be processed later on by the index. Here is a small example of sub-classing to create a custom extractor: Sub-Classing Retrievers The retriever is a bit more complicated than the extractors, and has it’s own special class to help make sub-classing easier. The return type of the retrieval is extremely flexible. It could be - a string - a TextNode - a NodeWithScore - a list of one of the above Here is a small example of sub-classing to create a custom retriever: For more complicated customization and use-cases, it is recommended to check out the source code and directly sub-class BasePGRetriever. sourceText: Introduction In many cases, especially with long documents, a chunk of text may lack the context necessary to disambiguate the chunk from other similar chunks of text. To combat this, we use LLMs to extract certain contextual information relevant to the document to better help the retrieval and language models disambiguate similar-looking passages. We show this in an example notebook and demonstrate its effectiveness in processing long documents. Usage First, we define a metadata extractor that takes in a list of feature extractors that will be processed in sequence. We then feed this to the node parser, which will add the additional metadata to each node. Then, we can run our transformations on input documents or nodes: Here is an sample of extracted metadata: Custom Extractors If the provided extractors do not fit your needs, you can also define a custom extractor like so: extractor.extract() will automatically call aextract() under the hood, to provide both sync and async entrypoints. In a more advanced example, it can also make use of an llm to extract features from the node content and the existing metadata. Refer to the source code of the provided metadata extractors for more details. title: 使用 VectorStoreIndex
text: 向量儲存庫是檢索增強生成（RAG）的重要元件，因此在使用 LlamaIndex 建構的幾乎所有應用程式中，您都會直接或間接用到它。 向量儲存庫會接收 Node 物件清單，並據此建立索引。 載入資料至索引 基本用法 使用向量儲存庫最簡單的方式，是載入一批文件，再透過 from documents 為這些文件建立索引： 提示 若您在命令列中使用 from documents，可以傳入 show progress=True，在建立索引時顯示進度列。 使用 from documents 時，系統會將您的 Documents 切分成區塊，再解析為 Node 物件。Node 是文字字串的輕量抽象，會保留中繼資料與關聯資訊。 若想進一步了解如何載入文件，請參閱了解資料載入。 VectorStoreIndex 預設會將所有資料儲存在記憶體中。若要了解如何使用持久化的向量儲存庫，請參閱下方的使用向量儲存庫。 提示 VectorStoreIndex 預設會以每批 2048 個節點的方式產生並寫入向量。若記憶體不足（或有餘裕），可傳入 insert batch size=2048（或改為您需要的批次大小）進行調整。 將資料寫入遠端代管的向量資料庫時，這項設定特別實用。 使用資料匯入管線建立節點 若要更精確地控制文件的索引方式，建議使用資料匯入管線。您可以藉此自訂節點的切分方式、中繼資料和嵌入向量。 提示 您可以在資料匯入管線使用指南中了解更多資訊。 直接建立與管理節點 若要完全掌控索引，可手動建立並定義節點，再直接傳給索引建構子： 處理 Document 更新 直接管理索引時，您需要處理會隨時間變動的資料來源。Index 類別提供 新增 、 刪除 、 更新 和 重新整理 操作，詳情請參閱： - 中繼資料擷取 - 文件管理 儲存向量索引 LlamaIndex 支援數十種向量儲存庫。傳入 StorageContext 即可指定要使用的向量儲存庫，並在其中設定 vector store 引數。以下範例使用 Pinecone： 更多 VectorStoreIndex 使用範例，請參閱向量儲存庫索引範例筆記本。 若要查看 VectorStoreIndex 搭配特定向量儲存庫的使用範例，請前往「儲存」章節中的向量儲存庫。 可組合式檢索 VectorStoreIndex（以及其他索引／檢索器）也能檢索一般物件，包括： - 節點參照 - 查詢引擎 - 檢索器 - 查詢管線 檢索到這些物件時，系統會自動使用提供的查詢執行它們。 例如： 若檢索到包含查詢引擎的索引節點，系統就會執行該查詢引擎，並將產生的回應以節點形式回傳。 詳細資訊請參閱指南。
sourceText: Vector Stores are a key component of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and so you will end up using them in nearly every application you make using LlamaIndex, either directly or indirectly. Vector stores accept a list of Node objects and build an index from them Loading data into the index Basic usage The simplest way to use a Vector Store is to load a set of documents and build an index from them using from documents: Tip If you are using from documents on the command line, it can be convenient to pass show progress=True to display a progress bar during index construction. When you use from documents, your Documents are split into chunks and parsed into Node objects, lightweight abstractions over text strings that keep track of metadata and relationships. For more on how to load documents, see Understanding Loading. By default, VectorStoreIndex stores everything in memory. See Using Vector Stores below for more on how to use persistent vector stores. Tip By default, the VectorStoreIndex will generate and insert vectors in batches of 2048 nodes. If you are memory constrained (or have a surplus of memory), you can modify this by passing insert batch size=2048 with your desired batch size. This is especially helpful when you are inserting into a remotely hosted vector database. Using the ingestion pipeline to create nodes If you want more control over how your documents are indexed, we recommend using the ingestion pipeline. This allows you to customize the chunking, metadata, and embedding of the nodes. Tip You can learn more about how to use the ingestion pipeline. Creating and managing nodes directly If you want total control over your index you can create and define nodes manually and pass them directly to the index constructor: Handling Document Updates When managing your index directly, you will want to deal with data sources that change over time. Index classes have insertion , deletion , update , and refresh operations and you can learn more about them below: - Metadata Extraction - Document Management Storing the vector index LlamaIndex supports dozens of vector stores. You can specify which one to use by passing in a StorageContext, on which in turn you specify the vector store argument, as in this example using Pinecone: For more examples of how to use VectorStoreIndex, see our vector store index usage examples notebook. For examples of how to use VectorStoreIndex with specific vector stores, check out vector stores under the Storing section. Composable Retrieval The VectorStoreIndex (and any other index/retriever) is capable of retrieving generic objects, including - references to nodes - query engines - retrievers - query pipelines If these objects are retrieved, they will be automatically ran using the provided query. For example: If the index node containing the query engine is retrieved, the query engine will be ran and the resulting response returned as a node. For more details, checkout the guide

title: 索引
text: 概念 Index 是一個允許我們快速檢索使用者查詢相關上下文的資料結構。對於 LlamaIndex 來說，它是檢索增強生成 (retrieval-augmented generation) (RAG) 用例的核心基礎。 從高層次來看，Indexes 是建立在 Documents 之上的。它們用於建構 Query Engines 和 聊天引擎，以實現基於您的資料的問答和聊天功能。 在底層，Indexes 將資料儲存在 Node 物件中（這些物件代表原始 documents 的區塊），並暴露一個 Retriever 介面，該介面支援額外的配置和自動化。 最常見的索引是 VectorStoreIndex；最好的起點是 VectorStoreIndex 使用指南。 對於其他索引，請查閱我們的 每個索引的工作原理 指南，以幫助您決定哪個索引最符合您的用例。 其他索引資源 請參閱 modules guide。
sourceText: Concept An Index is a data structure that allows us to quickly retrieve relevant context for a user query. For LlamaIndex, it’s the core foundation for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) use-cases. At a high-level, Indexes are built from Documents. They are used to build Query Engines and Chat Engines which enables question & answer and chat over your data. Under the hood, Indexes store data in Node objects (which represent chunks of the original documents), and expose a Retriever interface that supports additional configuration and automation. The most common index by far is the VectorStoreIndex; the best place to start is the VectorStoreIndex usage guide. For other indexes, check out our guide to how each index works to help you decide which one matches your use-case. Other Index resources See the modules guide.

title: 資料連接器
text: 概念 資料連接器（aka Reader）將來自不同資料來源和資料格式的資料，匯入為簡單的 Document 表示（文字和簡單的 metadata）。 提示 一旦您匯入資料，就可以在上面建立一個 Index，使用 Query Engine 提問，並使用 Chat Engine 進行對話。 整合套件 每個資料連接器都會作為自己的套件發布，因此您只需安裝需要的套件。完整套件位於 LlamaIndex repo 的 readers 目錄，每個套件在 PyPI 上都命名為 llama-index-readers- 。 使用模式 從以下開始： 查看完整的 使用模式指南 以獲取更多詳細資訊。 模組 一些範例資料連接器： - 本地檔案目錄 (SimpleDirectoryReader)。可以支援解析多種檔案類型：.pdf, .jpg, .png, .docx 等。 - Notion (NotionPageReader) - Google Docs (GoogleDocsReader) - Slack (SlackReader) - Discord (DiscordReader) - Apify Actors (ApifyActor)。可以爬網頁、抓取網頁內容、提取文字內容、下載包含 .pdf, .jpg, .png, .docx 等的檔案。 請參閱 modules guide 以獲取更多詳細資訊。
sourceText: Concept A data connector (aka Reader) ingest data from different data sources and data formats into a simple Document representation (text and simple metadata). Tip Once you’ve ingested your data, you can build an Index on top, ask questions using a Query Engine, and have a conversation using a Chat Engine. Integration packages Each data connector is published as its own package, so you only install the ones you need. The full set lives in the readers directory of the LlamaIndex repo, and every package is named llama-index-readers- on PyPI. Usage Pattern Get started with: See the full usage pattern guide for more details. Modules Some sample data connectors: - local file directory (SimpleDirectoryReader). Can support parsing a wide range of file types: .pdf, .jpg, .png, .docx, etc. - Notion (NotionPageReader) - Google Docs (GoogleDocsReader) - Slack (SlackReader) - Discord (DiscordReader) - Apify Actors (ApifyActor). Can crawl the web, scrape webpages, extract text content, download files including .pdf, .jpg, .png, .docx, etc. See the modules guide for more details.

They also contain metadata and relationship information with other nodes and index structures. Nodes are a first-class citizen in LlamaIndex. You can choose to define Nodes and all its attributes directly. You may also choose to “parse” source Documents into Nodes through our NodeParser classes. text: 概念 Document 和 Node 物件是 LlamaIndex 中的核心抽象。 Document 是一個泛型的容器，用於任何資料來源——例如 PDF、API 的輸出，或從資料庫檢索的資料。它們可以手動建構，或透過我們的 data loaders 自動建立。預設情況下，Document 會儲存文字以及一些其他屬性。這些屬性列在下方： - metadata - 一個可以附加到文字上的註釋字典。 - relationships - 一個包含與其他 Documents/Nodes 之間關係的字典。 注意 ：我們對允許 Documents 儲存圖片提供了 beta 支援，並正在積極改進其多模態能力。 Node 代表源 Document 的一個「chunk」，無論它是文字片段、圖片還是其他類型。與 Documents 類似，它們包含元資料以及與其他 nodes 之間的關係資訊。 Nodes 是 LlamaIndex 中的一等公民。您可以直接定義 Nodes 及其所有屬性。您也可以透過我們的 NodeParser 類別將源 Documents 解析成 Nodes。預設情況下，所有從 Document 衍生出的 Node 將繼承該 Document 的相同元資料（例如，Document 中的 "file\ name" 欄位會傳播到每個 Node）。 使用模式 以下是一些簡單的程式碼片段，用於開始使用 Documents 和 Nodes。 Documents Nodes Document/Node 使用 請查看我們的深度指南，了解更多關於如何使用 Documents/Nodes 的詳細資訊。 - Using Documents - Using Nodes - Ingestion Pipeline
sourceText: Concept Document and Node objects are core abstractions within LlamaIndex. A Document is a generic container around any data source - for instance, a PDF, an API output, or retrieved data from a database. They can be constructed manually, or created automatically via our data loaders. By default, a Document stores text along with some other attributes. Some of these are listed below. - metadata - a dictionary of annotations that can be appended to the text. - relationships - a dictionary containing relationships to other Documents/Nodes. Note : We have beta support for allowing Documents to store images, and are actively working on improving its multimodal capabilities. A Node represents a “chunk” of a source Document, whether that is a text chunk, an image, or other. Similar to Documents, they contain metadata and relationship information with other nodes. Nodes are a first-class citizen in LlamaIndex. You can choose to define Nodes and all its attributes directly. You may also choose to “parse” source Documents into Nodes through our NodeParser classes. By default every Node derived from a Document will inherit the same metadata from that Document (e.g. a “file\ name” filed in the Document is propagated to every Node). Usage Pattern Here are some simple snippets to get started with Documents and Nodes. Documents Nodes Document/Node Usage Take a look at our in-depth guides for more details on how to use Documents/Nodes. - Using Documents - Using Nodes - Ingestion Pipeline

sourceText: A transformation is something that takes a list of nodes as an input, and returns a list of nodes. Each component that implements the Transformation base class has both a synchronous call () definition and an async acall() definition. Currently, the following components are Transformation objects: - TextSplitter - NodeParser - MetadataExtractor - Embeddingsmodel (check our list of supported embeddings) Usage Pattern While transformations are best used with an IngestionPipeline, they can also be used directly. Combining with An Index Transformations can be passed into an index or overall global settings, and will be used when calling from documents() or insert() on an index. Custom Transformations You can implement any transformation yourself by implementing the base class. The following custom transformation will remove any special characters or punctuation in text. These can then be used directly or in any IngestionPipeline.

text: IngestionPipeline 使用 Transformations 的概念應用於輸入資料。這些 Transformations 應用於您的輸入資料，產生的 nodes 要麼會被回傳，要麼會插入到 vector database 中（如果提供）。每個 node+transformation 組合都會被快取，這樣後續的執行（如果快取是持久化的）使用相同的 node+transformation 組合可以利用快取結果，節省時間。 使用模式 最簡單的使用方式是像這樣實例化 IngestionPipeline： 請注意，在實際場景中，您會從 Llama Hub 的 SimpleDirectoryReader 或其他讀取器獲取您的 documents。 連接 Vector Databases 在執行 ingestion pipeline 時，您也可以選擇自動將結果的 nodes 插入到遠端 vector store 中。 然後，您可以稍後從該 vector store 建構 index。 在 pipeline 中計算 embeddings 請注意，在上述範例中，embeddings 是作為 pipeline 的一部分進行計算的。如果您將您的 pipeline 連接到 vector store，embeddings 必須是您的 pipeline 的一個階段，否則您後續對 index 的實例化將會失敗。 如果您不連接到 vector store，可以從您的 pipeline 中省略 embeddings，即只產生一個 nodes 的列表。 快取 (Caching) 在 IngestionPipeline 中，每個 node + transformation 組合都會被雜湊並快取。這可以節省使用相同資料的後續執行時間。 以下部分描述了與快取相關的一些基本用法。 本地快取管理 (Local Cache Management) 一旦您有了 pipeline，您可能想儲存和載入快取。 如果快取變得太大，您可以清除它 遠端快取管理 (Remote Cache Management) 我們支援多個遠端儲存後端用於快取。 - RedisCache - MongoDBCache - FirestoreCache 以下是使用 RedisCache 的範例： 在這裡，不需要 persist 步驟，因為在指定的遠端 collection 中，所有內容都會隨著進行被快取。 Async 支援 IngestionPipeline 也支援 async 操作。 Document 管理 將 docstore 附加到 ingestion pipeline 將啟用 document 管理。 使用 document.doc id 或 node.ref doc id 作為 grounding point，ingestion pipeline 會主動尋找重複的 documents。 它的運作方式如下： - 儲存一個 doc id - document hash 的 map - 如果附加了 vector store： - 如果偵測到重複的 doc id，且 hash 發生變化，則會重新處理並 upsert document - 如果偵測到重複的 doc id 且 hash 不變，則跳過 node - 如果沒有附加 vector store： - 檢查每個 node 的所有現有 hash - 如果找到重複項，則跳過 node - 否則，處理 node 注意： 如果我們沒有附加 vector store，我們只能檢查和移除重複的輸入。 完整的操作流程請參閱我們的 demo notebook。 也請查看使用 Redis 作為我們的整個 ingestion stack 的另一個指南。 並行處理 (Parallel Processing) IngestionPipeline 的 run 方法可以與並行處理過程一起執行。它透過利用 multiprocessing.Pool 將 nodes 的批次分散到各個 processor 來實現。 要以並行處理方式執行，請將 num workers 設定為您希望使用的處理器數量： 模組 (Modules) - Transformations Guide - Advanced Ingestion Pipeline - Async Ingestion Pipeline - Document Management Pipeline - Redis Ingestion Pipeline - Google Drive Ingestion Pipeline - Parallel Execution Pipeline
sourceText: An IngestionPipeline uses a concept of Transformations that are applied to input data. These Transformations are applied to your input data, and the resulting nodes are either returned or inserted into a vector database (if given). Each node+transformation pair is cached, so that subsequent runs (if the cache is persisted) with the same node+transformation combination can use the cached result and save you time. Usage Pattern The simplest usage is to instantiate an IngestionPipeline like so: Note that in a real-world scenario, you would get your documents from SimpleDirectoryReader or another reader from Llama Hub. Connecting to Vector Databases When running an ingestion pipeline, you can also chose to automatically insert the resulting nodes into a remote vector store. Then, you can construct an index from that vector store later on. Calculating embeddings in a pipeline Note that in the above example, embeddings are calculated as part of the pipeline. If you are connecting your pipeline to a vector store, embeddings must be a stage of your pipeline or your later instantiation of the index will fail. You can omit embeddings from your pipeline if you are not connecting to a vector store, i.e. just producing a list of nodes. Caching In an IngestionPipeline, each node + transformation combination is hashed and cached. This saves time on subsequent runs that use the same data. The following sections describe some basic usage around caching. Local Cache Management Once you have a pipeline, you may want to store and load the cache. If the cache becomes too large, you can clear it Remote Cache Management We support multiple remote storage backends for caches - RedisCache - MongoDBCache - FirestoreCache Here as an example using the RedisCache: Here, no persist step is needed, since everything is cached as you go in the specified remote collection. Async Support The IngestionPipeline also has support for async operation Document Management Attaching a docstore to the ingestion pipeline will enable document management. Using the document.doc id or node.ref doc id as a grounding point, the ingestion pipeline will actively look for duplicate documents. It works by: - Storing a map of doc id - document hash - If a vector store is attached: - If a duplicate doc id is detected, and the hash has changed, the document will be re-processed and upserted - If a duplicate doc id is detected and the hash is unchanged, the node is skipped - If only a vector store is not attached: - Checks all existing hashes for each node - If a duplicate is found, the node is skipped - Otherwise, the node is processed NOTE: If we do not attach a vector store, we can only check for and remove duplicate inputs. A full walkthrough is found in our demo notebook. Also check out another guide using Redis as our entire ingestion stack. Parallel Processing The run method of IngestionPipeline can be executed with parallel processes. It does so by making use of multiprocessing.Pool distributing batches of nodes to across processors. To execute with parallel processing, set num workers to the number of processes you’d like use: Modules - Transformations Guide - Advanced Ingestion Pipeline - Async Ingestion Pipeline - Document Management Pipeline - Redis Ingestion Pipeline - Google Drive Ingestion Pipeline - Parallel Execution Pipeline

title: Node 解析器模組
text: 基於檔案的 Node 解析器 有幾種基於檔案的 node 解析器，會根據正在解析的內容類型（JSON、Markdown 等）來建立 nodes。 最簡單的流程是將 FlatFileReader 與 SimpleFileNodeParser 組合，以便為每種內容自動使用最適合的 node 解析器。然後，您可能希望將基於檔案的 node 解析器與基於文字的 node 解析器串接起來，以考慮文本的實際長度。 SimpleFileNodeParser HTMLNodeParser 此 node 解析器使用 beautifulsoup 來解析原始 HTML。 預設情況下，它會解析一部分 HTML 標籤，但您可以覆蓋此設定。 預設標籤是： ["p", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "li", "b", "i", "u", "section"] JSONNodeParser JSONNodeParser 解析原始 JSON。 MarkdownNodeParser MarkdownNodeParser 解析原始 markdown 文本。 文字分割器 CodeSplitter 根據程式語言將原始程式碼文本進行分割。 請查看 支援的語言列表。 LangchainNodeParser 您也可以使用 node 解析器將 langchain 中的任何現有文本分割器包裝起來。 Chunker Chunker 是一個多用途的 node 解析器，它包裝了 chonkie chunkers。您可以使用任何支援的 chonkie 分塊策略的別名來初始化您的解析器，完整的有效別名列表可透過 Chunker.valid chunker types 屬性存取。 您也可以直接傳入一個 chonkie chunker 實例來初始化解析器。 SentenceSplitter SentenceSplitter 嘗試在尊重句子邊界的情況下分割文本。 SentenceWindowNodeParser SentenceWindowNodeParser 與其他 node 解析器相似，但它會將所有 documents 分割成單個句子。產生的 nodes 也在元數據中包含每個 node 周圍的句子“視窗”。請注意，此元數據不會對 LLM 或 embedding model 可見。 這對於生成具有非常特定範圍的 embedding 非常有用。然後，與 MetadataReplacementNodePostProcessor 結合，您可以將句子替換為其周圍的上下文，然後將 node 發送到 LLM。 設定解析器使用預設 settings 的範例如下。在實務上，您通常只需要調整句子的視窗大小。 完整的範例可以在 這裡與 MetadataReplacementNodePostProcessor 結合 找到。 SemanticSplitterNodeParser “Semantic chunking” 是 Greg Kamradt 在關於 5 層 embedding chunking 的影片教學中提出的新概念： 。 與使用 固定 的 chunk size 來分割文本不同，semantic splitter 透過 embedding 相似度自適應地選擇句子之間的斷點。這確保了“chunk”包含彼此在語義上相關的句子。 我們將其改編為一個 LlamaIndex 模組。 請查看我們的筆記！ 注意事項： - 正則表達式主要適用於英文句子 - 您可能需要調整斷點百分比閾值。 完整的範例可以在我們的 使用 SemanticSplitterNodeParser 的指南 中找到。 TokenTextSplitter TokenTextSplitter 嘗試根據原始 token 數量分割成一致的 chunk size。 基於關係的 Node 解析器 HierarchicalNodeParser 此 node 解析器會將 nodes 分塊成分層的 nodes。這意味著單一輸入將被分割成多種大小的層級塊，每個 node 都包含對其父級 node 的引用。當與 AutoMergingRetriever 組合時，這使我們在檢索到大多數子物件時，能夠自動用其父物件來替換檢索到的 nodes。此過程為 LLM 提供了更完整的上下文以進行回應合成。 完整的範例請參閱 這裡，與 AutoMergingRetriever 組合。
sourceText: File-Based Node Parsers There are several file-based node parsers, that will create nodes based on the type of content that is being parsed (JSON, Markdown, etc.) The simplest flow is to combine the FlatFileReader with the SimpleFileNodeParser to automatically use the best node parser for each type of content. Then, you may want to chain the file-based node parser with a text-based node parser to account for the actual length of the text. SimpleFileNodeParser HTMLNodeParser This node parser uses beautifulsoup to parse raw HTML. By default, it will parse a select subset of HTML tags, but you can override this. The default tags are: ["p", "h1", "h2", "h3", "h4", "h5", "h6", "li", "b", "i", "u", "section"] JSONNodeParser The JSONNodeParser parses raw JSON. MarkdownNodeParser The MarkdownNodeParser parses raw markdown text. Text-Splitters CodeSplitter Splits raw code-text based on the language it is written in. Check the full list of supported languages here. LangchainNodeParser You can also wrap any existing text splitter from langchain with a node parser. Chunker The Chunker is a multi purpose node parser that wraps around the chonkie chunkers. you can initialize your parser using an alias for any of the supported chonkie chunking strategies, the full list of valid aliases can be accessed via Chunker.valid chunker types attribute. you can also directly pass in a chonkie chunker instance to initialize the parser. SentenceSplitter The SentenceSplitter attempts to split text while respecting the boundaries of sentences. SentenceWindowNodeParser The SentenceWindowNodeParser is similar to other node parsers, except that it splits all documents into individual sentences. The resulting nodes also contain the surrounding “window” of sentences around each node in the metadata. Note that this metadata will not be visible to the LLM or embedding model. This is most useful for generating embeddings that have a very specific scope. Then, combined with a MetadataReplacementNodePostProcessor, you can replace the sentence with it’s surrounding context before sending the node to the LLM. An example of setting up the parser with default settings is below. In practice, you would usually only want to adjust the window size of sentences. A full example can be found here in combination with the MetadataReplacementNodePostProcessor. SemanticSplitterNodeParser “Semantic chunking” is a new concept proposed Greg Kamradt in his video tutorial on 5 levels of embedding chunking: . Instead of chunking text with a fixed chunk size, the semantic splitter adaptively picks the breakpoint in-between sentences using embedding similarity. This ensures that a “chunk” contains sentences that are semantically related to each other. We adapted it into a LlamaIndex module. Check out our notebook below! Caveats: - The regex primarily works for English sentences - You may have to tune the breakpoint percentile threshold. A full example can be found in our guide on using the SemanticSplitterNodeParser. TokenTextSplitter The TokenTextSplitter attempts to split to a consistent chunk size according to raw token counts. Relation-Based Node Parsers HierarchicalNodeParser This node parser will chunk nodes into hierarchical nodes. This means a single input will be chunked into several hierarchies of chunk sizes, with each node containing a reference to it’s parent node. When combined with the AutoMergingRetriever, this enables us to automatically replace retrieved nodes with their parents when a majority of children are retrieved. This process provides the LLM with more complete context for response synthesis. A full example can be found here in combination with the AutoMergingRetriever.

text: Node 解析器是一種簡單的抽象，它接收一個 documents 的列表，並將其切分成 Node 物件，使得每個 node 都是父級 document 的特定區塊。當一個 document 被分解成 nodes 時，它的所有屬性都會繼承給子 nodes（即 metadata、text 和 metadata templates 等）。您可以在 這裡 閱讀更多關於 Node 和 Document 屬性的資訊。 開始使用 單獨使用 Node 解析器可以單獨使用： 轉換使用 Node 解析器可以包含在任何具有 ingestion pipeline 的轉換集中。 索引使用 或者設定在 transformations 或全局 settings 中，以便在使用 .from documents() 建構索引時自動使用： 模組 請參閱完整的 modules guide。
sourceText: Node parsers are a simple abstraction that take a list of documents, and chunk them into Node objects, such that each node is a specific chunk of the parent document. When a document is broken into nodes, all of it’s attributes are inherited to the children nodes (i.e. metadata, text and metadata templates, etc.). You can read more about Node and Document properties here. Getting Started Standalone Usage Node parsers can be used on their own: Transformation Usage Node parsers can be included in any set of transformations with an ingestion pipeline. Index Usage Or set inside a transformations or global settings to be used automatically when an index is constructed using .from documents(): Modules See the full modules guide.
