title: SimpleDirectoryReader
text: SimpleDirectoryReader 是將本地檔案資料載入到 LlamaIndex 的最簡單方法。對於生產環境的用例，您可能更傾向於使用 許多讀取器整合套件，但 SimpleDirectoryReader 是開始的絕佳方式。 支援的檔案類型 預設情況下，SimpleDirectoryReader 會嘗試讀取它找到的任何檔案，將它們都視為文字。除了純文字之外，它明確支援以下檔案類型，這些類型會根據檔案副檔名自動偵測： - .csv - 逗號分隔值 - .docx - Microsoft Word - .epub - EPUB 電子書格式 - .hwp - Hangul Word Processor - .ipynb - Jupyter Notebook - .jpeg, .jpg - JPEG 圖片 - .mbox - MBOX 電子郵件封存檔 - .md - Markdown - .mp3, .mp4 - 音訊與影片 - .pdf - 可攜式文件格式 - .png - 可攜式網路圖形格式 - .ppt, .pptm, .pptx - Microsoft PowerPoint 您可能預期在此處找到的檔案類型是 JSON；對於該類型，我們建議您使用我們的 JSON Loader。 使用方法 最基本的用法是傳遞一個 input dir，它將載入該目錄中所有支援的檔案： 從單一目錄載入多個檔案時，Documents 也支援平行處理。請注意，multiprocessing 在 Windows 和 Linux/MacOS 電腦上的使用方式有所不同，詳情請參閱 multiprocessing 文件（例如此處）。整體而言，Windows 使用者可能看不到明顯的效能提升；Linux/MacOS 使用者載入相同檔案集合時則會看到效能提升。 從子目錄讀取 預設情況下，SimpleDirectoryReader 只會讀取目錄頂層的檔案。若要從子目錄讀取，請設定 recursive=True： 迭代載入的檔案 您也可以使用 iter data() 方法來迭代並處理檔案在載入時的過程： 限制載入的檔案 而不是所有檔案，您可以傳遞一個檔案路徑列表： 或者您可以使用 exclude 傳遞一個要 排除 的檔案路徑列表： 您也可以設定 required exts 為檔案副檔名的列表，以僅載入具有這些副檔名的檔案： 並且您可以使用 num files limit 設定要載入的最大檔案數量： 指定檔案編碼 SimpleDirectoryReader 預期檔案是 utf-8 編碼的，但您可以使用 encoding 參數來覆蓋此設定： 提取元資料 SimpleDirectoryReader 會自動為每個 Document 物件附加一個 metadata 字典。預設情況下，此字典包含以下項目： - file path：包含檔案名稱（string）的完整檔案系統路徑 - file name：包含副檔名的檔案名稱（string） - file type：檔案的 MIME type，由 mimetypes.guess type() 猜測（string） - file size：檔案的大小，以位元組為單位（integer） - creation date, last modified date, last accessed date：檔案的建立、修改和存取日期，已標準化到 UTC 時區。請參閱下方的 日期與時間中繼資料（string） 然而，您可以替換用於建立元資料字典的邏輯。建立一個接受檔案路徑字串並回傳字典的自訂函式，然後將此函式作為 file metadata 傳遞給 SimpleDirectoryReader 建構函式： 日期和時間元資料 SimpleDirectoryReader 中的預設元資料函式會以 格式 %Y-%m-%d 的字串輸出日期。 為確保一致性，時間戳會標準化到 UTC 時區。如果輸出日期與實際日期相差一天，這可能是由於與 UTC 午夜的時差所導致。 擴充其他檔案類型您可以將副檔名對應字典傳入 BaseReader 實例，藉此擴充 SimpleDirectoryReader，並將其指定為 file extractor 以支援其他檔案類型。BaseReader 應讀取檔案並回傳 Documents 清單。例如，若要為 .myfile 檔案新增自訂支援： 請注意，此映射會覆蓋您指定的檔案類型的預設檔案提取器，如果您想支援它們，則需要將它們重新加入。 支援外部檔案系統 與其他模組一樣，SimpleDirectoryReader 包含一個可選的 fs 參數，可用於遍歷遠端檔案系統。 這可以是任何由 fsspec 協定實作的 filesystem 物件。fsspec 協定有針對多種遠端檔案系統的開源實作，包括 AWS S3、Azure Blob & DataLake、Google Drive、SFTP 以及 許多其他。 以下是一個連接到 S3 的範例： 完整的範例筆記可以在 這裡 找到。
sourceText: SimpleDirectoryReader is the simplest way to load data from local files into LlamaIndex. For production use cases it’s more likely that you’ll want to use one of the many Reader integrations, but SimpleDirectoryReader is a great way to get started. Supported file types By default SimpleDirectoryReader will try to read any files it finds, treating them all as text. In addition to plain text, it explicitly supports the following file types, which are automatically detected based on file extension: - .csv - comma-separated values - .docx - Microsoft Word - .epub - EPUB ebook format - .hwp - Hangul Word Processor - .ipynb - Jupyter Notebook - .jpeg, .jpg - JPEG image - .mbox - MBOX email archive - .md - Markdown - .mp3, .mp4 - audio and video - .pdf - Portable Document Format - .png - Portable Network Graphics - .ppt, .pptm, .pptx - Microsoft PowerPoint One file type you may be expecting to find here is JSON; for that we recommend you use our JSON Loader. Usage The most basic usage is to pass an input dir and it will load all supported files in that directory: Documents can also be loaded with parallel processing if loading many files from a directory. Note that there are differences when using multiprocessing with Windows and Linux/MacOS machines, which is explained throughout the multiprocessing docs (e.g. see here). Ultimately, Windows users may see less or no performance gains whereas Linux/MacOS users would see these gains when loading the exact same set of files. Reading from subdirectories By default, SimpleDirectoryReader will only read files in the top level of the directory. To read from subdirectories, set recursive=True: Iterating over files as they load You can also use the iter data() method to iterate over and process files as they load Restricting the files loaded Instead of all files you can pass a list of file paths: or you can pass a list of file paths to exclude using exclude: You can also set required exts to a list of file extensions to only load files with those extensions: And you can set a maximum number of files to be loaded with num files limit: Specifying file encoding SimpleDirectoryReader expects files to be utf-8 encoded but you can override this using the encoding parameter: Extracting metadata SimpleDirectoryReader will automatically attach a metadata dictionary to each Document object. By default, this dictionary has these items: - file path: the full filesystem path to the file, including the file name (string) - file name: the file name, including suffix (string) - file type: the MIME type of the file, as guessed by \mimetypes.guess\ type() (string) - file size: the size of the file, in bytes (integer) - creation date, last modified date, last accessed date: the creation, modification, and access dates for the file, normalized to the UTC timezone. See Date and time metadata below (string) However, you can replace the logic used to create the metadata dictionary. Create a custom function which takes a file path string and returns a dictionary, then pass this function to the SimpleDirectoryReader constructor as file metadata: Date and time metadata The default metadata function in SimpleDirectoryReader outputs dates as a string with the format %Y-%m-%d. To ensure consistency, timestamps are normalized to the UTC timezone. If the output dates seem to be one day off from the real date, this may be explained by the offset with midnight UTC. Extending to other file types You can extend SimpleDirectoryReader to read other file types by passing a dictionary of file extensions to instances of BaseReader as file extractor. A BaseReader should read the file and return a list of Documents. For example, to add custom support for .myfile files : Note that this mapping will override the default file extractors for the file types you specify, so you’ll need to add them back in if you want to support them. Support for External FileSystems As with other modules, the SimpleDirectoryReader takes an optional fs parameter that can be used to traverse remote filesystems. This can be any filesystem object that is implemented by the fsspec protocol. The fsspec` protocol has open-source implementations for a variety of remote filesystems including AWS S3, Azure Blob & DataLake, Google Drive, SFTP, and many others. Here’s an example that connects to S3: A full example notebook can be found here.

title: 載入資料
text: 資料攝取在 LlamaIndex 中的關鍵在於載入和轉換。一旦您載入了 Documents，就可以透過轉換來處理它們並輸出 Nodes。 在我們的 Understanding 部分了解資料載入的基本知識後，您可以繼續了解更多關於以下內容： 載入 (Loading) - SimpleDirectoryReader，我們內建的載入器，可從本地目錄載入各種檔案類型 - LlamaParse，LlamaIndex 用於 PDF 解析的官方工具，可作為一個 managed API 提供 - Data connectors，數百種資料載入整合，可從任何來源攝取資料 轉換 (Transformations) 這包括文本分割等常用操作。 - Node Parser Usage Pattern，展示如何使用我們的 node parsers - Node Parser Modules，展示我們的文本分割器（sentence、token、HTML、JSON）和其他 parser modules 整合所有內容 (Putting it all Together) - The ingestion pipeline，讓您可以設定一個可重複、優化快取（cache-optimized）的資料載入流程。 抽象層 (Abstractions) - Document and Node objects 以及如何自訂它們以用於更進階的用例
sourceText: The key to data ingestion in LlamaIndex is loading and transformations. Once you have loaded Documents, you can process them via transformations and output Nodes. Once you have learned about the basics of loading data in our Understanding section, you can read on to learn more about: Loading - SimpleDirectoryReader, our built-in loader for loading all sorts of file types from a local directory - LlamaParse, LlamaIndex’s official tool for PDF parsing, available as a managed API. - Data connectors, hundreds of data loading integrations to ingest data from any source Transformations This includes common operations like splitting text. - Node Parser Usage Pattern, showing you how to use our node parsers - Node Parser Modules, showing our text splitters (sentence, token, HTML, JSON) and other parser modules. Putting it all Together - The ingestion pipeline which allows you to set up a repeatable, cache-optimized process for loading data. Abstractions - Document and Node objects and how to customize them for more advanced use cases

title: LlamaParse MCP
text: LlamaParse MCP 是一個 模型 內容 協定 伺服器，將 LlamaParse 平台的 document 處理能力（Parse、Classify、Extract、Split 與 Index）以工具形式提供，讓任何相容於 MCP 的 agent 都能夠呼叫。您不需要自行串接 REST API 或 SDK，只需將您的 agent 連接至 MCP 伺服器一次，即可直接讓它解析 documents、提取結構化資料、對檔案進行分類與分割，以及建立、更新和從索引中檢索資料。 此伺服器為開源專案，託管於 https://mcp.llamaindex.ai。 注意 mcp.llamaindex.ai 服務於北美地區，mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai 則服務於歐洲。您使用哪一個伺服器取決於您的 LlamaCloud 帳號所在地，而非單次連線設定：cloud.llamaindex.ai 的帳號使用北美伺服器，cloud.eu.llamaindex.ai 的帳號則使用歐洲伺服器。在其中一個區域核發的 token 會被另一個區域拒絕，並回傳一個包含正確 endpoint 的 401。請參閱 Regions 以取得完整的區域 endpoint 列表。 Authentication MCP 伺服器接受兩種憑證，兩者皆對應至相同的帳號與權限。 OAuth 是大多數 MCP 用戶端所使用的方式，除非您額外加入 header，否則本頁面上的所有設定均使用 OAuth。您只需在用戶端登入一次；首次使用時會自動進行驗證，且 token 會自動更新，無需手動干預。 LlamaCloud API key 適用於無法使用瀏覽器登入的場景，例如 headless agents、CI 工作流程以及不支援 OAuth 的用戶端。在新增伺服器時，請將其作為 bearer token 發送： 終端機視窗 請參閱 API 金鑰指南 以建立 key。 兩者唯一的區別在於：getUploadUrl 不對使用 API-key 的呼叫者開放，因為它會儲存呼叫者的憑證以供 upload route 使用 —— 對於 expiring token 是有限制的，而對 key 則是無限制的。請改用 uploadFileByUrl 或透過 OAuth 連接。 Connecting 與 MCP client 連接至統一 endpoint https://mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp，即可在單一伺服器中獲得完整的平台功能（Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, and Index）。 - Cursor - VS Code - Claude Code - Claude - Codex 點擊按鈕即可一鍵新增伺服器： 在 Cursor 中開啟 或手動將伺服器新增至 /.cursor/mcp.json： 點擊按鈕即可一鍵新增伺服器： 在 VS Code 中開啟 或手動將伺服器新增至您的 settings.json： 終端機視窗 LlamaParse 已列在 Claude 的 connector 目錄中，因此無需設定。在 Claude 中，前往 Customize → Connectors ，搜尋 LlamaParse 並連接。此目錄在網頁版 Claude、Claude Desktop 和 Claude 行動版之間共用，因此連接一次即可涵蓋所有平台。 在 Claude Desktop 中開啟 connectors 該列表連接至北美伺服器。若要使用歐洲伺服器或指定特定產品的 endpoint，請在 Customize → Connectors 下自行新增，或編輯 Claude Desktop 的 /Library/Application Support/Claude/claude desktop config.json (macOS) 或 %APPDATA%\Claude\claude desktop config.json (Windows)。以下設定使用北美統一 endpoint —— 若要使用歐洲伺服器，請將 host 替換為 https://mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai/mcp；若要使用如 /parse/mcp 等特定產品伺服器，請替換 path： 開啟 Codex settings 以新增伺服器： 在 Codex 中開啟 或透過 CLI 新增： 終端機視窗 如果您使用 OAuth 連接，當您的 agent 首次使用工具時，系統會提示您透過瀏覽器進行驗證。 EU region歐洲地區的帳號請連接至 https://mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai/mcp。其工具介面與 OAuth 流程與北美地區完全相同，僅主機 (host) 不同。由於 Claude connector 的目錄列表指向北美伺服器，因此歐洲帳號需手動新增伺服器，而非從目錄中安裝。 點擊按鈕即可一鍵新增歐洲伺服器： 在 Cursor Open 中開啟 VS Code 或者手動新增伺服器，請使用與上述相同的檔案格式與路徑 —— 對於 Cursor，路徑為 /.cursor/mcp.json： 透過 CLI： 終端機視窗 使用 llamaparse-eu 名稱可將歐洲伺服器與指向北美的 llamaparse 項目區分開來，使兩者能同時安裝。上述的一鍵安裝按鈕會以 llamaparse 為名稱進行安裝，如果您已經設定了北美伺服器，請重新命名該項目。 Available tools 伺服器將工具按產品分組。下方的 project 與 upload 輔助工具由每個 endpoint（包括統一 endpoint 與各產品專屬 endpoint）提供，因為所有處理工具都需要檔案 ID，且對於擁有一個以上 project 的帳號，還需要 project ID。 Projects 且上傳 - getUserProjects — 列出您的帳號可存取的 project，以便 agent 能透過名稱解析 project 並將正確的 project ID 傳遞給其他工具。 - uploadFileByUrl — 接收公開的檔案 URL、擷取檔案並將其上傳至平台。 - getUploadUrl — 回傳一個暫時的、經過驗證的上傳 endpoint，您的 client 可透過 multipart form data 將本地檔案 POST 至該 endpoint。 Parse - parseFile — 對檔案執行 Parse 作業，並回傳乾淨的 markdown 或純文字。 - parseWithLiteParse — 對 PDF 執行 LiteParse，這是一個快速且不消耗 Parse 額度的解析器。僅支援 PDF，且最適用於版面簡單、文字密集之 documents。 - estimateFileComplexity — 逐頁對 PDF 進行評分，並針對每頁回傳所需的 Parse tier 或 LiteParse 是否已足夠。可將其與 parseFile 及 parseWithLiteParse 搭配使用，僅將有需要的頁面傳送到較高階的 tier。 Classify - classifyFile — 使用 Classify 將 document 分配至您的其中一個類別。在統一伺服器與 Classify 伺服器上，類別是每次呼叫的必填參數，因此 agent 可以針對每個檔案決定類別，而無需先建立儲存的設定。在 pinned /classify/{configId}/mcp 伺服器上，類別則來自設定，且不提供該參數。 Split - splitFile — 使用 Split 將 document 分割成邏輯區段。與 classifyFile 類似，它採取 inline 傳遞類別，但在 pinned /split/{configId}/mcp 伺服器上除外。 Extract 相較於要求 agent 閱讀解析後的 document 並從文字中提取欄位，使用專用工具進行 Structured extraction 會更可靠：agents 可能僅接收到大型 documents 的截斷版本，且僅靠 prompt 提取會導致輸出 schema 定義不足。 - searchSchemaTemplates — 在內建的起始 schema 目錄（如發票、合約、履歷等）中搜尋，並回傳匹配項及其 template ID。 - getSchemaTemplate — 透過 ID 回傳單一 template 的完整 JSON schema，以便 agent 在使用前閱讀並調整。 - createExtractionConfigFromSchema — 透過 template ID 或明確的 JSON schema 建立提取設定，並回傳 configuration ID。此工具可讓 agent 即時建立設定。 - generateExtractionConfig — 使用範例檔案，根據您想要的資料描述生成 JSON schema 與提取規則。同樣會回傳 configuration ID。 - extractFile — 使用提取設定 ID 對檔案執行提取。 IndexIndex 是由 LlamaParse Platform 提供的託管知識庫，專為 agentic workflows 設計。除了 semantic search 之外，它還為 agents 提供類似檔案系統的存取方式來操作底層的 documents。相關工具涵蓋了這兩個面向：建立 index 與查詢 index。 Index 是建立在來源 documents 的目錄之上，因此建立流程為：上傳檔案、將其放入目錄，然後進行 index： - createDirectory — 建立一個目錄，即建立 index 時所依據的來源 documents 資料夾。 - addFilesToDirectory — 使用上傳輔助工具回傳的檔案 ID，將已上傳的檔案新增至目錄中。檔案會逐一新增，且回應會報告哪些檔案成功，以便您僅針對失敗的項目重試。 - createIndex — 對目錄進行 index。Indexing 在背景執行，且在報告為 ready 之前無法進行查詢。 - syncIndex — 重新對目錄進行 index，以納入自上次執行以來新增或變更的檔案。Index 不會自動更新，因此這是讓現有 index 偵測到新 documents 的方式。 - getIndexStatus — 報告 index 是否已完成建立。查詢尚未 ready 的 index 與查詢沒有匹配 documents 的 index 結果相同，因此請在 createIndex 和 syncIndex 之後輪詢此工具。 - listDirectories — 分頁列出專案中的目錄。 - listDirectory — 分頁列出目錄內的檔案。 搜尋與讀取 index： - listIndexes — 發現您可以查詢的 index。 - findFilesInIndex — 在 index 中定位相關檔案。 - readFileFromIndex — 讀取 index 中檔案的內容。 - grepFileFromIndex — 在已 index 的檔案中搜尋模式匹配。 - retrieveFromIndex — 在 index 上執行 hybrid (sparse + dense) retrieval。 API keys 僅由統一的 /mcp endpoint 提供 — 特定產品的伺服器不會公開此功能。 - createProjectApiKey — 建立一個範圍限定於單一專案的 API key，用於交付給應用程式或團隊成員。該 key 僅能存取該專案，因此 agent 可以直接完成專案設定，而無需停下來向您請求 key。Secret 僅會回傳一次且無法再次讀取 — 請在回傳時立即儲存，否則必須撤銷該 key 並重新建立。此工具建立的所有 key 都會過期；預設值與此工具可發行的最長期限均為 90 天。Web UI 提供更長的有效期，最高可設定為永不過期。 Product 專屬伺服器 統一的 /mcp endpoint 提供所有功能，非常適合探索性工作和更廣泛的 document 處理任務。如果您需要更精簡的工具清單，可以直接連接到特定產品的伺服器。縮小範圍有助於 agents 更可靠地做出工具選擇決定，並平行執行獨立任務。 伺服器樹狀結構如下： 對於歐洲區域的帳戶，https://mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai/ 下也存在相同的子路徑。 每個特定產品的伺服器都包含 getUserProjects 和兩個上傳輔助工具，以及其專屬工具： Server 除共用輔助工具外的其他工具 --------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- /parse/mcp parseFile, parseWithLiteParse, estimateFileComplexity /classify/mcp classifyFile /split/mcp splitFile /extract/mcp searchSchemaTemplates, getSchemaTemplate, createExtractionConfigFromSchema, generateExtractionConfig, extractFile /index/mcp 上述列出的每個 Index 工具 classify、extract 與 split 伺服器可以選擇直接從 route 繼承 configuration ID。當您連線到 /{configId}/mcp endpoint 時，agent 會在該 configuration 的 context 下運作：classifyFile 從中取得 categories，splitFile 取得 categories 與 splitting strategy，而 extractFile 則取得其 schema —— 因此 pinned extract server 僅提供 extractFile，並捨棄所有 configuration-building 工具。 例如，要將 agent 直接連線到特定的 classification configuration： 同時，連線到特定的 extraction configuration： 這種模組化模型讓您能由多個專門的伺服器組成 workflows，每個伺服器負責定義明確的任務，藉此提升隔離度、實現更高的平行處理能力，並讓您能精細控制 throughput。 選擇 configuration agent 如何選擇 configuration 取決於產品，因為 Classify 和 Split 在呼叫時會攜帶 configuration，而 Extract 則是參照已儲存的 configuration。 Classify 和 Split 使用 inline 方式提供 configuration。 categories 是每個 classifyFile 與 splitFile 呼叫的必要參數，因此 agent 會針對每個檔案決定，無需事先儲存。在下次呼叫時傳遞不同的 categories，行為隨之改變。唯一的例外是下文提到的 pinned server，它會提供這些資訊並捨棄該參數。 Extract 透過 ID 參照 configuration。 extractFile 需要 configurationId，因此在呼叫前 configuration 必須已存在。agent 有三種方式可以取得： - 從 starter schema 建立 —— 呼叫 searchSchemaTemplates 尋找 template，可選擇使用 getSchemaTemplate 讀取並調整，接著使用 createExtractionConfigFromSchema 建立 configuration 並取得其 ID。 - 從範例檔案建立 —— 呼叫 generateExtractionConfig 並提供檔案以及您想要的資料描述。 - 重用已儲存的 configuration —— 從 web UI 的 Extract Configurations 頁面取得現有 configuration 的 ID，並直接傳遞給 extractFile。 或者將 configuration pin 到連線中。 連線到 /{configId}/mcp endpoint 會將 configuration 設定為整個 session 的 context，且 agent 不需再做選擇。當 configuration 固定且您不希望 agent 變更它時，請使用此方式。 目前沒有可用於列出專案中已儲存 configuration 的工具，因此 agent 要麼在 session 期間建立一個，要麼被提供一個 ID 以供使用。 Example workflows - 先分類再提取 —— agent 使用 classification server 對資料夾中的檔案進行分類，將其整理到特定類別的子資料夾中，然後針對每個類別平行執行對應的 extraction configuration，並將結果儲存為 JSON 以供後續分析。 - Agentic retrieval —— agent 使用 listIndexes 發現 indexes，使用 findFilesInIndex 定位相關檔案，使用 readFileFromIndex 檢查檔案，使用 grepFileFromIndex 搜尋，並使用 retrieveFromIndex 檢索 passages —— 像操作檔案系統一樣導覽 PDF、Office documents、圖片和其他非結構化檔案。 - 從零開始建立知識庫 —— agent 使用 uploadFileByUrl 或 getUploadUrl 上傳一批檔案，使用 createDirectory 與 addFilesToDirectory 將其分組，呼叫 createIndex，並輪詢 getIndexStatus 直到 index 準備就緒，然後對其進行查詢。後續執行時，將檔案新增至相同目錄並呼叫 syncIndex 將其併入。 - 僅解析必要內容 —— agent 對 PDF 執行 estimateFileComplexity，將需要較高階層處理的頁面傳送到 parseFile，其餘則由 parseWithLiteParse 處理。 提示統一的 /mcp 伺服器是原型設計的最佳起點。當您確定 workflow 需要哪些功能，且希望縮小範圍或提高平行處理能力時，再改用特定產品的伺服器。 相關內容 - Skills and Plugins — 將 MCP 伺服器與解析 skill 以及 llamaparse-mcp plugin 一併安裝，或僅為 coding agent 提供 skills。 - LlamaParse Platform n8n Node — 在 no-code workflow 中提供與 nodes 相同的功能。
sourceText: The LlamaParse MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that exposes the LlamaParse Platform’s document-processing capabilities (Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, and Index) as tools that any MCP-compatible agent can call. Instead of wiring up the REST API or SDK yourself, you connect your agent to the MCP server once and let it parse documents, extract structured data, classify and split files, and build, refresh, and retrieve from your indexes directly. The server is open source and hosted at https://mcp.llamaindex.ai. Note mcp.llamaindex.ai serves the North America region and mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai serves Europe. Which one you use is decided by where your LlamaCloud account lives, not by a per-connection setting: an account on cloud.llamaindex.ai uses the North America server, and an account on cloud.eu.llamaindex.ai uses the Europe one. A token issued in one region is rejected by the other with a 401 that names the correct endpoint. See Regions for the full list of regional endpoints. Authentication The MCP server accepts two credentials, and both resolve to the same account and the same permissions. OAuth is what most MCP clients use, and what every configuration on this page uses unless you add a header. You sign in once, in your client; authentication happens automatically on first use, and tokens refresh without manual intervention. A LlamaCloud API key works where a browser sign-in does not — headless agents, CI jobs, and clients with no OAuth support. Send it as the bearer token when you add the server: Terminal window See the API key guide to create one. The two differ in one place: getUploadUrl is not available to API-key callers, because it stores the caller’s credential for the upload route to spend — bounded for an expiring token, unbounded for a key. Use uploadFileByUrl instead, or connect with OAuth. Connecting an MCP client Connect to the unified endpoint https://mcp.llamaindex.ai/mcp to get the full platform surface area (Parse, Classify, Extract, Split, and Index) in one server. - Cursor - VS Code - Claude Code - Claude - Codex Click the button to add the server in one click: Open in Cursor Or add the server manually to /.cursor/mcp.json: Click the button to add the server in one click: Open in VS Code Or add the server manually to your settings.json: Terminal window LlamaParse is a listed connector in Claude’s connector directory, so there is nothing to configure. In Claude, go to Customize → Connectors , search for LlamaParse, and connect. The directory is shared across Claude on the web, Claude Desktop, and Claude mobile, so connecting once covers all of them. Open connectors in Claude Desktop The listing connects to the North America server. To use the Europe server, or to pin a product-specific endpoint, add it yourself under Customize → Connectors , or edit Claude Desktop’s /Library/Application Support/Claude/claude desktop config.json (macOS) or %APPDATA%\Claude\claude desktop config.json (Windows). The configuration below uses the North America unified endpoint — swap the host for https://mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai/mcp for Europe, or the path for a product-specific server such as /parse/mcp: Open Codex settings to add the server: Open in Codex Or add through the CLI: Terminal window If you connected with OAuth, the first time your agent uses a tool you’ll be prompted to authenticate through your browser. EU region Accounts in the Europe region connect to https://mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai/mcp instead. The tool surface and the OAuth flow are identical to North America — only the host changes. The Claude connector directory listing points at the North America server, so Europe accounts add the server manually rather than installing it from the directory. Click a button to add the Europe server in one click: Open in Cursor Open in VS Code Or add the server manually, in the same file and shape your client uses above — for Cursor, that is /.cursor/mcp.json: From the CLI: Terminal window The llamaparse-eu name keeps the Europe server distinct from a llamaparse entry pointing at North America, so both can stay installed side by side. The one-click buttons above install under the name llamaparse, so rename that entry if you already have the North America server configured. Available tools The server groups its tools by product. The project and upload helpers below are carried by every endpoint — the unified one and each product-specific one — because the processing tools all take a file ID and, for accounts with more than one project, a project ID. Projects and uploads - getUserProjects — lists the projects your account can reach, so an agent can resolve a project by name and pass the right project ID to the other tools. - uploadFileByUrl — accepts a public file URL, fetches the file, and uploads it to the platform. - getUploadUrl — returns a temporary, authenticated upload endpoint your client can POST a local file to via multipart form data. Parse - parseFile — runs a Parse job over a file and returns clean markdown or plain text. - parseWithLiteParse — runs LiteParse over a PDF, a fast parser that costs no Parse credits. PDFs only, and best on text-dense documents with straightforward layouts. - estimateFileComplexity — scores a PDF page by page and returns, for each page, the Parse tier it needs or whether LiteParse is enough. Pair it with parseFile and parseWithLiteParse to send only the pages that need it to the heavier tiers. Classify - classifyFile — assigns a document to one of your categories using Classify. On the unified and Classify servers the categories are a required argument on every call, so an agent can decide them per file without creating a saved configuration first. On a pinned /classify/{configId}/mcp server they come from the configuration and the argument is not offered. Split - splitFile — segments a document into logical sections using Split. Like classifyFile, it takes its categories inline, except on a pinned /split/{configId}/mcp server. Extract Structured extraction is more reliable through dedicated tools than asking an agent to read a parsed document and pull fields out of the text: agents may only receive a truncated version of large documents, and prompt-only extraction leaves the output schema underspecified. - searchSchemaTemplates — searches a built-in catalog of starter schemas (invoice, contract, resume and others) and returns the matches with their template IDs. - getSchemaTemplate — returns one template’s full JSON schema by ID, so an agent can read it and adapt it before use. - createExtractionConfigFromSchema — creates an extraction configuration from either a template ID or an explicit JSON schema, and returns the configuration ID. This is the tool that lets an agent build a configuration on the fly. - generateExtractionConfig — generates a JSON schema and extraction rules from a description of the data you want, using a sample file. Also returns a configuration ID. - extractFile — runs extraction against a file using an extraction configuration ID. Index Index is the managed knowledge base offered by the LlamaParse Platform, built for agentic workflows. Beyond semantic search, it gives agents file-system-like access to the underlying documents. The tools cover both halves of that: building an index and querying one. An index is built over a directory of source documents, so the build flow is upload the files, put them in a directory, then index it: - createDirectory — creates a directory, the folder of source documents an index is built over. - addFilesToDirectory — adds already-uploaded files to a directory, using the file IDs returned by the upload helpers. Files are added one at a time and the response reports which succeeded, so you retry only the failures. - createIndex — indexes a directory. Indexing runs in the background, and the index isn’t queryable until it reports ready. - syncIndex — re-indexes a directory to pick up files added or changed since the last run. An index doesn’t refresh on its own, so this is how an existing one sees new documents. - getIndexStatus — reports whether an index has finished building. Querying an index that isn’t ready yet looks the same as querying one with no matching documents, so poll this after createIndex and syncIndex. - listDirectories — lists the directories in a project, one page at a time. - listDirectory — lists the files inside a directory, one page at a time. Searching and reading an index: - listIndexes — discovers the indexes you can query. - findFilesInIndex — locates relevant files within an index. - readFileFromIndex — reads the contents of a file in an index. - grepFileFromIndex — searches for pattern matches within indexed files. - retrieveFromIndex — performs hybrid (sparse + dense) retrieval over an index. API keys Carried by the unified /mcp endpoint only — the product-specific servers do not expose it. - createProjectApiKey — creates an API key scoped to a single project, for handing to an application or a teammate. The key reaches only that project, so an agent can finish setting a project up rather than stopping to ask you for a key. The secret comes back once and cannot be read again — store it when it is returned, or revoke the key and create another. Every key this tool creates expires; 90 days is both the default and the longest this tool will issue. The web UI offers longer lifetimes, up to a key that never expires. Product-specific servers The unified /mcp endpoint exposes every capability, which is ideal for exploratory work and broader document-processing tasks. When you want a more focused tool list, you can connect directly to a product-specific server instead. Narrowing the scope helps agents make tool-selection decisions more reliably and run independent tasks in parallel. The server tree looks like this: The same subpaths exist under https://mcp.eu.llamaindex.ai/ for accounts in the Europe region. Every product-specific server carries getUserProjects and both upload helpers, plus its own tools: Server Tools beyond the shared helpers --------------- --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- /parse/mcp parseFile, parseWithLiteParse, estimateFileComplexity /classify/mcp classifyFile /split/mcp splitFile /extract/mcp searchSchemaTemplates, getSchemaTemplate, createExtractionConfigFromSchema, generateExtractionConfig, extractFile /index/mcp every Index tool listed above The classify, extract, and split servers can optionally inherit a configuration ID directly from the route. When you connect to a /{configId}/mcp endpoint, the agent operates with that configuration already in context: classifyFile takes its categories from it, splitFile its categories and splitting strategy, and extractFile its schema — so the pinned extract server serves extractFile alone and drops every configuration-building tool. For example, to connect an agent directly to a specific classification configuration: And, in parallel, to a specific extraction configuration: This modular model lets you compose workflows from multiple specialized servers, each responsible for a well-defined task, improving isolation, enabling greater parallelism, and giving you fine-grained control over throughput. Choosing a configuration How an agent selects a configuration depends on the product, because Classify and Split carry theirs in the call while Extract refers to a saved one. Classify and Split take their configuration inline. categories is a required argument on every classifyFile and splitFile call, so an agent decides per file and nothing has to be saved first. Pass different categories on the next call and the behavior changes with it. The exception is a pinned server, below, which supplies them and drops the argument. Extract refers to a configuration by ID. extractFile requires a configurationId, so the configuration has to exist before the call. An agent has three ways to get one: - Build one from a starter schema — call searchSchemaTemplates to find a template, optionally getSchemaTemplate to read and adapt it, then createExtractionConfigFromSchema to create the configuration and get its ID back. - Build one from a sample file — call generateExtractionConfig with a file and a description of the data you want. - Reuse a saved one — take the ID of an existing configuration from the Extract Configurations page in the web UI and pass it straight to extractFile. Or pin the configuration to the connection. Connecting to a /{configId}/mcp endpoint puts the configuration in context for the whole session, and the agent never chooses. Use this when the configuration is fixed and you would rather the agent not vary it. There is no tool for listing the configurations already saved in a project, so an agent either creates one during the session or is given an ID to use. Example workflows - Classify, then extract — an agent classifies the files in a folder using a classification server, organizes them into category-specific subfolders, then runs the matching extraction configuration against each category in parallel and saves the results as JSON for downstream analysis. - Agentic retrieval — an agent discovers indexes with listIndexes, locates relevant files with findFilesInIndex, inspects them with readFileFromIndex, searches with grepFileFromIndex, and retrieves passages with retrieveFromIndex — navigating PDFs, Office documents, images, and other unstructured files the way it would a file system. - Build a knowledge base from scratch — an agent uploads a batch of files with uploadFileByUrl or getUploadUrl, groups them with createDirectory and addFilesToDirectory, calls createIndex, polls getIndexStatus until the index is ready, and then queries it. Later runs add files to the same directory and call syncIndex to fold them in. - Parse only what needs it — an agent runs estimateFileComplexity over a PDF, sends the pages that need a heavier tier to parseFile, and handles the rest with parseWithLiteParse. Tip The unified /mcp server is the best starting point for prototyping. Reach for the product-specific servers once you know which capabilities a workflow needs and want tighter scoping or more parallelism. Related - Skills and Plugins — install the MCP server and a parsing skill together with the llamaparse-mcp plugin, or give a coding agent the skills alone. - LlamaParse Platform n8n Node — the same capabilities as nodes in a no-code workflow.

title: 模型上下文協議（MCP）
text: 模型上下文協議（MCP）是一種開放原始碼標準協定，讓大型語言模型（LLM）能透過結構化 API 呼叫與外部工具及資料來源互動。 MCP 為 AI 應用提供標準化的溝通層，讓應用能有效地連接工具、資料庫和預先定義的範本等外部服務。您可以把 MCP 想成 AI 應用的「USB-C 連接埠」：它提供一致的方式，讓各種工具、平台和資料來源連接至 AI 模型。 架構 MCP 採用用戶端－伺服器架構： - MCP 主機 ：透過 MCP 存取資料的應用程式，例如 Claude Desktop、IDE 或 AI 工具 - MCP 用戶端 ：與 MCP 伺服器維持一對一連線的協定用戶端 - MCP 伺服器 ：透過標準協定提供各種功能（工具、資源和提示）的輕量服務 核心功能 MCP 支援三種主要功能： 1. Tools ：可透過結構化輸入呼叫的函式 2. Resources ：可讀取的資料來源，例如檔案、資料庫等 3. Prompts ：可重複使用並帶有參數的提示範本 搭配 LlamaIndex 使用 您可以透過多種方式在 LlamaIndex 中使用 MCP 伺服器，為 agent 工作流程加入更多資源與功能： - 在 LlamaIndex workflows 中使用現有 MCP 伺服器的工具 ：從現有 MCP 伺服器提供的外部資源取得資料。 - 將 LlamaIndex workflows 作為 MCP 伺服器提供服務 ：您可以將自訂的 LlamaIndex workflows 轉換成 MCP 伺服器。 - 在 LlamaIndex workflows 中使用 LlamaParse 服務 ：執行我們以 Python 或 TypeScript 提供的 MCP 伺服器，在任何可與 MCP 伺服器通訊的應用程式中使用 LlamaParse（原名 LlamaCloud）的 Extract、Parse 等功能，包括 LlamaIndex workflows。 下一步 - 在 LlamaIndex 中使用 MCP 工具 - 將 LlamaParse（原名 LlamaCloud）API 作為 MCP 工具／伺服器使用 - 將既有的 LlamaIndex workflow／tool 作為 MCP 工具／伺服器使用
sourceText: Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open-source standard protocol that allows Large Language Models (LLMs) to interact with external tools and data sources through structured API calls. MCP serves as a standardization layer for AI applications to communicate effectively with external services such as tools, databases and predefined templates. Think of MCP as a “USB-C port” for AI applications - it provides a standardized way for various tools, platforms, and data sources to connect to AI models. Architecture MCP operates through a client-server architecture: - MCP Hosts : Applications like Claude Desktop, IDEs, or AI tools that wish to access data via MCP - MCP Clients : Protocol clients that maintain 1:1 connections with MCP servers - MCP Servers : Lightweight services that expose capabilities (tools, resources, prompts) via the standardized protocol Core Capabilities MCP supports three main types of capabilities: 1. Tools : Functions that can be invoked with structured inputs 2. Resources : Data sources that can be read (files, databases, etc.) 3. Prompts : Reusable prompt templates with parameters With LlamaIndex With LlamaIndex, there are a number of ways you can use MCP servers, which allows you to bring additional resources and functionality your agentic workflows. - Use existing MCP servers tools with LlamaIndex workflows : Get data from external resources that are served via existing MCP servers. - Serve LlamaIndex workflows as MCP servers : You can convert your own custom LlamaIndex workflows to MCP servers. - Use LlamaParse services within LlamaIndex workflows : Run one of our MCP servers (both in Python and Typescript) that serve LlamaParse (formerly LlamaCloud) functionality such as Extract or Parse, within any other application that communicates with MCP servers, including LlamaIndex workflows Next Steps - Using MCP Tools with LlamaIndex - Use LlamaParse (formerly LlamaCloud) APIs as MCP Tools/Servers - Use any existing LlamaIndex workflow/tool as an MCP Tool/Server

title: 嵌入 (Embeddings)
text: 概念 Embeddings 在 LlamaIndex 中用於使用複雜的數值表示來代表您的 documents。Embedding 模型以文字為輸入，回傳一長串數字，用來捕捉文字的語義。這些 embedding 模型經過訓練，以這種方式來表示文字，有助於啟用許多應用程式，包括搜尋！ 從高層次來看，如果使用者詢問關於狗的問題，則該問題的 embedding 將與談論狗的文字高度相似。 在計算 embedding 之間的相似度時，有許多方法可供選擇（點積、cosine similarity 等）。預設情況下，LlamaIndex 在比較 embedding 時使用 cosine similarity。 有許多 embedding 模型可供選擇。預設情況下，LlamaIndex 使用 text-embedding-ada-002 from OpenAI。我們也支援 Langchain 此處 提供的任何 embedding 模型，以及提供一個易於擴展的 base class 以實作您自己的 embedding。 使用模式 在 LlamaIndex 中，最常見的情況是將 embedding 模型指定在 Settings 物件中，然後在 vector index 中使用它。該 embedding 模型將用於索引建構期間使用的 documents，以及稍後使用 query engine 進行的任何查詢的 embedding。您也可以針對每個 index 指定 embedding 模型。 如果您尚未安裝您的 embedding： 終端機視窗 然後： 為了節省成本，您可能希望使用本地模型。 終端機視窗 這將使用 Hugging Face 的高效且快速的預設模型。 您可以在下方找到更多使用細節和可用的自訂選項。 開始使用 embedding 模型最常見的使用方式是將其設定在全局 Settings 物件中，然後用它來建構 index 和查詢。輸入的 documents 將被分解成 nodes，並且 embedding 模型將為每個 node 生成一個 embedding。 如果您沒有設定 Settings.embed model，LlamaIndex 將回退到 OpenAIEmbedding 的預設值 text-embedding-ada-002。下面的範例展示了如何明確設定當前的 OpenAI 模型。我們建議在新專案中這樣做。 然後，在查詢時，embedding 模型將再次用於為查詢文字生成 embedding。 選擇 embedding 模型 有許多 embedding 模型可供選擇。在撰寫本文時，每個常見場景的一個合理起點是： - 無縫託管 API：OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small")。無需託管模型，良好的通用品質。 - 本地運行，小且快速（約 22-33M 參數）：HuggingFaceEmbedding("BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5") 或 HuggingFaceEmbedding("sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2")。 - 本地運行，中等大小，最新架構（約 150M 參數）：HuggingFaceEmbedding("lightonai/DenseOn")（2026 年 4 月發布）。相較於小型基準模型，是一個自然的升級，而無需承諾使用 0.6B+ 的模型。 - 本地運行，更強的準確性，多語言（約 0.6-4B 參數）：HuggingFaceEmbedding("Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B")（或如果您有 VRAM，則為 -4B）。 - CPU-only 部署，對吞吐量敏感：使用上述任何本地選項並搭配 backend="openvino"；請參閱 ONNX / OpenVINO section 了解基準測試。 MTEB leaderboard 是比較當前模型在準確性、速度和多語言支援方面的標準參考。 重要：如果您在索引後更改了您的 embedding 模型，則必須重新索引。不同模型的 embedding 是不可互換的。 自訂 Batch Size 預設情況下，embedding 請求以 10 的批次發送到 OpenAI。對於某些使用者，這可能會（很少見地）導致速率限制。對於嵌入大量 documents 的其他使用者，此批次大小可能太小。 本地 embedding 模型 使用本地模型的最簡單方法是使用 llama-index-embeddings-huggingface 中的 HuggingFaceEmbedding： 哪個載入小型快速（ 33M params）BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model。您可以使用 任何 Sentence Transformers embedding model from Hugging Face。瀏覽 MTEB leaderboard 以比較目前的選項。 作為中等規模的升級（ 150M params），lightonai/DenseOn 是 2026 年 4 月的發布，當小型基準模型不夠準確但您不想服務 0.6B+ 的模型時是一個好選擇： 為了更強的準確性和多語言覆蓋，切換為更大的現代模型，例如 Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（或對於單個 GPU 獲得更高準確性的 Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B）： 除了 HuggingFaceEmbedding 建構器中可用的關鍵字參數外，額外的關鍵字參數會傳遞給底層的 SentenceTransformer instance，例如 backend、model kwargs、truncate dim、revision 等。 ONNX 或 OpenVINO 優化 LlamaIndex 也支援使用 ONNX 或 OpenVINO 來加速本地推論，依賴於 Sentence Transformers 和 Optimum。 一些先決條件： 終端機視窗 指定模型和輸出路徑進行建立： 如果模型儲存庫中尚未包含 ONNX 或 OpenVINO 模型，則會使用 Optimum 自動轉換。請參閱 Sentence Transformers documentation 以查看各種選項的基準測試結果。 如果我想使用優化或量化模型檢查點呢？ 嵌入模型通常會有多個 ONNX 和/或 OpenVINO 檢查點，例如 sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 具有 2 OpenVINO checkpoints 和 9 ONNX checkpoints。請參閱 Sentence Transformers documentation 以了解這些選項及其預期性能的更多詳細資訊。 您可以指定一個 file name 在 model kwargs 參數中以載入特定的檢查點。例如，要從 sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 模型儲存庫載入 openvino/openvino model qint8 quantized.xml 檢查點： 在 CPU 上應該使用哪個選項？ 如 Sentence Transformers 基準測試所示，量化到 int8 的 OpenVINO (openvino model qint8 quantized.xml) 具有極高的性能，對準確性只產生微小的代價。如果您想確保結果完全一致，那麼基本的 backend=“openvino” 或 backend=“onnx” 可能會是最強的選項。 CPU Backend Benchmark 根據此查詢和這些 documents，使用 int8 量化的 OpenVINO 與預設的 Hugging Face 模型相比，獲得了以下結果： 在保持相同的 document 排名下，速度提升了 6.97 倍。 點擊查看重現腳本 在 GPU 上應該使用哪個選項？ 在 GPU 上，OpenVINO 並不特別引人注目，並且 ONNX 不一定比在預設 torch back end 運行量化模型表現更好。 GPU Backend Benchmark 這意味著您不需要額外的依賴項就能在 GPU 上獲得強大的加速，您只需在載入模型時使用較低的精度即可： 如果我想要的模型沒有我想要的 back end、優化或量化呢？ backend-export Hugging Face Space 可用於將任何 Sentence Transformers 模型轉換為帶有量化或優化的 ONNX 或 OpenVINO。這將向模型儲存庫創建一個包含轉換後模型檔案的 pull request。然後您可以使用此模型在 LlamaIndex 中，像這樣指定 revision 參數： LangChain 整合 我們也支援 Langchain 此處 提供的任何 embedding。 下面的範例使用 Langchain 的 embedding class 從 Hugging Face 載入一個模型。 自訂 Embedding Model如果您想使用 LlamaIndex 或 Langchain 不提供的 embeddings，您也可以擴展我們的 base embeddings class 並實作您自己的！ 下面的範例使用了 Instructor Embeddings (install/setup details here)，並實作了一個自訂的 embeddings class。Instructor embeddings 的運作方式是提供文本，以及關於該文本嵌入領域的「指示」(instructions)。這在對非常特定和專業的主題的文本進行嵌入時非常有用。 單獨使用 (Standalone Usage) 您也可以將 embeddings 作為一個獨立模組用於您的專案、現有應用程式或一般測試和探索。 支援的 embeddings 列表 LlamaIndex 與多種 embedding provider 整合：託管 API、自託管伺服器和本地模型。您也可以使用通過 LangChain 提供的任何東西，透過 LangChain 整合。 - Anyscale - Azure OpenAI - Baseten - Clarifai - Cohere - Custom - Dashscope - ElasticSearch - FastEmbed - Fireworks AI - Google PaLM - Hugging Face (local, Sentence Transformers) - JinaAI - LangChain - LLM Rails - MistralAI - Nomic - OpenAI - Sagemaker - Text Embeddings Inference - TogetherAI - Upstage - VoyageAI
sourceText: Concept Embeddings are used in LlamaIndex to represent your documents using a sophisticated numerical representation. Embedding models take text as input, and return a long list of numbers used to capture the semantics of the text. These embedding models have been trained to represent text this way, and help enable many applications, including search! At a high level, if a user asks a question about dogs, then the embedding for that question will be highly similar to text that talks about dogs. When calculating the similarity between embeddings, there are many methods to use (dot product, cosine similarity, etc.). By default, LlamaIndex uses cosine similarity when comparing embeddings. There are many embedding models to pick from. By default, LlamaIndex uses text-embedding-ada-002 from OpenAI. We also support any embedding model offered by Langchain here, as well as providing an easy to extend base class for implementing your own embeddings. Usage Pattern Most commonly in LlamaIndex, embedding models will be specified in the Settings object, and then used in a vector index. The embedding model will be used to embed the documents used during index construction, as well as embedding any queries you make using the query engine later on. You can also specify embedding models per-index. If you don’t already have your embeddings installed: Terminal window Then: To save costs, you may want to use a local model. Terminal window This will use a well-performing and fast default from Hugging Face. You can find more usage details and available customization options below. Getting Started The most common usage for an embedding model will be setting it in the global Settings object, and then using it to construct an index and query. The input documents will be broken into nodes, and the embedding model will generate an embedding for each node. If you don’t set Settings.embed model, LlamaIndex will fall back to OpenAIEmbedding’s default of text-embedding-ada-002. The example below shows how to set a current OpenAI model explicitly. We recommend doing this for new projects. Then, at query time, the embedding model will be used again to embed the query text. Choosing an embedding model There are many embedding models to choose from. At the time of writing, a reasonable starting point for each common scenario is: - Frictionless hosted API: OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small"). No model to host, good general-purpose quality. - Runs locally, small and fast (\ 22-33M params): HuggingFaceEmbedding("BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5") or HuggingFaceEmbedding("sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2"). - Runs locally, mid-size, recent architecture (\ 150M params): HuggingFaceEmbedding("lightonai/DenseOn") (released April 2026). A natural step up from the small baselines without committing to a 0.6B+ model. - Runs locally, stronger accuracy, multilingual (\ 0.6-4B params): HuggingFaceEmbedding("Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B") (or -4B if you have the VRAM). - CPU-only deployment, throughput-sensitive: any of the local options above with backend="openvino"; see the ONNX / OpenVINO section for benchmarks. The MTEB leaderboard is the canonical place to compare current models across accuracy, speed, and multilingual support. Important: if you change your embedding model after indexing, you must re-index. Embeddings from different models are not interchangeable. Customization Batch Size By default, embeddings requests are sent to OpenAI in batches of 10. For some users, this may (rarely) incur a rate limit. For other users embedding many documents, this batch size may be too small. Local Embedding Models The easiest way to use a local model is by using HuggingFaceEmbedding from llama-index-embeddings-huggingface: Which loads the small-and-fast (\ 33M params) BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 embedding model. You can use any Sentence Transformers embedding model from Hugging Face. Browse the MTEB leaderboard to compare current options. As a mid-size step up (\ 150M params), lightonai/DenseOn is an April 2026 release and a good option when the small baselines aren’t accurate enough but you don’t want to serve a 0.6B+ model: For stronger accuracy and multilingual coverage, swap in a larger modern model like Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (or Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B for even higher accuracy on a single GPU): Beyond the keyword arguments available in the HuggingFaceEmbedding constructor, additional keyword arguments are passed down to the underlying SentenceTransformer instance, like backend, model kwargs, truncate dim, revision, etc. ONNX or OpenVINO optimizations LlamaIndex also supports using ONNX or OpenVINO to speed up local inference, by relying on Sentence Transformers and Optimum. Some prerequisites: Terminal window Creation with specifying the model and output path: If the model repository does not already contain an ONNX or OpenVINO model, then it will be automatically converted using Optimum. See the Sentence Transformers documentation for benchmarks of the various options. What if I want to use an optimized or quantized model checkpoint instead? It's common for embedding models to have multiple ONNX and/or OpenVINO checkpoints, for example sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 with 2 OpenVINO checkpoints and 9 ONNX checkpoints. See the Sentence Transformers documentation for more details on each of these options and their expected performance. You can specify a file name in the model kwargs argument to load a specific checkpoint. For example, to load the openvino/openvino model qint8 quantized.xml checkpoint from the sentence-transformers/all-mpnet-base-v2 model repository: What option should I use on CPUs? As shown in the Sentence Transformers benchmarks, OpenVINO quantized to int8 (openvino model qint8 quantized.xml) is extremely performant, at a small cost to accuracy. If you want to ensure identical results, then the basic backend=“openvino” or backend=“onnx” might be the strongest options. CPU Backend Benchmark Given this query and these documents, the following results were obtained with int8 quantized OpenVINO versus the default Hugging Face model: That’s a 6.97x speedup while keeping the same document ranking. Click to see a reproduction script What option should I use on GPUs? On GPUs, OpenVINO is not particularly interesting, and ONNX does not necessarily outperform a quantized model running in the default torch backend. GPU Backend Benchmark That means that you don’t need additional dependencies for a strong speedup on GPUs, you can just use a lower precision when loading the model: What if my desired model does not have my desired backend and optimization or quantization? The backend-export Hugging Face Space can be used to convert any Sentence Transformers model to ONNX or OpenVINO with quantization or optimization applied. This will create a pull request to the model repository with the converted model files. You can then use this model in LlamaIndex by specifying the revision argument like so: LangChain Integrations We also support any embeddings offered by Langchain here. The example below loads a model from Hugging Face, using Langchain’s embedding class. Custom Embedding Model If you wanted to use embeddings not offered by LlamaIndex or Langchain, you can also extend our base embeddings class and implement your own! The example below uses Instructor Embeddings (install/setup details here), and implements a custom embeddings class. Instructor embeddings work by providing text, as well as “instructions” on the domain of the text to embed. This is helpful when embedding text from a very specific and specialized topic. Standalone Usage You can also use embeddings as a standalone module for your project, existing application, or general testing and exploration. List of supported embeddings LlamaIndex integrates with a wide range of embedding providers: hosted APIs, self-hosted servers, and local models. You can also use anything LangChain offers via the LangChain integration. - Anyscale - Azure OpenAI - Baseten - Clarifai - Cohere - Custom - Dashscope - ElasticSearch - FastEmbed - Fireworks AI - Google PaLM - Hugging Face (local, Sentence Transformers) - JinaAI - LangChain - LLM Rails - MistralAI - Nomic - OpenAI - Sagemaker - Text Embeddings Inference - TogetherAI - Upstage - VoyageAI

title: 使用本地模型
text: LlamaIndex 可以完全在本地模型上運行。當您不想將資料傳送給託管的 API、需要離線工作，或希望成本可預測時，這非常有用。典型的完全本地堆疊如下： - LLM：llama.cpp、vLLM、Hugging Face Transformers 或 Ollama。 - Embeddings：HuggingFaceEmbedding，它可以在本地運行任何 Sentence Transformers 模型（可選在 CPU 上啟用 ONNX / OpenVINO 加速）。 - Reranker (可選)：SentenceTransformerRerank 搭配像 cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 或 Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B 這樣的 cross-encoder。 - Vector store：預設的 SimpleVectorStore（持久化到磁碟），或任何自託管整合（Chroma、Qdrant、Postgres/pgvector、Milvus 等）。 最快速路徑 遵循 local 入門教學，該教學會引導您安裝 Ollama、llama-index-llms-ollama 和 llama-index-embeddings-huggingface，然後建立一個完整的本地 RAG pipeline。 如需一個由 Chroma 支援的持久化本地堆疊，請參閱 fully-local RAG cookbook。 可用的本地 LLM 整合 LlamaIndex 通過多個整合套件支援本地 LLMs： - llama-index-llms-llama-cpp：直接的 llama.cpp bindings。 - llama-index-llms-huggingface：Hugging Face Transformers（來自 Hub 的任何 causal LM）。 - llama-index-llms-vllm：用於高吞吐量自託管服務的 vLLM。 - llama-index-llms-openai-like：任何暴露 OpenAI-compatible API 的伺服器（text-generation-webui、LM Studio、vLLM 等）。 - llama-index-llms-ollama：Ollama（llama3、mistral、qwen 等）。 瀏覽 LLM 整合完整清單。
sourceText: LlamaIndex can run entirely against local models. This is useful when you don’t want to send data to a hosted API, when you need to work offline, or when you want predictable cost. The typical fully-local stack is: - LLM: llama.cpp, vLLM, Hugging Face Transformers, or Ollama. - Embeddings: HuggingFaceEmbedding, which runs any Sentence Transformers model locally (with optional ONNX / OpenVINO acceleration on CPU). - Reranker (optional): SentenceTransformerRerank with a cross-encoder like cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 or Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B. - Vector store: the default SimpleVectorStore (persisted to disk), or any self-hosted integration (Chroma, Qdrant, Postgres/pgvector, Milvus, etc.). Quickest path Follow the local starter tutorial, which walks through installing Ollama, llama-index-llms-ollama, and llama-index-embeddings-huggingface, then builds a full local RAG pipeline. For a persistent local stack backed by Chroma, see the fully-local RAG cookbook. Available local LLM integrations LlamaIndex supports local LLMs via several integration packages: - llama-index-llms-llama-cpp: direct llama.cpp bindings. - llama-index-llms-huggingface: Hugging Face Transformers (any causal LM from the Hub). - llama-index-llms-vllm: vLLM for high-throughput self-hosted serving. - llama-index-llms-openai-like: any server that exposes an OpenAI-compatible API (text-generation-webui, LM Studio, vLLM, etc.). - llama-index-llms-ollama: Ollama (llama3, mistral, qwen, etc.). Browse the full list of LLM integrations.

title: 自訂 LLMs 在 LlamaIndex Abstractions 中的設定
text: 您可以將這些 LLM abstraction 整合到 LlamaIndex（indexes、retrievers、query engines、agents）的其他模組中，讓您能夠在您的資料上建構先進的 workflows。 預設情況下，我們使用 OpenAI 的 gpt-3.5-turbo 模型。但您可以選擇自訂所使用的底層 LLM。 範例：更改底層 LLM 以下是自訂所使用的 LLM 的範例程式碼片段。 在這個範例中，我們使用 gpt-4o-mini 而非 gpt-3.5-turbo。可用的模型包括 gpt-4o-mini、gpt-4o、o3-mini 等。 範例：使用自訂 LLM 模型 - 進階 要使用自訂的 LLM 模型，您只需實作 LLM 類別（或 CustomLLM 以獲得更簡單的介面）。您需要負責將文本傳遞給模型並回傳新生成的 tokens。 此實作可以是某個本地模型，甚至是您自己的 API 的包裝器。 請注意，為了獲得完全私人的體驗，也請設定一個 本地 embeddings 模型。 以下是一個小的範例程式碼： 使用此方法，您可以使用任何 LLM。也許您在本地運行一個，或者在您自己的伺服器上運行。只要類別被實作並且回傳了生成的 tokens，它就應該可以運作。請注意，我們需要使用 prompt helper 來自訂 prompt 的大小，因為每個模型都有略有不同的 context length。 decorator 是可選的，但它透過在 LLM 呼叫上提供可觀察性（observability）回調。 請注意，您可能需要調整內部 prompt 以獲得良好的效能。即使如此，您也應該使用足夠大的 LLM，以確保它有能力處理 LlamaIndex 內部使用的複雜查詢，因此您的表現可能會有所不同。 所有預設內部 prompt 的列表可以在 這裡 找到，聊天特定的 prompt 則列在 這裡。您也可以實作 您自訂的 prompts。
sourceText: You can plugin these LLM abstractions within our other modules in LlamaIndex (indexes, retrievers, query engines, agents) which allow you to build advanced workflows over your data. By default, we use OpenAI’s gpt-3.5-turbo model. But you may choose to customize the underlying LLM being used. Example: Changing the underlying LLM An example snippet of customizing the LLM being used is shown below. In this example, we use gpt-4o-mini instead of gpt-3.5-turbo. Available models include gpt-4o-mini, gpt-4o, o3-mini, and more. Example: Using a Custom LLM Model - Advanced To use a custom LLM model, you only need to implement the LLM class (or CustomLLM for a simpler interface) You will be responsible for passing the text to the model and returning the newly generated tokens. This implementation could be some local model, or even a wrapper around your own API. Note that for a completely private experience, also setup a local embeddings model. Here is a small boilerplate example: Using this method, you can use any LLM. Maybe you have one running locally, or running on your own server. As long as the class is implemented and the generated tokens are returned, it should work out. Note that we need to use the prompt helper to customize the prompt sizes, since every model has a slightly different context length. The decorator is optional, but provides observability via callbacks on the LLM calls. Note that you may have to adjust the internal prompts to get good performance. Even then, you should be using a sufficiently large LLM to ensure it’s capable of handling the complex queries that LlamaIndex uses internally, so your mileage may vary. A list of all default internal prompts is available here, and chat-specific prompts are listed here. You can also implement your own custom prompts.

title: 使用 LLMs
text: 概念 在建立任何基於您的資料的 LLM 應用程式時，選擇適當的 Large Language Model (LLM) 是您需要考慮的第一步。 LLMs 是 LlamaIndex 的核心組成部分。它們可以作為獨立的 module 使用，或插入到其他核心 LlamaIndex module 中（indices、retrievers、query engines）。它們總是在回應合成步驟中被使用（例如，在檢索之後）。根據使用的 index 的類型，LLMs 也可能在 index 建構、插入和 query traversal 期間被使用。 LlamaIndex 為定義 LLM module 提供了一個統一的介面，無論是來自 OpenAI、Hugging Face 還是 LangChain，這樣您就不必自己編寫定義 LLM interface 的樣板程式碼。此介面包含以下內容（更多詳情見下）： - 支援 text completion 和 chat endpoint（詳情見下） - 支援 streaming 和 non-streaming endpoint - 支援 synchronous 和 asynchronous endpoint 使用模式 以下程式碼片段展示了如何開始使用 LLMs。 如果您還沒有安裝，請安裝您的 LLM： 然後： 在 standalone usage 或 自訂用法 了解更多詳情。 關於 Tokenization 的說明 預設情況下，LlamaIndex 對所有 token 統計使用一個全局 tokenizer。這預設為來自 tiktoken 的 cl100k，它是與預設的 LLM gpt-3.5-turbo 相匹配的 tokenizer。 如果您更改了 LLM，您可能需要更新此 tokenizer 以確保準確的 token 統計、chunking 和 prompting。 tokenizer 的唯一要求是它是一個可呼叫的 function，它接受一個 string 並回傳一個 list。 您可以像這樣設定一個全局 tokenizer： Modules 我們支援與 OpenAI、HuggingFace、Anthropic 等的整合。 請參閱完整的 list of modules。 進一步閱讀 - Embeddings - Prompts - Local LLMs - Running Llama2 Locally
sourceText: Concept Picking the proper Large Language Model (LLM) is one of the first steps you need to consider when building any LLM application over your data. LLMs are a core component of LlamaIndex. They can be used as standalone modules or plugged into other core LlamaIndex modules (indices, retrievers, query engines). They are always used during the response synthesis step (e.g. after retrieval). Depending on the type of index being used, LLMs may also be used during index construction, insertion, and query traversal. LlamaIndex provides a unified interface for defining LLM modules, whether it’s from OpenAI, Hugging Face, or LangChain, so that you don’t have to write the boilerplate code of defining the LLM interface yourself. This interface consists of the following (more details below): - Support for text completion and chat endpoints (details below) - Support for streaming and non-streaming endpoints - Support for synchronous and asynchronous endpoints Usage Pattern The following code snippet shows how you can get started using LLMs. If you don’t already have it, install your LLM: Then: Find more details on standalone usage or custom usage. A Note on Tokenization By default, LlamaIndex uses a global tokenizer for all token counting. This defaults to cl100k from tiktoken, which is the tokenizer to match the default LLM gpt-3.5-turbo. If you change the LLM, you may need to update this tokenizer to ensure accurate token counts, chunking, and prompting. The single requirement for a tokenizer is that it is a callable function, that takes a string, and returns a list. {% for %} 迴圈用於迭代傳入的 images and texts 列表 - {{ image path image }} 語法用於將圖片路徑格式化為圖片內容區塊。在這裡， 用於對變數應用「filter」以幫助識別它為圖片。 讓我們看看另一個範例，這次是使用 nodes 從 retriever 建立模板： 使用 f-string 提示模板 截至本文撰寫時，許多舊的元件和範例會使用 f-string 提示。 定義自訂提示就像建立一個 format string 您也可以從聊天訊息中定義模板 取得和設定自訂提示 由於 LlamaIndex 是一個多步驟管線，因此重要的是要識別您想要修改的操作，並在正確的位置傳入自訂提示。 例如，提示用於 response synthesizer、retrievers、index construction 等；這些模組有些是嵌套在其他模組中的（synthesizer 嵌套在 query engine 中）。 請參閱 此指南 以獲取有關存取/自訂提示的完整詳細資訊。 常見使用的提示 最常用的提示將是 text qa template 和 refine template。 - sourceText: Using RichPromptTemplate and Jinja Syntax By leveraging Jinja syntax, you can build prompt templates that have variables, logic, parse objects, and more. Let’s look at a few examples: The main difference between Jinja prompts and f-strings is the variables now have double brackets {{ }} instead of single brackets { }. Let look at a more complex example that uses loops to generate a multi-modal prompt. In this example, you can see several features: - the {% chat %} block is used to format the message as a chat message and set the role - the {% for %} loop is used to iterate over the images and texts list that is passed in - the {{ image path image }} syntax is used to format the image path as an image content block. Here, is used to apply a “filter” to the variable to help identify it as an image. Let’s look at another example, this time for creating a template using nodes from a retriever: Using f-string Prompt Templates As of this writing, many older components and examples will use f-string prompts.\ Defining a custom prompt is as simple as creating a format string You can also define a template from chat messages Getting and Setting Custom Prompts Since LlamaIndex is a multi-step pipeline, it’s important to identify the operation that you want to modify and pass in the custom prompt at the right place. For instance, prompts are used in response synthesizer, retrievers, index construction, etc; some of these modules are nested in other modules (synthesizer is nested in query engine). See this guide for full details on accessing/customizing prompts. Commonly Used Prompts The most commonly used prompts will be the text qa template and the refine template. - text qa template - used to get an initial answer to a query using retrieved nodes - refine template - used when the retrieved text does not fit into a single LLM call with response mode="compact" (the default), or when more than one node is retrieved using response mode="refine". The answer from the first query is inserted as an existing answer, and the LLM must update or repeat the existing answer based on the new context. Accessing Prompts You can call get prompts on many modules in LlamaIndex to get a flat list of prompts used within the module and nested submodules. For instance, take a look at the following snippet. You might get back the following keys: Note that prompts are prefixed by their sub-modules as “namespaces”. Updating Prompts You can customize prompts on any module that implements get prompts with the update prompts function. title: 重新排序器
text: 概念 Reranker 會對初始 retriever 返回的頂部 k nodes 進行重新排序，依據更強、通常較慢的查詢 document 相關性度量來重新排序。Reranking 是 RAG 管線中最高槓桿的調整項：初始檢索器針對大型資料集進行召回調校，而 reranker 讓您在 nodes 到達 LLM 之前恢復精確度。 在 LlamaIndex 中，reranker 被實作為運行在檢索和回應合成之間的 node 後處理器。 使用模式 retriever 擷取更廣泛的集合 (similarity top k=10)，而 reranker 會將其篩選至最佳 top n=3，然後 LLM 看到它們。 選擇 reranker - 無 API key，本地，高品質：SentenceTransformerRerank 是推薦的預設選項。與現代的 cross-encoder 搭配使用，例如 Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B（更強、多語言）或 cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2（較小、更快）。請瀏覽 Sentence Transformers cross-encoder list 和 MTEB leaderboard 上的更多模型。 - 託管 API，最小設置：CohereRerank、JinaRerank、VoyageAIRerank、MixedbreadAIRerank。當您不想自行運行 inference 時，這些是很好的選擇。 - 最高品質，延遲不是關鍵：LLMRerank、RankGPTRerank、RankLLMRerank。這些使用 LLM 本身來判斷相關性。 - 多模態延遲互動（documents 為圖片）：ColPaliRerank。 - 文字延遲互動：ColbertRerank。當查詢和 document 包含狹窄的技術術語時很有用。 如需包含所有整合和所有模型的完整參考，請參閱 Node Postprocessors guide。Rerankers 是 node 後處理器的ㄧ類。 進一步閱讀 - Node Postprocessors guide：包含程式碼範例的每個支援的 reranker。 - Sentence Transformers cross-encoder documentation：開源模型的速度/準確度權衡。 - Advanced retrieval：reranking 如何融入更廣泛的檢索策略中。
sourceText: Concept A reranker takes the top-k nodes returned by an initial retriever (usually a dense vector search, keyword search, or a hybrid of the two) and re-orders them based on a stronger, and typically slower, measure of query-document relevance. Reranking is one of the highest-leverage knobs in a RAG pipeline: initial retrievers are tuned for recall over a large corpus, and a reranker lets you recover precision before nodes reach the LLM. In LlamaIndex, rerankers are implemented as node postprocessors that run between retrieval and response synthesis. Usage pattern The retriever fetches a wider set (similarity top k=10) and the reranker prunes it down to the best top n=3 before the LLM sees them. Choosing a reranker - No API key, local, strong quality: SentenceTransformerRerank is the recommended default. Pair with a modern cross-encoder like Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B (stronger, multilingual) or cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 (smaller, faster). Browse more models on the Sentence Transformers cross-encoder list and the MTEB leaderboard. - Hosted API, minimal setup: CohereRerank, JinaRerank, VoyageAIRerank, MixedbreadAIRerank. Good options when you’d rather not run inference yourself. - Highest quality, latency is not critical: LLMRerank, RankGPTRerank, RankLLMRerank. These use an LLM itself to judge relevance. - Multimodal late interaction (documents as images): ColPaliRerank. - Text late interaction: ColbertRerank. Useful when the query and document contain narrow technical terms. For the full reference including every integration and every model, see the Node Postprocessors guide. Rerankers are one category of node postprocessors. Further reading - Node Postprocessors guide: every supported reranker with code examples. - Sentence Transformers cross-encoder documentation: speed/accuracy tradeoffs for open-source models. - Advanced retrieval: how reranking fits into a broader retrieval strategy.

title: 回呼
text: 概念 LlamaIndex 提供回調（callbacks）以協助除錯、追蹤和追蹤函式庫的內部運作。使用 callback manager，可以新增所需的任意數回調。 除了記錄與事件相關的資料外，您還可以追蹤每個事件的持續時間和發生次數。 此外，也會記錄事件的追蹤地圖（trace map），回調可以根據需要使用這些資料。例如，LlamaDebugHandler 會在大多數操作後印出事件的追蹤資訊。 回調事件類型 雖然每個回調可能不會使用每種事件類型，但以下事件可以被追蹤： - CHUNKING - 記錄文字分割的前後。 - NODE PARSING - 記錄被解析為的 documents 和 nodes。 - EMBEDDING - 記錄嵌入的文本數量。 - LLM - 記錄 LLM 呼叫的 template 和 response。 - QUERY - 追蹤每個查詢的開始和結束。 - RETRIEVE - 記錄為查詢檢索的 nodes。 - SYNTHESIZE - 記錄 synthesize 呼叫的結果。 - TREE - 記錄生成的摘要及其層級。 - SUB QUESTION - 記錄生成的子問題和答案。 您可以實作自己的回調來追蹤和追蹤這些事件，或使用現有的回調。 模組 目前支援的回調如下： - TokenCountingHandler - 為 prompt、completion 和 embedding token 使用提供彈性的 token 統計。請參閱 the migration details。 - LlamaDebugHanlder - 對事件進行基本的追蹤和追蹤。範例用法可在下方的 notebook 中找到。 - WandbCallbackHandler - 使用 Wandb Prompts 前端追蹤事件和追蹤。更多詳情請參閱下方的 notebook 或 Wandb。 - AimCallback - 追蹤 LLM 的輸入和輸出。範例用法可在下方的 notebook 中找到。 - OpenInferenceCallbackHandler - 追蹤 AI 模型推論。範例用法可在下方的 notebook 中找到。 - OpenAIFineTuningHandler - 記錄所有 LLM 的輸入和輸出。然後，提供一個 save finetuning events() 函式，以以適合與 OpenAI 進行微調的格式儲存輸入和輸出。
sourceText: Concept LlamaIndex provides callbacks to help debug, track, and trace the inner workings of the library. Using the callback manager, as many callbacks as needed can be added. In addition to logging data related to events, you can also track the duration and number of occurrences of each event. Furthermore, a trace map of events is also recorded, and callbacks can use this data however they want. For example, the LlamaDebugHandler will, by default, print the trace of events after most operations. Callback Event Types While each callback may not leverage each event type, the following events are available to be tracked: - CHUNKING - Logs for the before and after of text splitting. - NODE PARSING - Logs for the documents and the nodes that they are parsed into. - EMBEDDING - Logs for the number of texts embedded. - LLM - Logs for the template and response of LLM calls. - QUERY - Keeps track of the start and end of each query. - RETRIEVE - Logs for the nodes retrieved for a query. - SYNTHESIZE - Logs for the result for synthesize calls. - TREE - Logs for the summary and level of summaries generated. - SUB QUESTION - Log for a generated sub question and answer. You can implement your own callback to track and trace these events, or use an existing callback. Modules Currently supported callbacks are as follows: - TokenCountingHandler - Flexible token counting for prompt, completion, and embedding token usage. See the migration details - LlamaDebugHanlder - Basic tracking and tracing for events. Example usage can be found in the notebook below. - WandbCallbackHandler - Tracking of events and traces using the Wandb Prompts frontend. More details are in the notebook below or at Wandb - AimCallback - Tracking of LLM inputs and outputs. Example usage can be found in the notebook below. - OpenInferenceCallbackHandler - Tracking of AI model inferences. Example usage can be found in the notebook below. - OpenAIFineTuningHandler - Records all LLM inputs and outputs. Then, provides a function save finetuning events() to save inputs and outputs in a format suitable for fine-tuning with OpenAI.

title: 儀器
text: 注意 ：instrumentation 模組（在 llama-index v0.10.20 及更高版本中可用）旨在取代舊版的 callbacks 模組。在棄用期間，llama-index 函式庫同時支援這兩個模組，作為對您的 LLM 應用程式進行儀器化（instrumentation）的手段。然而，在所有現有整合都已遷移到新的 instrumentation 模組之後，我們將不再支援 callbacks 模組。 新的 instrumentation 模組允許對 llama-index 應用程式進行儀器化。特別是，可以同時使用自訂邏輯以及模組提供的功能來處理事件和追蹤 spans。使用者也可以定義自己的事件，並指定在程式碼邏輯的何處以及何時應發出這些事件。以下列出 instrumentation 模組的核心類別及其簡要描述： - Event — 代表應用程式程式碼執行過程中某個特定時間點發生的單一事件。 - EventHandler — 監聽 Event 的事件，並在這些時間點執行程式碼邏輯。 - Span — 代表應用程式程式碼中特定部分的執行流程，因此包含 Event。 - SpanHandler — 負責處理 Span 的進入、退出和丟棄（即因錯誤而提前退出）。 - Dispatcher — 發出 Event，以及信號以進入/退出/丟棄 Span 到適當的處理器。 使用儀器化模組進行可觀察性（Observability） 儀器化的核心用途是可觀察性。我們與第三方合作夥伴的原生儀器化整合，讓您可以獲得整個呼叫堆疊的詳細追蹤。 請參閱我們的 observability guide 以了解更多關於支援合作夥伴的詳細資訊。 使用方法 使用新的 instrumentation 模組涉及 3 個高階步驟。 1. 定義一個 dispatcher 2. (可選) 定義並將您的 EventHandler 附加到 dispatcher 3. (可選) 定義並將您的 SpanHandler 附加到 dispatcher 這樣做將使您能夠處理在 llama-index 函式庫和擴充套件中傳輸的所有事件和獲取 spans。 例如，如果我想追蹤函式庫中發出的每一個 LLM 呼叫： 請參閱 完整指南 了解所有記錄在 LlamaIndex 中的事件，或造訪 api reference 了解更多詳細資訊。 定義自訂的 EventHandler 使用者可以透過繼承 BaseEventHandler 並為抽象方法 handle() 提供邏輯，來建立自己的自訂處理器（handler）。 定義完您的處理器後，您可以將其附加到所需的 dispatcher： 定義自訂的 Event 使用者可以透過繼承 BaseEvent 來建立自己的自訂事件。BaseEvent 類別包含一個 timestamp 以及一個 id 欄位。若要向此事件載荷中添加更多項目，只需將它們作為新的 Fields 添加即可（因為它們是 pydantic.BaseModel 的子類別）。 一旦您定義了自訂事件，您就使用 dispatcher 在應用程式程式碼的所需實例中觸發該事件。 定義自訂的 Span Span 與 Event 類似，它們都是結構化資料類別（structured data classes）。與 Event 不同，Span 如其名稱所示，跨越程式執行流程中的一段時間。您可以定義一個自訂的 Span 來儲存您想要的所有資訊。 為了處理您的新 Span 類型，您還需要透過繼承 BaseSpanHandler 類別來定義您的自訂 SpanHandler。當繼承此基礎類別時，需要定義三個抽象方法：new span()、prepare to exit span() 和 prepare to drop span()。 要使用您的新的 SpanHandler（及相關的 Span 類型），您只需將其添加到所需的 dispatcher 中即可。 進入/退出 Span 要向 SpanHandler 發送訊號，使其進入/退出 Span，我們分別使用 span enter() 和 span exit() 方法。此外，還有 span drop() 方法可用於處理在受保護程式碼執行過程中，Span 被截斷於常態之外的情況。 使用 dispatcher 層級 與標準的 Python logging 函式庫及其 Logger class 類似，dispatcher 也存在類似的層級結構。具體來說，除了根級的 dispatcher 之外，所有 dispatcher 都有一個父物件，並且在處理 events 或 spans 時，它們也可以傳播給其父物件（這是預設行為）。這種處理 events 和 spans 的層級方法允許定義「global」event handlers 以及「local」的 handler。 考慮以下定義的專案結構。有 3 個 dispatcher：一個位於 project 的頂層，以及另外兩個位於個別子模組 llama1 和 llama2。在這種設定下，任何附加到專案根 dispatcher 的 EventHandler 都會訂閱在 llama1 和 llama2 程式碼執行中發生的所有 Event。另一方面，定義在各自 llama 子模組中的 EventHandler 只會訂閱在其各自子模組執行範圍內發生的 Event。 終端視窗 Notebook 指南： - 基本用法 - 觀察 Model Calls - 觀察所有 Events API 參考 - Instrumentation API Reference
sourceText: NOTE : The instrumentation module (available in llama-index v0.10.20 and later) is meant to replace the legacy callbacks module. During the deprecation period, the llama-index library supports both modules as a means to instrument your LLM application. However, at some point after all of the existing integrations have moved over to the new instrumentation module, we will no longer support callbacks module. The new instrumentation module allows for the instrumentation of llama-index applications. In particular, one can handle events and track spans using both custom logic as well as those offered in the module. Users can also define their own events and specify where and when in the code logic that they should be emitted. Listed below are the core classes as well as their brief description of the instrumentation module: - Event — represents a single moment in time that a certain occurrence took place within the execution of the application’s code. - EventHandler — listen to the occurrences of Event’s and execute code logic at these moments in time. - Span — represents the execution flow of a particular part in the application’s code and thus contains Event’s. - SpanHandler — is responsible for the entering, exiting, and dropping (i.e., early exiting due to error) of Span’s. - Dispatcher — emits Event’s as well as signals to enter/exit/drop a Span to the appropriate handlers. Using the Instrumentation Module for Observability A core use case for instrumentation is observability. Our native instrumentation integrations with third-party partners allow you to get detailed traces across the entire call stack. Check out our observability guide for more details on supported partners. Usage Using the new instrumentation module involves 3 high-level steps. 1. Define a dispatcher 2. (Optional) Define and attach your EventHandler’s to dispatcher 3. (Optional) Define and attach your SpanHandler to dispatcher Doing so, would result in the ability to handle events and obtain spans that have been transmitted throughout the llama-index library and extension packages. For example, if I wanted to track every LLM call made in the library: See the full guide on all events logged in LlamaIndex, or visit the api reference for more details. Defining a custom EventHandler Users can create their own custom handlers by subclassing BaseEventHandler and providing logic to the abstract method handle(). After defining your handler, you can attach it to the desired dispatcher: Defining a custom Event User can create their own custom events by subclassing BaseEvent. The BaseEvent class comes with a timestamp as well as an id field. To add more items to this event payload, simply add them in as new Fields (since they are subclasses of pydantic.BaseModel). Once you have your custom event defined, you use a dispatcher to fire the event at desired instances throughout your application’s code. Defining a custom Span Span’s are like Event’s in that they are both structured data classes. Unlike Event’s though, Span’s as their name implies, span a duration of time within the programs execution flow. You can define a custom Span to store any information you would like. To handle your new Span type, you need to also define your custom SpanHandler by subclassing the BaseSpanHandler class. Three abstract methods need to be defined when subclass this base class, namely: new span(), prepare to exit span(), and prepare to drop span(). To make use of your new SpanHandler (and associated Span type), you simply need to add it to your desired dispatcher. Entering/Exiting a Span To send a signal to SpanHandler’s to enter/exit a Span, we use the span enter(), span exit() methods, respectively. There is also span drop() method that could be used to handle cases where Span’s are cut shorter than usual due to errors within the covered code’s execution. Making use of dispatcher hierarchy A similar hierarchy to that seen with the standard Python logging library and its Logger class exists for dispatcher. Specifically, all dispatcher’s except for the root dispatcher has a parent, and when handling events or span’s can propagate them to its parent as well (this is the default behaviour). This hierarchical method of handling events and spans allows for defining “global” event handlers as well as “local” ones. Consider the project structure defined below. There are 3 dispatcher’s: one at the top-level of the project and then two others at the individual sub-modules llama1 and llama2. With this setup, any EventHandler’s attached to the project root’s dispatcher will be subscribed to all Event’s that occur in the execution of code in llama1 and llama2. On the other hand, EventHandler’s defined in the respective llama sub modules will only be subscribed to the Event’s that occur within their respective sub-module execution. title: 可觀察性
text: LlamaIndex 提供 一鍵式可觀察性 🔭，協助你在正式環境中打造可靠、可掌握的 LLM 應用程式。 要以資料為基礎（例如 RAG 系統或代理程式）可靠地開發 LLM 應用程式，關鍵在於能夠觀察、偵錯並評估整個系統及其中的每個元件。 這項功能可讓你將 LlamaIndex 程式庫輕鬆整合至合作夥伴提供的強大可觀測性與評估工具。只要設定一次變數，就能使用下列功能： - 查看 LLM／提示的輸入與輸出 - 確認各元件（例如 LLM、嵌入模型）的輸出是否符合預期 - 查看索引與查詢流程的呼叫追蹤 各家服務的功能各有相同與不同之處，請參閱下方各整合的完整指南。 注意： 自 v0.10.20 起，可觀測性功能改由 instrumentation 模組負責。 本頁提到的許多工具與整合仍使用舊版 CallbackManager，或未使用 set global handler。我們已為這些整合加上標示。 使用方式 通常只要執行以下步驟即可啟用： 所有 kwargs 都會傳給 set global handler，再由底層 callback handler 處理。 就這麼簡單！執行過程會自動傳送至下游服務，你便能查看應用程式的執行追蹤等資訊。 整合服務 OpenTelemetry OpenTelemetry 是廣泛使用的開放原始碼追蹤與可觀測性服務，並可整合多種後端，例如 Jaeger、Zipkin 和 Prometheus。 我們的 OpenTelemetry 整合會追蹤 LlamaIndex 程式碼所產生的所有事件，包括 LLM、代理程式、RAG 管線元件等。你可以將 LlamaIndex 原生儀表化功能所產生的所有資料匯出為 OpenTelemetry 格式。 請安裝此程式庫： 終端機視窗 以下範例示範如何使用預設設定，將它用於 RAG 管線： 你也可以採用更複雜且經過客製化的設定，例如以下範例： 我們也提供一個示範儲存庫，示範如何追蹤代理式工作流程，並將記錄的追蹤資料傳送至 Postgres 資料庫。 LlamaTrace（Arize Phoenix 代管版） 我們與 Arize AI 合作推出 LlamaTrace，這是一套代管式追蹤、可觀測性與評估平台，原生支援 LlamaIndex 開放原始碼使用者，也整合了 LlamaParse（原名 LlamaCloud）。 此平台以開放原始碼專案 Arize Phoenix 為基礎。Phoenix 以筆記本為核心，提供下列功能來監控模型與 LLM 應用程式： - LLM 追蹤：追蹤 LLM 應用程式的執行過程，了解內部運作方式，並排查檢索或工具執行等問題。 - LLM 評估：運用大型語言模型評估生成式模型或應用程式的相關性、毒性等品質。 若團隊需要用於正式環境 AI 系統的代管雲端服務或企業自架可觀測性與評估方案，Arize AX 也能接收 LlamaIndex 的 OpenInference 追蹤資料。 使用方式 請安裝整合套件：pip install -U llama-index-callbacks-arize-phoenix。 接著在 LlamaTrace 建立帳戶： 。建立 API 金鑰，並將它填入下方的 PHOENIX API KEY 變數。 然後執行以下程式碼： 指南 - 使用 Arize AX 追蹤 LlamaIndex - Arize 代理程式評估指南 - Arize LLM 評估指南 SigNoz SigNoz 是開放原始碼的可觀測性框架，以 OpenTelemetry 為基礎，在同一個介面中提供追蹤、日誌與指標，也支援自架及雲端部署。將 SigNoz 與 LlamaIndex 搭配使用後，你可以查看所有 RAG 與代理程式工作流程的詳細追蹤，並監控 token 使用量、延遲、錯誤率、LLM 模型分布等重要指標。 使用方式 安裝以下相依套件： 終端機視窗 接著加入自動儀表化設定： 終端機視窗 然後透過自動儀表化執行 LlamaIndex 應用程式： 終端機視窗 - sourceText: LlamaIndex provides one-click observability 🔭 to allow you to build principled LLM applications in a production setting. A key requirement for principled development of LLM applications over your data (RAG systems, agents) is being able to observe, debug, and evaluate your system - both as a whole and for each component. This feature allows you to seamlessly integrate the LlamaIndex library with powerful observability/evaluation tools offered by our partners. Configure a variable once, and you’ll be able to do things like the following: - View LLM/prompt inputs/outputs - Ensure that the outputs of any component (LLMs, embeddings) are performing as expected - View call traces for both indexing and querying Each provider has similarities and differences. Take a look below for the full set of guides for each one! NOTE: Observability is now being handled via the instrumentation module (available in v0.10.20 and later.) A lot of the tooling and integrations mentioned in this page use our legacy CallbackManager or don’t use set global handler. We’ve marked these integrations as such! Usage Pattern To toggle, you will generally just need to do the following: Note that all kwargs to set global handler are passed to the underlying callback handler. And that’s it! Executions will get seamlessly piped to downstream service and you’ll be able to access features such as viewing execution traces of your application. Integrations OpenTelemetry OpenTelemetry is a widely used open-source service for tracing and observability, with numerous backend integrations (such as Jaeger, Zipkin or Prometheus). Our OpenTelemetry integration traces all the events produced by pieces of LlamaIndex code, including LLMs, Agents, RAG pipeline components and many more: everything you would get out with LlamaIndex native instrumentation you can export in OpenTelemetry format! You can install the library with: Terminal window And can use it in your code with the default settings, as in this example with a RAG pipeline: Or you can use a more complex and customized set-up, such as in the following example: We also have a demo repository where we show how to trace agentic workflows and pipe the registered traces into a Postgres database. LlamaTrace (Hosted Arize Phoenix) We’ve partnered with Arize AI on LlamaTrace, a hosted tracing, observability, and evaluation platform that works natively with LlamaIndex open-source users and has integrations with LlamaParse (formerly LlamaCloud). This is built upon the open-source Arize Phoenix project. Phoenix provides a notebook-first experience for monitoring your models and LLM Applications by providing: - LLM Traces - Trace through the execution of your LLM Application to understand the internals of your LLM Application and to troubleshoot problems related to things like retrieval and tool execution. - LLM Evals - Leverage the power of large language models to evaluate your generative model or application’s relevance, toxicity, and more. For teams that want managed cloud or enterprise self-hosted observability and evaluation for production AI systems, Arize AX can also ingest LlamaIndex OpenInference traces. Usage Pattern To install the integration package, do pip install -U llama-index-callbacks-arize-phoenix. Then create an account on LlamaTrace: . Create an API key and put it in the PHOENIX API KEY variable below. Then run the following code: Guides - Trace LlamaIndex with Arize AX - Arize agent evaluation guide - Arize LLM evaluation guide SigNoz SigNoz is an open source observability framework. It is built natively off of OpenTelemetry, offers traces, logs, and metrics all in one pane, and has both self hosted and cloud deployment options. By using SigNoz with LlamaIndex, you can view detailed traces of all RAG and Agent workflows, while keeping track of important metrics like token usage, latency, error rates, LLM model distribution and much more. Usage Pattern Install the following dependencies: Terminal window Next, add automatic instrumentation: Terminal window Then, run your LlamaIndex application with auto-instrumentation: Terminal window - is the name of your service - Set the to match your SigNoz Cloud region - Replace with your SigNoz ingestion key - Replace with the actual command you would use to run your application. For example: python main.py 📌 Note: Using self-hosted SigNoz? Most steps are identical. To adapt this guide, update the endpoint and remove the ingestion key header as shown in Cloud → Self-Hosted. You will now be able to see any traces, logs, and metrics that are automatically or manually exported by your LlamaIndex application usage. LlamaIndex Trace View Example Guides - SigNoz LlamaIndex Integration Docs - SigNoz LLamaIndex Q\&A RAG Demo Weights and Biases (W\&B) Weave W\&B Weave is a framework for tracking, experimenting with, evaluating, deploying, and improving LLM applications. Designed for scalability and flexibility, Weave supports every stage of your application development workflow. Usage Pattern The integration leverages LlamaIndex’s instrumentation module to register spans/events as Weave calls. By default, Weave automatically patches and tracks calls to common LLM libraries and frameworks. Install the weave library: Terminal window Get a W\&B API Key: If you don’t already have a W\&B account, create one by visiting and copy your API key from . When prompted to authenticate, enter the API key. weave quickstart Traces include execution time, token usage, cost, inputs/outputs, errors, nested operations, and streaming data. If you are new to Weave tracing, learn more about how to navigate it here. If you have a custom function which is not traced, decorate it with @weave.op(). You can also control the patching behavior using the autopatch settings argument in weave.init. For example if you don’t want to trace a library/framework you can turn it off like this: No additional LlamaIndex configuration is required; tracing begins once weave.init() is called. Guides The integration with LlamaIndex supports almost every component of LlamaIndex — streaming/async, completions, chat, tool calling, agents, workflows, and RAG support. Learn more about them in the official W\&B Weave × LlamaIndex documentation. MLflow Tracing is an OpenTelemetry-based tracing capability and supports one-click instrumentation for LlamaIndex applications. Usage Pattern Since MLflow is open-source, you can start using it without any account creation or API key setup. Jump straight into the code after installing the MLflow package!
