Agenta integration with LlamaIndex Example Guides - Documentation Observability for LlamaIndex with Agenta - Notebook Observability for LlamaIndex with Agenta Confident AI Confident AI is an LLM observability and evaluation platform. confident-trace, its OpenTelemetry-native tracing SDK, subscribes to LlamaIndex’s instrumentation dispatcher, so every agent run, workflow step, retrieval, and tool call shows up in the Observatory with its hierarchy intact. Usage Pattern Terminal window Get your project API key from Confident AI and set it alongside your model provider key. For users in the EU region, set CONFIDENT OTEL ENDPOINT="https://eu.otel.confident-ai.com/v1/traces", otherwise your traces are forwarded to the US servers. Terminal window Call init() once at startup, before defining or running agents. Keep your normal agent.run call. In a long-running server, call init() at startup and shutdown() during graceful shutdown rather than per request. title: Node 後處理模組
text: Node postprocessors 在檢索和回應合成之間執行：它們會對 nodes 由 retriever 返回的結果進行轉換、過濾或重新排序，然後 LLM 才會看到它們。最常見的類型是 reranker ，詳見下文。 選擇 reranker - 無 API key，本地，推薦預設值：SentenceTransformerRerank，一個透過 sentence-transformers 的 cross-encoder。使用 cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 追求速度，使用 Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B 追求更強的多語言品質。 - 託管 API，最小設置：CohereRerank，JinaRerank，VoyageAIRerank，MixedbreadAIRerank，NVIDIARerank。 - 最高品質，容忍延遲：LLMRerank，RankGPTRerank，RankLLMRerank。這些模型使用 LLM 本身來判斷相關性。 - Token 級延遲互動：ColbertRerank，適用於狹窄的技術術語。 - 多模態（documents 作為圖片）：ColPaliRerank。 請參閱 rerankers 概觀頁面 以獲得更廣泛的說明。 SimilarityPostprocessor 用於移除相似度分數低於某個閾值的 nodes。 KeywordNodePostprocessor 用於確保某些關鍵字被排除或包含。 MetadataReplacementPostProcessor 用於將 node 的內容替換為 node 的 metadata 中的欄位。如果 metadata 中沒有該欄位，則 node 的文本保持不變。最常與 SentenceWindowNodeParser 組合使用。 LongContextReorder 模型在擴展上下文的中心部分難以存取重要細節。一項研究 A study 觀察到，最佳的表現通常發生在關鍵資料位於輸入上下文的開頭或結尾時。此外，隨著輸入上下文的加長，即使是設計用於長上下文的模型，表現也會顯著下降。 此模組會重新排序檢索到的 nodes，這在需要大型 top-k 的情況下會很有幫助。 SentenceEmbeddingOptimizer 此 postprocessor 通過移除與查詢無關的句子（使用 embeddings 進行此操作）來優化 token 的使用。 百分位數截止點是衡量使用相關句子前百分比的指標。 也可以指定 threshold cutoff，這會使用原始的相似度截止點來選擇要保留的句子。 完整的筆記本指南可在此找到 此處。 CohereRerank 使用 “Cohere ReRank” 功能來重新排序 nodes，並返回前 N 個 nodes。 完整的筆記本指南可在此獲得 此處。 SentenceTransformerRerank 使用 sentence-transformer 套件中的 cross-encoders 來重新排序 nodes，並返回前 N 個 nodes。 完整的筆記本指南可在此獲得 此處。 也請參閱 sentence-transformers docs 以獲取更多關於速度/準確度權衡的 cross-encoder 模型列表。構造函數的 model 參數預設為 cross-encoder/stsb-distilroberta-base，它經過訓練用於語義文本相似性，而不是段落重新排序。對於檢索工作負載，我們強烈建議傳遞一個經過 MS MARCO 訓練的模型，例如 cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2（上面顯示的是較小的 L2 版本）或現代選項如 Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B（見下文）。 對於多語言內容更強的準確性，請替換為最近的 cross-encoder，例如 Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B： 這仍然在本地運行，沒有 API key，與 MiniLM 基線相比，每個查詢的計算量會增加。 LLM RerankUses a LLM 重新排序 nodes 透過詢問 the LLM 以回傳相關的 documents 以及它們相關程度的分數。 Returns 前 N 名排名最高者 nodes. 完整的 notebook 指南已提供 her 對於 Gatsby 以及 here 對於 Lyft 10K documents. JinaRerank 使用 “Jina ReRank” 功能來重新排序 nodes，並回傳前 N 個 nodes。 完整的 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. FixedRecencyPostprocessor 此 postprocessor 會回傳前 K 個 nodes 依日期排序。 這假設存在一個 date 要在每個 metadata 中解析的欄位 node. 完整的 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. EmbeddingRecencyPostprocessor 此 postprocessor 會回傳前 K 個 nodes 在依日期排序並移除較舊的項目之後 nodes 在測量 embedding 相似度後過於相似的內容。 完整的 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. TimeWeightedPostprocessor 此 postprocessor 會回傳前 K 個 nodes 對每個項目套用時間加權的 rerank node. 每次一個 node 當節點被擷取時，系統會記錄其擷取時間。 這會使搜尋產生偏差，以優先考慮在查詢中尚未回傳的資訊。 完整的 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. (Beta) PIINodePostprocessor PII (Personal Identifiable Information) postprocessor 會移除可能造成安全性風險的資訊。其運作方式是使用 NER （可搭配專用的 NER 模型或本地的 LLM 模型）。 LLM Version NER Version 此版本使用 Hugging Face 的預設本地模型，該模型會在您執行 pipeline("ner") 時載入。 這兩者的完整 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. (Beta) PrevNextNodePostprocessor 使用預定義的 settings 來讀取 Node 關係，並擷取所有在前、在後或兩者皆有的 nodes。 這在您知道關係指向重要內容時非常有用 data （在之前、之後或兩者皆是）應傳送到 LLM 如果該 node 被擷取。 (Beta) AutoPrevNextNodePostprocessor 與...相同 PrevNextNodePostprocessor，但讓 the LLM 決定 mode （下一個、上一個，或兩者皆是）。 完整的範例 notebook 請參閱 此處. (Beta) RankGPT 使用 RankGPT agent 根據相關性對 documents 進行 rerank。Returns 前 N 個排名的 nodes。 完整的 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. Colbert Reranker 使用 Colbert V2 模型作為 reranker，根據 query tokens 與 passage tokens 之間的細粒度相似度對 documents 進行重新排序。回傳前 N 個排名最高的 nodes。 完整的 notebook 指南請參閱 此處. rankLLM 使用 rankLLM 的模型來對 documents 進行 rerank。Returns 前 N 個排名的 nodes。 完整的 notebook 範例為 available。 所有 notebook 本地 / 自行託管的 rerankers: - SentenceTransformer Rerank：透過 sentence-transformers 的 cross-encoders（本地 reranking 的建議預設值）。 - FlagEmbedding Reranker：BAAI/bge-reranker- 系列。 - Colbert Rerank：透過 ColBERT v2 進行 token-level late interaction。 - OpenVINO Rerank：Intel 優化的 cross-encoder 推論。 - RankLLM：經過 instruction-tuned 的 listwise LLM rerankers (RankZephyr, RankVicuna)。 Hosted API rerankers: - Cohere Rerank - JinaAI Rerank - Mixedbread AI Rerank - VoyageAI Rerank - NVIDIA Rerank (NIM) - AIMon Rerank - IBM watsonx.ai LLM 作為 reranker: - LLM Reranker Gatsby - LLM Reranker Lyft 10k - Structured LLM Reranker Lyft 10k - RankGPT 多模態 rerankers: - ColPali Rerank：針對 document 影像的 vision-language reranking。 其他 node postprocessors： - Sentence Optimizer - Recency - Time Weighted - PII - PrevNext - Metadata Replacement - Long Context Reorder
sourceText: Node postprocessors run between retrieval and response synthesis: they take the nodes returned by a retriever and transform, filter, or re-order them before the LLM sees them. The most common kind is a reranker , covered immediately below. Choosing a reranker - No API key, local, recommended default: SentenceTransformerRerank, a cross-encoder via sentence-transformers. Use cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 for speed, Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B for stronger multilingual quality. - Hosted API, minimal setup: CohereRerank, JinaRerank, VoyageAIRerank, MixedbreadAIRerank, NVIDIARerank. - Highest quality, latency tolerant: LLMRerank, RankGPTRerank, RankLLMRerank. These use an LLM itself to judge relevance. - Token-level late interaction: ColbertRerank, useful for narrow technical terminology. - Multimodal (documents as images): ColPaliRerank. See also the rerankers overview page for a broader framing. SimilarityPostprocessor Used to remove nodes that are below a similarity score threshold. KeywordNodePostprocessor Used to ensure certain keywords are either excluded or included. MetadataReplacementPostProcessor Used to replace the node content with a field from the node metadata. If the field is not present in the metadata, then the node text remains unchanged. Most useful when used in combination with the SentenceWindowNodeParser. LongContextReorder Models struggle to access significant details found in the center of extended contexts. A study observed that the best performance typically arises when crucial data is positioned at the start or conclusion of the input context. Additionally, as the input context lengthens, performance drops notably, even in models designed for long contexts. This module will re-order the retrieved nodes, which can be helpful in cases where a large top-k is needed. SentenceEmbeddingOptimizer This postprocessor optimizes token usage by removing sentences that are not relevant to the query (this is done using embeddings). The percentile cutoff is a measure for using the top percentage of relevant sentences. The threshold cutoff can be specified instead, which uses a raw similarity cutoff for picking which sentences to keep. A full notebook guide can be found here CohereRerank Uses the “Cohere ReRank” functionality to re-order nodes, and returns the top N nodes. Full notebook guide is available here. SentenceTransformerRerank Uses the cross-encoders from the sentence-transformer package to re-order nodes, and returns the top N nodes. Full notebook guide is available here. Please also refer to the sentence-transformers docs for a more complete list of cross-encoder models with speed/accuracy tradeoffs. The constructor’s model argument defaults to cross-encoder/stsb-distilroberta-base, which was trained for semantic textual similarity rather than passage re-ranking. For retrieval workloads we strongly recommend passing an MS MARCO-trained model like cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2 (shown above is the smaller L2 variant) or a modern option like Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B (see below). For stronger accuracy on multilingual content, swap in a recent cross-encoder such as Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B: This still runs locally with no API key, at the cost of extra compute per query compared to the MiniLM baselines. LLM Rerank Uses a LLM to re-order nodes by asking the LLM to return the relevant documents and a score of how relevant they are. Returns the top N ranked nodes. Full notebook guide is available her for Gatsby and here for Lyft 10K documents. JinaRerank Uses the “Jina ReRank” functionality to re-order nodes, and returns the top N nodes. Full notebook guide is available here. FixedRecencyPostprocessor This postprocessor returns the top K nodes sorted by date. This assumes there is a date field to parse in the metadata of each node. A full notebook guide is available here. EmbeddingRecencyPostprocessor This postprocessor returns the top K nodes after sorting by date and removing older nodes that are too similar after measuring embedding similarity. A full notebook guide is available here. TimeWeightedPostprocessor This postprocessor returns the top K nodes applying a time-weighted rerank to each node. Each time a node is retrieved, the time it was retrieved is recorded. This biases search to favor information that has not been returned in a query yet. A full notebook guide is available here. (Beta) PIINodePostprocessor The PII (Personal Identifiable Information) postprocessor removes information that might be a security risk. It does this by using NER (either with a dedicated NER model, or with a local LLM model). LLM Version NER Version This version uses the default local model from Hugging Face that is loaded when you run pipeline("ner"). A full notebook guide for both can be found here. (Beta) PrevNextNodePostprocessor Uses pre-defined settings to read the Node relationships and fetch either all nodes that come previously, next, or both. This is useful when you know the relationships point to important data (either before, after, or both) that should be sent to the LLM if that node is retrieved. (Beta) AutoPrevNextNodePostprocessor The same as PrevNextNodePostprocessor, but lets the LLM decide the mode (next, previous, or both). A full example notebook is available here. (Beta) RankGPT Uses RankGPT agent to rerank documents according to relevance. Returns the top N ranked nodes. Full notebook guide is available here. Colbert Reranker Uses Colbert V2 model as a reranker to rerank documents according to the fine-grained similarity between query tokens and passage tokens. Returns the top N ranked nodes. Full notebook guide is available here. rankLLM Uses models from rankLLM to rerank documents. Returns the top N ranked nodes. A full notebook example is available. All notebooks Local / self-hosted rerankers: - SentenceTransformer Rerank: cross-encoders via sentence-transformers (recommended default for local reranking). - FlagEmbedding Reranker: BAAI/bge-reranker- family. - Colbert Rerank: token-level late interaction with ColBERT v2. - OpenVINO Rerank: Intel-optimized cross-encoder inference. - RankLLM: instruction-tuned listwise LLM rerankers (RankZephyr, RankVicuna). Hosted API rerankers: - Cohere Rerank - JinaAI Rerank - Mixedbread AI Rerank - VoyageAI Rerank - NVIDIA Rerank (NIM) - AIMon Rerank - IBM watsonx.ai LLM-as-reranker: - LLM Reranker Gatsby - LLM Reranker Lyft 10k - Structured LLM Reranker Lyft 10k - RankGPT Multimodal rerankers: - ColPali Rerank: vision-language reranking over document images. Other node postprocessors: - Sentence Optimizer - Recency - Time Weighted - PII - PrevNext - Metadata Replacement - Long Context Reorder

text: 概念 Node postprocessors 是一組模組，它接收一組 nodes，並在返回它們之前套用某種轉換或過濾。 在 LlamaIndex 中，node postprocessors 最常在查詢引擎中應用，在 node 檢索步驟之後、回應合成步驟之前。 LlamaIndex 提供多種 node postprocessors 供立即使用，同時也提供一個簡單的 API 用於新增您自己的自訂 postprocessors。 提示 不確定 node postprocessor 在 RAG workflow 中的位置？請閱讀 高層次概念。 使用模式 以下是使用 node postprocessors 的範例： 請注意，postprocess nodes 可以接收 query str 或 query bundle (QueryBundle)，但不能同時接收兩者。 使用模式 最常見的情況是，node-postprocessors 將在查詢引擎中使用，它們會應用於從 retriever 返回的 nodes，並在回應合成步驟之前。 與查詢引擎一起使用 與檢索到的 Nodes 一起使用 或者可作為一個獨立的物件來過濾檢索到的 nodes： 與您自己的 nodes 一起使用 如您所注意，postprocessors 以 NodeWithScore 物件作為輸入，這只是一個包含 Node 和一個 score 值的包裝類別。 (custom-node-postprocessor)= 自訂 Node PostProcessor 基礎類別是 BaseNodePostprocessor，而 API interface 非常簡單： 一個虛擬的 node-postprocessor 只需幾行程式碼即可實作： 模組 請參閱完整的 modules list 以獲取更多詳細資訊。
sourceText: Concept Node postprocessors are a set of modules that take a set of nodes, and apply some kind of transformation or filtering before returning them. In LlamaIndex, node postprocessors are most commonly applied within a query engine, after the node retrieval step and before the response synthesis step. LlamaIndex offers several node postprocessors for immediate use, while also providing a simple API for adding your own custom postprocessors. Tip Confused about where node postprocessor fits in the RAG workflow? Read about high-level concepts Usage Pattern An example of using a node postprocessors is below: Note that postprocess nodes can take in either a query str or query bundle (QueryBundle), though not both. title: Response Synthesizer
text: 概念 Response Synthesizer 是使用用戶查詢和給定的文本區塊，從 LLM 生成回應的。回應合成器的輸出是一個 Response 物件。 執行此操作的方法有許多形式，從簡單地迭代文本區塊，到複雜地建立一個樹狀結構。這裡的主要想法是簡化使用 LLM 在您的資料上生成回應的過程。 在查詢引擎中使用時，回應合成器在從 retriever 檢索到 nodes 之後，以及在執行任何 node-postprocessors 之後使用。 提示 不確定回應合成器在 RAG workflow 中的位置？請閱讀 高層次概念 使用模式 單獨使用回應合成器： 或在建立索引後在查詢引擎中使用： 您可以在下方找到所有可用的回應合成器、模式以及如何建立您自己的詳細資訊。 使用模式 開始使用 使用 response mode 為查詢引擎配置回應合成器： 或者，更常見的是，在建立索引後在查詢引擎中使用： 提示 要了解如何建立索引，請參閱 索引 配置回應模式 回應合成器通常透過一個 response mode kwarg 設定來指定。 LlamaIndex 中已經實作了幾種回應合成器： - refine：透過依序遍歷每個檢索到的文本區塊來 建立並完善 一個答案。這會為每個 Node/檢索到的區塊執行一個單獨的 LLM 呼叫。 詳細資訊 ：第一個區塊使用 text qa template prompt 進行查詢。然後答案和下一個區塊（以及原始問題）使用 refine template prompt 進行另一個查詢。以此類推，直到所有區塊都被解析。 如果一個區塊太大無法在視窗內容納（考慮 prompt 大小），則使用 TokenTextSplitter 進行分割（允許區塊之間有部分文本重疊），並且（新的）額外的區塊被視為原始區塊集合的區塊（因此也使用 refine template 進行查詢）。 適合更詳細的答案。 - compact (預設值)：類似於 refine 但 壓縮 （連接）區塊，從而減少 LLM 呼叫次數。 詳細資訊 ：將盡可能多的文本（從檢索到的區塊中連接/打包）放入上下文視窗內（考慮 text qa template 和 refine template 之間的最大 prompt 大小）。如果文本太長無法放入一個 prompt，則按需要分割成多個部分（使用 TokenTextSplitter，從而允許文本區塊之間有部分重疊）。 每個文本部分都被視為一個 “chunk”，並發送給 refine synthesizer。 簡而言之，它就像 refine，但 LLM 呼叫次數更少。 - tree summarize：重複查詢 LLM，使用 summary template prompt，直到所有連接的區塊都被查詢，從而產生許多答案，這些答案本身會被遞迴用作 tree summarize LLM 呼叫中的區塊，依此類推，直到只剩一個區塊，因此只有一個最終答案。 詳細資訊 ：盡可能多地將區塊連接以適應上下文視窗，使用 summary template prompt，如果需要則分割（再次使用 TokenTextSplitter 並允許部分文本重疊）。然後，對每個結果的區塊/分割進行查詢，對 summary template（沒有 refine 查詢！）進行查詢，以獲得最多的答案。 如果只有一個答案（因為只有一個區塊），那就是最終答案。 如果有多個答案，這些答案本身也被視為區塊，並遞迴發送到 tree summarize 流程（連接/分割以適應/查詢）。 適合摘要目的。- simple summarize：將所有文本區塊截斷以適應單一 LLM prompt。適合快速摘要，但由於截斷可能丟失細節。 - no text：僅執行 retriever 以獲取原本會傳送給 LLM 的 nodes，而不會實際傳送它們。然後可以透過檢查 response.source nodes 來檢查。 - context only：回傳所有文本區塊的合併字串。 - accumulate：給定一組文本區塊和查詢，將查詢應用於每個文本區塊，並將回應累積到一個 array 中。回傳所有回應的合併字串。適合當你需要對每個文本區塊分別執行相同的查詢時。 - compact accumulate：與 accumulate 相同，但會像 compact 一樣「壓縮」每個 LLM prompt，並對每個文本區塊執行相同的查詢。 自訂回應合成器 (Custom Response Synthesizers) 每個回應合成器都繼承自 llama index.response synthesizers.base.BaseSynthesizer。基礎的 API 非常簡單，這使得創建您自己的回應合成器變得容易。 也許您想自訂在 tree summarize 的每個步驟中使用的模板，或者也許有新的研究論文詳細說明了生成回應的新方法，您可以創建自己的回應合成器並將其插入任何查詢引擎中，或單獨使用它。 以下我們展示了 init () 函式，以及每個回應合成器必須實作的兩個抽象方法。基本要求是處理查詢和文本區塊，並回傳一個字串（或字串生成器）回應。 使用結構化答案過濾 (Using Structured Answer Filtering) 當使用 "refine" 或 "compact" 回應合成模組時，您可能會發現嘗試 structured answer filtering 選項是有益的。 當將 structured answer filtering 設定為 True 時，我們的 refine 模組能夠過濾掉任何與所問問題無關的輸入 nodes。這對於涉及從外部 vector store 檢索特定使用者查詢的 RAG-based Q\&A 系統特別有用。 如果您正在使用支援 function calling 的 OpenAI 模型，此選項特別有用。其他沒有原生 function calling 支援的 LLM 提供者或模型，在產生此功能所依賴的結構化回應方面可能不太可靠。 使用自訂提示模板（帶有額外變數）(Using Custom Prompt Templates (with additional variables)) 您可能想自訂回應合成器中使用的提示，並在查詢時添加額外的變數。 您可以在 kwargs 中為 get response 指定這些額外變數。 例如， 模組 (Modules) 請參閱完整的 module guide 以獲取更多詳細資訊。
sourceText: Concept A Response Synthesizer is what generates a response from an LLM, using a user query and a given set of text chunks. The output of a response synthesizer is a Response object. The method for doing this can take many forms, from as simple as iterating over text chunks, to as complex as building a tree. The main idea here is to simplify the process of generating a response using an LLM across your data. When used in a query engine, the response synthesizer is used after nodes are retrieved from a retriever, and after any node-postprocessors are ran. Tip Confused about where response synthesizer fits in the RAG workflow? Read the high-level concepts Usage Pattern Use a response synthesizer on it’s own: Or in a query engine after you’ve created an index: You can find more details on all available response synthesizers, modes, and how to build your own below. Usage Pattern Get Started Configuring the response synthesizer for a query engine using response mode: Or, more commonly, in a query engine after you’ve created an index: Tip To learn how to build an index, see Indexing Configuring the Response Mode Response synthesizers are typically specified through a response mode kwarg setting. Several response synthesizers are implemented already in LlamaIndex: - refine: create and refine an answer by sequentially going through each retrieved text chunk. This makes a separate LLM call per Node/retrieved chunk. Details: the first chunk is used in a query using the text qa template prompt. Then the answer and the next chunk (as well as the original question) are used in another query with the refine template prompt. And so on until all chunks have been parsed. If a chunk is too large to fit within the window (considering the prompt size), it is split using a TokenTextSplitter (allowing some text overlap between chunks) and the (new) additional chunks are considered as chunks of the original chunks collection (and thus queried with the refine template as well). Good for more detailed answers. - compact (default): similar to refine but compact (concatenate) the chunks beforehand, resulting in less LLM calls. Details: stuff as many text (concatenated/packed from the retrieved chunks) that can fit within the context window (considering the maximum prompt size between text qa template and refine template). If the text is too long to fit in one prompt, it is split in as many parts as needed (using a TokenTextSplitter and thus allowing some overlap between text chunks). Each text part is considered a “chunk” and is sent to the refine synthesizer. In short, it is like refine, but with less LLM calls. - tree summarize: Query the LLM using the summary template prompt as many times as needed so that all concatenated chunks have been queried, resulting in as many answers that are themselves recursively used as chunks in a tree summarize LLM call and so on, until there’s only one chunk left, and thus only one final answer. Details: concatenate the chunks as much as possible to fit within the context window using the summary template prompt, and split them if needed (again with a TokenTextSplitter and some text overlap). Then, query each resulting chunk/split against summary template (there is no refine query !) and get as many answers. If there is only one answer (because there was only one chunk), then it’s the final answer. If there are more than one answer, these themselves are considered as chunks and sent recursively to the tree summarize process (concatenated/splitted-to-fit/queried). Good for summarization purposes. - simple summarize: Truncates all text chunks to fit into a single LLM prompt. Good for quick summarization purposes, but may lose detail due to truncation. - no text: Only runs the retriever to fetch the nodes that would have been sent to the LLM, without actually sending them. Then can be inspected by checking response.source nodes. - context only: Returns a concatenated string of all text chunks. - accumulate: Given a set of text chunks and the query, apply the query to each text chunk while accumulating the responses into an array. Returns a concatenated string of all responses. Good for when you need to run the same query separately against each text chunk. - compact accumulate: The same as accumulate, but will “compact” each LLM prompt similar to compact, and run the same query against each text chunk. Custom Response Synthesizers Each response synthesizer inherits from llama index.response synthesizers.base.BaseSynthesizer. The base API is extremely simple, which makes it easy to create your own response synthesizer. Maybe you want to customize which template is used at each step in tree summarize, or maybe a new research paper came out detailing a new way to generate a response to a query, you can create your own response synthesizer and plug it into any query engine or use it on it’s own. Below we show the init () function, as well as the two abstract methods that every response synthesizer must implement. The basic requirements are to process a query and text chunks, and return a string (or string generator) response. Using Structured Answer Filtering When using either the "refine" or "compact" response synthesis modules, you may find it beneficial to experiment with the structured answer filtering option. With structured answer filtering set to True, our refine module is able to filter out any input nodes that are not relevant to the question being asked. This is particularly useful for RAG-based Q\&A systems that involve retrieving chunks of text from external vector store for a given user query. This option is particularly useful if you’re using an OpenAI model that supports function calling. Other LLM providers or models that don’t have native function calling support may be less reliable in producing the structured response this feature relies on. Using Custom Prompt Templates (with additional variables) You may want to customize the prompts used in our response synthesizer, and also add additional variables during query-time. title: 路由器
text: 概念 Router 是接收使用者查詢和一組「選擇」（由 metadata 定義）的模組，並回傳一個或多個被選定的選擇。 它們可以單獨使用（作為「selector modules」），或用作 query engine 或 retriever（例如，在其他 query engine/retriever 之上）。 它們是簡單但強大的模組，使用 LLMs 進行決策能力。它們可用於以下使用案例及更多： - 在多樣化的資料來源中選擇正確的資料來源 - 決定是否進行摘要（例如，使用 summary index query engine）或語義搜尋（例如，使用 vector index query engine） - 決定是否一次嘗試一堆選擇並組合結果（使用 multi-routing capabilities）。 核心 router 模組存在以下形式： - LLM selectors 將選擇作為文字匯入 prompt，並使用 LLM text completion endpoint 進行決策 - Pydantic selectors 將選擇作為 Pydantic schemas 傳遞給 function calling endpoint，並回傳 Pydantic objects 使用模式 以下提供一個使用我們的 router 模組作為 query engine 部分的簡單範例。 使用模式 定義一個「selector」是定義 router 的核心。 您可以輕鬆地將我們的 router 用作 query engine 或 retriever。在這些情況下，router 將負責「選擇」要將使用者查詢導向的 query engine 或 retriever。 我們也強調了我們的 ToolRetrieverRouterQueryEngine 用於檢索增強路由（retrieval-augmented routing）- 這是選擇的集合本身可能非常大，可能需要被索引的情況。 注意 ：這是一個 beta 功能。 我們也強調了將我們的 router 作為獨立模組使用。 定義 selector 以下提供了一些使用 LLM 和 Pydantic 基於單一/多重 selector 的範例： 作為 Query Engine 使用 RouterQueryEngine 在其他 query engine 之上作為 tools 組成。 作為 Retriever 使用 同樣地，RouterRetriever 在其他 retrievers 之上作為 tools 組成。以下提供一個範例： 作為獨立模組使用 selector 您可以將 selectors 用作獨立模組。將 choices 定義為 ToolMetadata 的列表或字串的列表。 更多範例： - Router Query Engine - Retriever Router Query Engine - SQL Router Query Engine - Router Retriever
sourceText: Concept Routers are modules that take in a user query and a set of “choices” (defined by metadata), and returns one or more selected choices. They can be used on their own (as “selector modules”), or used as a query engine or retriever (e.g. on top of other query engines/retrievers). They are simple but powerful modules that use LLMs for decision making capabilities. They can be used for the following use cases and more: - Selecting the right data source among a diverse range of data sources - Deciding whether to do summarization (e.g. using summary index query engine) or semantic search (e.g. using vector index query engine) - Deciding whether to “try” out a bunch of choices at once and combine the results (using multi-routing capabilities). The core router modules exist in the following forms: - LLM selectors put the choices as a text dump into a prompt and use LLM text completion endpoint to make decisions - Pydantic selectors pass choices as Pydantic schemas into a function calling endpoint, and return Pydantic objects Usage Pattern A simple example of using our router module as part of a query engine is given below. Usage Pattern Defining a “selector” is at the core of defining a router. You can easily use our routers as a query engine or a retriever. In these cases, the router will be responsible for “selecting” query engine(s) or retriever(s) to route the user query to. We also highlight our ToolRetrieverRouterQueryEngine for retrieval-augmented routing - this is the case where the set of choices themselves may be very big and may need to be indexed. NOTE : this is a beta feature. We also highlight using our router as a standalone module. Defining a selector Some examples are given below with LLM and Pydantic based single/multi selectors: Using as a Query Engine A RouterQueryEngine is composed on top of other query engines as tools. Using as a Retriever Similarly, a RouterRetriever is composed on top of other retrievers as tools. An example is given below: Using selector as a standalone module You can use the selectors as standalone modules. Define choices as either a list of ToolMetadata or as a list of strings. More examples: - Router Query Engine - Retriever Router Query Engine - SQL Router Query Engine - Router Retriever

text: 提示 Pydantic Program 是用於結構化輸出提取的較低層抽象。執行結構化輸出提取的預設方式是使用我們的 LLM classes，這讓您可以輕鬆地將這些 LLMs 嵌入到更高層級的 workflows 中。請查看我們的 結構化資料擷取教學。 pydantic program 是一個通用抽象，它接收一個輸入字串並將其轉換為結構化的 Pydantic 物件類型。 由於這個抽象非常通用，它涵蓋了廣泛的 LLM workflows。這些 program 是可組合的，可用於更通用或特定的使用情境。 Pydantic Program 有幾種一般類型： - Text Completion Pydantic Programs ：透過 text completion API + output parsing，將輸入文字轉換為使用者指定的結構化物件。 - Function Calling Pydantic Programs ：透過 LLM function calling API，將輸入文字轉換為使用者指定的結構化物件。 - Prepackaged Pydantic Programs ：將輸入文字轉換為預先指定的結構化物件。 文字補完 Pydantic 程式 請參閱 LLM Text Completion programs 的範例 notebook。 Function Calling Pydantic Programs - Function Calling Pydantic Program - OpenAI Pydantic Program - Guidance Pydantic Program - Guidance Sub-Question Generator Prepackaged Pydantic Programs - DF Program - Evaporate Program
sourceText: Tip Pydantic Programs are a lower-level abstraction for structured output extraction. The default way to perform structured output extraction is with our LLM classes, which lets you plug these LLMs easily into higher-level workflows. Check out our structured data extraction tutorial. A pydantic program is a generic abstraction that takes in an input string and converts it to a structured Pydantic object type. Because this abstraction is so generic, it encompasses a broad range of LLM workflows. The programs are composable and be for more generic or specific use cases. There’s a few general types of Pydantic Programs: - Text Completion Pydantic Programs : These convert input text into a user-specified structured object through a text completion API + output parsing. - Function Calling Pydantic Programs : These convert input text into a user-specified structured object through an LLM function calling API. - Prepackaged Pydantic Programs : These convert input text into prespecified structured objects. sourceText: Tip This guide references a deprecated method of extracting structured outputs in a RAG workflow. Check out our structured output starter guide for more details. Every query engine has support for integrated structured responses using the following response modes in RetrieverQueryEngine: - refine - compact - tree summarize - accumulate (beta, requires extra parsing to convert to objects) - compact accumulate (beta, requires extra parsing to convert to objects) Under the hood, this uses OpenAIPydanitcProgam or LLMTextCompletionProgram depending on which LLM you’ve setup. title: 結構化輸出
text: LLMs 產生結構化輸出（structured outputs）的能力對於依賴可靠解析輸出值的下游應用程式非常重要。LlamaIndex 本身也透過以下方式依賴結構化輸出。 - Document 檢索 (retrieval) ：LlamaIndex 中的許多資料結構依賴於使用特定 Schema 呼叫 LLM 來進行 Document 檢索。例如，tree index 預期 LLM 呼叫的格式是「ANSWER: (number)」。 - 回應合成 (Response synthesis) ：使用者可能會期望最終的回應包含一定程度的結構（例如 JSON 輸出、格式化的 SQL 查詢等）。 LlamaIndex 提供多種模組，使 LLMs 能夠以結構化的格式產生輸出。預設情況下，結構化輸出在我們的 LLM classes 中提供。我們也提供較底層的模組： - Pydantic Programs ：這些是通用模組，將輸入 prompt 映射到結構化輸出，由一個 Pydantic 物件表示。它們可以使用 function calling APIs 或 text completion APIs + output parsers。這些也可以與 query engines 整合。 - 預定義 Pydantic Program ：我們有預定義的 Pydantic programs，將輸入映射到特定的輸出類型（如 dataframes）。 - Output Parsers ：這些是在 LLM text completion endpoint 之前和之後運作的模組。它們不與 LLM function calling endpoints 一起使用（因為後者預設就包含結構化輸出）。 請參閱下方的章節以了解 output parsers 和 Pydantic programs 的概述。 🔬 結構化輸出函式結構 (Anatomy of a Structured Output Function) 這裡描述了由 LLM 驅動的結構化輸出函式的不同組成部分。管線取決於您是使用 generic LLM text completion API 還是 LLM function calling API 。 對於 generic completion APIs，輸入和輸出由 text prompts 處理。output parser 在 LLM 呼叫之前和之後扮演角色，以確保結構化輸出。在 LLM 呼叫之前，output parser 可以將格式指令附加到 prompt 上。在 LLM 呼叫之後，output parser 可以解析輸出以符合指定的指令。 對於 function calling APIs，輸出本質上就是結構化的格式，輸入可以接受所需物件的 signature。結構化輸出只需轉換成正確的物件格式（例如 Pydantic）。 啟動指南 (Starter Guides) - Structured data extraction tutorial - Examples of Structured Outputs 其他資源 (Other Resources) - Pydantic Programs - Structured Outputs + Query Engines - Output Parsers
sourceText: The ability of LLMs to produce structured outputs are important for downstream applications that rely on reliably parsing output values. LlamaIndex itself also relies on structured output in the following ways. - Document retrieval : Many data structures within LlamaIndex rely on LLM calls with a specific schema for Document retrieval. For instance, the tree index expects LLM calls to be in the format “ANSWER: (number)”. - Response synthesis : Users may expect that the final response contains some degree of structure (e.g. a JSON output, a formatted SQL query, etc.) LlamaIndex provides a variety of modules enabling LLMs to produce outputs in a structured format. By default, structured output is offered within our LLM classes. We also provide lower-level modules: - Pydantic Programs : These are generic modules that map an input prompt to a structured output, represented by a Pydantic object. They may use function calling APIs or text completion APIs + output parsers. These can also be integrated with query engines. - Pre-defined Pydantic Program : We have pre-defined Pydantic programs that map inputs to specific output types (like dataframes). - Output Parsers : These are modules that operate before and after an LLM text completion endpoint. They are not used with LLM function calling endpoints (since those contain structured outputs out of the box). See the sections below for an overview of output parsers and Pydantic programs. 🔬 Anatomy of a Structured Output Function Here we describe the different components of an LLM-powered structured output function. The pipeline depends on whether you’re using a generic LLM text completion API or an LLM function calling API . With generic completion APIs, the inputs and outputs are handled by text prompts. The output parser plays a role before and after the LLM call in ensuring structured outputs. Before the LLM call, the output parser can append format instructions to the prompt. After the LLM call, the output parser can parse the output to the specified instructions. With function calling APIs, the output is inherently in a structured format, and the input can take in the signature of the desired object. The structured output just needs to be cast in the right object format (e.g. Pydantic). Starter Guides - Structured data extraction tutorial - Examples of Structured Outputs Other Resources - Pydantic Programs - Structured Outputs + Query Engines - Output Parsers

title: 聊天儲存區
text: 聊天儲存區提供集中式介面，用來保存聊天記錄。與其他儲存格式不同，聊天記錄中的訊息順序很重要，因為順序會影響整段對話的脈絡。 聊天儲存區可依鍵值（例如 user ids 或其他可唯一識別的字串）整理聊天訊息序列，並支援 delete、insert 和 get 操作。 SimpleChatStore 最基本的聊天儲存區是 SimpleChatStore，它會將訊息保存在記憶體中，也可以讀寫磁碟，或序列化後存放在其他位置。 通常會建立聊天儲存區並傳入記憶體模組。若未指定聊天儲存區，使用聊天儲存區的記憶體模組預設會採用 SimpleChatStore。 建立記憶體後，可以將它用於代理程式或聊天引擎： 若要稍後繼續使用聊天儲存區，可以將它存入磁碟並在之後載入。 也可以將聊天儲存區轉換成字串，另行保存該字串，再從字串還原。 UpstashChatStore 使用 UpstashChatStore，可以透過 Upstash Redis 遠端保存聊天記錄。Upstash Redis 是無伺服器 Redis 服務，適合需要可擴充且有效率的聊天儲存應用程式。此聊天儲存區同時支援同步與非同步操作。 安裝 終端機視窗 使用方式 UpstashChatStore 同時支援同步與非同步操作。以下是使用非同步方法的範例： RedisChatStore 使用 RedisChatStore 可將聊天記錄遠端保存，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 AzureChatStore 使用 AzureChatStore 可將聊天記錄遠端保存至 Azure Table Storage 或 CosmosDB，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 DynamoDBChatStore 使用 DynamoDBChatStore 可將聊天記錄保存至 AWS DynamoDB。 安裝 終端機視窗 使用方式 請確認已建立符合需求結構的 DynamoDB 資料表。以下為預設範例： 接著可使用 DynamoDBChatStore 類別保存及擷取聊天記錄： PostgresChatStore 使用 PostgresChatStore 可將聊天記錄遠端保存，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 TablestoreChatStore 使用 TablestoreChatStore 可將聊天記錄遠端保存，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 安裝 終端機視窗 使用方式 Google AlloyDB ChatStore 使用 AlloyDBChatStore 可將聊天記錄保存至 AlloyDB，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 本教學示範同步介面；所有同步方法都有對應的非同步方法。 安裝 終端機視窗 使用方式 Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL ChatStore 使用 PostgresChatStore 可將聊天記錄保存至 Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 本教學示範同步介面；所有同步方法都有對應的非同步方法。 安裝 終端機視窗 使用方式 YugabyteDBChatStore 使用 YugabyteDBChatStore 可將聊天記錄遠端保存，無須手動持久化或載入聊天記錄。 先決條件 使用此整合前，請先準備可正常運作的 YugabyteDB 執行個體。你可以依照 YugaByteDB 快速入門指南設定本機執行個體。 安裝 終端機視窗 使用方式 連線字串參數 YugabyteDBChatStore.from uri() 接受多種參數，可用來設定與 YugabyteDB 叢集的連線。完整的支援參數清單請參閱 YugabyteDB psycopg2 驅動程式文件。 YugabyteDB 專用參數包括： - load balance：啟用或停用負載平衡（預設值：false） - topology keys：指定連線路由的偏好節點 - yb servers refresh interval：重新整理可用伺服器清單的間隔（秒） - fallback to topology keys only：是否只連線至 topology\ keys 指定的節點 - failed host ttl seconds：再次嘗試連線至失敗節點前等待的秒數
sourceText: A chat store serves as a centralized interface to store your chat history. Chat history is unique compared to other storage formats, since the order of messages is important for maintaining an overall conversation. Chat stores can organize sequences of chat messages by keys (like user ids or other unique identifiable strings), and handle delete, insert, and get operations. SimpleChatStore The most basic chat store is SimpleChatStore, which stores messages in memory and can save to/from disk, or can be serialized and stored elsewhere. Typically, you will instantiate a chat store and give it to a memory module. Memory modules that use chat stores will default to using SimpleChatStore if not provided. Once you have the memory created, you might include it in an agent or chat engine: To save the chat store for later, you can either save/load from disk Or you can convert to/from a string, saving the string somewhere else along the way UpstashChatStore Using UpstashChatStore, you can store your chat history remotely using Upstash Redis, which offers a serverless Redis solution, making it ideal for applications that require scalable and efficient chat storage. This chat store supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations. Installation Terminal window Usage UpstashChatStore supports both synchronous and asynchronous operations. Here’s an example of using async methods: RedisChatStore Using RedisChatStore, you can store your chat history remotely, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. AzureChatStore Using AzureChatStore, you can store your chat history remotely in Azure Table Storage or CosmosDB, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. DynamoDBChatStore Using DynamoDBChatStore, you can store your chat history in AWS DynamoDB. Installation Terminal window Usage Ensure you have a DynamoDB table created with the appropriate schema. By default, here is an example: You can then use the DynamoDBChatStore class to persist and retrieve chat histories: PostgresChatStore Using PostgresChatStore, you can store your chat history remotely, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. TablestoreChatStore Using TablestoreChatStore, you can store your chat history remotely, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. Installation Terminal window Usage Google AlloyDB ChatStore Using AlloyDBChatStore, you can store your chat history in AlloyDB, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. This tutorial demonstrates the synchronous interface. All synchronous methods have corresponding asynchronous methods. Installation Terminal window Usage Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL ChatStore Using PostgresChatStore, you can store your chat history in Cloud SQL for Postgres, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. This tutorial demonstrates the synchronous interface. All synchronous methods have corresponding asynchronous methods. Installation Terminal window Usage YugabyteDBChatStore Using YugabyteDBChatStore, you can store your chat history remotely, without having to worry about manually persisting and loading the chat history. Prerequisites Before using this integration, you’ll need to have a YugabyteDB instance running. You can set up a local YugabyteDB instance by following the YugaByteDB Quick Start Guide. Installation Terminal window Usage Connection String Parameters The connection string passed to YugabyteDBChatStore.from uri() supports various parameters that can be used to configure the connection to your YugabyteDB cluster. You can find a complete list of supported parameters in the YugabyteDB psycopg2 Driver Documentation. The YugabyteDB specific parameters include: - load balance: Enable/disable load balancing (default: false) - topology keys: Specify preferred nodes for connection routing - yb servers refresh interval: Interval (in seconds) to refresh the list of available servers - fallback to topology keys only: Whether to only connect to nodes specified in topology\ keys - failed host ttl seconds: Time (in seconds) to wait before trying to connect to failed nodes

text: 預設情況下，LlamaIndex 隱藏了複雜性，讓您只需少於 5 行程式碼即可查詢資料： 在底層，LlamaIndex 也支援可切換的 storage layer ，讓您可以自訂 ingested documents（即 Node 物件）、embedding vectors 和 index metadata 的儲存位置。 底層 API 為此，與高階的 API 不同， 我們使用更底層的 API，它提供了更細緻的控制權： 您只需一行更改即可自訂底層儲存，以實例化不同的 document stores、index stores 和 vector stores。請參閱 Document Stores、Vector Stores、索引儲存區 指南以了解更多詳情。 Vector Store 整合與儲存 我們大多數的 vector store 整合會將整個 index（vectors + text）儲存在 vector store 本身。這帶來了主要的優勢，即無需明確地將 index 持久化如上所示，因為 vector store 已經託管並將資料儲存在我們的 index 中。 支援此做法的 vector stores 如下： - AzureAISearchVectorStore - ChatGPTRetrievalPluginClient - CassandraVectorStore - ChromaVectorStore - EpsillaVectorStore - DocArrayHnswVectorStore - DocArrayInMemoryVectorStore - JaguarVectorStore - LanceDBVectorStore - MetalVectorStore - MilvusVectorStore - MyScaleVectorStore - OpensearchVectorStore - PineconeVectorStore - QdrantVectorStore - TablestoreVectorStore - RedisVectorStore - UpstashVectorStore - WeaviateVectorStore 以下是一個使用 Pinecone 的小範例： 如果您有一個已載入資料的現有 vector store，您可以連接到它並直接像這樣建立一個 VectorStoreIndex：
sourceText: By default, LlamaIndex hides away the complexities and let you query your data in under 5 lines of code: Under the hood, LlamaIndex also supports a swappable storage layer that allows you to customize where ingested documents (i.e., Node objects), embedding vectors, and index metadata are stored. Low-Level API To do this, instead of the high-level API, we use a lower-level API that gives more granular control: You can customize the underlying storage with a one-line change to instantiate different document stores, index stores, and vector stores. See Document Stores, Vector Stores, Index Stores guides for more details. Vector Store Integrations and Storage Most of our vector store integrations store the entire index (vectors + text) in the vector store itself. This comes with the major benefit of not having to explicitly persist the index as shown above, since the vector store is already hosted and persisting the data in our index. title: Document 儲存
text: Document stores 包含已擷取的 document chunks，我們稱之為 Node objects。 請參閱 API Reference 以獲取更多詳細資料。 簡單的 Document Store 預設情況下，SimpleDocumentStore stores 將 Node objects 儲存在記憶體中。它們可以透過呼叫 docstore.persist()（和 SimpleDocumentStore.from persist path(...)）分別存取到磁碟上（儲存和載入）。 更完整的範例可見 這裡。 MongoDB Document Store 我們支援 MongoDB 作為替代 document store backend，在擷取 Node objects 時持久化資料。 在底層，MongoDocumentStore 連接到一個固定的 MongoDB database，並為您的 nodes 初始化新的 collection（或載入現有的 collection）。 注意：您可以在實例化 MongoDocumentStore 時配置 db name 和 namespace，否則它們預設為 db name="db docstore" 和 namespace="docstore"。 請注意，在使用 MongoDocumentStore 時不需要呼叫 storage context.persist()（或 docstore.persist()），因為資料預設會持久化。 您可以重新連線到您的 MongoDB collection，並透過重新初始化一個具有現有 db name 和 collection name 的 MongoDocumentStore 來重新初始化 index。 更完整的範例可見 這裡。 Redis Document Store 我們支援 Redis 作為替代 document store backend，在擷取 Node objects 時持久化資料。 在底層，RedisDocumentStore 連接到一個 redis database，並將您的 nodes 添加到儲存在 {namespace}/docs 下的 namespace 中。 注意：您可以在實例化 RedisDocumentStore 時配置 namespace，否則它預設為 namespace="docstore"。 您可以輕鬆重新連線到您的 Redis client，並透過重新初始化一個具有現有 host、port 和 namespace 的 RedisDocumentStore 來重新初始化 index。 更完整的範例可見 這裡。 Firestore Document Store 我們支援 Firestore 作為替代 document store backend，在擷取 Node objects 時持久化資料。 在底層，FirestoreDocumentStore 連接到 Google Cloud 中的 firestore database，並將您的 nodes 添加到儲存在 {namespace}/docs 下的 namespace 中。 注意：您可以在實例化 FirestoreDocumentStore 時配置 namespace，否則它預設為 namespace="docstore"。 您可以輕鬆重新連線到您的 Firestore database，並透過重新初始化一個具有現有 project、database 和 namespace 的 FirestoreDocumentStore 來重新初始化 index。 更完整的範例可見 這裡。 Couchbase Document Store 我們支援 Couchbase 作為替代 document store backend，在擷取 Node objects 時持久化資料。 在底層，CouchbaseDocumentStore 連接到一個 Couchbase operational database，並將您的 nodes 添加到在指定 {bucket name} 和 {scope name} 下的 collection 中，該 collection 名稱為 {namespace} data。 注意：您可以在實例化 CouchbaseIndexStore 時配置 namespace、bucket 和 scope。預設使用的 collection 是 docstore data。除了字母數字字元外，-、 和 % 僅允許作為 collection 名的一部分。store 會自動將其他特殊字元轉換為 。 您可以輕鬆重新連線到您的 Couchbase database，並透過重新初始化一個具有現有 client、bucket name、scope name 和 namespace 的 CouchbaseDocumentStore 來重新初始化 index。 Tablestore Document Store 我們支援 Tablestore 作為替代 document store backend，在擷取 Node objects 時持久化資料。 Under the hood, TablestoreDocumentStore connects to a Tablestore database and adds your nodes to a table named under {namespace} data. sourceText: Document stores contain ingested document chunks, which we call Node objects. See the API Reference for more details. Simple Document Store By default, the SimpleDocumentStore stores Node objects in-memory. They can be persisted to (and loaded from) disk by calling docstore.persist() (and SimpleDocumentStore.from persist path(...) respectively). A more complete example can be found here MongoDB Document Store We support MongoDB as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. Under the hood, MongoDocumentStore connects to a fixed MongoDB database and initializes new collections (or loads existing collections) for your nodes. Note: You can configure the db name and namespace when instantiating MongoDocumentStore, otherwise they default to db name="db docstore" and namespace="docstore". Note that it’s not necessary to call storage context.persist() (or docstore.persist()) when using a MongoDocumentStore since data persists by default. You can reconnect to your MongoDB collection and reload the index by re-initializing a MongoDocumentStore with an existing db name and collection name. A more complete example can be found here Redis Document Store We support Redis as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. Under the hood, RedisDocumentStore connects to a redis database and adds your nodes to a namespace stored under {namespace}/docs. Note: You can configure the namespace when instantiating RedisDocumentStore, otherwise it defaults namespace="docstore". You can easily reconnect to your Redis client and reload the index by re-initializing a RedisDocumentStore with an existing host, port, and namespace. A more complete example can be found here Firestore Document Store We support Firestore as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. Under the hood, FirestoreDocumentStore connects to a firestore database in Google Cloud and adds your nodes to a namespace stored under {namespace}/docs. Note: You can configure the namespace when instantiating FirestoreDocumentStore, otherwise it defaults namespace="docstore". You can easily reconnect to your Firestore database and reload the index by re-initializing a FirestoreDocumentStore with an existing project, database, and namespace. A more complete example can be found here Couchbase Document Store We support Couchbase as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. Under the hood, CouchbaseDocumentStore connects to a Couchbase operational database and adds your nodes to a collection named under {namespace} data in the specified {bucket name} and {scope name}. Note: You can configure the namespace, bucket and scope when instantiating CouchbaseIndexStore. By default, the collection used is docstore data. Apart from alphanumeric characters, -, and % are only allowed as part of the collection name. The store will automatically convert other special characters to . You can easily reconnect to your Couchbase database and reload the index by re-initializing a CouchbaseDocumentStore with an existing client, bucket name, scope name and namespace. Tablestore Document Store We support Tablestore as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. Under the hood, TablestoreDocumentStore connects to a Tablestore database and adds your nodes to a table named under {namespace} data. Note: You can configure the namespace when instantiating TablestoreDocumentStore. You can easily reconnect to your Tablestore database and reload the index by re-initializing a TablestoreDocumentStore with an existing endpoint, instance name, access key id and access key secret. A more complete example can be found here Google AlloyDB Document Store We support AlloyDB as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. This tutorial demonstrates the synchronous interface. All synchronous methods have corresponding asynchronous methods. Terminal window Note: You can configure the schema name along with the table name when initializing a new table and instantiating AlloyDBDocumentStore. By default the schema name is public. Under the hood, AlloyDBDocumentStore connects to the alloydb database in Google Cloud and adds your nodes to a table under the schema name. You can easily reconnect to your AlloyDB database and reload the index by re-initializing a AlloyDBDocumentStore with an AlloyDBEngine without initializing a new table. A more detailed guide can be found here Google Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL Document Store We support Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL as an alternative document store backend that persists data as Node objects are ingested. This tutorial demonstrates the synchronous interface. All synchronous methods have corresponding asynchronous methods. Terminal window Note: You can configure the schema name along with the table name when initializing a new table and instantiating PostgresDocumentStore. By default the schema name is public. Under the hood, PostgresDocumentStore connects to the cloud sql for pg database in Google Cloud and adds your nodes to a table under the schema name. You can easily reconnect to your Postgres database and reload the index by re-initializing a PostgresDocumentStore with an PostgresEngine without initializing a new table. A more detailed guide can be found here

text: Key-Value stores 是驅動我們的 Document Stores 和 索引儲存區 的底層儲存抽象。 我們提供以下 key-value stores： - Simple Key-Value Store ：一個記憶體中的 KV store。使用者可以選擇呼叫 persist 在此 kv store 上將資料持久化到磁碟。 - MongoDB Key-Value Store ：一個 MongoDB KV store。資料在寫入時即被持久化，因此使用者無需呼叫 persist，多個程序可以共用同一個 store。支援 async 操作。 - Tablestore Key-Value Store ：一個 Tablestore KV store。 請參閱 API Reference 以獲取更多詳細資訊。 注意：目前，這些儲存抽象不對外開放。
sourceText: Key-Value stores are the underlying storage abstractions that power our Document Stores and Index Stores. We provide the following key-value stores: - Simple Key-Value Store : An in-memory KV store. The user can choose to call persist on this kv store to persist data to disk. - MongoDB Key-Value Store : A MongoDB KV store. Data is persisted as it is written, so the user doesn’t need to call persist and multiple processes can share the same store. Supports async operations. - Tablestore Key-Value Store : A Tablestore KV store. See the API Reference for more details. Note: At the moment, these storage abstractions are not externally facing.

sourceText: Persisting Data By default, LlamaIndex stores data in-memory, and this data can be explicitly persisted if desired: This will persist data to disk, under the specified persist dir (or ./storage by default). Simple Vector Store By default, LlamaIndex uses a simple in-memory vector store that’s great for quick experimentation. text: 概念 LlamaIndex 提供了一個高階介面，用於攝取、索引和查詢您的外部資料。 在底層，LlamaIndex 也支援可替換的 storage components ，讓您可以自訂： - Document stores ：已攝取的 documents（即 Node 物件）儲存的位置， - Index stores ：索引元數據儲存的位置， - Vector stores ：嵌入向量儲存的位置， - Property Graph stores ：知識圖譜儲存的位置（即針對 PropertyGraphIndex）。 - Chat Stores ：聊天訊息的儲存和組織方式。 Document/Index stores 依賴一個共同的 Key-Value store abstraction，詳見下文。 LlamaIndex 支援將資料持久化到 fsspec 支援的任何 storage backend。我們確認支援以下 storage backends： - 本地檔案系統 - AWS S3 - Cloudflare R2 使用模式 許多 vector stores（除了 FAISS）會同時儲存資料和索引（embeddings）。這意味著您不需要使用單獨的 document store 或 index store。這也意味著您不需要明確地持久化這些資料——這是自動發生的。使用方式看起來像如下，用於建立新的索引/重新載入現有的索引。 請參閱我們的 Vector Store Module Guide 以獲取更多詳細資訊。 請注意，一般要使用 storage abstractions，您需要定義一個 StorageContext 物件： 關於自訂/持久化的更多詳細資訊請參閱下方的指南。 - Customization - Save/Load 模組 我們提供關於不同 storage components 的深入指南。 - Vector Stores - Docstores - Index Stores - Key-Val Stores - Property Graph Stores - ChatStores
sourceText: Concept LlamaIndex provides a high-level interface for ingesting, indexing, and querying your external data. Under the hood, LlamaIndex also supports swappable storage components that allows you to customize: - Document stores : where ingested documents (i.e., Node objects) are stored, - Index stores : where index metadata are stored, - Vector stores : where embedding vectors are stored. - Property Graph stores : where knowledge graphs are stored (i.e. for PropertyGraphIndex). - Chat Stores : where chat messages are stored and organized. The Document/Index stores rely on a common Key-Value store abstraction, which is also detailed below. LlamaIndex supports persisting data to any storage backend supported by fsspec. We have confirmed support for the following storage backends: - Local filesystem - AWS S3 - Cloudflare R2 Usage Pattern Many vector stores (except FAISS) will store both the data as well as the index (embeddings). This means that you will not need to use a separate document store or index store. This also means that you will not need to explicitly persist this data - this happens automatically. title: 設定 Settings
text: Settings 是一個在 LlamaIndex workflow/application 的索引和查詢階段常用資源的組合。 您可以使用它來設定全域配置。本地配置（transformations、LLMs、embedding models）可以直接傳遞給使用它們的介面。 Settings 是一個簡單的 singleton 物件，它在您的整個應用程式中都存在。每當特定的元件未提供時，Settings 物件會用它來提供作為全域預設值。 以下屬性可以設定在 Settings 物件上： LLM LLM 用於回應提示和查詢，並負責撰寫自然語言回應。 Embed Model embedding model 用於將文字轉換為數值表示，用於計算相似度及 top-k retrieval。 Node Parser 文字 Splitter node parser / text splitter 用於將 documents 解析成較小的區塊，稱為 nodes。 如果您只想更改 chunk size 或 chunk overlap 而不更改預設的 splitter，也可以這樣做： Transformations Transformations 在資料攝取（ingestion）過程中應用於 Document。預設情況下使用 node parser/text splitter，但這可以被覆蓋並進一步自訂。 Tokenizer tokenizer 用於計算 tokens 的數量。這應該設定為與您使用的 LLM 相匹配的值。 Callbacks 您可以設定一個全域 callback manager，可用於觀察和消耗在 llama-index 程式碼中產生的事件。 提示詞 輔助參數 在查詢過程中會使用一些特定的參數/值，以確保輸入給 LLM 的提示有足夠的空間來生成特定數量的 tokens。 通常這些會使用 LLM 的屬性自動配置，但在特殊情況下可以被覆蓋。 提示 瞭解如何設定特定模組：- LLM - Embedding Model - Node Parser/Text Splitters - Callbacks 設定本地配置 使用 settings 特定部分的介面也可以接受本地覆蓋。
sourceText: The Settings is a bundle of commonly used resources used during the indexing and querying stage in a LlamaIndex workflow/application. You can use it to set the global configuration. Local configurations (transformations, LLMs, embedding models) can be passed directly into the interfaces that make use of them. The Settings is a simple singleton object that lives throughout your application. Whenever a particular component is not provided, the Settings object is used to provide it as a global default. The following attributes can be configured on the Settings object: LLM The LLM is used to respond to prompts and queries, and is responsible for writing natural language responses. Embed Model The embedding model is used to convert text to numerical representations, used for calculating similarity and top-k retrieval. Node Parser / Text Splitter The node parser / text splitter is used to parse documents into smaller chunks, called nodes. If you just want to change the chunk size or chunk overlap without changing the default splitter, this is also possible: Transformations Transformations are applied to Documents during ingestion. By default, the node parser/text splitter is used, but this can be overridden and customized further. Tokenizer The tokenizer is used to count tokens. This should be set to something that matches the LLM you are using. Callbacks You can set a global callback manager, which can be used to observe and consume events generated throughout the llama-index code Prompt Helper Arguments A few specific arguments/values are used during querying, to ensure that the input prompts to the LLM have enough room to generate a certain number of tokens. Typically these are automatically configured using attributes from the LLM, but they can be overridden in special cases. Tip Learn how to configure specific modules: - LLM - Embedding Model - Node Parser/Text Splitters - Callbacks Setting local configurations Interfaces that use specific parts of the settings can also accept local overrides.

title: 查詢轉換
text: LlamaIndex 讓您能針對索引結構執行 query transformations 。Query transformations 是將一個 query 轉換為另一個 query 的模組。它們可以是 單步驟 (single-step) ，即在針對索引執行 query 之前，轉換程序僅執行一次。 它們也可以是 多步驟 (multi-step) ，例如： 1. 轉換 query 並針對索引執行， 2. 取得回應。 3. 以循序方式轉換並執行後續的 query。 我們在下方詳細列出部分 query transformations。 使用場景 Query transformations 有多種使用場景： - 將初始 query 轉換為更容易進行 embedding 的形式（例如 HyDE） - 將初始 query 轉換為更容易從資料中獲得答案的子問題（單步驟 query decomposition） - 將初始 query 分解為多個可獨立回答的子問題（多步驟 query decomposition） HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings) HyDE 是一種技術，在給定自然語言 query 時，會先生成一個假設性的 document/答案。接著使用這個假設性的 document 進行 embedding 查找，而非直接使用原始 query。 若要使用 HyDE，請參考下方的程式碼範例。 請參閱我們的 範例 notebook 以獲取完整指南。 Multi-分步查詢轉換 Multi-step query transformations 是對現有單步驟 query transformation 方法的泛化。 針對一個初始的複雜 query，系統會將其轉換並針對索引執行，隨後取得回應。根據該回應（以及先前的回應）與 query，系統可能會針對索引提出後續問題。此技術允許針對單一知識源執行 query，直到該 query 滿足所有問題為止。 下方為範例圖片。 以下是對應的程式碼範例。 請參閱我們的 範例 notebook 以獲取完整指南。 - HyDE Query Transform - Multistep Query
sourceText: LlamaIndex allows you to perform query transformations over your index structures. Query transformations are modules that will convert a query into another query. They can be single-step , as in the transformation is run once before the query is executed against an index. They can also be multi-step , as in: 1. The query is transformed, executed against an index, 2. The response is retrieved. 3. Subsequent queries are transformed/executed in a sequential fashion. We list some of our query transformations in more detail below. Use Cases Query transformations have multiple use cases: - Transforming an initial query into a form that can be more easily embedded (e.g. HyDE) - Transforming an initial query into a subquestion that can be more easily answered from the data (single-step query decomposition) - Breaking an initial query into multiple subquestions that can be more easily answered on their own. (multi-step query decomposition) HyDE (Hypothetical Document Embeddings) HyDE is a technique where given a natural language query, a hypothetical document/answer is generated first. This hypothetical document is then used for embedding lookup rather than the raw query. To use HyDE, an example code snippet is shown below. Check out our example notebook for a full walkthrough. Multi-Step Query Transformations Multi-step query transformations are a generalization on top of existing single-step query transformation approaches. Given an initial, complex query, the query is transformed and executed against an index. The response is retrieved from the query. Given the response (along with prior responses) and the query, follow-up questions may be asked against the index as well. This technique allows a query to be run against a single knowledge source until that query has satisfied all questions. An example image is shown below. Here’s a corresponding example code snippet. Check out our example notebook for a full walkthrough. - HyDE Query Transform - Multistep Query

text: 您可以在現有的 LlamaIndex RAG workflow 之上建構 agents，賦予其自動化決策能力。許多模組（如 routing、query transformations 等）在本質上已具備 agentic 特性，因為它們使用 LLMs 進行決策。 較簡單的 Agentic 策略 這包括 routing 與 query transformations。 - Routing - Query Transformations - Sub Question Query Engine (Intro) Data Agents 下方的指南將向您展示如何將完整的 agent 迴圈部署在現有的 RAG query engines 之上，將其作為工具以實現更進階的決策，並使其具備 chain-of-thought 與 query planning 能力。 請務必參閱我們的 Data Agents 完整模組指南，其中詳細介紹了這些使用案例及更多內容。 我們的 低階 agent API 則向您展示 agent 的內部運作方式（包含 step-wise execution）。 以下為範例指南（使用 LLM-provider-specific function calling）： - Basic Function Agent - Function Agent with Query Engine Tools - Function Agent Retrieval - Function Agent Query Cookbook - Function Agent w/ Context Retrieval
sourceText: You can build agents on top of your existing LlamaIndex RAG workflow to empower it with automated decision capabilities. title: 基礎策略
text: 當您需要快速提升效能並優化 RAG workflow 時，有許多簡單的方法可以嘗試。 提示詞 工程設計 如果您遇到與 LLM 相關的失敗情況（例如幻覺或輸出格式不正確），這應該是您首先嘗試的優化方向。 以下列出了一些任務，由淺入深排列： 1. 嘗試檢查並自定義 RAG workflow 中使用的 prompt（例如問答 prompt）。 - Customizing Prompts - Advanced Prompts 2. 嘗試加入 prompt functions ，讓您能動態注入 few-shot 範例或處理注入的輸入內容。 - Advanced Prompts Embeddings 選擇正確的 embedding 模型對整體效能有重大影響。 - 您是否想要比 OpenAI 的 text-embedding-ada-002（為了向下相容仍為 OpenAIEmbedding 預設值）更強大或更新的模型？ - 您是否想在本地執行模型，而非呼叫託管的 API？ - 您是否需要一個針對特定語言表現良好的 embedding 模型？ 除了 OpenAI 之外，目前有許多 embedding API 選項，您也可以在本地執行自己的 embedding 模型或架設自己的伺服器。 MTEB Leaderboard 是比較目前各種模型在大量資料集與任務表現的最佳地點。在撰寫本文時，熱門的開源選擇包括： - 快速 / 小型基準 (\ 22-33M params)：sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 或 BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5。體積小、速度快，且對許多工作負載而言依然穩健。 - 中型、近期架構 (\ 150M params)：lightonai/DenseOn，於 2026 年 4 月發佈。尺寸介於小型基準與 Qwen3 系列之間，如果您想要最新的 state-of-the-art 檢索能力且不想使用 0.6B 以上的模型，值得嘗試。 - 強大全方位、多語言 (\ 0.6-4B params)：Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B（或追求更高準確度可選 -4B）。在 MTEB 上具有競爭力，且體積小到足以在單張 GPU 上提供服務。 - 方便的託管 API：OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small")。 上述所有本地/開源選項皆可透過 HuggingFaceEmbedding 使用，並可受益於 CPU 上的 ONNX / OpenVINO 加速；詳情請參閱 embeddings 指南。 注意： 與 LLM（您可以隨時更改）不同，如果您更改了 embedding 模型，則必須重新為資料建立索引。此外，您應確保索引與查詢時使用相同的 embedding 模型。 我們提供了一份 所有支援的 embedding 模型整合清單。 Chunk Sizes 根據您索引的資料類型或檢索結果，您可能需要自定義 chunk size 或 chunk overlap。 當 documents 被匯入索引時，它們會被分割成具有一定重疊量的 chunks。預設的 chunk size 為 1024，而預設的 chunk overlap 為 20。 更改其中任何一個參數都會改變計算出的 embeddings。較小的 chunk size 意味著 embeddings 更為精確，而較大的 chunk size 則意味著 embeddings 可能較為概括，但可能會遺漏細節。 我們在此提供了關於 chunk size 的初步評估。 此外，當更改向量索引的 chunk size 時，您可能也需要增加 similarity top k 參數，以更適當地代表每次查詢要檢索的資料量。 以下是一個完整範例： 由於我們將預設的 chunk size 減半，因此範例中將 similarity top k 從預設的 2 增加到 4。 Hybrid Search Hybrid search 是檢索領域的常用術語，指的是將 semantic search（即 embedding 相似度）與關鍵字搜尋的結果相結合。 Embeddings 並非完美，在檢索步驟中可能會無法回傳包含匹配關鍵字的文字 chunks。 解決此問題的方法通常是 hybrid search。在 LlamaIndex 中，有兩種主要方式可以實現：1. 使用具有 hybrid search 功能的向量資料庫（請參閱 我們的完整支援向量儲存清單）。 2. 使用 BM25 建立本地的 hybrid search 機制。 以下是包含這兩種方法的相關指南： - BM25 Retriever - Reciprocal Rerank Query Fusion - Weaviate Hybrid Search - Pinecone Hybrid Search - Milvus Hybrid Search Reranking Reranking 是提升 RAG 品質最有效的手段之一。retriever 會回傳較多數量的候選結果（similarity top k=10 個或更多），接著由 reranker（效能更強但速度較慢的模型）重新排序，使最佳的 nodes 能進入 LLM。這通常是決定「檢索結果大致正確」與「檢索結果能真正回答問題」之間的關鍵。 最簡單的實作方式是透過 SentenceTransformerRerank 使用本地的 cross-encoder；無需 API key，且可隨處執行： 若要提升多國語言內容的品質，請將模型更換為 Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B。若需要設定簡單的 hosted-API 選項，請使用 CohereRerank、JinaRerank 或 VoyageAIRerank。在延遲要求不高且追求最高品質的情況下，基於 LLM 的 reranker（LLMRerank, RankGPTRerank）效能可能優於 cross-encoders，但代價是需要額外的 LLM 呼叫。 請參閱 node postprocessors 指南 以獲取完整清單，以及 rerankers 概覽 以查看決策樹。 Metadata Filters 在將 documents 放入向量索引之前，為其附加 metadata 會非常有幫助。這些 metadata 後續可用於從 response 物件追蹤答案來源，也可以在查詢時用於執行 top-k 相似度搜尋前的資料篩選。 Metadata filters 可以手動設定，以便僅回傳具有匹配 metadata 的 nodes： 如果您使用 GPT-4 等進階 LLM，且您的 向量資料庫支援篩選，您可以透過 AutoVectorRetriever 讓 LLM 在查詢時自動撰寫 filters。 - Vector Store Guide Document/Node 使用方式 請參閱我們的詳細指南，了解如何使用 Documents/Nodes 的更多細節。 - Documents Usage - Nodes Usage - Metadata Extraction Multi-Tenancy RAG RAG 系統中的 Multi-Tenancy 對於確保資料安全性至關重要。它能讓使用者僅存取其索引的 documents，從而防止未經授權的共享並保障資料隱私。搜尋操作僅限於使用者自己的資料，以保護敏感資訊。透過 Metadata Filters，可以使用 VectorStoreIndex 和 VectorDB provider 來實現。 請參閱以下指南以獲取更多詳細資訊。 - Multi Tenancy RAG 關於如何使用 LlamaIndex 和 Qdrant 實作 Multi-Tenancy RAG 的詳細指引，請參閱 Qdrant 發佈的 部落格文章。
sourceText: There are many easy things to try, when you need to quickly squeeze out extra performance and optimize your RAG workflow. Prompt Engineering If you’re encountering failures related to the LLM, like hallucinations or poorly formatted outputs, then this should be one of the first things you try. Some tasks are listed below, from simple to advanced. 1. Try inspecting the prompts used in your RAG workflow (e.g. the question–answering prompt) and customizing it. - Customizing Prompts - Advanced Prompts 2. Try adding prompt functions , allowing you to dynamically inject few-shot examples or process the injected inputs. - Advanced Prompts Embeddings Choosing the right embedding model plays a large role in overall performance. - Maybe you want a stronger or more recent model than OpenAI’s text-embedding-ada-002 (still the OpenAIEmbedding default for backwards compatibility)? - Maybe you want to run a model locally rather than call a hosted API? - Maybe you need an embedding model that works well for a specific language? Beyond OpenAI, many options exist for embedding APIs, running your own embedding model locally, or hosting your own server. The MTEB Leaderboard is the best place to compare current models across tons of datasets and tasks. At the time of writing, popular open-source picks include: - Fast / small baseline (\ 22-33M params): sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 or BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5. Tiny, fast, still solid for many workloads. - Mid-size, recent architecture (\ 150M params): lightonai/DenseOn, released April 2026. Sits between the small baselines and the Qwen3 family in size, worth trying if you want recent state-of-the-art retrieval without going to a 0.6B+ model. - Strong all-around, multilingual (\ 0.6-4B params): Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (or -4B for higher accuracy). Competitive on MTEB, small enough to serve on a single GPU. - Frictionless hosted API: OpenAIEmbedding(model="text-embedding-3-small"). All of the local/open-source options above can be used via HuggingFaceEmbedding and benefit from ONNX / OpenVINO acceleration on CPU; see the embeddings guide for details. NOTE: Unlike an LLM (which you can change at any time), if you change your embedding model, you must re-index your data. Furthermore, you should ensure the same embedding model is used for both indexing and querying. We have a list of all supported embedding model integrations. Chunk Sizes Depending on the type of data you are indexing, or the results from your retrieval, you may want to customize the chunk size or chunk overlap. When documents are ingested into an index, they are split into chunks with a certain amount of overlap. The default chunk size is 1024, while the default chunk overlap is 20. Changing either of these parameters will change the embeddings that are calculated. A smaller chunk size means the embeddings are more precise, while a larger chunk size means that the embeddings may be more general, but can miss fine-grained details. We have done our own initial evaluation on chunk sizes here. Furthermore, when changing the chunk size for a vector index, you may also want to increase the similarity top k parameter to better represent the amount of data to retrieve for each query. Here is a full example: Since we halved the default chunk size, the example also doubles the similarity top k from the default of 2 to 4. Hybrid Search Hybrid search is a common term for retrieval that involves combining results from both semantic search (i.e. embedding similarity) and keyword search. Embeddings are not perfect, and may fail to return text chunks with matching keywords in the retrieval step. The solution to this issue is often hybrid search. In LlamaIndex, there are two main ways to achieve this: 1. Use a vector database that has a hybrid search functionality (see our complete list of supported vector stores). 2. Set up a local hybrid search mechanism with BM25. Relevant guides with both approaches can be found below: - BM25 Retriever - Reciprocal Rerank Query Fusion - Weaviate Hybrid Search - Pinecone Hybrid Search - Milvus Hybrid Search Reranking Reranking is one of the highest-leverage knobs for RAG quality. The retriever returns a wider set of candidates (similarity top k=10 or more) and a reranker (a stronger but slower model) re-orders them so the best nodes reach the LLM. It’s often the difference between “retrieval looks roughly right” and “retrieval is actually answering the question.” The frictionless recipe uses a local cross-encoder via SentenceTransformerRerank; no API key, runs anywhere: For stronger quality on multilingual content, swap the model for Qwen/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B. For a hosted-API option with minimal setup, use CohereRerank, JinaRerank, or VoyageAIRerank. For the highest quality when latency isn’t critical, an LLM-based reranker (LLMRerank, RankGPTRerank) can outperform cross-encoders at the cost of extra LLM calls. See the node postprocessors guide for the full list and the rerankers overview for a decision tree. Metadata Filters Before throwing your documents into a vector index, it can be useful to attach metadata to them. While this metadata can be used later on to help track the sources to answers from the response object, it can also be used at query time to filter data before performing the top-k similarity search. Metadata filters can be set manually, so that only nodes with the matching metadata are returned: If you are using an advanced LLM like GPT-4, and your vector database supports filtering, you can get the LLM to write filters automatically at query time, using an AutoVectorRetriever. - Vector Store Guide Document/Node Usage Take a look at our in-depth guides for more details on how to use Documents/Nodes. - Documents Usage - Nodes Usage - Metadata Extraction Multi-Tenancy RAG Multi-Tenancy in RAG systems is crucial for ensuring data security. It enables users to access exclusively their indexed documents, thereby preventing unauthorized sharing and safeguarding data privacy. Search operations are confined to the user’s own data, protecting sensitive information. Implementation can be achieved with VectorStoreIndex and VectorDB providers through Metadata Filters. Refer the guides below for more details. - Multi Tenancy RAG For detailed guidance on implementing Multi-Tenancy RAG with LlamaIndex and Qdrant, refer to the blog post released by Qdrant.

title: 從零開始建構 RAG (底層)
text: 本文件是一個指南，旨在展示如何僅使用低階抽象（例如 LLMs、prompts、embedding models），而不使用更「封裝」的現成抽象，來建構基於 RAG 與 agent 的應用程式。 現成的抽象包括： - 高階 ingestion 程式碼，例如 VectorStoreIndex.from documents - 高階 query 與 retriever 程式碼，例如 VectorStoreIndex.as retriever() 與 VectorStoreIndex.as query engine() - 高階 agent 抽象，例如 FunctionAgent、ReActAgent、CodeActAgent 本文件的目標並非使用這些功能，而是讓使用者了解底層的運作原理。透過向您展示建構 RAG 與 agent workflows 的底層演算法，您將能建立自定義的 LLM workflows（同時仍可在任何合理的粒度層級使用 LlamaIndex 抽象）。 我們將展示如何從零開始逐步建構應用程式的各個元件。為了集中討論，每個教學將展示如何從零建構特定元件，而其他元件則使用現成的抽象。 注意 ：這是一個開發中的 document，我們目前正在完善內容！ 從零建構 Ingestion 本教學將展示如何定義將資料導入向量資料庫的 ingestion pipeline。 - 從零開始的 Ingestion 從零建構 Vector Retrieval 本教學將展示如何建構一個用於查詢向量資料庫的 retriever。 - 從零開始的 Vector Retrieval 從零建構 Ingestion/Retrieval（開源/本地元件） 本教學將展示如何僅使用開源元件來建構 ingestion/retrieval pipeline。 - 開源 RAG 從零建構（極簡）向量資料庫 如果您想深入了解向量資料庫的運作方式，本教學將展示如何建構一個支援 dense search 與 metadata filtering 的極簡向量資料庫。 顯然，這不能取代正式環境的資料庫。 - 從零開始的 Vector Store 從零建構 Response Synthesis 本教學將展示如何使用 LLM，根據一組檢索到的 context 來合成結果。內容涵蓋 context overflow、async calls 以及來源引用！ - 從零開始的 Response Synthesis 從零建構 Evaluation 學習如何使用 LLMs 與 prompt 模組來建構常見的基於 LLM 的 eval 模組（如 correctness、faithfulness）；這將幫助您定義自定義的 evals！ - 從零開始的 Evaluation 從零建構進階 RAG 這些教學將展示如何建構超出基本 RAG workflow 的進階功能。對於有自定義 workflows 或正式環境需求的進階使用者尤其有用。 從零建構 Hybrid Search Hybrid search 是許多向量資料庫支援的進階檢索功能。它允許您將 dense 檢索與匹配關鍵字的 sparse 檢索相結合。 - 從零建構 Hybrid Search 從零建構 Router 除了標準的 RAG workflow 之外，本教學將透過展示如何從零建構 router 模組，帶您向使用 LLMs 實現自動化決策邁進一步。 - 從零開始的 Router 從零建構 RAG Fusion Retriever 在此我們將展示如何建構一個支援 query-rewriting、ensembling 與動態檢索的進階 retriever。 - 從零開始的 Fusion Retrieval 從零建構結構化資料的 QA RAG 作為一個框架，主要聚焦於非結構化資料。但 LlamaIndex 同樣也對結構化資料與半結構化資料提供現成支援。 請參閱以下指南，了解如何從零建構 text-to-SQL（使用我們的 Workflows 函式庫）。 - 從零開始的 Text-to-SQL
sourceText: This doc is a hub for showing how you can build RAG and agent-based apps using only lower-level abstractions (e.g. LLMs, prompts, embedding models), and without using more “packaged” out of the box abstractions. Out of the box abstractions include: - High-level ingestion code e.g. VectorStoreIndex.from documents - High-level query and retriever code e.g. VectorStoreIndex.as retriever() and VectorStoreIndex.as query engine() - High-level agent abstractions e.g. FunctionAgent, ReActAgent, CodeActAgent Instead of using these, the goal here is to educate users on what’s going on under the hood. By showing you the underlying algorithms for constructing RAG and agent workflows, you can then be empowered to create your own custom LLM workflows (while still using LlamaIndex abstractions at any level of granularity that makes sense). We show how to build an app from scratch, component by component. For the sake of focus, each tutorial will show how to build a specific component from scratch while using out-of-the-box abstractions for other components. NOTE : This is a WIP document, we’re in the process of fleshing this out! Building Ingestion from Scratch This tutorial shows how you can define an ingestion pipeline into a vector store. - Ingestion from scratch Building Vector Retrieval from Scratch This tutorial shows you how to build a retriever to query a vector store. - Vector Retrieval from Scratch Building Ingestion/Retrieval from Scratch (Open-Source/Local Components) This tutorial shows you how to build an ingestion/retrieval pipeline using only open-source components. - Open Source RAG Building a (Very Simple) Vector Store from Scratch If you want to learn more about how vector stores work, here’s a tutorial showing you how to build a very simple vector store capable of dense search + metadata filtering. Obviously not a replacement for production databases. - Vector Store from Scratch Building Response Synthesis from Scratch This tutorial shows you how to use the LLM to synthesize results given a set of retrieved context. Deals with context overflows, async calls, and source citations! - Response Synthesis from Scratch Building Evaluation from Scratch Learn how to build common LLM-based eval modules (correctness, faithfulness) using LLMs and prompt modules; this will help you define your own custom evals! - Evaluation from Scratch Building Advanced RAG from Scratch These tutorials will show you how to build advanced functionality beyond the basic RAG workflow. Especially helpful for advanced users with custom workflows / production needs. Building Hybrid Search from Scratch Hybrid search is an advanced retrieval feature supported by many vector databases. It allows you to combine dense retrieval with sparse retrieval with matching keywords. - Building Hybrid Search from Scratch Building a Router from Scratch Beyond the standard RAG workflow, this takes you one step towards automated decision making with LLMs by showing you how to build a router module from scratch. - Router from Scratch Building RAG Fusion Retriever from Scratch Here we show you how to build an advanced retriever capable of query-rewriting, ensembling, dynamic retrieval. - Fusion Retrieval from Scratch Building QA over Structured Data from Scratch RAG as a framework is primarily focused on unstructured data. LlamaIndex also has out of the box support for structured data and semi-structured data as well. Take a look at our guides below to see how to build text-to-SQL from scratch (using our Workflows library). - Text-to-SQL from Scratch

text: LlamaIndex 的核心設計原則是 幾乎所有核心模組都可以透過 subclassing 進行自定義 。 這讓您能將 LlamaIndex 應用於任何進階的 LLM 使用情境，突破預設模組的功能限制。您可以針對特定模組編寫任意 amount 的自定義程式碼，同時仍能利用底層的 abstraction 並將該模組與其他元件整合。 我們提供了便捷且有引導的 subclassing 方式，讓您在撰寫自定義邏輯時，不必擔心定義所有 boilerplate（例如 callbacks）。 本指南彙整了在 LlamaIndex 中編寫自定義模組的所有資源，請參閱下方內容 👇 Custom LLMs - Custom LLMs 自訂 Embeddings - Custom Embedding Model 自訂輸出解析器 - Custom Output Parsers 自訂轉換 - Custom Transformations - Custom Property Graph Extractors 自訂 Retriever - Custom Retrievers - Custom Property Graph Retrievers 自訂後處理器/Rerankers - Custom Node Postprocessor Custom Query Engines - Custom Query Engine Custom Agents - Custom Function Calling Agent - Custom ReAct Agent 其他 Customization 方式 部分模組可以在 workflows 中進行深度自定義，但並非透過 subclassing（而是透過我們提供的參數或 function）。相關說明請參閱以下指南： - Customizing Documents - Customizing Nodes - Customizing Prompts within Higher-Level Modules
sourceText: A core design principle of LlamaIndex is that almost every core module can be subclassed and customized . This allows you to use LlamaIndex for any advanced LLM use case, beyond the capabilities offered by our prepackaged modules. You’re free to write as much custom code for any given module, but still take advantage of our lower-level abstractions and also plug this module along with other components. We offer convenient/guided ways to subclass our modules, letting you write your custom logic without having to worry about having to define all boilerplate (for instance, callbacks). This guide centralizes all the resources around writing custom modules in LlamaIndex. Check them out below 👇 Custom LLMs - Custom LLMs Custom Embeddings - Custom Embedding Model Custom Output Parsers - Custom Output Parsers Custom Transformations - Custom Transformations - Custom Property Graph Extractors Custom Retrievers - Custom Retrievers - Custom Property Graph Retrievers Custom Postprocessors/Rerankers - Custom Node Postprocessor Custom Query Engines - Custom Query Engine Custom Agents - Custom Function Calling Agent - Custom ReAct Agent Other Ways of Customization Some modules can be customized heavily within your workflows but not through subclassing (and instead through parameters or functions we expose). We list these in guides below: - Customizing Documents - Customizing Nodes - Customizing Prompts within Higher-Level Modules

title: 元件級評估
text: 若要對您的 workflow 進行更深入的評估，將其拆解為各個元件的評估會很有幫助。 例如，某個特定的失敗案例可能是由於未能檢索到正確的 documents，且 LLM 誤解了上下文並產生幻覺而導致錯誤結果。能夠將這些問題分開隔離並處理，有助於降低複雜度，並引導您逐步達成更令人滿意的整體結果。 利用公開基準測試 在進行初步的模型選擇時，觀察模型在標準化且多元的領域或任務中的表現會很有幫助。 對於 embeddings，一個有用的基準測試是 MTEB Leaderboard。 評估 Retrieval BEIR 資料集 BEIR 可用於基準測試特定的 retrieval 模型在 zero-shot 設定下，對分眾領域（niche domains）的泛化能力是否良好。 由於大多數公開的 embedding 和 retrieval 模型都已經針對 BEIR 進行過基準測試（例如透過 MTEB benchmark），因此當您有想要評估的獨特模型時，使用 BEIR 會更有幫助。 例如，在您的資料集上 fine-tuning embedding 模型後，觀察其在多元領域中的性能是否下降以及下降幅度，會很有幫助。這可以指示 data drift 對 retrieval 準確度的影響程度，例如當您在 fine-tuning 訓練分佈之外，將 documents 新增到您的 RAG 系統中時。 這裡有一個 notebook 示範如何將 BEIR 資料集應用於您的 retrieval 流程。 - BEIR Evaluation 我們很快會增加更多評估 retrieval 的方法，包括在您自己的資料集上評估 retrieval。 評估 Query Engine 元件（例如：不含 Retrieval） 在這種情況下，我們可能想要評估 query engine 的特定元件（例如可產生子問題或後續問題的元件）在標準基準測試中的表現。這有助於指示您的 retrieval 流程與其他流程或模型相比，領先或落後多少。 HotpotQA 資料集 HotpotQA 資料集可用於評估需要多個 retrieval 步驟的查詢。 範例： - HotpotQA Eval 限制： 1. HotpotQA 是在 Wikipedia 語料庫上進行評估。LLMs（尤其是 GPT4）傾向於能較好地記憶 Wikipedia 的資訊。因此，對於使用像 GPT4 這樣具備豐富知識的模型，此基準測試並不特別適合用來評估 retrieval + rerank 系統。
sourceText: To do more in-depth evaluation of your workflow, it helps to break it down into an evaluation of individual components. For instance, a particular failure case may be due to a combination of not retrieving the right documents and also the LLM misunderstanding the context and hallucinating an incorrect result. Being able to isolate and deal with these issues separately can help reduce complexity and guide you in a step-by-step manner to a more satisfactory overall result. Utilizing public benchmarks When doing initial model selection, it helps to look at how well the model is performing on a standardized, diverse set of domains or tasks. A useful benchmark for embeddings is the MTEB Leaderboard. Evaluating Retrieval BEIR dataset BEIR is useful for benchmarking if a particular retrieval model generalize well to niche domains in a zero-shot setting. Since most publicly-available embedding and retrieval models are already benchmarked against BEIR (e.g. through the MTEB benchmark), utilizing BEIR is more helpful when you have a unique model that you want to evaluate. For instance, after fine-tuning an embedding model on your dataset, it may be helpful to view whether and by how much its performance degrades on a diverse set of domains. This can be an indication of how much data drift may affect your retrieval accuracy, such as if you add documents to your RAG system outside of your fine-tuning training distribution. Here is a notebook showing how the BEIR dataset can be used with your retrieval flow. - BEIR Evaluation We will be adding more methods to evaluate retrieval soon. This includes evaluating retrieval on your own dataset. Evaluating the Query Engine Components (e.g. Without Retrieval) In this case, we may want to evaluate how specific components of a query engine (one which may generate sub-questions or follow-up questions) may perform on a standard benchmark. It can help give an indication of how far behind or ahead your retrieval flow is compared to alternate flows or models. HotpotQA Dataset The HotpotQA dataset is useful for evaluating queries that require multiple retrieval steps. Example: - HotpotQA Eval Limitations: 1. HotpotQA is evaluated on a Wikipedia corpus. LLMs, especially GPT4, tend to have memorized information from Wikipedia relatively well. Hence, the benchmark is not particularly good for evaluating retrieval + rerank systems with knowledgeable models like GPT4.
