title: 聊天機器人
text: 聊天機器人是 LLMs 的另一個極受歡迎的應用場景。與單次問答不同，聊天機器人可以處理多輪的問答，進行澄清或回答後續問題。 LlamaIndex 提供了建構知識增強型聊天機器人的工具，以及 agents。此應用場景建立在 Q\&A 應用場景之上，請務必先查看它！ 資源 您想查看的中心模組指南是我們的 聊天引擎。 以下是一些可用的額外相關資源，用於建構全端聊天機器人應用程式： - 建立聊天機器人 教學 - 本地入門教學：在完全本地堆疊上建構聊天機器人，沒有 hosted-API 依賴。 - create-llama，一個用於為您生成全端聊天機器人應用程式的命令列工具 - SECinsights.ai，一個使用 LlamaIndex 來建構回答關於 SEC 文件的問題的聊天機器人 的開源應用程式 - RAGs，一個受 OpenAI 的 GPTs 啟發的專案，讓您使用 Streamlit 在您的資料上建構低程式碼聊天機器人 - 我們的 OpenAI agents 都是聊天機器人性質的 外部來源 - Building 聊天機器人，使用 Streamlit - Building 聊天機器人，使用 CopilotKit
sourceText: Chatbots are another extremely popular use case for LLMs. Instead of single-shot question-answering, a chatbot can handle multiple back-and-forth queries and answers, getting clarification or answering follow-up questions. LlamaIndex gives you the tools to build knowledge-augmented chatbots and agents. This use case builds upon the Q\&A use case, make sure to check that out first! Resources The central module guide you’ll want to check out is our Chat Engines. Here are some additional relevant resources to build full-stack chatbot apps: - Building a chatbot tutorial - Local starter tutorial: build a chatbot on top of a fully local stack with no hosted-API dependency. - create-llama, a command line tool that generates a full-stack chatbot application for you - SECinsights.ai, an open-source application that uses LlamaIndex to build a chatbot that answers questions about SEC filings - RAGs, a project inspired by OpenAI’s GPTs that lets you build a low-code chatbot over your data using Streamlit - Our OpenAI agents are all chat bots in nature External sources - Building a chatbot with Streamlit - Building a chatbot with CopilotKit

title: 結構化資料擷取
text: LLMs 能夠擷取大量非結構化資料並以結構化格式回傳，而 LlamaIndex 則會讓這變得容易。 使用 LlamaIndex，您可以取得一個 LLM 來讀取自然語言並識別語義上重要的細節，例如姓名、日期、地址和數字，並以一致的結構化格式回傳，無論來源格式為何。 這在您有聊天記錄和對話文字記錄等非結構化來源資料時尤其有用。 一旦您取得結構化資料，可以將其傳送給 database，或者在程式碼中解析結構化輸出以自動化 workflows。 完整教學 我們的 Learn 區有 structured data extraction 的完整教學。我們建議從那裡開始。 還有一個 範例 notebook 來說明教學中一些技術。 其他指南 如需更全面的了解使用 LlamaIndex 進行結構化資料擷取，包括較底層的 modules，請查看以下指南： - Structured Outputs - Pydantic Programs - Output Parsing 我們也有多模態結構化資料擷取。 查看。 雜項範例 一些強調使用案例的額外範例： - 從人物描述中擷取姓名和地點 - 從音樂評論中擷取專輯資料 - 從電子郵件中擷取資訊
sourceText: LLMs are capable of ingesting large amounts of unstructured data and returning it in structured formats, and LlamaIndex is set up to make this easy. Using LlamaIndex, you can get an LLM to read natural language and identify semantically important details such as names, dates, addresses, and figures, and return them in a consistent structured format regardless of the source format. This can be especially useful when you have unstructured source material like chat logs and conversation transcripts. Once you have structured data you can send them to a database, or you can parse structured outputs in code to automate workflows. Full tutorial Our Learn section has a full tutorial on structured data extraction. We recommend starting out there. There is also an example notebook demonstrating some of the techniques from the tutorial. Other Guides For a more comprehensive overview of structured data extraction with LlamaIndex, including lower-level modules, check out the following guides: - Structured Outputs - Pydantic Programs - Output Parsing We also have multi-modal structured data extraction. Check it out. Miscellaneous Examples Some additional examples highlighting use cases: - Extracting names and locations from descriptions of people - Extracting album data from music reviews - Extracting information from emails

title: 微調
text: 概觀 對模型進行 finetuning 意味著使用一組資料來更新模型本身，從而從多方面改善模型。這可以包括提升輸出的品質、減少幻覺、整體記憶更多資料，以及降低延遲/成本。 我們的工具包的核心圍繞在 in-context learning / retrieval augmentation，這涉及在 inference 模式下使用模型，而不是訓練模型本身。 雖然 finetuning 也可用於用外部資料來「增強」模型，但 finetuning 可以以多種方式補充 retrieval augmentation： Embedding Finetuning 的優點 - 對 embedding model 進行 finetuning 可以讓在訓練資料分佈上獲得更有意義的 embedding 表示 — 帶來更好的 retrieval performance。 LLM Finetuning 的優點 - 讓模型學習特定資料集中的風格 - 讓模型學習在訓練資料中可能較少出現的 DSL（例如 SQL） - 讓模型修正可能難以透過 prompt engineering 修正的幻覺/錯誤 - 讓模型將一個更好的模型（例如 GPT-4）蒸餾成一個更簡單/更便宜的模型（例如 gpt-3.5, Llama 2） 與 LlamaIndex 的整合 這是一份不斷演進的指南，目前與 LlamaIndex 有三個主要的整合。請查看以下部分以獲取更多詳細資訊！ - 為提升 retrieval performance 而對 embeddings 進行 finetuning - 為提升 text-to-SQL 而對 Llama 2 進行 finetuning - 為蒸餾 gpt-4 而對 gpt-3.5-turbo 進行 finetuning Embedding 的 Finetuning 我們創建了全面的指南，向您展示如何以不同方式對 embeddings 進行 finetune，無論是針對模型本身（在本例中是 bge）在非結構化文本語料庫上進行，還是針對任何 black-box embedding 進行 adapter 的 finetuning。它包含以下步驟： 1. 使用 LlamaIndex 在任何非結構化上下文上生成合成問題/答案 dataset。 2. 對模型進行 finetuning。 3. 評估模型。 Finetuning 可以讓 retrieval evaluation metrics 提升 5-10%。然後您可以將這個 finetuned 模型與 LlamaIndex 一起，插入到您的 RAG application 中。 - Fine-tuning an Adapter - Embedding Fine-tuning Guide - Router Fine-tuning 舊版 - Embedding Fine-tuning Repo - Embedding Fine-tuning Blog LLMs 的 Finetuning 將 GPT-3.5 進行 Finetuning 以蒸餾 GPT-4 我們有多個指南展示如何使用 OpenAI 的 finetuning endpoints 來對 gpt-3.5-turbo 進行 finetune，以輸出 RAG/agents 的 GPT-4 回應。 我們使用 GPT-4 自動從任何非結構化上下文生成問題，並使用一個 GPT-4 query engine flow 來生成「ground-truth」答案。我們的 OpenAIFineTuningHandler callback 會自動將問題/答案記錄到 dataset 中。 然後我們啟動一個 finetuning job，並獲得一個蒸餾模型。我們可以利用 Ragas 來評估這個模型，以與一個簡單的 GPT-3.5 flow 進行基準比較。 - GPT-3.5 微調 Notebook（Colab） - GPT-3.5 微調 Notebook（Notebook 連結） - [\[WIP\] Function Calling 微調](https://developers.llamaindex.ai/python/examples/finetuning/openai fine tuning functions/index.md) 舊版 - GPT-3.5 微調 Notebook（Colab） - GPT-3.5 微調 Notebook（Repo） 為更好的結構化輸出進行 Finetuning Finetuning 的另一個用途是讓模型更擅長輸出結構化資料。這對 OpenAI 和 Llama2 都可以做到。 - OpenAI Function Calling 微調 為更好的 Text-to-SQL 進行 Llama 2 的 Finetuning 在這個教學中，我們向您展示如何對 Llama 2 在 text-to-SQL dataset 上進行 finetune，然後使用它透過 LlamaIndex 的 abstractions 對任何 SQL database 進行結構化分析。 此堆疊包括 sql-create-context 作為訓練 dataset、OpenLLaMa 作為 base model、PEFT 用於 finetuning、Modal 用於雲端運算、LlamaIndex 用於 inference abstractions。- Llama 2 文字轉SQL Fine-tuning (w/ Modal，Repo) - Llama 2 Text-to-SQL 微調（Modal、Notebook） 微調 Evaluator 在這些教學中，我們的目標是將一個 GPT-4 judge（或 evaluator）蒸餾到一個 GPT-3.5 judge 上。最近觀察到，GPT-4 judge 可以與人類 evaluator 達到很高的一致性（例如，請參閱 ）。 因此，透過微調一個 GPT-3.5 judge，我們或許可以在較低的成本下達到 GPT-4 的水準（以及間接的與人類的一致性）。 - Fine-tune LLM Correctness Judge - Fine-tune LLM Judge 微調 Cross-Encoders 以進行 Re-Ranking 透過微調 cross encoder，我們可以嘗試在我們自己的私有資料上提升 re-ranking 的表現。 Re-ranking 是進階檢索中的關鍵步驟，其中從多個來源檢索到的 nodes 會使用一個獨立的模型進行重新排序，以確保最相關的 nodes 排在最前面。 在這個範例中，我們使用 sentence-transformers package 來幫助微調 crossencoder 模型，並使用基於 QASPER dataset 生成的資料集。 - Cross-Encoder Finetuning - Finetuning Llama 2 用於 Text-to-SQL - Finetuning GPT-3.5 至 Distill GPT-4 Cohere 自訂 Reranker 透過使用 CohereAI 訓練一個自訂 reranker，我們可以嘗試在我們自己的私有資料上提升 re-ranking 的表現。 Re-ranking 是進階檢索流程中的關鍵步驟。此步驟涉及使用一個獨立的模型來重新組織初始檢索階段檢索到的 nodes。目標是確保最相關的 nodes 獲得優先權並排在最前面。 在這個範例中，我們使用 cohere custom reranker training module，在您的領域或特定 dataset 上建立一個 reranker 以提升檢索表現。 - Cohere Custom Reranker
sourceText: Overview Finetuning a model means updating the model itself over a set of data to improve the model in a variety of ways. This can include improving the quality of outputs, reducing hallucinations, memorizing more data holistically, and reducing latency/cost. The core of our toolkit revolves around in-context learning / retrieval augmentation, which involves using the models in inference mode and not training the models themselves. While finetuning can be also used to “augment” a model with external data, finetuning can complement retrieval augmentation in a variety of ways: Embedding Finetuning Benefits - Finetuning the embedding model can allow for more meaningful embedding representations over a training distribution of data — leads to better retrieval performance. LLM Finetuning Benefits - Allow it to learn a style over a given dataset - Allow it to learn a DSL that might be less represented in the training data (e.g. SQL) - Allow it to correct hallucinations/errors that might be hard to fix through prompt engineering - Allow it to distill a better model (e.g. GPT-4) into a simpler/cheaper model (e.g. gpt-3.5, Llama 2) Integrations with LlamaIndex This is an evolving guide, and there are currently three key integrations with LlamaIndex. Please check out the sections below for more details! - Finetuning embeddings for better retrieval performance - Finetuning Llama 2 for better text-to-SQL - Finetuning gpt-3.5-turbo to distill gpt-4 Finetuning Embeddings We’ve created comprehensive guides showing you how to finetune embeddings in different ways, whether that’s the model itself (in this case, bge) over an unstructured text corpus, or an adapter over any black-box embedding. It consists of the following steps: 1. Generating a synthetic question/answer dataset using LlamaIndex over any unstructured context. 2. Finetuning the model 3. Evaluating the model. Finetuning gives you a 5-10% increase in retrieval evaluation metrics. You can then plug this fine-tuned model into your RAG application with LlamaIndex. - Fine-tuning an Adapter - Embedding Fine-tuning Guide - Router Fine-tuning Old - Embedding Fine-tuning Repo - Embedding Fine-tuning Blog Fine-tuning LLMs Fine-tuning GPT-3.5 to distill GPT-4 We have multiple guides showing how to use OpenAI’s finetuning endpoints to fine-tune gpt-3.5-turbo to output GPT-4 responses for RAG/agents. We use GPT-4 to automatically generate questions from any unstructured context, and use a GPT-4 query engine flow to generate “ground-truth” answers. Our OpenAIFineTuningHandler callback automatically logs questions/answers to a dataset. We then launch a finetuning job, and get back a distilled model. We can evaluate this model with Ragas to benchmark against a naive GPT-3.5 flow. - GPT-3.5 Fine-tuning Notebook (Colab) - GPT-3.5 Fine-tuning Notebook (Notebook link) - [\[WIP\] Function Calling Fine-tuning](/python/examples/finetuning/openai fine tuning functions/index.md) Old - GPT-3.5 Fine-tuning Notebook (Colab) - GPT-3.5 Fine-tuning Notebook (in Repo) Fine-tuning for Better Structured Outputs Another use case for fine-tuning is to make the model better at outputting structured data. We can do this for both OpenAI and Llama2. - OpenAI Function Calling Fine-tuning Fine-tuning Llama 2 for Better Text-to-SQL In this tutorial, we show you how you can finetune Llama 2 on a text-to-SQL dataset, and then use it for structured analytics against any SQL database using LlamaIndex abstractions. The stack includes sql-create-context as the training dataset, OpenLLaMa as the base model, PEFT for finetuning, Modal for cloud compute, LlamaIndex for inference abstractions. - Llama 2 Text-to-SQL Fine-tuning (w/ Modal, Repo) - Llama 2 Text-to-SQL Fine-tuning (w/ Modal, Notebook) Fine-tuning An Evaluator In these tutorials, we aim to distill a GPT-4 judge (or evaluator) onto a GPT-3.5 judge. It has been recently observed that GPT-4 judges can reach high levels of agreement with human evaluators (e.g., see ). Thus, by fine-tuning a GPT-3.5 judge, we may be able to reach GPT-4 levels (and by proxy, agreement with humans) at a lower cost. - Fine-tune LLM Correctness Judge - Fine-tune LLM Judge Fine-tuning Cross-Encoders for Re-Ranking By finetuning a cross encoder, we can attempt to improve re-ranking performance on our own private data. Re-ranking is key step in advanced retrieval, where retrieved nodes from many sources are re-ranked using a separate model, so that the most relevant nodes are first. In this example, we use the sentence-transformers package to help finetune a crossencoder model, using a dataset that is generated based on the QASPER dataset. - Cross-Encoder Finetuning - Finetuning Llama 2 for Text-to-SQL - Finetuning GPT-3.5 to Distill GPT-4 Cohere Custom Reranker By training a custom reranker with CohereAI, we can attempt to improve re-ranking performance on our own private data. Re-ranking is a crucial step in advanced retrieval processes. This step involves using a separate model to re-organize nodes retrieved from initial retrieval phase. The goal is to ensure that the most relevant nodes are prioritized and appear first. In this example, we use the cohere custom reranker training module to create a reranker on your domain or specific dataset to improve retrieval performance. - Cohere Custom Reranker

sourceText: LlamaIndex offers capabilities to not only build language-based applications but also multi-modal applications - combining language and images. Types of Multi-modal Use Cases This space is actively being explored right now, but some fascinating use cases are popping up. RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) All the core RAG concepts: indexing, retrieval, and synthesis, can be extended into the image setting. - The input could be text or image. - The stored knowledge base can consist of text or images. - The inputs to response generation can be text or image. - The final response can be text or image. Check out our guides below: - GPT-4V Multi Modal - Multi-modal retrieval with CLIP - Image to Image Retrieval - Structured Image Retrieval - Chroma Multi-Modal - Gemini Multi-Modal Structured Outputs You can generate a structured output with the new OpenAI GPT4V via LlamaIndex. The user just needs to specify a Pydantic object to define the structure of the output. Check out the guide below: - Multi-Modal Pydantic Program Retrieval-Augmented Image Captioning Oftentimes understanding an image requires looking up information from a knowledge base. A flow here is retrieval-augmented image captioning - first caption the image with a multi-modal model, then refine the caption by retrieving it from a text corpus. Check out our guides below: - Llava + Testla 10Q Agents Here are some initial works demonstrating agentic capabilities with GPT-4V. - Multi-Modal Agents - GPT-4V Experiments Evaluations and Comparisons These sections show comparisons between different multi-modal models for different use cases. LLaVa-13, Fuyu-8B, and MiniGPT-4 Multi-Modal LLM Models Comparison for Image Reasoning These notebooks show how to use different Multi-Modal LLM models for image understanding/reasoning. The various model inferences are supported by Replicate or OpenAI GPT4-V API. We compared several popular Multi-Modal LLMs: - GPT4-V (OpenAI API) - LLava-13B (Replicate) - Fuyu-8B (Replicate) - MiniGPT-4 (Replicate) - CogVLM (Replicate) Check out our guides below: - Replicate Multi-Modal - GPT4-V Simple Evaluation of Multi-Modal RAG In this notebook guide, we’ll demonstrate how to evaluate a Multi-Modal RAG system. As in the text-only case, we will consider the evaluation of Retrievers and Generators separately. As we alluded to in our blog on the topic of Evaluating Multi-Modal RAGs, our approach here involves the application of adapted versions of the usual techniques for evaluating both Retriever and Generator (used for the text-only case). These adapted versions are part of the llama-index library (i.e., evaluation module), and this notebook will walk you through how you can apply them to your evaluation use cases. - Multi-Modal RAG Evaluation Model Guides Here are notebook guides showing you how to interact with different multimodal model providers. - OpenAI Multi-Modal - Replicate Multi-Modal

title: 提示
text: Prompting LLMs 是任何 LLM 應用程式的基本單元。您可以完全圍繞 prompting 建構一個應用程式，或與其他模組（例如 retrieval）協調，以建構 RAG、agents 等。 LlamaIndex 支援 LLM 抽象和從簡單到進階的 prompt 抽象，以使複雜的 prompt workflows 成為可能。 LLM 整合 LlamaIndex 支援 40 多種 LLM 整合，從像 OpenAI、Anthropic 這樣的專有模型提供者，到 Mistral、Ollama、Replicate 等開源模型/模型提供者。它提供了所有工具，以標準化圍繞常見 LLM 使用模式的介面，包括但不限於 async、streaming、function calling。 請參閱 LLMs 的完整模組指南。 Prompts LlamaIndex 具有強大的 prompt 抽象，可以捕捉與 LLMs 的所有常見互動模式。 請參閱 prompt 的完整模組指南。 基本要求 (Table Stakes) - Text Completion Prompts - Chat Prompts 進階 (Advanced) - Variable Mappings, Functions, Partials - RichPromptTemplate Features Prompt Chains 和 Pipelines LlamaIndex 具有強大的抽象，用於建立連續的 prompt chains，以及通用的 DAGs 來與任何其他組件協調 prompts。這讓您可以建構複雜的 workflows，包括具有多跳查詢理解層的 RAG，以及 agents。 這些 pipelines 與 observability partners 原生整合。
sourceText: Prompting LLMs is a fundamental unit of any LLM application. You can build an entire application entirely around prompting, or orchestrate with other modules (e.g. retrieval) to build RAG, agents, and more. LlamaIndex supports LLM abstractions and simple-to-advanced prompt abstractions to make complex prompt workflows possible. LLM Integrations LlamaIndex supports 40+ LLM integrations, from proprietary model providers like OpenAI, Anthropic to open-source models/model providers like Mistral, Ollama, Replicate. It provides all the tools to standardize interface around common LLM usage patterns, including but not limited to async, streaming, function calling. Here’s the full module guide for LLMs. Prompts LlamaIndex has robust prompt abstractions that capture all the common interaction patterns with LLMs. Here’s the full module guide for prompts. Table Stakes - Text Completion Prompts - Chat Prompts Advanced - Variable Mappings, Functions, Partials - RichPromptTemplate Features Prompt Chains and Pipelines LlamaIndex has robust abstractions for creating sequential prompt chains, as well as general DAGs to orchestrate prompts with any other component. This allows you to build complex workflows, including RAG with multi-hop query understanding layers, as well as agents. These pipelines are integrated with observability partners out of the box.

title: 問答 (RAG)
text: LLMs 最常見的用例之一是針對一組資料回答問題。這些資料通常是以非結構化的 documents 形式存在（例如 PDF、HTML），但也可能是半結構化或結構化的。 啟用 LLMs 的主要框架是檢索增強生成 (Retrieval Augmented Generation, RAG)。LlamaIndex 提供從簡單到進階的 RAG 技術，用於處理不同量和類型的資料上的簡單到進階問題。您可以選擇使用我們預建的 RAG 抽象層（例如 query engines）或建立自訂的 RAG workflows（範例 guide）。 在非結構化 Documents 上進行 RAG LlamaIndex 可以擷取非結構化文本、PDF、Notion 和 Slack documents 等資料並在其中建立索引。 最簡單的查詢涉及語義搜尋或摘要。 - 語義搜尋 (Semantic search) ：關於 document 中特定資訊的查詢，它與查詢詞彙和/或語義意圖相符。這通常使用簡單的向量檢索（top-k）來執行。語義搜尋範例 - 摘要 (Summarization) ：將大量資料濃縮成與您當前問題相關的簡短摘要。 Example of summarization 結構化資料上的 QA 如果您的資料已存在於 SQL 資料庫、CSV 檔案或其他結構化格式中，LlamaIndex 可以查詢這些來源中的資料。這包括 text-to-SQL （自然語言到 SQL 操作）以及 text-to-Pandas （自然語言到 Pandas 操作）。 - Text-to-SQL Guide - Text-to-Pandas Guide 進階 QA 主題 隨著您擴展到更複雜的問題/更多資料，LlamaIndex 中有許多技術可以幫助您更好地理解查詢、檢索和整合資料來源。 - 查詢複雜的 Documents ：通常您的 document 表示是複雜的——您的 PDF 可能包含文本、表格、圖表、圖片、標頭/頁腳等。LlamaIndex 提供與 LlamaParse（我們專有的 document 解析器）整合的進階索引/檢索功能。Full cookbooks here。 - 組合多個來源 ：您的資料有些在 Slack 中，有些在 PDF 中，有些在非結構化文本中？LlamaIndex 可以組合跨任意數量的來源的查詢並將它們組合起來。 - Example of combining multiple sources - 跨多個來源路由 ：在多個資料來源中，您的應用程式可以首先選擇最佳來源，然後將問題「路由」到該來源。 - Example of routing across multiple sources - 多 document 查詢 ：有些問題在多個資料來源中有部分答案，需要分別查詢後才能組合。 - Example 的多個 document queries - Building 多個 document agent 跨越 LlamaIndex docs - Text 至 SQL 資源 LlamaIndex 在 QA / RAG 方面有許多資源。以下是一些核心資源指南供您參考。 我是 RAG 初學者，想學習基礎知識 ：查看我們的 “Learn” 系列指南。 我想在不將資料傳送給託管的 API 的情況下運行 ：查看 privacy guide 和 本地入門教學。兩者都透過使用 Hugging Face embeddings、reranker 和像 Ollama 這樣的本地 LLM runtime 來介紹一個 OSS stack。 我已經建置了 RAG，現在想優化它 ：查看我們的 “Advanced Topics” Guides。 我更進階，想建置自訂的 RAG workflow ：使用 LlamaIndex workflows 來組成進階的、具代理性的 RAG pipeline，例如這個 Corrective RAG workflow。 我想了解某個特定模組的所有資訊 ：以下是幫助建置從簡單到進階的 QA/RAG 系統的核心模組指南： - Query Engines - Chat Engines - Agents 更多範例 欲查看更多 Q\&A 用例範例，請參閱我們的 Putting it All Together 中的 Q\&A 部分。
sourceText: One of the most common use-cases for LLMs is to answer questions over a set of data. This data is oftentimes in the form of unstructured documents (e.g. PDFs, HTML), but can also be semi-structured or structured. The predominant framework for enabling QA with LLMs is Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). LlamaIndex offers simple-to-advanced RAG techniques to tackle simple-to-advanced questions over different volumes and types of data. You can choose to use either our prebuilt RAG abstractions (e.g. query engines) or build custom RAG workflows(example guide). RAG over Unstructured Documents LlamaIndex can pull in unstructured text, PDFs, Notion and Slack documents and more and index the data within them. The simplest queries involve either semantic search or summarization. - Semantic search : A query about specific information in a document that matches the query terms and/or semantic intent. This is typically executed with simple vector retrieval (top-k). Example of semantic search - Summarization : condensing a large amount of data into a short summary relevant to your current question. Example of summarization QA over Structured Data If your data already exists in a SQL database, CSV file, or other structured format, LlamaIndex can query the data in these sources. This includes text-to-SQL (natural language to SQL operations) and also text-to-Pandas (natural language to Pandas operations). - Text-to-SQL Guide - Text-to-Pandas Guide Advanced QA Topics As you scale to more complex questions / more data, there are many techniques in LlamaIndex to help you with better query understanding, retrieval, and integration of data sources. - Querying Complex Documents : Oftentimes your document representation is complex - your PDF may have text, tables, charts, images, headers/footers, and more. LlamaIndex provides advanced indexing/retrieval integrated with LlamaParse, our proprietary document parser. Full cookbooks here. - Combine multiple sources : is some of your data in Slack, some in PDFs, some in unstructured text? LlamaIndex can combine queries across an arbitrary number of sources and combine them. - Example of combining multiple sources - Route across multiple sources : given multiple data sources, your application can first pick the best source and then “route” the question to that source. - Example of routing across multiple sources - Multi-document queries : some questions have partial answers in multiple data sources which need to be questioned separately before they can be combined - Example of multi-document queries - Building a multi-document agent over the LlamaIndex docs - Text to SQL Resources LlamaIndex has a lot of resources around QA / RAG. Here are some core resource guides to refer to. I’m a RAG beginner and want to learn the basics : Take a look at our “Learn” series of guides. I want to run without sending data to a hosted API : See the privacy guide and the local starter tutorial. Both walk through an OSS stack using Hugging Face embeddings, reranker, and a local LLM runtime like Ollama. I’ve built RAG, and now I want to optimize it : Take a look at our “Advanced Topics” Guides. I’m more advanced and want to build a custom RAG workflow : Use LlamaIndex workflows to compose advanced, agentic RAG pipelines, like this Corrective RAG workflow. I want to learn all about a particular module : Here are the core module guides to help build simple-to-advanced QA/RAG systems: - Query Engines - Chat Engines - Agents Further examples For further examples of Q\&A use cases, see our Q\&A section in Putting it All Together.
